BOOKTEXTLEFT_FILLER20060602120251.text: The decision for the future of the world lies in the hands of one man. The question is not whether he will decide for Innos or Beliar. The question is if there is another path that he can choose. To free the world from the war of the gods, the divine power must disappear from the world. This divine power is in the five artifacts of Adanos. They can be destroyed in the ore smelter of Nordmar, if enough energy can be supplied to the furnace. I should test if my new focus stone is enough for that...

BOOKTEXTRIGHT_FILLER20060602120335.text: As Chosen Ones, Zuben and King Rhobar bear the power of the gods within them. With their deaths, this power will also disappear from the world. But what about their artifacts? The staff of the eternal wanderer and the scepter of Varant cannot be destroyed in the ore smelter. But they will open the portal to the unknown land. The Decider must take the scepter and the staff through the portal. Then a world free from divine power will remain behind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31.text: Let me fight in your arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ310.text: You want Trompok? You'll get Trompok.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3100.text: His throne stands in the highest building of this town, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31000.text: I'll kill the druid for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31001.text: Well, who'd have imagined it? Finally someone with guts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31006.text: It's about time. I've been looking for the pig for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31007.text: Then I'll take a little break before I go back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31010.text: Then take a rest from your hard work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31012.text: My name is Runak. I am a druid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31013.text: Who seeks me out in this hour?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31015.text: Ah, it is you. The Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31016.text: You have come in this time when we are in need of your help.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31017.text: Why do you call me the Decider?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31018.text: The war of the gods has raged since the dawn of time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31019.text: Innos and Beliar each aspire to dominion over the world.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3102.text: I serve our leader with my wisdom and clairvoyance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31020.text: The peoples of the world each fight for victory in the name of their god.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31021.text: This battle will last until one side is defeated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31022.text: What does all that have to do with ME?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31023.text: You have been chosen to decide the war of the gods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31024.text: Adanos himself has freed you from any influence of the other gods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31025.text: You alone have the power to decide of your own free will which side you will join.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3103.text: I see. So you're his advisor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31030.text: Tell me more about the war of the gods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31031.text: Adanos wanted all of the inhabitants of the world to decide their fate alone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31032.text: However, everyone, human or orc, is subject to the influence of the gods...

INFO_BPANKRATZ31033.text: You won't live long enough to tell anyone about my existence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31034.text: If that is your way, then I must accept it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31035.text: However, I will not acquiesce without a fight!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31037.text: The eldest, and some claim I am also the strongest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31039.text: We druids are being hunted by the beast that has conquered the world.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3104.text: Umbrak sent me to kill the rebel Anog.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31040.text: No living human can truly protect us from the orcs. Not even the rangers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31041.text: Only you, the Decider, can master this task.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31042.text: The orc search party is history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31044.text: Some orcs have come from Geldern and have dug themselves in farther up in the woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31045.text: They have come to kill me and steal my power.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31046.text: You must stop them. Otherwise I am lost.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31047.text: You have performed a great service for us druids, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31048.text: Take this as a sign of my thanks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31049.text: What do the orcs want from you druids?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3105.text: You must have really impressed him, or he wouldn't have trusted you with such a difficult task.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31051.text: Each druid carries a different stone with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31052.text: They were given to us by Adanos himself and grant us our power.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31053.text: My druid stone contains the power of the shadowbeast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31054.text: I want to learn your power.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31057.text: Gladly. However, there is one condition.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31058.text: I have heard that druid hunters have been sent to the south of Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31059.text: Kill Gunock, the leader of the druid search party.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3106.text: Where should I look for the rebels?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31060.text: Then I will entrust you with my druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31064.text: In days such as these, it is better that you keep it, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31065.text: Gunock, the leader of the southern druid search party, is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31067.text: Adanos is with you. Here, take my druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31068.text: It will show you the way to Adanos, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31069.text: Here. I brought Runak's druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3107.text: I cannot tell you where the rebels are hiding.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31070.text: That is what I was looking for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31071.text: This stone contains the secret of the druids' power.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31072.text: Now we can defend ourselves against those forest dwellers more efficiently.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31073.text: Well done, Morra. Here's your reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31074.text: Go and see what they're doing there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31076.text: Mmh. You're looking at me with the eyes of an experienced warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31077.text: I've never seen such a strong gaze in your weak people, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3108.text: But I can tell you from what direction they have always attacked us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31080.text: I've been told that there's a ranger camp south of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31081.text: One of them is hiding out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31082.text: A really obstinate specimen. They say his name is Torn.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31083.text: You won't catch Torn the druid while you're sitting on your behind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31084.text: None of that lip. Even if you are a fighter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31085.text: I will eliminate the druid Torn for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31086.text: Ha. I'll believe that when I see it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31088.text: All the better. Then I won't have to set out to kill the fellow myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31089.text: Here, take these coins, and then buzz off.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31090.text: You lazy pig, you never could've caught up with Torn.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31091.text: Maybe you should have moved your OWN butt for a change.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31092.text: WHAAAT? A stinking Morra has the nerve to say this to my face?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31093.text: I should report to Grok that you're nothing but a lazy swine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31094.text: That's enough, Morra. You will never mock me again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31096.text: I will teach you to rat on an orc captain.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31097.text: Looks like Gunock and his druid search party never left town in the first place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31098.text: Are you telling me that Gunock is still HERE?

INFO_BPANKRATZ311.text: Enter the arena. He'll be waiting for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31100.text: Grrr. Gunock will get what's coming to him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31101.text: I'm hunting druids with my search party, on the orders of our leader, Grok.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31102.text: You're too loud. You're scaring off all the game.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31103.text: I am Torn. Druid and warrior of Adanos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31104.text: And you are different from the others.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31105.text: Where do you think you know me from?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31106.text: You are restless, Decider. Without a country. I know that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31108.text: If you are in one place too long, you no longer feel alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31109.text: You are a warrior of Adanos?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31110.text: See what the beasts of Beliar have done in their avarice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31111.text: There are very few humans who can live free and without fear.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31112.text: I am the terror that will fall upon the orcs if they dare to attack the woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31113.text: Teach me to fight like a druid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31114.text: I know who you are, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31115.text: And so I also know that your path is not determined by the gods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31116.text: How do I know that you won't use the power of the druid stones against us druids?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31118.text: Go to Geldern and convince the humans there to fight at your side against the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31119.text: Then I will teach you druid magic, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3112.text: Why aren't you looking for Anog yourselves?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31120.text: The humans in Geldern trust me. The Fire Mage Marius helped me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31121.text: Good. If that is so, I will give you my druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31122.text: May the power of the snapper aid you in the battle against the orcs, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31124.text: That is proof enough that I can trust you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31125.text: Here, take the druid stone of the snapper.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31127.text: Tell me about the druid stones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31128.text: They are the sacred stones of Adanos. The source of our being.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31129.text: They are six in number. Six, like the number of their masters.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3113.text: The slave camps out there need to be guarded.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31130.text: In each of them lives the power of an animal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31131.text: My stone is the stone of the snapper.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31132.text: Dammit. Am I going too slow for you again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31133.text: When will you idiots finally get it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31134.text: I need time to supply all of the troops here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31136.text: I used to be. Now I'm the cook for this voracious gang of mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31137.text: Now don't tell me you're one of them yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31138.text: A Fire Mage shouldn't be heard cursing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31139.text: I've had it with good manners.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3114.text: Lots of slaves mean lots of trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31141.text: Where are the other Fire Mages?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31142.text: They are in the big monastery in Nordmar, looking for the twelve Fire Chalices of ancient magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31143.text: They hope to use them to restore magical abilities to the paladins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31144.text: Those chalices must be found. The monastery needs every single one of them, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31145.text: I see that you still wear your robe.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31146.text: Yes, in hopes that this nightmare will soon be over and humans will be free once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31147.text: That attitude won't get you far in this town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31148.text: Is there anything worse than being a cook here? Death, perhaps?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31149.text: I'm not afraid of dying. I will go down fighting when my time has come.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3115.text: We cannot spare a single man here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31150.text: And believe me, there are many here in Geldern who think like me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31151.text: What can I do to help you persuade the humans to fight the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31152.text: I need to know whether the shamans are hiding one of the Fire Chalices in their temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31158.text: Where can I find the Fire Chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31159.text: I found some evidence when I studied the history of Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3116.text: What does a runt like you want from a leader of orc armies? Speak!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31160.text: According to what I learned, it seems certain that one of the chalices is located here in Geldern, in the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31161.text: There's another clue pointing to the temple in Geldern, but that one is rather vague.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31163.text: I don't think they are, but it still gives me sleepless nights.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31164.text: Talk to Grok, the senior shaman, and make sure they don't have a Fire Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31165.text: Only then will I help you persuade the humans to revolt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31168.text: And did you find a Fire Chalice there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31170.text: I find that very reassuring, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31172.text: If you attack the orcs in this town, we will fight by your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31174.text: All I want is some peace and quite, dammit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31175.text: What are YOU doing here all by yourself?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31176.text: What you see here is all that is left of the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31178.text: Ivan, that swine, was supposed to guard the mine here with his mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31179.text: Instead, he just killed off everybody and ran away with the mined gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31180.text: I would pay a lot of gold if someone were to make short work of this unholy traitor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31181.text: Ivan, that treacherous mercenary swine, has destroyed it all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31184.text: The renegade mercenary Ivan is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31185.text: Serves him right. Death to all traitors.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31186.text: I will give a few gold nuggets for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3119.text: Hmmm, yes, this will be just right for someone of your stripe.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31190.text: I need more tools. I need more timber. I need more people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31191.text: Those gold nuggets won't jump out of the hard rock all by themselves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31192.text: Go talk to Samuel, the leader of the mercenaries in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31193.text: Tell him to send me new people and equipment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31194.text: Thank you, friend. At last, the mine is up and running again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31195.text: It was very generous of you to help me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31196.text: Now I am finally at ease and can go back to my work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31197.text: Dawson needs your help out in his mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31198.text: What has he done this time?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31199.text: A mercenary named Ivan has plundered the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ312.text: That was one of the best fights we've ever seen here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31200.text: That godless cur. I should have known the fellow wasn't to be trusted.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31201.text: I'll set off with my boys right away and rebuild the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31203.text: Well look here! A new face in my city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31205.text: I am the leader of the mercenaries in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31209.text: What is there to do in Geldern?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3121.text: There is a rebel camp outside the pass to Nordmar. I want the head of its leader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31211.text: We mercenaries were hired to open up and secure the mines around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31213.text: That's what I like to hear. Then pay close attention.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31214.text: If you follow the road from the north gate of Geldern, you'll find a cave that hasn't been developed yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31216.text: While you're at it, you might as well wipe out all of the vermin crawling around in there. Got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31218.text: And I can tell you that it has always paid off for us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31219.text: If you're not afraid of honest work, you can earn a good profit here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31220.text: I've taken a look at the undeveloped mine north of Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31221.text: The mine ought to be secure now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31222.text: Good work. I'll arrange for all the work that needs to be done for the mining to start.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31223.text: You're pretty useful, stranger. Here is your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31224.text: Geldern is the city of mines and artifact collectors.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31225.text: Go and see if it's worthwhile to set up a mine there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31226.text: While you're at it, you might as well wipe out all of the vermin crawling around in there. Got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31227.text: Tell me more about the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31229.text: Gold from the orcs or gold from the humans. It's all the same to them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31230.text: That's all you really need to know about this corrupt bunch of cretins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31231.text: Which mercenary here would kill his own people?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31232.text: His name is Ivan. He always shoots his mouth off at the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31233.text: He's more of an unholy bandit than a mercenary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31234.text: Right now, Ivan and his boys are watching a mine north of Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31236.text: Ivan the unholy mercenary is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31237.text: I found him in the north with a bunch of evil bandits.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31238.text: I was thinking of planning a mutiny along with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31239.text: Thank Innos I changed my mind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31240.text: One of them even killed his own people for gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31241.text: I bet that swine would have sold us out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31242.text: Here. Take a few potions. I could do with a nip myself after such a shock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31243.text: Where do you think you're going, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31244.text: What sort of temple is this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31245.text: These halls are the headquarters of the highest dignitaries of the shamans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31246.text: Our leader Grok rules the ancient alchemist city of Geldern from here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31247.text: I want to enter the service of the shamans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31249.text: You can prove your prowess in the mines around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3125.text: Ask my advisor, the shaman Grompel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31250.text: Or maybe you're good in battle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31251.text: Then you would be better off with the mercenaries or the gladiators.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31252.text: The shamans accept men who have a good reputation in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31254.text: We dig gold, sulphur, artifacts, and other valuable natural resources for them, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31257.text: I am Nemrok. I take care of the shamans' needs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31258.text: Meet them with reverence or you will feel my blade.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31259.text: I hope we understand each other.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3126.text: He will help you find them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31260.text: The mines have to be productive. That is my job.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31261.text: I want to work for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31262.text: Mmh. Normally, the most I'd let a Morra do is bring me a joint of meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31263.text: But I think I might have a job for a fighter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31264.text: What happened to your last messenger?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31266.text: What would I do as your messenger?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31267.text: You would go to the mines in my name, find out about the missing yields, and bring them to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31268.text: And if the mines aren't productive, then you would get them going again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31270.text: Well, well. That's what you call a 'messenger', huh? Sounds like deadly, back-breaking work to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31271.text: Do you want to work for me or not?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31273.text: Then get started already and stop talking about it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31274.text: Mmh. Yes. I remember saying something like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31276.text: I say you can just do your job yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31277.text: You Morras are all alike. A big mouth and a bigger yellow streak.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31278.text: Beat it and come back when you're up to it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31279.text: What do you need from the sulphur mine?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31281.text: I hope for your sake that you've changed your mind and decided to stop wasting my time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31282.text: What will YOU do in the meantime?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31284.text: Or else I'll show you who the masters of this city are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31285.text: The lazy rabble in the sulphur mine to the north promised me 30 lumps of sulphur.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31287.text: Here. I have your lumps of sulphur.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31288.text: I said 30. Are you deaf? Go and get the rest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3129.text: Ah. And so they are still following him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31290.text: Good. Then I'll consider the matter closed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31292.text: What should I do with the gold mines?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31293.text: I've been waiting for days for 50 gold nuggets from the mines in the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31294.text: Go and bring them to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31295.text: I don't care how you do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31297.text: That's not enough. I need 50. Go and fetch them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31299.text: Good. That should do for now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3130.text: The rebels have always attacked from the woods up there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31301.text: The tunnel wolves in the wolf mine are history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31303.text: I hope the mine will start to yield something soon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31304.text: Where can I get artifacts for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31306.text: But the mine is abandoned at the moment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31307.text: A pack of tunnel wolves ate all the slaves. And the guards, too, while they were at it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31308.text: Get yourself some 'eager slaves' and get the wolf mine going again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31309.text: The slaves will show you the way to the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3131.text: I suppose they must be hiding up there somewhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31310.text: But before you take the slaves to the wolf mine, make sure the tunnel wolves are gone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31311.text: We have taken many artifacts from the wolf mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31312.text: I'll take care of the snappers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31313.text: Take me to the wolf mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31315.text: The wolf mine is back in operation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31316.text: I'm curious how long it will take before anything arrives here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31318.text: Move your butt, or I'll light a fire under it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31319.text: Yes, of course. Right away, master. Follow me. I will show you the wolf mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3132.text: I wish you luck. You'll need it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31321.text: The orc colonel? Looks like I have no choice, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31322.text: All right. Follow me. I will show you the wolf mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31323.text: This is it. The wolf mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31324.text: Grab a pickaxe, then, and get to work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31325.text: This mine must be made profitable once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31326.text: Am I supposed to run the mine all by myself?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31327.text: Just wait. I will get you some more 'eager' workers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31328.text: You will now enter the wolf mine and dig for artifacts there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31329.text: No problem. I've just been waiting for someone to yell 'Go forth'!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31330.text: Get moving! To the wolf mine!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31332.text: Go to the wolf mine and start digging again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31334.text: Then I'll punch you in the mouth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31335.text: Since you're asking so nicely... I'm on my way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31336.text: Yes. Get rid of them! But quickly. They make me nervous.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31339.text: Hey, Morra. It's a good thing you came. I have something for you to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31340.text: What sort of mine is this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31341.text: Only a Morra could ask such a dumb question.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31342.text: Take a whiff with that ugly beak of yours.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31344.text: I make sure that the Morras work, and that the mine operates.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31346.text: The snapper threat has been averted.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31347.text: Then I can sleep peacefully again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31348.text: Take this as a reward. A heap of stinking, yellow lumps of sulphur.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31349.text: Well? Is that not enough for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31350.text: Can I take a few lumps of sulphur with me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31351.text: Do that. Take the nasty stuff to Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31352.text: I can hardly breathe as it is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31355.text: Stop yanking my chain, Morra. Get me that sulphur, or you'll be sorry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31356.text: But don't even think about bringing unrefined chunks of sulphur, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31357.text: Here you are, five lumps of sulphur.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31358.text: Good. Here's a healing potion for you. And now scram, I'm busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3136.text: Anog, the leader of the rebels at the pass, is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31360.text: What about a little fight in my arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31362.text: Kulak is the undefeated champion in Geldern, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31363.text: Looking at you, I wonder if you shouldn't pick an easier opponent.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31364.text: What about Dimitar? He's a Morra. Just about right for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31366.text: Have it your way. I warned you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31367.text: Off you go to the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31369.text: Can I interest you in working for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3137.text: That is good. Then it won't be long before the rest of the band surrenders.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31370.text: Let me fight in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31371.text: Fine. Enter the arena, then. Dimitar will be your opponent.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31374.text: Very well. Gembak will meet you in the arena. Go ahead and fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31375.text: That wasn't bad at all. You fight well, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31376.text: But don't forget that Kulak is still the champion.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31377.text: You want me to work for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31378.text: I would do it myself, but it is a somewhat delicate matter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31379.text: Mirzo, that big-headed louse of an Hashishin, has been mocking me for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3138.text: You have done the orcish people a great service.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31380.text: Every time he gets a major shipment, he dumps his trash right in front of my arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31381.text: He only does that to annoy me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31382.text: I would love to teach him a little lesson.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31383.text: Why don't you take care of it yourself?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31384.text: I thought you orcs were the rulers of this city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31385.text: Ever since we entered this alliance with the desert people, things haven't been the same.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31386.text: I can't just go and smack that Hashishin around!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31387.text: But you're a Morra. It's different for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31389.text: Fine. Just don't kill him, or you'll be in a lot more trouble than you can afford.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3139.text: Beliar will reward you for this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31390.text: I'm not your slave. Kindly go and see to it yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31391.text: Coward. Are you trying to tell me that you are scared of an Hashishin?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31392.text: Mirzo got what he had coming.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31393.text: Amazing. I never thought you had it in you, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31394.text: I will pay big for this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31395.text: I'm going to punch you in the face a few times now in the name of Agenak.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31396.text: Ha ha ha. Aren't you the bold one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31397.text: All right then, show me what you're made of.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31398.text: Don't you blather at me, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31399.text: I am the champion here. You are not worthy of my attention.

INFO_BPANKRATZ314.text: You'd be better off hunting boars in the woods, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3140.text: How about if YOU reward me for it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31401.text: I said, don't blather at me!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31402.text: Alright, Morra. You're the better fighter of us two.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31403.text: Are you happy, then? Go now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31404.text: I find it degrading to fight for a handful of junk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31408.text: In this arena you only fight for artifacts, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31409.text: Nothing worthwhile, just some old stuff from times long forgotten.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3141.text: Mmh. What do you want? Glory? Honor?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31410.text: Then why don't you go fight in a different arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31412.text: I'd have left here long ago if I could.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31413.text: So what can we do to restore your honor?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31414.text: I've heard of an unholy bastard who raided one of our mines.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31415.text: A renegade mercenary named Ivan. Death to all traitors!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31417.text: Good. Then I will keep on fighting in the arena until another opportunity arises.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31419.text: There's no honor in that if you ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3142.text: You already have too much for a Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31420.text: Let's give Ivan what he deserves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31422.text: First you will prove that you're worthy to fight by my side, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31423.text: Defeat me in the arena. Then I might think about it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31425.text: You honorably defeated me. We will fight together.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31426.text: The renegade mercenary Ivan is somewhere north of Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31428.text: You're a strong and proud fighter, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31429.text: Have you also come to win fame and glory in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31430.text: Why are YOU fighting in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31431.text: Many people do this in order to improve their reputation with the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31432.text: Well, at any rate, it improves their lives, if you get my drift.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31433.text: Where ELSE can I find artifacts other than the wolf mine?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31434.text: A lot of artifacts can be found in this part of Myrtana, around Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31435.text: So far we haven't gotten around to opening up all of the areas.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31436.text: In the north is an old ruin on top of a crag.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31437.text: Go and see what can be had there, and bring it to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31438.text: Here. I found this scepter in the old ruins in the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31439.text: Mmh. Doesn't look particularly valuable. I think you can keep it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3144.text: If you are interested in gold, you can have it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31440.text: Well done. I don't need to send anyone else to the ruins then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31441.text: Welcome to my humble business, Son of Tastefulness.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31442.text: Do you seek goods from the distant desert, or are you looking for rare artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31443.text: Whatever it is, you will find it here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31445.text: What a curious question, Son of Puzzlement.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31446.text: Don't you know where you are? This is Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31447.text: The meeting point for every artifact hunter in the land.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31451.text: I have everything you want, Son of Bargaining.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31452.text: Even a successful fight in the arena is rewarded with an artifact here in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31453.text: Nowhere in Myrtana are there more artifact dealers and seekers than here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31454.text: Where do you get your artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31455.text: Ha ha ha. I ask you, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31456.text: What sort of a businessman would I be if I gave away my sources?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31457.text: What are you doing digging around here alone?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3146.text: And now go! I am busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31463.text: He is also an Hashishin and a very powerful merchant in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31464.text: He won't be happy if you bother me while I work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31465.text: Just watch out. If you touch a hair on my head, I'll tell my brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31468.text: Yes, and? Is that so unusual?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3147.text: Hey! What are you creeping around here for?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31470.text: I see you've already had the pleasure of meeting him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31471.text: Then you also know what will happen if you bother me while I work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31472.text: You had better mind your own affairs, Son of Prying.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31477.text: You let your own brother Mazin dig up artifacts in the abandoned mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31478.text: Uh... how in Beliar's name did you find out about that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31479.text: The poor devil is digging his hands raw out there so that YOU can make a profit here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31480.text: Pssssst. Not so loud. You don't have to let everyone know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31481.text: The orcs mustn't know that the abandoned mine to the north is productive again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31485.text: I'll pay you a pretty sum if you keep it to yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31487.text: You bastard, you told the orcs about the abandoned mine. Admit it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3149.text: I have come to do away with you dirty rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31490.text: The abandoned mine is still productive after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31493.text: Very good work. Here is your reward. You earned it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31494.text: Mirzo is ruined. I have closed down his business.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31495.text: Hahaha. That's even more than I had hoped for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31496.text: If they find out, they will reoccupy the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31498.text: Mirzo the Hashishin gets his artifacts from there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31499.text: Not any more. I'll put the mine back into operation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3150.text: Be careful what you're asking for, kid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31500.text: Not bad. Here, take this as a reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31501.text: Are there mines in the south of Geldern?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31502.text: There is an abandoned mine. But we don't dig there any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31503.text: It was no longer productive enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31504.text: I've done enough in this life.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31506.text: My name is Hamil. I can offer you the best and most reasonably priced artifacts there are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31507.text: You're a trader in the slave quarter?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31508.text: We all do what we can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31509.text: It is my fate to be stuck in this slave hole.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3151.text: Relax. I'm just having a look around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31510.text: But my goods are top quality nevertheless.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31513.text: Oh, you know... here and there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31514.text: Things will fall off the back of carts sometimes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31515.text: In other words, you're stealing from the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31516.text: One of the slaves is dealing in stolen artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3152.text: You can't just traipse around here, young fellow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31520.text: One of the alchemists in the city is behind this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31521.text: Go and find out which alchemist Hamil is working for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31522.text: Peratur the alchemist has ordered the slave Hamil to steal artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31523.text: Ah, yes. Peratur and Hamil you say? That's good to know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31524.text: I'll make the necessary arrangements to put a stop to it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31526.text: Stealing is such an ugly word.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31527.text: We humans should stick together, don't you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31528.text: You swine, you ratted me out. Now I'm back to breaking rocks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31529.text: Very soon you'll see where it gets you to be in cahoots with the orcs, scumbag!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31530.text: Do you know a slave named Hamil?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31533.text: All right. I admit I know the fellow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31535.text: You order a slave to steal for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31536.text: He doesn't do it just for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31537.text: As far as I know, he also sells the stolen stuff himself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31538.text: Aren't you afraid that the orcs will find out what you and Hamil are up to?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31539.text: No. The orcs need me here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31540.text: Hamil is the only one who has anything to fear. He is expendable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31541.text: If they sent you to tell me that it should go faster...

INFO_BPANKRATZ31543.text: Never mind. I thought you were here to demand the next delivery for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31545.text: I am an alchemist. What would I make for the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31547.text: Those warmongers have an inhumanly high need for healing and mana potions.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31549.text: Not just that. I also have some rare artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31554.text: I'm an old man and I can't remember every face anymore, you know?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31558.text: I ASKED WHAT YOU'RE DOING HERE?!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3156.text: And he is going to have your hide if you mess with us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31562.text: Yes. Exactly. That's it. Thank you, son. Now I remember. Yes. Alchemist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31563.text: Say, are you yanking my chain?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31565.text: Yes. It does get a bit addled at times.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31568.text: Potions, you say? Eh. Yes. I think so.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31569.text: Can I help you, old man?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31571.text: Eh... it could be that I have some... take a look, son.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31572.text: Certainly. Eh... what was I about to make again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31575.text: Weeell. Let me think a moment. I think I'm Renwik, aren't I?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31577.text: Right. It was even a very powerful one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31578.text: All I'm missing is a bunch of King's Sorrel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31579.text: It's very rare. Yes, it is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3158.text: We haven't set up a camp here in front of the pass to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31581.text: Where can I find King's Sorrel?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31582.text: What would a man like you want with such a rare plant?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31583.text: I thought I might bring it to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31584.text: Really? That would be most charming, son.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31585.text: I think I saw some near the abandoned mine to the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31586.text: Although I'm not sure. Yes, that's it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31587.text: Tell me more about the abandoned mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3159.text: We have occupied the whole damn forest!

INFO_BPANKRATZ31591.text: Eh. You look familiar. Do I know you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ31592.text: You are the alchemist Renwik, and I am the fellow who has the privilege of getting you King's Sorrel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31594.text: Here, I have your King's Sorrel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31595.text: King's Sorrel? Really? Oh, that's wonderful.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31596.text: Then I can devote myself once again to my... eh.

INFO_BPANKRATZ31597.text: You can devote yourself to your potions again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3160.text: And any Orc trying to get through here will come to regret it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3161.text: But if you are looking for our leader...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3162.text: His hut is further up, in the hills.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3164.text: What does it look like, kid? Of course I am.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3165.text: The warlord Umbrak in Silden wants you dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3166.text: I know. That's no big secret.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3167.text: I'm just amazed that he hasn't sent anyone to kill me off yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3170.text: You've got a lot of stuff up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3171.text: This is all cargo belonging to the Orcs from Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3173.text: And so everything's stacking up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3174.text: So far, we have intercepted every single shipment to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3177.text: Thought about? We have attacked the Orcs' outposts many times.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3178.text: But we do more damage to them by heading off the Orcs trying to get through to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3186.text: How's the situation at the pass?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3187.text: I have heard that some Orcs are trying to make it to Silden from Nordmar again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3188.text: My scouts saw a group of Orcs up on the pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3189.text: I will be relieved if they never reached their destination.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3190.text: I took this stuff here from the Orcs at the pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3192.text: We need to keep on our toes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3193.text: The Orcs will certainly try to get through to Silden over the pass again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3194.text: I bring a delivery from Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3195.text: Very well. Although I would have preferred a legion of orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3197.text: I have to go to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ32.text: Go and fight. Jarock is expecting you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3200.text: The rebels have occupied the entire forest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120102430.text: Come with me. I'll show you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120135823.text: Why are you disturbing my council of war? Speak!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140045_0.text: Little smart ass. You humans have been subdued.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140045_1.text: No serious threat can be expected from you any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140045_2.text: Nevertheless, I must attend to the balance of power in this part of the country.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140045.text: Council of war? The war is over.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140342_0.text: I said nothing of challenge. I said balance of power.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140342_2.text: They let us conduct excavations in their desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140342_3.text: Furthermore, they grant us unobstructed access to their desert and their cities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120140342.text: Who could challenge the power of the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141038_0.text: The Hashishin were very helpful in the war against the Morras.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141038_1.text: They took care of that part of the world which we orcs rarely visit, the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141038_2.text: Furthermore, we pray to the same god. Beliar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141038.text: Tell me more about your alliance with the Hashishin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141130.text: It was a strategic decision to make an alliance with them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141822_0.text: We are on the edge of the desert here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141822_1.text: If the Hashishin send a sizable army into the midlands, I will get warning from here first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141822.text: You're preparing for a war with the Hashishin?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120141945.text: If this castle falls, nothing will stop the Hashishin from entering the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120142313.text: For that, we pay them a heap of gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120143534.text: But despite their friendship, someone has to make sure they don't get too strong.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120144232.text: We're digging like lunatics all over the world to find the divine artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120144817.text: Only Beliar knows if the amulet from the temple in the east really is a divine artifact.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120145529.text: So far, our efforts haven't borne as much fruit as we hoped.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120162732_0.text: Ha ha ha. Why should I give it to you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120162732_1.text: It's of no value to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164644_0.text: I've been hearing this scary grunting up here for days now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164644_1.text: I suspect that some beasts have made themselves at home in the caves below this rock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164644_2.text: I can no longer sleep in peace.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164644.text: What's up with the caves under your farm?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164836_0.text: Go eradicate those nests down there once and for all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164836.text: I will take care of the grunting beasts in the caves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120164924.text: The grunting beasts beneath your farm are gone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120165004.text: High time that someone took care of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120165205_0.text: I am positive that you are the right person to take it there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120165205.text: Here's the rent that is due to the orcs in Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120165423.text: You look like a strong fighter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120165517.text: You are surely the right person to help me with the small problem in the caves under my farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170321_0.text: I think the only reason they haven't killed us peasants yet is because they know nothing about breeding livestock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170321.text: The orcs are the bosses. They squeeze us farmers like ripe fruit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170512_0.text: If I didn't have to pay such high rent every month, I'd be a lot better off.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170512.text: How's it going on your farm?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170712_0.text: They want 1000 gold coins every month.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170712.text: How much rent do you pay the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170744.text: I managed to scrape the gold together, but so far I haven't dared to leave my farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120170827.text: First, I want to know what's wrong with the caves down there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120172744_0.text: You want to bring me all the gold? Are you serious?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120172744.text: I will bring you the gold for the Hashishin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120173341_0.text: Who would've though? Give me the gold quickly, before someone takes it from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120181113.text: That cutthroat of a Hashishi, Khabir, has been waiting for an answer from me for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120181745.text: Nonsense. I have other problems, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120182103.text: I still don't have enough gold to keep our part of the agreement with the Hashishin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120184849_0.text: The best way is to visit the farmers in the area and demand the rent.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120184849_1.text: Go to the adjacent temple and have them give you everything they've discovered there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120184849_2.text: You'll have to get the rest of the gold somewhere else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120184849_3.text: I don't care how you do it, just do it fast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060120184849.text: Where should I get the gold for the Hashishin?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123094903.text: Be careful what you touch in here, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123095113_0.text: I'm a direct emissary from Varant. My name is Khabir.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123095201.text: I will tolerate you in my house only as long as you have gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123095248.text: I buy and sell the rare valuables of the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123095632.text: I will make you a powerful man if you can afford it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123100114.text: If your purse is empty, you might as well not waste my time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123100345.text: Every blessing has its price, as does every curse.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123110557_0.text: How perceptive of you. The orcs are searching throughout the land for relics of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123110557_1.text: We give the orcs free access to all parts of Varant and support them in their excavations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123110557_2.text: I see to it that the orcs keep up their end of the agreement.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123110557.text: You're more than just a merchant, aren't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111353_0.text: We support the orcs, and they pay us for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111353_2.text: But Vak has been behind on his payments for a few days now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111353_3.text: I cannot say that this pleases me at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111353.text: What's the agreement between you Hashishins and the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111901_0.text: An inconceivable amount of gold, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111901_1.text: If Vak doesn't pay up soon, we will close the gates of Varant to the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111901.text: How much gold does Vak still owe you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123111950.text: We won't open them again until the orcs settle their debt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123112057.text: Tell me more about the relics of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123112250.text: The orcs will gather whatever artifacts and ancient writing they can find.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123112831.text: But they are most interested in the divine artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114006_0.text: That's why they make the humans excavate the old temples in order to find them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114006.text: They say that the Ancient Ones possessed several of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114541_0.text: I'm a businessman, not a scholar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114541_1.text: The secrets of these rare relics have so far remained concealed from us secular people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114541.text: What do you know about the divine artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123114755.text: Presumably, they are incredibly powerful in the hands of one who is chosen by the gods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123115014_0.text: They say that such an artifact existed in the eastern temple of Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123115014.text: What divine artifacts have the orcs already found?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123115417.text: Where is the divine artifact from the eastern temple?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123115441.text: The price for this answer exceeds the capacity of your purse, I'm afraid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123120849_0.text: Quite simple. I know where it is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123121748_1.text: You see to it that Vak sticks to his part of the agreement, and I will help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123121748.text: What will it take for you to tell me how to get to the divine artifact?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123122351_0.text: So I have heard. Well done, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123122351.text: Vak has enough gold to pay his debts with you Hashishin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123123015_0.text: Well. Then I have nothing to offer in return for your service, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123123015_1.text: But I don't want you to leave empty-handed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123123015_2.text: Take this artifact to pay for our agreement.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123123015.text: I already know where the divine artifact is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123125114.text: I think that is only fair.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123134230.text: Now I can tell you where the divine artifact is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123134610_0.text: I'll see what I can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123134610.text: But alright. If you actually manage to succeed, then we can talk about the artifact again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123135059.text: Grrr. You get straight to the point, don't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123135122.text: But don't tell anyone that I gave it to you, or it will go very badly for you, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123154326.text: What do you think will happen if he doesn't get his accursed gold soon?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123160425_0.text: Vak is the lord of this castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123160425_1.text: But if you want to talk to someone responsible here, then you had better go to Thorus.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123160425_2.text: He is a Morra, like you. He usually stands on the bridge at the south gate of Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123160425_3.text: That is, at the gate on the other side of the moat here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123161008_0.text: The war council of our lord Vak meets here, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123161444.text: Behave yourself Morra, or else you'll answer to me, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123162239.text: You again. I can't go anywhere without running into you, can I?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123162558_0.text: That's right. I take care of the outer areas of Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123162558_1.text: The farms around here must be inspected and the excavations in the eastern temple need to be guarded.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123163232_0.text: Grrr. Don't ever let me hear you say that again, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123163347.text: You wouldn't talk so tough if you ran into those sneaky forest fellows.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123163745_0.text: Good. One less thing to worry about. Here is your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123163745.text: Those sneaky ogres are guaranteed not to bother anyone ever again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123164237_0.text: Some ogres live in the caves out there in the woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123164237_1.text: Until recently, they were quite peaceful. But now they're attacking anything that moves in their woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123164237_2.text: I wouldn't go out there if I were you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123164237.text: What sneaky fellows are you talking about?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123165229_0.text: Trelis is a strategically important castle of the orcs. We are close to the desert of Varant here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123165229_1.text: Lots of Hashishin come by here on their way to the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123165229.text: Tell me more about the city of Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123165419.text: Nowhere in the midlands will you find more experienced warriors and more prosperous Hashishin than here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123170345_0.text: I'd prefer it if you just went away again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123170345_1.text: But since I'm sure you won't do me that favor, you might as well work for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123170649.text: What is there to do on the farms?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123170921_1.text: But I haven't heard from them in days either.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123170921.text: The farm to the west hasn't been heard from in ages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123171716_0.text: The overseer Tempeck is constantly demanding new men and the deliveries are missing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123171716.text: How are the excavations at the eastern temple coming along?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123173336.text: I've had enough of that. Go to the temple and tell Tempeck that he must send a delivery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123173459.text: I sent out a reconnaissance patrol to find out what's wrong.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123173928.text: The excavations at the eastern temple are on track again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123174306.text: It's about time. Not much longer and I would've gotten in trouble from above.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123175650.text: Thorus expects the excavations here to start producing again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123175814.text: Oh? Does he, now? The bastard isn't even here! He doesn't have to deal with this stupid temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123175958.text: What should I tell Thorus now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180043.text: Tell him I'm breaking my back here. The Morra will have his delivery soon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180609_0.text: I bet he does. Well, you can see for yourself that there's nobody left here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180609.text: Thorus wants to know why he hasn't heard anything from this farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180820_0.text: I knew it. I can only hope that this is an isolated incident.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180820_1.text: Otherwise, we'll be dependent on the caravans. And that will be expensive for Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123180820.text: The farm to the west has been devastated. No one is left alive there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060123181058.text: Go see what's going on out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124094250.text: Tell him not to expect anything from this farm any more. It's a goner.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124094345.text: Have you got a message for Thorus?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095421.text: Watch your step here or you might erase all traces.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095648_0.text: I'd like to know that, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095648_1.text: This farm was just fine until a few days ago.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095648_2.text: There were about four peasants living here. Now they are all gone and the farm is completely trashed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095754.text: Well, if I knew that, I'd be chasing after them now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095911_1.text: They looked mighty dangerous. Maybe they made this mess here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124095911.text: There's a cave over to the west.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124100913_0.text: Do that. You should probably just kill anything that's alive there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124100913.text: I could have a look inside this suspicious cave for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124101229_0.text: They seemed to be pretty distraught.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124101229_1.text: I don't think that they made this mess on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124101229.text: In the cave to the west, I found nothing but a pride of sabertooth tigers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124101348.text: Dammit. And me hoping this wouldn't get too complicated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102100_0.text: Lately, I have seen some rangers roaming about up in the northern woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102100_1.text: I wouldn't be surprised if those bastards were responsible for the devastation here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102329_0.text: Don't underestimate those people. They are a belligerent lot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102329_1.text: When they show up in numbers they can be a serious threat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102329.text: You think that rangers could have done this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102725_0.text: Rangers are often led by a druid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124102725_1.text: Find out if their druid gave the order for this mess here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124103144_0.text: That swine. I thought as much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124103144.text: Torn the druid razed this farm and killed all the peasants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124103755.text: Grrr. Too bad. Then I will have to see to it myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124103856.text: Good work. Here's some gold for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124103909.text: I hope you killed Torn for this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124104125_0.text: That's probably for the best. Then I won't have to do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124104125_1.text: Looks like the farm problem is now taken care of, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124110949_0.text: Humans like those farmers who work for the orcs only make things worse for everyone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124110949.text: And they're damn right - I did!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124111207.text: I can't stand by and watch while humans let themselves be enslaved just to extend their miserable existence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124112432_0.text: I won't rest until the seed of evil has vanished from our woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124112432.text: Better dead than a lackey of that brood of Beliar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124112754.text: The orcs believe that you destroyed a farm near Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124113140.text: You'd better not get too close to the temple, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124113923_0.text: Not good at all. I'm supposed to collect artifacts and other relics here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124113923_1.text: But I don't know where I should get them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124113923_2.text: There's nothing more to be had out here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124113923_3.text: And twenty snappers couldn't drag me back into the temple!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124115849_1.text: You'd better not mess around with those disgusting beings.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124120328_1.text: My group here used to be twice as big.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124120328_2.text: But then suddenly, all these skeletons came out of the ground and attacked us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124120328_3.text: What you see here is the battered remains of my people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124120328.text: Have you ever been in the temple?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124121024_0.text: I don't know. Someone will have to look.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124121024.text: Are there any survivors in the temple?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124121456.text: I found a survivor in the temple. Kamak the shaman.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124121641_0.text: Thanks for the good news, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124121641.text: Thank Beliar! Kamak's death would have been a great loss for the orcish people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124122012.text: But I won't do it, that much is certain.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124122429.text: He was a great man. That is a bitter loss for our people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124123232_0.text: That's just like him. His fear far outweighs his honor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124123232.text: Tempeck has given up the search for survivors in the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124123440_0.text: He would be better off herding sheep, the coward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124123440.text: I never found out how he managed to become an overseer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124123743_0.text: I almost took you for one of those disgusting undead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124008_0.text: You're about to see if I can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124113.text: I thought I would be left to rot here forever.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124142.text: Come on. Let's get out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124325_0.text: I would never have found the courage to face the undead by myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124325_1.text: Take these potions as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124124325.text: Thank you for your help, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124134324.text: The others were lost in the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124135358.text: Your man at the farm west is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124135817_0.text: Damn. Then I'll have to go out there myself one of these days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124135817.text: Tempeck, the overseer at the temple excavations, is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124144103_0.text: But I cannot pay, those thieving scum have stolen it all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124144103_1.text: Oh dammit. See, here they go again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124144103.text: I bet you came to demand the rent, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124150224.text: Those filthy thieves are taking everything I have.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124150514_0.text: The rent money I was going to give Trelis has been stolen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152222_0.text: They keep coming here from up north, stealing like there's no tomorrow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152222_1.text: There must be a nest somewhere along the river.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152222_2.text: I wish someone would find it and sort them out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152222_3.text: Then I could finally do my work here in peace.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152222.text: Where do these thieving goblins come from?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152429_0.text: There will be no more goblins coming from there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152429_1.text: Thank Innos. Now there will be some peace and quiet on my farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152429_2.text: Thank you very much, stranger. May this little reward help you on your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124152429.text: The cave of the thieving goblins to the north has been cleaned out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124163722_0.text: Did you come to make trouble for us, too?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124163722_1.text: Beat it. We've already suffered enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124163842_0.text: Come on, then. I'm not afraid of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124163842.text: Take it easy, kid, otherwise I'll have to teach you a lesson.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124163948.text: You'd better get back to work, you little brat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124164036_0.text: Then show me what you've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124164036.text: It's time somebody taught you some manners.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124164421.text: Relax, kid. I didn't come to make trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124164613_0.text: Damn, every bone in my body hurts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124164613_1.text: What do you want from me anyway, you headcase?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124165450_0.text: Yeah, yeah. All right. I'll keep my mouth shut.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124165450.text: I think I'll just come by now and then to smash your face.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124172438.text: A servant like you shouldn't talk so big.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124172733.text: Servant? I'm no servant. I know important people!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124172930_0.text: Um... the Orcs at the temple excavation to the south, for example.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173016_0.text: Um... the overseer. Yeah, that's it, the overseer there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173357_0.text: Really. I worked for the Orcs at the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173357_1.text: My shovel must be lying around somewhere over there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173357.text: I don't believe a word of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173439.text: Take a look if you don't believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124173716.text: And what's in it for me if I find your rotten old shovel?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124174636_0.text: Really? This is getting better and better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124174636.text: If you bring me my shovel, I'll tell you how you can get your hands on a lot of gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124175005.text: I have your shovel. You owe me something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124175152.text: Um... you were really in the temple?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124175858.text: But... but, there were these horrible...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124180433.text: Hey. I may be a hothead, but I'm not a liar, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124180608_0.text: One thing I've gotta give you: you're brave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060124183414.text: Sometimes I've seen the farmer Derec creeping over to the Innos statue at night.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125095903.text: Take a look around. He's definitely got something stashed away there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125105628.text: They would probably starve if it weren't for us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125105820_1.text: I only hope that the orcs aren't going to kill us all now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125105820.text: I heard that Trelis has been freed from the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110120_0.text: If you've come to collect the rent, forget it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110120_1.text: The rebels came and pillaged everything. There's nothing left to take here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110120.text: What are you doing on my farm?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110345_0.text: Those layabouts are only hiding in the woods so they won't have to do any decent work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110436.text: How are you going to pay your tribute to the orcs if you have nothing left?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110949_0.text: The orcs won't be around here much longer if you ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110949_1.text: Soon, the Hashishin will take over everything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110949_2.text: And then the deck will be reshuffled.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125110949.text: Right now, the orcs have other things to worry about.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503_0.text: Oh, what do I know? At any rate, I've been seeing more Hashishin here than orcs over the last few weeks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503_1.text: The Varant desert begins not far from here, to the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503_2.text: Go see the magnificent buildings they've erected there for yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503_3.text: I refuse to believe the orcs are letting them do that out of the goodness of their hearts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503_4.text: The orcs are scared of them, that's what I think.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125111503.text: The Hashishin want to take over the midlands?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125113000.text: I don't care who I work for - king or orcs, it makes no difference.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125113116_0.text: Somebody or other is always ruler of the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125113116.text: You don't really seem to mind the orcs hanging around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125113703_0.text: Nonsense. Rebels will attack orcs, or orc mercenaries, but never farmers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125113703.text: I already told you that the rebels attacked me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125114936_0.text: Their leader was called Hengley or something like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125114936_1.text: He and his men turned my entire farm upside down and took whatever they could find.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125114936.text: If you say so. Two days ago, three rebels came to my farm from the west.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115111_0.text: They headed back to the west, where they came from.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115111.text: Where did Hengley go with your gold?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115449_0.text: Er... what? Umm... I don't know anything about that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115449_1.text: Some rebel you are. Instead of fighting orcs, you're stealing from harmless peasants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115449.text: Farmon claims you raided his farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115613.text: Here, this is the gold I took from Farmon. You can have it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125115841.text: If the boss finds out, he's going to feed me to the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120036.text: You were right. Hengley the rebel really did rob you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120146.text: I told you so. Those lazy so-and-sos should be smoked out, or sent to work in the mines.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120440_0.text: That's enough. I'll throw the guy out of my camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120440_1.text: I've tolerated that swine for far too long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120440.text: Hengley is raiding harmless farmers to line his pockets.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125120606.text: That was well done. Keep your eyes and ears open, alright?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125121154_0.text: So you better just get out of my way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125121154.text: Just leave me alone, you ratfink. The rebels banned me from Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125122817.text: Hey, stranger. Did you hear anything about the rebels in Nemora?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125122953_0.text: Some of them were here a few days ago.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125122953_1.text: I would have loved to go with them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125122953.text: What do you want from the rebels?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125123055.text: I'm tired of working on the farm here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125123116.text: Living in freedom is better than being a slave to the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125123835.text: I heard that the rebels raided Farmon's farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125124114.text: So what? They never harmed me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125124710_0.text: Nemora is a rebel camp to the west.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125124710_1.text: Those guys up there are really well organized.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125124710.text: What do you know about Nemora?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125125404_0.text: Curses. Looks like I will have to remain a simple farmhand for the rest of my life.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125125404.text: The leader of Nemora has fallen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125130549_0.text: I've been there before. I observed them for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125130549_1.text: But I never found the courage to show myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125130549.text: Do you know where Nemora is?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125130823.text: I wouldn't try again to go there by myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132248_0.text: You would do that for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132248_1.text: At last. Forget the farm and all. A rebel's life for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132248_2.text: Do you think they would let me join?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132248.text: I will accompany you to Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132433.text: OK. Let me know when we're leaving.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132609.text: I hope you know that I'm not much help in a fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132706.text: In that case, you should run faster.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125132830.text: That's it, we're here. I really hope the rebels will let me join.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125133056.text: Thank you, stranger. Here, take this for your way back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125144548_0.text: Neither do you. What do you want here? To empty out the farm?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125144548.text: You don't look like a swineherd.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125144624_0.text: You've got a point, I suppose.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125144624.text: Why would you worry about that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125144816.text: You look like someone with a lucrative extra income. A thief.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125145114.text: But I'm telling you, there isn't much here to be had.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125145240.text: If you want to steal, then you'll get a better haul from the orcs in Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125150509.text: Believe me, I know what I'm talking about, kid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125152642.text: Halt, Morra. Do you have any healing potions?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125152812.text: I need healing potions. Give me all you've got or I'll pound you, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125153109.text: I'll give you one for now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125153205.text: That's not enough. I need more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125153404.text: Forget it. You'll get nothing from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125153646_0.text: No. That's the problem, you wise guy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125160201_0.text: Well. I can't wait to see how you will go about that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125160201.text: All right. I'll get you an alchemist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125160450.text: I don't have any potions. Do you take gold as well?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125160526.text: Grrr. All right. Give it here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125163524.text: Don't you have an alchemist here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164026_0.text: But he disappeared a couple of days ago.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164026_2.text: No idea where he is, but he had better move his butt back to his lab.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164026.text: That slimy Morra Avogadro was our alchemist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164244_0.text: Not just find, Morra. You'll bring him here, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164352_0.text: You need it, too. You Morras are such a bunch of weenies.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164352.text: I'm sure you can teach me how to fight better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164426.text: See, that wasn't so hard. But that still isn't enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125164612.text: You've got to improve. Your're right, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125165144_0.text: Very good. Now take him back to his lab.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125165424.text: Crap. Whatever. Then you're our man from now on, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125165600_0.text: I'll give you two days. Then I get 20 healing potions from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125165600_1.text: And you'll regret it if you run off, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125170253_0.text: Fine. If he takes off like that again, I'll kill him myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125170253_1.text: Very good, Morra. You're pretty useful, all in all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125170253.text: Avogadro is working in your lab again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125171058.text: I don't think I'll be able to find an alchemist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125171241_1.text: You'll bring me 20 healing potions within two days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125171241_2.text: And don't even think about being late, then you'll REALLY get it from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125171241.text: Whatever you like, Morra. Then, from now on it's YOUR job.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125172315_0.text: Wonderful. You do that more often, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125172315_1.text: It's not like I've got anything else to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125172819.text: Were you going to get one for us, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125173407_0.text: Grrr. Ah. How nice for him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125173407.text: I found him on one of the farms.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125173758_0.text: Well, if that doesn't beat all...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125174344.text: Why do you warriors have so few healing potions?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125182621.text: No, please! Don't hurt me. It wasn't me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125182715.text: Relax. I just want to look around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125182910_1.text: Um... nothing. I'm just a simple farmer doing my job. Believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125182910.text: Hold on. What have you been up to?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183127_0.text: I've spent my whole life on this farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183127_1.text: I've never been anywhere else. I don't know anything. Honest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183127.text: There's something not right about you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183526_0.text: You worked for the Orcs in Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183526_2.text: I'll give you all my gold, but don't tell anyone I'm hiding here, all right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183526.text: You're no farmer. You're a runaway alchemist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183607_0.text: Oh. Can you imagine how the Orcs treat you when you aren't a fighter?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183607_1.text: You're always getting pushed around and humiliated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183607_2.text: I just couldn't take it anymore.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183607.text: Why did you run away from Trelis, anyway?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125183756.text: You're going back to Trelis, or I'll drag you there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125184502.text: But you'd better make sure I get there in one piece, pig.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125184625.text: I'm here. Are you happy now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125185134_0.text: I'll give you 150 gold coins if you leave me alone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125185134.text: Did you just say something about gold?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125185355_0.text: Oh. Thank you, stranger. May Innos bless you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125185355_1.text: Here's your gold. And thank you again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125185355.text: Give me your gold and I'll let you go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125190016_0.text: What do you Morras think this is, some kind of request program?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060125190016_1.text: All right. Then from now on, YOU are our man, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126104548_0.text: The rebels raid the farms, blockade the pass to the desert, and rob us whenever they can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126104548_1.text: They're said to have a major camp up in the west. They call it Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126104548_2.text: I would love to eradicate Nemora, but I have other worries at the moment, as you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126104548.text: Yes, right. They still exist, too. And you say the war is over. Bah.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126104903.text: I would richly reward anyone who manages to smash that camp to bits.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105250.text: Eh...if I can afford it, of course.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105452.text: The Nemora rebels won't cause you any more worries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105914_1.text: What? Don't tell me you had a hand in the destruction.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105914_3.text: A masterstroke, Morra. I will give you a princely reward for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105914_4.text: You are truly a loyal man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126105914.text: Sounds good. But what exactly do you mean by that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126110710_0.text: So that's how it is. Now I get to work for you, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126110710_2.text: Grrr. Here's a couple of healing potions.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126112507.text: Tell me what you need and then go. I'm busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126112650_0.text: I have a few things for a fighter like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126113016_0.text: I'm supposed to teach you? Bah. Why? What have you done for ME?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126113016.text: Can you teach me how to be a smith?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126113200.text: Who taught YOU how to be a smith?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126113738_0.text: Often, it is passed down from father to son.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126113738.text: We orcs are warriors. Many of us are masters of this art.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121256_1.text: Many warriors have gone to battle successfully with my blades.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121256_2.text: But that was not always so.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121256_3.text: You should have seen my first sword, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121256_4.text: It was shabby, with a jagged blade. But I have always carried it with me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121256_5.text: It reminds me of my father.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121717_0.text: No. Because that idiotic failure of an overseer Tempeck just won't listen to what he's told.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121717_1.text: I said he could take some weapons from my chamber for his excavations at the eastern temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121717_2.text: But not the old sword lying on my bed, I said.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121717_3.text: Tempeck must have taken it, the idiot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121717.text: You don't have your old sword any more?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121929_0.text: Don't bother me with that old story, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121929_1.text: It could be that I brought it here with me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126121929.text: Milok is looking for his old sword.
