INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126122038.text: But I don't really remember. I don't have time for that sort of nonsense.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126122346_1.text: Indeed. This is it. Where did you find it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126122346_2.text: At the excavations in the eastern temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126122346_3.text: I knew it. Tempeck did pocket it, the dog.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126122346_4.text: Thanks, Morra. For that, you'll get something from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126123404.text: Don't look at me like that. I know that I really have no business being here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126123518_0.text: I used to be one, until we lost the war and our rune magic, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126123538.text: Today I'm nothing but a shadow from the past.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126124419_0.text: Of course. Or should I go hide in caves, like the rebels do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126124419_1.text: I'm strong and I don't want to hide, you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126124419.text: You are working for the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126125926_1.text: When the rune magic died, so did my faith.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126125926.text: You're fighting against your own people?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126130210.text: I will not raise my sword against the oppressors again unless Innos gives me back my magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126130806_0.text: Stop mocking me, or I'll make you regret it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126130806_3.text: What do you know. It feels just like it did back then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126130806_4.text: Praised be Innos! He has not deserted me after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126130806.text: I have come to restore your magic to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126131133_0.text: I will, with all the strength that Innos has given me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126131133_1.text: Whenever you take up the fight against the orcs here in Trelis, I will fight by your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126131458_0.text: Knowing the strengths and weaknesses of your enemies can mean the difference between victory and failure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126131458.text: I'll do that as soon as you have attended the war council of Vak, the lord of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126132243.text: Trelis is free. Your work here is done.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126132523_0.text: I'm at your disposal. I will fight by your side, liberator.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126132523.text: But the fight against evil is not over yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126133744.text: Will you teach me how to be a smith NOW?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126134239.text: You helped me, I'll help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142211_0.text: Eh... alright. Then forget I said anything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142211.text: Shut up. If I wanted to kill you, you'd be dead now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142258.text: Keep calm, kid. I won't hurt you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142320.text: You haven't come to make trouble, have you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142447_1.text: I am a rebel and fight for the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142447.text: Never mind. Tell me what's going on up here...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142826_0.text: But I'm looking forward to taking out my first orc.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126142826.text: I haven't been in any battles yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143010_0.text: I've already practiced a lot with my sword.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143010.text: You couldn't even kill a meatbug.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143315_0.text: I make sure no one sneaks into the camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143315_2.text: It's not that easy, you know. Especially not with all the beasts in the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143315.text: What do you do here all day long?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143958_0.text: I don't want to know what they'd do to someone they got their hands on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126143958.text: But what scares me the most is the undead in the cave over there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144516.text: I could clean out the undead cave for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144517_0.text: It wouldn't be the first time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144517_1.text: If you manage that, I'll give you 300 gold coins, all right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144517.text: You'd really have the guts to go into a cave full of undead?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144752_0.text: The skeletons that were there are nothing but dust now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144752.text: The cave over there is an old cemetery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126144901.text: That's reassuring. It's worth 300 gold coins to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126150108.text: Oh. I could tell you a thing or two about that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126151157_0.text: You're NOT the messenger from Nemora?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126151519.text: Then let's get straight to work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126151551.text: I thought you wouldn't be coming back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126151928_0.text: Innos be with us. That means we're on our own.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126152936.text: Damn. I have to know if Nemora still stands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126153030.text: When will this nightmare finally end?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126153237.text: So far I have heard nothing about Nemora being destroyed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126153630_0.text: Nemora needs to send reinforcements. Quickly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126153630.text: Then you'll have to tell their leader that we're pinned down here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126154351.text: What's the name of the leader in Nemora again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126155111.text: You don't know? It seems to me you don't even know where Nemora is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126155452.text: I don't have the faintest idea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126155552.text: Of course I know where Nemora is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126155751.text: Damn. And I thought you could be trusted.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126160533.text: What are you still here for, filthy Orc mercenary?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174145_1.text: Well, you can forget about reinforcements.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174145.text: I talked to Russel, the commander of Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174358_0.text: No hard feelings. I'll have to think of something else, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174358.text: Damn. I was afraid of that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174535_0.text: Tell him he can forget the reinforcements.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174535_1.text: We don't have enough people for that kind of action.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174535_2.text: He'll have to make it on his own.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174937_0.text: Dammit all. Anything else while we're at it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174937_1.text: Is there anything at all that goes right in this cursed land?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126174937.text: The rebel Charles at the temple of Trelis needs reinforcements.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175208.text: You seem to be a decent sort after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175634_0.text: We were overrun by the Orcs when we tried to secure the temple of Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175634_1.text: They're obsessed with searching for divine artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175634.text: What are you doing in this cave?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175947_0.text: Every artifact that the Orcs recover can be used against us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126175947.text: What is so important about the temple?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180155_0.text: Someone has to prevent the Orcs in and around the temple of Trelis from digging.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180155.text: The excavations at the temple must be stopped.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180245_0.text: How else? They don't understand any other language.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180408_0.text: Very good. Then we can still hope.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180408_1.text: Thanks for this extremely good news.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180408.text: The Orcs at the temple have been thoroughly annihilated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180535.text: And to think I would have killed you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126180826.text: They came with about 30 warriors. All we could do was flee here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126181030_0.text: The Orcs have taken everything they could recover from the temple to Trelis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126181030_1.text: If one of those rare artifacts was indeed in the temple, then it's bound to be in Trelis now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060126181030.text: What do you know about the divine artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127120119.text: Wait a moment. I've seen you before.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127120246.text: Almost everybody seems to know me here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122107_0.text: Yep. It's a tragic story all right.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122107_1.text: As soon as the rune magic left this world, the orcs descended on us like flies.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122107_2.text: We were so confused that many of us just up and ran.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122107_3.text: Including me. That's probably the reason why I am still alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122107.text: The paladins are a thing of the past.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127122512.text: Well, I am an experienced fighter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127123451.text: My deeds aren't completely unheard of in this part of the land either.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127123536.text: At any rate, you've gone into battle against the orcs before.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127123625.text: I can just tell from the way you look.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127124809_1.text: A good opportunity to make use of my fighting prowess once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127141922.text: The rebel camp Nemora is looking for new recruits.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127142043.text: I actually had thought about joining the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127142142.text: But first I want to end what I started.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127142405_0.text: We definitely still need a strong man to stand guard on the lower entrance to Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127142405_1.text: If we don't watch out, the orcs will overrun us in the end.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127142930.text: Thank you, stranger. Just say the word, and I will fight by your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127143215_0.text: Paladins are exactly what we need to get our morale back in shape.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127143215_1.text: Very good. You know how to help us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127144540.text: I've still got an account to settle, you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145137_0.text: He was a paladin, like me. We fought for the king side by side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145137_1.text: But when we lost the war, Kurt completely lost his mind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145137_2.text: He started killing and robbing simple peasants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145137.text: Back in the war, I had a comrade-in-arms. His name was Kurt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145459_0.text: He simply couldn't come to terms with our defeat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145459_1.text: I tried to make him see reason.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145459_2.text: But in the end, he tried to kill me as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145459.text: Why did Kurt crack in the first place?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145827_0.text: He has taken up company with the worst rabble in all of the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145827_1.text: He and his gang have dug themselves in at the pass to Varant.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127145827_2.text: They attack everybody who dares to cross the pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127150149_0.text: I swore to myself that I would stop him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127150149_1.text: I just want to get close enough so I can kill him before he does even more damage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127150149.text: What are you going to do with Kurt?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127150549_1.text: There must be no such thing as a renegade paladin in the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127152403_0.text: See? This is just the opportunity I have been waiting for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127152403_1.text: Draw your weapon and follow me. It's going to be a bitter battle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127152557.text: By Innos. The pass is bigger than I thought.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153410.text: Now that we're here, I might as well show you the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153538.text: It's not far from here. Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153831_0.text: Hot burning sand as far as the eye can see.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153831.text: Will you look at that, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153936_0.text: I prefer the more moderate climate of the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127153936.text: That's no place for me and my metal armor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127154052.text: Will you go to Nemora now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127154250.text: Yes. I am going to become a rebel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127154433_0.text: Take these healing potions from me. May they help you in battle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127154433.text: Thank you for giving my life a new purpose, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127160500.text: Here, take my gold. My mission is now fulfilled.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060127162649.text: He was a completely changed man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130102127_0.text: We do not reveal the identity of our leader to just ANYONE, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130102538_0.text: We can really use a strong man like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130102750_0.text: Alright. You have done enough for us, so I will now freely admit it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130102750_1.text: Yes. I am the leader of Nemora. Welcome among us, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130102750.text: You are the leader of Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130124303_0.text: You've got your work cut out for you, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130124303_1.text: Here, take these healing potions. You'll need them. The beasts are tough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130124303.text: I will kill the snorting monsters.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130130055_1.text: That means we can finally relax for a change.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130130055_2.text: I think that earns you a share of our gold, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130130055.text: The snorting monsters of Nemora are history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130150244_0.text: That's good. But be careful and don't let any of them catch you from behind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130150244.text: I will take care of the orcs on the devastated farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130150719_0.text: Good. They were coming dangerously close.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130150719_1.text: Here's your share of our gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060130150719.text: The leader of the orcs on the devastated farm is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131123517.text: Watch where you're going. It's dangerous out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131123707_0.text: The north of Nemora is populated by monsters, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131123707_1.text: The worst are those big, snorting ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131123707.text: Just what is so dangerous out there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131123748.text: Don't get too close or they'll eat you, bones and all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131124024_0.text: I could tell you who our leader is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131124024_1.text: But I would have to kill you afterwards.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131124103.text: No stranger must know who's boss here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131124810.text: If the orcs got wind of who they have to kill for Nemora to collapse, he'd be a dead man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131131319.text: We'll tell you our leader's name once we know you better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135052_0.text: A caravan of Hashishins has recently settled where the pass to the desert begins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135052_1.text: They say that the desert merchants were all killed by snappers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135052.text: You could lend us your strong arm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135132.text: I will recover the goods from the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135231_0.text: They're still bound to be in the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135231.text: Alright. But watch out for the snappers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135431_0.text: I knew they were still there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135431_1.text: Very well done. Here is your share of our gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131135431.text: Here are the goods from the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131140207.text: Will you tell me now who your boss is?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131140225.text: Mmh. I'm still not really sure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131140240.text: I think you should ask the others.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131140934.text: I hope you won't disappoint us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131145809.text: If we hurry, we could still recover the goods from the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131145932.text: If you meet anyone you think might be right for the job, bring him here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131150417_0.text: Sorry, but I cannot tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131150417.text: Wouldn't you like to know that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131150752_0.text: Nobody's told you so far, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131150752_1.text: Then I most certainly won't, either.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131150828.text: You'll have to find that out for yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131151238_0.text: If you break anything, I'll be in trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131151548_0.text: Actually, I'm only supposed to guard these things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131151548_1.text: But if you make me a good offer... nobody needs to know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131151548.text: Do you sell this stuff as well?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131152208.text: I'm not going to tell you that, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131152242.text: I don't know you well enough for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131152746_0.text: Not me, at any rate. I'm not allowed to say any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131152746.text: Tell me who's the boss here, now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131155641_0.text: We rebels always need one thing or another.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131155641.text: Is there anything in particular that you need?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131155828.text: Our last battle with the orcs left everything in shambles.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131160047.text: I will get you some weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131160313.text: Right. You should probably go to Trelis. The orcs have stashed a whole lot in their stronghold there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131162330_0.text: That's excellent. Here, have some of our gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131162330.text: Here you are, ten bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131162854_0.text: Well, it's NOT me. But I cannot tell you who is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131162854.text: Tell me who the boss is here in Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131162936.text: You will have to try your luck elsewhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131165700.text: Maybe we could talk about it again if we knew you better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131165806.text: Come and find your place in our community.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131165850_0.text: I'm a fighter. I am concerned with the safety of Nemora.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131170658_0.text: This place is the only serious bastion of humans that is left in this part of the world.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171040.text: The castle of Trelis lies to the east, not far from here. The pass to Varant is in the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171050.text: If we're not careful, we'll soon be slain by orcs, or enslaved by Hashishins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171120.text: Welcome to our rock and our hard place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171343_0.text: Lately, we saw a troop of orcs on the devastated farm east of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171343.text: Why are you looking so worried?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131171815.text: Somebody must eliminate their leader before they find our hideout here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060131180937.text: So are you the boss here, or what?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110443_0.text: I'm waiting for something to happen at long last.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110443_1.text: Hiding from the orcs in this hole gets my dander up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110556_0.text: Wouldn't mess with me if I were you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110556.text: You're a really tough customer, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110656.text: How about we go smash Trelis to bits?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201110758.text: Ah. A man of action. I like it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201111512.text: You really should become one of us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201111654.text: And how do I go about that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201112133.text: What are we waiting for, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201112418.text: I'll come with you if the boss doesn't object.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201112559.text: Talk to our leader. It's that simple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201112935_0.text: Leader? Me? With this bunch of bums? Thanks, but no thanks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201112935.text: You're not the leader of Nemora, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201113409_0.text: But don't take forever, you hear me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201113409.text: I'm going to wait here until you tell me to attack.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201113628_0.text: Finally. None to soon, either. Let's go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201114638_0.text: Good thing, too. Pity, though, that the fight for Trelis is over already.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201114638.text: Trelis is defeated. Vak is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201120110.text: Where NOW? To Trelis, or what?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201120513.text: All right, Tyler. Move your butt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201121125.text: The castle didn't LOOK so big from a distance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201121337.text: I'm waiting for someone to call us to arms.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201121723_0.text: Forget it. I'm doing my own thing here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201121723_1.text: I'm not involved in anything else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201122620_0.text: A mage searching for the ancient magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201122620_1.text: Like all former Fire Mages, friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201125227_0.text: In order to learn who leads Nemora, first you'll have to secure the trust of the important people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132501_0.text: I am looking for an ancient recipe for a potion.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132501_1.text: Unfortunately, I can't get the ingredients right now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132606.text: I'll get you the herbaceous lobelia.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132642.text: That is commendable. I need five of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132920_0.text: I need the rare herbaceous lobelia.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132920_1.text: I discovered some up in the west where all the monsters roam around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132920_2.text: But I'm not crazy enough to tangle with the beasts myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201132920.text: What ingredients do you need for your potion?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201133313_1.text: I hope the beasts up there didn't trouble you too much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201133313_2.text: Here are some potions as payment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201133538_0.text: Talk to the others. It isn't ME, friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201133538.text: Tell me who the boss is here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201134349.text: But don't let yourself be eaten, alright?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201134502.text: Only then will we be ready to tell you his name.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201150128_0.text: Yay. Then there isn't much left for me to do, is there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201150128.text: Trelis no longer has a leader. Vak is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201170532.text: Basically I do what Finley does. He is my comrade-in-arms.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201170643_0.text: Well. What can I say? These things happen in our line of work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201170919.text: And don't forget to take Tyler with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201171127.text: Yeah, yeah. I heard you already.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201171430.text: Just don't leave that fellow here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201172352_0.text: Yes, I know. Tyler is dead. Can't help it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060201172440.text: We need to carry on anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060202120655_0.text: Weapons. About ten bundles of weapons would help us a lot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060202120655.text: But there is one thing of which we never have enough: weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060202121024.text: We need ten bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209092329_0.text: Who the devil let YOU in here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209092329.text: Another one of you stinking Morras.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209092445_0.text: Our all-encompassing search for the divine artifacts is none of your business, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209092515.text: It would be better for you if you turned your attention to the security of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209093615.text: I don't like your looks, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209094001_0.text: The king's rebels hide in caves and woods, and prefer to attack from ambush.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209094001.text: Up to now, your cowardly people have brought me nothing but trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209094431_0.text: Countless men of the Morras fight and work for our cause.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209100117.text: Without the mercenaries, this city would collapse.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209101242.text: As mercenaries, you fight in our arenas and subjugate your own people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209101755.text: The fact that you are still alive is a sign of our benevolence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209102143.text: You seem to have some experience with the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209103756_0.text: We have smashed their positions countless times, but they keep coming back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209103756_1.text: I heard that they get their supplies from a large rebel camp called Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209103756_2.text: I would love to smash that nest if I knew where it was.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209103756.text: I certainly do. They are lurking outside the gates of the city, waiting for an opportunity to reconquer it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209104021.text: I could crush the rebel camp Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209104414_0.text: If you find Okara and raze it to the ground, you will be appropriately rewarded.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209104414.text: I expected nothing less from someone like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209105023.text: The rebel camp you were looking for was called Okara. It has been crushed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209105824_1.text: Very good. Here is your pay, mercenary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209105824.text: You mean the rebel supplies have been cut off?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209110603.text: What about the rest of the rebels around Montera?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209110733_0.text: Good, Morra. It's about time they learned their lesson.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209110733.text: I'll take care of the rest of the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209111119_0.text: You are a remarkable fellow. No Morra has ever done such good work for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209111119_1.text: I am impressed by your fighting spirit. But not by the betrayal of your own people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209111119_2.text: Nevertheless, here is your pay. I will be watching your further actions with interest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209111119.text: The remaining rebel positions have also been smashed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209114104_0.text: You ask too many questions about things that are none of your business.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209114104_1.text: Even if I knew what the power of those relics of the Ancient Ones was, I wouldn't share it with a mercenary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209114245_0.text: The much bigger question is - why are you interested in the bearer of Beliar's power?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209114245.text: What do you know about Xardas?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209115201.text: Many people claim that. But only a select few have ever really seen him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209115740.text: Just tell me where I can find Xardas.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209120605_0.text: He built his tower in a secret place, far from all that is worldly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209120605.text: If you know him so well, then you ought to know where he prefers to stay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209121258.text: YOU will never set foot there anyway, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209122325.text: I work for Marik, the leader of the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209122511_0.text: Say what you came to say, my time is precious.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209122511.text: Grrr. If it were up to me, they'd send you filthy mercenary rabble to the mines of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209122706_0.text: I have a very select inventory of goods here, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209130915.text: Don't mess things up, or else I'll chop off your fingers, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131154_1.text: I will send them to the smithy and have them refurbished.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131154_2.text: I think 20 bundles of weapons should do for a start.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131437_0.text: The rebels fight with that kind of old junk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131437_1.text: Wherever there are rebels, you will also find old weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131437.text: Where do I get bundles of weapons?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131526_0.text: That's not enough. I need 20 bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209131526.text: I've got some old weapons for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209140040.text: Hey you! Where do you think you're going?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209140215.text: I'll have a look around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209140619_0.text: I'll have you know you are speaking to an orc commander.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209140619.text: Now don't YOU get on my nerves, too!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209140650.text: You think you're really strong, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209145351.text: Bet you've never been on a really dangerous mission.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209150128_0.text: Either you train with weapons here, or you make yourself scarce right away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209150128.text: You can have your look around in the slave quarters, you joker.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209150231.text: Alright. What can I do for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151059_0.text: He's a strong warrior, but he's resting on the laurels he won during the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151059_1.text: But as long as the rebels are still pressing us, there's no reason to let ourselves go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151059.text: One of my people is shirking work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151218.text: I'll bring the orc warrior into the castle yard to report for work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151314_0.text: He's hiding out somewhere in the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151314.text: Ha ha. I'm looking forward to this. His name is Folleck.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151635_0.text: What do you know. That Folleck is one tough customer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151635_1.text: Not bad for a Morra. Not bad at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209151635.text: Folleck will show up for work in the castle yard from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152118_0.text: Go shoot off your mouth with those losers in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152118_1.text: I'll skin you alive if you don't make yourself scarce.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152118.text: So this tower is all yours, or what?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152226.text: Take it easy. I'm already gone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152437_0.text: All right. You asked for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152437.text: We're all alone here. So show me what you've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152514.text: So you knocked me down. That proves nothing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152642.text: Go down to the castle yard where the others are, or I'll make you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209152949_0.text: I'm going. But you leave me alone from now on, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209153212.text: They are looking for you. They want you in the castle yard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209170644.text: You didn't mean to just walk past me, did you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209170829_0.text: Rarely is a Morra tolerated in the inner circle of this castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209170829.text: This is the residence of Varek the Great.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209171247_0.text: Yes. But behave yourself. The boys in there are training and don't like to be disturbed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209171247.text: Will you let me into the castle?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172109_0.text: I mean the guard up there by the gate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172109_1.text: The orcs may appear a bit gruff, but if you speak their language, they turn out to be quite affable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172255.text: I suppose the orc guards by the castle gate don't stand around there for no reason?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172553_0.text: The orcs will attack anyone they don't know in the inner ward of the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172553.text: Certainly not. Don't even think of simply stumbling into the castle yard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172807_0.text: Only then can you move freely among them and talk to their leader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209172807.text: It means that you have to render outstanding services to the city before they accept you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209173818_0.text: I don't know where the mage has made his home.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209173818_1.text: They say only the orc shamans know his true location.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174139_0.text: But I don't know all that for sure. I'm only a human.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174139.text: As far as I know, some of the most important shamans of the orcs are in Geldern and Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174636_0.text: But I like the idea of finally ending this eternal battle between orcs and humans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174636_1.text: Xardas seems to play the key role in this. He's got big plans for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174636_2.text: I don't find that very reassuring.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174636_3.text: Whatever. Despite everything they say about him, even Xardas is only human after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209174636.text: That's saying a bit much, really. I know next to nothing about the dark mage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209180035_0.text: My name is Marik. I'm the leader and trainer of the mercenaries in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209180035_1.text: If you cause any trouble here, I will be held responsible and that would be very bad for you, get it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209181658.text: Have you got anything for me to do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209181815_0.text: But I have a very special task for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209181815.text: There's always work for a mercenary here in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182034_1.text: I can use you against my own people and they won't make the connection.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182034.text: They barely know your face in town. That's a huge advantage for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182316_0.text: Why would that surprise you? Take a look around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182316_1.text: Every one of these nitwits thinks of nothing but his own profit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182316_2.text: If we cooperated with the orcs a bit more, we'd all be doing better in Myrtana.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182455_0.text: Aw, come on. Do you feel like you're too good for a job like that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182455.text: I see. You want me to work as your spy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182615.text: I don't think you've got a choice, really.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209182822_0.text: Wise decision. Then let's not waste any time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209183154_0.text: As you like. But don't wait too long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060209183154.text: I need to think about it some more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210101516.text: You'll find me in my hut near the western entrance to the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210102932_0.text: Lately there's been an increasing number of strange incidents in Montera and on the farms.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210102932_1.text: Goods are stolen, slaves disappear, farms are raided, and so on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210102932_2.text: All of this stinks to high heaven of rebels and treason.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210102932_3.text: I want you to find out who among my people is reliable and who isn't.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210102932.text: Fine. What exactly should I do as your spy?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210103158_0.text: No idea. Talk to them, work for them, befriend them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210103158_2.text: ... is not your problem. Got it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210103158_3.text: I'll see what I can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210103158.text: How should I test the loyalty of your people?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210110831_0.text: I suppose there's no other way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210110831.text: I can get rid of Sanford for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210110856.text: But be quick before the others get wind of it, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210110910.text: Sanford the warehouse keeper is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210111052.text: Very regrettable. But it's better this way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210113835.text: I'll be in my hut by the western entrance to the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210123750.text: A new delivery? Put it with the others.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210124003_0.text: Stupid question. You can see that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210124003_1.text: It's no bed of roses, let me tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210124003_2.text: When everything is running smoothly, nobody's interested in what I do all day.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210124003_3.text: But if anything is missing, they all panic right away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210125347_0.text: I need 15 sacks of wheat from the grain farm to the north, and I need them fast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210125347_1.text: What do you think will happen here if the others don't get any more bread?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210125516_0.text: Well, finally. Here is a bit of gold for your service.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210125516.text: Here are your sacks of wheat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210130438_0.text: Well. Like I said, the job is no bed of roses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210130438.text: You won't believe it, but I still need five milk barrels from the stockyard in the west.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210130639_2.text: Well then. Here is your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210130822_0.text: I think that is all I need in the way of goods for now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210131031_0.text: You have to help us out a bit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210131031.text: Why don't you go and get the crap yourself?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210132503_0.text: You'll do the right thing. I'm sure of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210141916_0.text: Marik is an orc lover. He was already working with them during the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210141916_1.text: He's such a toady, always sucking up to Varek, the leader of the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210142119_0.text: I don't particularly like Marik. He's a self-righteous asshole.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210142119.text: Everybody here is out for himself and has skeletons in his closet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210142933_2.text: Oh well. As long as he does his work, I don't care what he thinks of me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210142933.text: Sanford isn't very fond of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210143325.text: What do you think of your leader Marik?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210143400.text: His leadership qualities leave something to be desired.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210144842_1.text: You won't get far talking like that with the orcs occupying the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210144953_0.text: You should treat us with a little more respect, otherwise you'll wind up like the desert merchants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210144953.text: We rebels can be recognized a mile away, anyhow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210145229_0.text: I'm waiting for a message from our man in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210145229_2.text: We planted a spy in among the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210145229_3.text: He's supposed to let us know when the right moment has come to start the revolution.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210145450_0.text: Just because you haven't killed me yet doesn't mean I trust you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210145450.text: Will you tell me more about your spy with the mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210152645_0.text: He's disturbing our communication with each other.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210152645.text: For days, one of those stupid mercenaries has been hanging around our meeting place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210152929_0.text: On the hill south of Montera. There is an old ruined tower there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210153121_0.text: You're good, stranger. Now the situation isn't quite so hopeless.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210160812_0.text: Oh, really? And what are you going to do about it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210160812.text: This hill ain't big enough for the both of us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210160945.text: Get back to work or I'll report you to your superiors.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210163518.text: Oh, will you? Huh, I'm shaking in my boots.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210163800_0.text: Let me guess. It's Trano again, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210163800.text: One of your boys is shirking work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210164800.text: Good for him. Here's your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210165644_0.text: Why is that any of YOUR business? Leave me alone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210165644.text: Taking a little break, huh? Shouldn't you be watching the slaves or something?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210170551_0.text: I knew you'd rat me out, you scumbag.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210170906.text: This is the last time. Go tell him I'm cutting his pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210171215_0.text: Calm down, I'm going already, you lunatic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210171215.text: So, are you going back to work again, or not?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210173642_0.text: I don't know who he is exactly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210173642_1.text: All I know is that he'll give us a sign when it's time to attack.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210173642_2.text: Since then, we've been waiting here like idiots.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060210173642.text: What about your contact in Montera?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165156_0.text: We would take the whole place by storm if we could.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165156_1.text: But, unfortunately, the orcs outnumber us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165156_2.text: We probably wouldn't even make it to the temple complex.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165156.text: You rebels are dangerously close to the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165254.text: Stop making such a commotion, or the orcs will spot us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165520_0.text: But, unfortunately, the orcs will raise the alarm as soon as they notice anything suspicious.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165520_1.text: We don't stand a chance fighting them in the open. There are just too many of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165520.text: I am looking for a way to get rid of the slave camp guards so that we can help the slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165622.text: Too many orcs in the slave camp? We can change that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211165738_1.text: If those slave camp guards come running all at once, we are done for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211170151_0.text: Ha. Those orcs are better at using axes than their brains, but they aren't stupid either.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211170151_2.text: Now this will be worth watching.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211170151.text: I will think of something to lure the slave camp guards away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211170427.text: One would have to pick them off one by one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211171508_0.text: Great. So the right time to storm the city has almost come.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211171508.text: The slave camp guards are gone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211171717.text: Carry on like that, mate. Bet you can use a few gold coins, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211173834_0.text: But somehow he hasn't achieved much so far.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211173834.text: We already had one of our men infiltrate the orc mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211174132_0.text: We've done a lot of damage to the city lately.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211174132_1.text: The orcs haven't noticed, but the mercenaries have become more cautious.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211174132_2.text: Therefore I assume that our spy is lying low so he won't blow his cover.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211174132.text: What's the problem with your spy among the mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211175406_0.text: If I tell you that, I might as well give myself up to the orcs right now!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211175406.text: Who is your spy among the mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211175648_1.text: A few yards down the road to the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211180839_1.text: Down the road, to the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211180839_2.text: I'll take care of it right away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211180839.text: One of your slaves ran away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211181014.text: I saw rebels outside the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211181530.text: ALARM! Well, we'll take care of that right now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211181933_0.text: WHAT? I ought to smash your teeth in.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211181933.text: You've got a really ugly face, even for an orc.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211182529_0.text: Bah. You weakling. Where is the beast?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211182529_1.text: A few yards down the south road.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211182529_2.text: Out of my way. Let a master deal with it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211182529.text: I need your help with a really big reptile back there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183014.text: Don't get smart with me, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183127.text: You pulled a fast one on me, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183545_0.text: What does he want this time?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183545_3.text: He's waiting for you a way down the south road.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183545.text: Your boss is looking for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211183945.text: I'd better get back to my post.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184157_0.text: No idea. I'd better get back to work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184700_0.text: I'm an orc. Of course I can hunt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184700_2.text: I'll prove it to you, you greenhorn.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184700_3.text: All right. I saw a couple of big reptiles down the south road.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184700_4.text: I'll get them. Just watch me, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060211184759_2.text: ALARM. We'll take care of that right now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214093401_0.text: Well, the fat cows in the stockyard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214093401.text: What livestock do you want to kill?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214093709_1.text: Probably not. Otherwise you'd have killed me, wouldn't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214093709.text: You wouldn't happen to be one of the mercenaries, would you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094043_1.text: I've surrounded the stockyard with my people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094204_0.text: We rebels are everywhere, you should know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094204_1.text: Even if you can't always see us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094204_2.text: Anyway, we control the whole valley here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094204.text: Surrounded? What are you talking about?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094502.text: You aren't quite right in the head, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214094718.text: We're just waiting for the sign to attack.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214095040_0.text: Just wait, once we kill the livestock, the mercenaries are going to feel really stupid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214095040.text: I see you don't believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214095339_0.text: First we'll sort out the livestock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214095339.text: What in the world are you planning?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214095822.text: If the mercenaries don't have anything left to eat, they're bound to give up quickly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101350_0.text: What? Really? That would be fantastic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101350_1.text: You'll see, the mercenaries will give up soon, once the cattle are dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101350.text: I'll take care of the cows in the stockyard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101531_0.text: They aren't so important. They don't give milk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101715.text: You are completely nuts, you know that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101927_0.text: Those bastards keep a closer eye on their animals than on their purses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214101927.text: If you think it's easy to kill the cows, you'd better think again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102121_0.text: Very good. Now we just have to wait until we get the sign.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102121_2.text: Hey. Don't you want your reward?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102121_3.text: Here's a couple of gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102512.text: Who's going to give you the sign to attack?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102629_0.text: He'll inform us when it is time to strike.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102629.text: We've planted a spy in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102844_0.text: He's mixed in with the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214102844_1.text: We have a password. It's 'Long live Okara'.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103348.text: If you tell him that, he'll trust you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829_0.text: That was my idea. Great, huh? Okara is our headquarters in the north of Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829_1.text: What could be a better password than that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829_2.text: Great password. You might as well run through the city yelling:

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829_3.text: Hello, I'm a rebel. Come and kill me!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829_4.text: Ups.. I didn't think of that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214103829.text: Long live Okara'? Who came up with that nonsense?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214104841_0.text: Mmh. I don't really know if I can trust you, but maybe you can prove it to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214104841_1.text: You help us with the business with the cows, and I'll tell you how to get in contact with our spy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214105631.text: First I would need some proof that I can trust you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214110114_0.text: He will reveal himself to you when you tell him our password.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214110114_2.text: Just don't ask. It wasn't my idea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214110114.text: Who is your spy in Montera?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214113649_0.text: You should drop by there sometimes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214113649_1.text: We can always use people like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214113649.text: It is located north of Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214114128_0.text: You bastard! Where did you pick that up? Talk!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214114759_0.text: How did you know I wouldn't kill you right away if you told me the password?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214114759_2.text: You sure are lucky, pal. I am the rebel contact here in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115007_0.text: Damn. We'll have to improve on our security.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115007_1.text: I can only hope for our sake that you are also for the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115007.text: The whole world knows that anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115518.text: I'll kill you, you dirty rebel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115708.text: I've discovered the traitor among your people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115750.text: Sanford the warehouse keeper. He's in cahoots with the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115854_0.text: Without solid evidence, this is a pretty bold allegation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115854.text: Sanford? That's hard to believe. Have you got proof?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115944_0.text: Dammit. I'm going to have to eliminate Sanford, the traitor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115944_1.text: And that won't exactly improve the morale of the troops.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214115944.text: Look at this letter. Sanford wrote it to the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214121516_1.text: I've seen a lot of men, but no one I would trust to lead a revolution.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214121516.text: That depends on what you have to tell me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214121601.text: You've got the right stuff. Unfortunately, you're working for the wrong side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214121835.text: What do I have to do so that you will free Montera with me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214122453_0.text: If you should manage to completely infiltrate the orcs, we can talk about this some more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214122453_1.text: Worm your way into the orcs' confidence until they admit you to Varek, the orc leader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214122453_2.text: Only if we can get to their leader do we have a chance of winning the battle for Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214122453.text: In my position as warehouse keeper, I never even get inside the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214123341_0.text: You actually did it? Then it is finally time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214123341_1.text: I'll let the others know that it will soon start.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214124448_0.text: Good. I'll see what I can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214124448.text: Together we will have to eliminate the rest of the orcs and the mercenaries until Montera is free.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214131725_0.text: May Innos guide you, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214131725_1.text: Here are some things that will help you on your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214131725.text: Montera is free. You are a hero.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214133455_0.text: Okara is the central rebel camp in the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214133455_1.text: I absolutely have to make contact with Roland, the leader of Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214133455_2.text: Unfortunately, I can't leave here, but you can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214133455_3.text: Can you take a message to Roland?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142051_0.text: Good. Here it is. But don't get caught with it, all right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142051.text: Give me the message. I'll take it to Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142226_0.text: Very good. Hopefully, everything will turn out all right now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142226.text: I took your message to Roland.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142349.text: I have a message from Sanford the warehouse keeper in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142801.text: Ah. A new man. You've come in the nick of time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214142930_0.text: But with these crappy conditions, it's no fun, let me tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214143018.text: There's always something new. Supply problems, slaves run away, and I don't know what all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214143136.text: Dammit all. I just want some peace.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214143722_0.text: These emaciated figures all look the same to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214143722_1.text: I can't make heads or tails of it any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214143722_2.text: You should take a closer look at the boys and tell me who needs to be exchanged.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214144200_1.text: So we exchange the slaves with the farms once a week.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214144200_2.text: The work out there is a bit easier. The boys recover really well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214144200.text: We can't have the poor dogs digging in the temple all the time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214144619.text: Fine. But don't take too long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214145809_0.text: Well. I don't know. I don't have much to do with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214145809_1.text: I think he does his job pretty well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214145809.text: What do you think of Marik?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214150005.text: I took care of the slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214150456.text: So I see. I'd have done it differently, but whatever...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214150809.text: Now we need new workers here in camp in a hurry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214150934_0.text: All right. Just take what you can find here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214152043.text: Go tell Dennis from the stockyard outside the city that he should send me new people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214152538_0.text: Thanks, my friend. I couldn't stand it here much longer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214152538.text: Today is your lucky day. You can go to the stockyard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214152702_0.text: Thanks, friend. I'm already on my way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060214152702.text: You can take a break. Go to the stockyard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215100435_0.text: Yeah, sure. And your little dog, too..

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215101055_0.text: I can barely use his people in my yard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215101055.text: Tell Bradley he shouldn't work the slaves so hard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215101325_0.text: That smart ass. Let him do this job, then

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215101325.text: Dennis says you shouldn't work the slaves so hard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215105708_0.text: Oh no, please. I can't bear the pain of the excavations any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215105708.text: You're going to work in town again from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215105905_0.text: Gold? I'm a slave. I don't have any gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215105905.text: Give me some gold, and you can stay on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110107.text: Get moving to the excavations now, or I'll drag you there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110224_0.text: I could give you some information that will help you gain favor with the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110224.text: Oh well. Then what can you offer me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110330.text: OK. Tell me what you've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110420.text: Listen, then. Not too long ago, Dennis sent some of his people to the grain farm to cause some trouble there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110914_1.text: I'm sorry. That's all I know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215110914.text: No idea what it was that they did, but I'm sure they were up to no good.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215111133_0.text: Thanks a thousand times. I will never forget what you did for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215111133.text: All right. You can stay here on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215111820.text: Dennis is having a running battle at the grain farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215111951.text: That idiot. I'll have to go out there to put an end to this nonsense.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215113830.text: The slave Leon is working in the temple again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114011_0.text: Don't even say that. I can't go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114011.text: You're needed at the excavations in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114151_0.text: Yeah, yeah, I guess I have no choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114151.text: Enough said. Off you go, to the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114430_0.text: Good work. Here's a few coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114430.text: The slave Kelvin is working in the temple again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114636.text: I could tell you where to find a treasure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114818_0.text: Oh no. It's not that easy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215114818_1.text: How do I know you won't send me to work in town anyway if I tell you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215115903.text: Working at the excavations is the job from hell. You have no idea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215120242.text: I want you to go to Dennis and tell him that I should stay here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215120430.text: Then I'll let you know where there is some treasure to be had.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215120720.text: I will let the slave Kelvin stay here in the yard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215121008_0.text: Oh please, you can't mean that!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215121008.text: Alright, mate. Now you're going to work in the temple again anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215121214_0.text: You're a right bastard, you know!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215121438.text: I talked to Dennis. Are you happy now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215122254_0.text: Everybody knows they're all fighting for gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215122254_1.text: Ashton turns the gold in to his boss.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215122254_2.text: But I know that most of it ends up in his own pocket.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215122254_3.text: He hides his gold under a bush behind the arena so he won't be found out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215122254.text: Ashton the mercenary lets the other mercenaries fight in his arena in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215123031_0.text: Is he, really? How would you know that? I need proof.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215123031.text: Ashton is embezzling gold from you for the arena fights.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215131601_0.text: Crap. Looks like you were right after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215131601_1.text: That swine is raking in gold by the bushel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215131601_2.text: I need to have a serious talk with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215131601_3.text: Very well done. Here's your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215131601.text: I found this in Ashton's hidey-hole behind the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215133113_0.text: Once, when I was cleaning his rooms, I watched him hide his gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215133113.text: How do you know about this thing with Ashton?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215133343.text: Fine, you get to stay on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215133642.text: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't send you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215141135.text: When is the relief finally coming?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215141308_0.text: But I don't have anything. What could I give you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215141308.text: What will you give me if I get you out of here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215142150.text: Tell me something about your overseer, Bradley.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215142507_0.text: Every slave here wants to get out to the farms. Nobody wants to work in here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215142507.text: Bradley does his own sleazy business here in the camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215142557.text: Bradley has this list. If you're at the top of Bradley's list, you get to go to the farms for a while.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215143032.text: That damn swine makes us pay to move to the top of his list.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215151635_0.text: I know. The slaves will pay gold to get on the rotation list.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215151635_1.text: And Bradley passes this gold on to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215151635_2.text: Are you sure that you see ALL of the gold?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152029.text: No. I'm not. I need to have a look at that list.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152104.text: This is Bradley's list of slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152239_0.text: I guess Bradley is cleared, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152430_1.text: What's the problem? You simply stole it from him, didn't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152430_2.text: Ha ha ha. Well, my friend. This is YOUR problem.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215152430.text: You better take this list back to Bradley right away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215153244.text: WHAAAT? What are you doing digging through my stuff?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215153403_0.text: Don't do that again or you'll regret it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215153403.text: Now you have your list back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215153501.text: I ought to skin you alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215153627_0.text: You don't want it any other way, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215164548_1.text: Assuming the rebels have not already plundered it all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215164956_1.text: The divine artifacts of the Ancient Ones, my pale friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215164956_3.text: But now it is gone and out of my reach. Forever.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215164956.text: Tell me more about your artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165213_1.text: They are of inestimable value on the open market.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165517_2.text: Or plainly: I was simply faster than the others.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165517.text: How did you get a divine artifact?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165802_0.text: Are you listening to me at all?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165802_2.text: If anyone knows, it is those cursed royalists.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215165802.text: Who has the divine artifact now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215170915_0.text: It is of inestimable personal value to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215170915.text: If at least I had my old gold casket.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215171925_0.text: It was still lying in the road to the west with your other stuff.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215171925.text: Here is your old gold casket.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215171954.text: You son of a dog, that is fantastic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215172034.text: I will richly reward you for this, my pale friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215173411_1.text: But before you get any silly ideas... we already took everything to Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174220_0.text: If you follow the road to the west, you can still see their old stuff lying around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174220_1.text: We robbed them and drove them off.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174220.text: What desert merchants are you talking about?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174307_0.text: They ran all the way to Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174307_1.text: It would be better for them if they stay there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174307.text: Where are these desert merchants now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174425.text: You'll learn about that soon enough, believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174625.text: Have you come to mock me, too?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174708_0.text: I come from the desert and was traveling through the land with my caravan.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174708_1.text: Those cursed rebel dogs ambushed me outside the city and took everything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174708.text: Seems like you haven't heard about my encounter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174900.text: If you leave the west gate of Montera towards Trelis, you will see my old stuff lying there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174937.text: I know what the orcs are seeking. Why they are digging throughout the land, hoping to find it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215174958.text: And I swear to you, I held one of them in my hands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215175027.text: You mean, other than the fact that the orcs are looking for them like mad?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215175101_0.text: While others perish in the sands of the desert in the sweat of their brow, I used my head.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215175101.text: Let me put it this way, my pale friend...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215180736.text: Greetings, stranger. Why have you come to me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215180924_1.text: I have the honorable task of providing for the continued presence of slaves in this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215181136_0.text: Help is always necessary for someone like me in this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215181136_1.text: As a rule, all the good fighters here are just lapdogs of that Marik.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215181136_2.text: No one has the courage to work on his own initiative.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215182156_0.text: I would like to get them back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215182156_1.text: I assume that they would pose no problem for a strong fighter like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185023.text: Despite my razor-sharp attention, two of my slaves have escaped.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185236.text: You need a man with fighting strength to bring back a broken-down slave?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185547_0.text: Marik just grabbed a slave right out from under my nose and gave him to one of his people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185547_1.text: I knew there was a catch.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185547.text: Well, the case is somewhat more complex.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185756_0.text: Very good, stranger. I knew I could rely on you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185756_1.text: You will receive your reward immediately.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215185756.text: Thorek's slave is working for you again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215190024.text: The fellow who owns my slave now is called Dan. He is a gladiator in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215190351.text: Working for that fat orc Thorek is really tough going.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215190524.text: You're now working for Sobota again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215191542_0.text: One of my slaves now works for the orc smith Thorek.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215191542_1.text: Marik assigned him to the fat orc for cleaning services.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215191542_2.text: He's my property and I want him back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215191542.text: Tell me more about your lost slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215191803.text: But as long as the mercenaries outnumber us in this city, you come to terms with it, or you die.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215192038_0.text: You're good. I never doubted it for a moment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215192038.text: The slave of the gladiator Dan is yours once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215193438.text: If you don't want any trouble with my master, you'd better not talk to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060215193527.text: His name is Dan and he's a gladiator. So watch out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111145_0.text: What do you think you're doing, just walking off with my slave?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111145.text: Hey, stop right there, you bastard!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111331.text: I just take what I want.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111511_0.text: Pay? First, you'll pay for the audacity of stealing from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111511_1.text: Give me 1000 gold coins and we'll forget the whole thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111511.text: I'll pay you for the slave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216111733_0.text: Good. Now give me another 100 for the slave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216112441_0.text: Alright. Then, YOU will have to work for me from now on!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113042_0.text: You will get five pieces of magic ore for my smithy within two days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113042_1.text: And don't even think of being late, otherwise you won't leave the city alive, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113042.text: But not just scrubbing floors, pal. That would be too easy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113220.text: Where is my ore? You ran out of time quite a while ago, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113354_0.text: Grrr. Right. I'm gonna let it slide time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113354_1.text: But you'd better not be yanking my chain.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113354.text: Here are your five lumps of ore.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113514_0.text: Then I'll have to beat it out of you, you runt!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113514.text: I still don't have your magic ore.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113833.text: If you want to buy weapons or learn smithing from me, you'll have to pay for it, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216113859.text: Here's some gold. Now will you trade with me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216121047.text: Aha. Methinks I haven't had the pleasure of putting a fist in your face, have I?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216121123.text: Let's fight in the arena, show-off.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216122025_0.text: Heavens. You pack an incredible punch, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216122434_0.text: There's nothing I would rather do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216122518.text: You're good, friend. But you don't look the part if you ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216122642_0.text: Go ahead and take my slave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216122642_1.text: I have no real use for him anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216123926.text: You look like you could do with a thrashing or two.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124216_0.text: Yes. Marik stuck me with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124216_1.text: No idea what I'm supposed to do with the fellow. You can have him if you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124216_2.text: I will use him as my entry fee for an arena fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124216.text: Is that YOUR slave over there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124410_0.text: About Marik? He's got all kinds of problems with this bunch of losers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124410_1.text: But as far as I can see, he's got it all under control.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124655_0.text: Nothing would work here if it weren't for Marik, that's for sure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216124655.text: What do you think of Marik?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216125342_0.text: I would love to beat him in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216125342_1.text: The others think the world of him, but it's all just bullshit if you ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216125342_2.text: Marik is a total loser, I'd bet my head on that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216131722_0.text: Yep. Marik is good. We mercenaries don't have this much freedom anywhere in the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132109_1.text: You look pretty clueless to me. Running around here, babbling at everybody...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132355_0.text: Alright. I guess I'd better get my weary bones moving, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132355.text: Fight with me in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132508_0.text: You have a curious fighting style, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132508_1.text: Well. In any case, you beat me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132508.text: Missing anything? Like maybe your dignity?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216132945.text: Whatever. Now I will show you everything a thief can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216133101.text: I'm looking for a teacher. Can you teach me something?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216133741_0.text: All right. See you in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216133841.text: Not bad. You knocked me right over, man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216133958_0.text: If you beat me, I'll give you 500 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216133958.text: What's the prize if I defeat you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216134133.text: Fedor thinks you are a weakling.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216134513_0.text: Ah yes. I suspected as much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216134513_1.text: It's high time I once again showed the boys in the arena who's boss.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216134513.text: He says he could defeat you in the arena hands down.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140011_0.text: Before you get to fight in my arena, you must pay me your entry fee.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140345_0.text: No way, pal. You're not going to get away with that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140345_1.text: Pay your entry fee or get lost.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140451_0.text: Who is supposed to believe THAT?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140451_1.text: Trying to play me for a sucker, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216140822.text: Has everyone here paid an entry fee?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216141108.text: Great. Welcome to the Montera arena. Ha ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216141344.text: No entry fee, no fight. It's as easy as that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216143300_0.text: Don't want to, huh? Get lost then, you quitter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145236.text: 500 gold coins, or get outta here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145352.text: You will get your gold back, along with mine, once you have defeated ME in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145748_0.text: Whoa, kid. I'm the champion here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145748_1.text: Maybe you should warm up a little before you dare to challenge me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145748_2.text: I'm not going to enter the arena with you until there is nobody else left here to fight you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216145748.text: I want you to fight me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216152528_0.text: You really want to go up against ME?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216152528_1.text: Be my guest, then. You get what you ask for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216152528.text: Prepare yourself, great champion. There is nobody left but the two of us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216153318_0.text: You broke all my bones, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216153318_1.text: Stop crying already. I want my gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216153755_0.text: Amazing. You have reason to be proud.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216153755.text: I heard that you defeated Ashton in a fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216154045.text: I've heard that you are the new arena champion in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216154242.text: So how about it, arena champion?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216154417_0.text: No one's ever done that before.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216154417.text: Wow. You knocked Ashton right out of his boots.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216154520.text: We have a new arena champion!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216155650_0.text: So? What are you going to do about it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216155650.text: You're bilking Marik out of his gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216160028_0.text: So? What are you going to do about it now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216160028.text: You ratted me out with Marik, you swine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216160132.text: Grrr. I'm looking forward to sweeping the arena floor with you, scumbag.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216160619.text: Grrr. Get out of my sight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216161016_1.text: Grrr. And my 500 gold coins too. Happy now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216161016.text: Yeah, yeah. Here's your prize money back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216161801.text: Give your starting fee to Ashton, and there you are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216161915.text: Once you have paid Ashton, that is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216162314.text: Pay your starting fee with Ashton already. I want to fight against you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216162815.text: You need to pay Ashton in order to fight here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171513.text: Is there anything here besides booze?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171826_0.text: Montera is a trading city and, how could it be otherwise, occupied by the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171826_1.text: But the orcs mostly stay inside the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171826_2.text: The orcs' mercenaries rule the outer districts of Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171826.text: Tell me something about this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171921_0.text: Well. So so. Marik is the leader of the troop.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216171921.text: How do you get along with the mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172006.text: If the boys cause any trouble, Marik gives them a rap on the knuckles.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172204.text: Where do I find this Marik?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172318.text: His hut is diagonally across from the bar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172508.text: But he's also often found at the inner castle gate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172823_0.text: His name is Varek. So far, I haven't laid eyes on him myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172823_1.text: Up to now, he hasn't come out of the inner castle yard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216172823.text: Who leads the orcs in this city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173119.text: Every piece of information costs five gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173704_0.text: A fighter like you should join the mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173704_1.text: That's probably best for you and makes you a lot of gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173704_2.text: The real fat cats in the city, of course, are the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173704_3.text: But for that, you have to be tolerated inside the castle by the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216173704.text: Is there any work to be had here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175408_1.text: I thought I'd take a break here in this hut.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175408_2.text: No one's using it now anyways.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175408_3.text: But I think I'd better get back to work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175841_0.text: That old shack, you mean? You can have it if you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175841_1.text: No one's been living there for ages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216175841.text: What about the hut next to your house?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216180958_0.text: Fresh water, new tools, unused torches?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216180958_1.text: As long as the gold is right, I can get you anything you want, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216180958.text: How can I be of assistance?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216181034_0.text: Certainly. Just tell me what you need.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216181331_0.text: Sure, you only need to ask.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216181331.text: Do you also sell your wares?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216181635.text: This is the merchant quarter of the city. But don't expect too much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182043.text: Since the orcs started digging up the whole city, very few merchants have found their way to Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182316_0.text: Wherever there are ruins of the Ancient Ones left, the orcs dig up everything they can find.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182316_1.text: Who knows what they're looking for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182316_2.text: I've heard that meanwhile there are excavations like this in almost every city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182316.text: Tell me more about the excavations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182807_0.text: I'm the boss here if that's what you mean.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216182807_1.text: I see to it that the stockyard works as it should.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216183108_0.text: Great. I've got something for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216183108_1.text: My people are obviously too stupid to deal with this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216183108_2.text: Lately, a pack of stray wolves has been roaming the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216183108_3.text: They creep up to the yard at night and eat our livestock from right under our noses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216183336.text: I would pay you a good deal if you could make them go away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326_0.text: One more thing. Those beasts are damn clever.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326_1.text: They must be hiding out somewhere when it's light outside.
