INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326_2.text: You will hardly catch them out in the open.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326_3.text: I would imagine they have a cave somewhere near Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326_4.text: They're only wolves. I'll find them. Trust me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184326.text: I will take care of the wolves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184500_0.text: You mean I can relax now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184500.text: The stray wolves have been eliminated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060216184657_0.text: That's a comforting thought. Good job.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100021.text: What is it? Are you unhappy with your pay as well?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100203_0.text: Then what do want here? I am busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100203_1.text: If I don't watch out, the slaves will take off, and the boys will just hang around and be idle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100203.text: Slow down. I'm not one of your people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100455_0.text: Yes, dammit. Go ahead and rub it in.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100455_1.text: Not enough that this Marik is constantly after me, my own people are making fun of me now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217100455.text: Slaves are escaping from your farm?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104119.text: That's no way to talk to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104413_0.text: We can discuss that while we cross our blades.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104413.text: Well, well, well. Another no good tramp who wants my job...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104549.text: Get lost already. I have better things to do than picking fights with tramps.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104843_0.text: No way, I have no use for a troublemaker like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104843.text: Relax, I want to work for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217104951.text: I've got better things to do than keeping an eye on the likes of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110100_0.text: Great suggestion. The only thing that could motivate them now is alcohol.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110100_1.text: We're either going to be stabbed by grain thieves, or overrun by the undead from the castle to the east.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110100.text: You should get your lads going somehow. Light a fire under them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110905_0.text: The royalists are lying low in the mountains, or hanging around outside of Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110905_1.text: The rebels aren't a serious threat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110905_2.text: The grain thieves up north are more cause for worry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217110905_3.text: They will come at night and steal those sacks of wheat right from under our noses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111104_0.text: You want to do what my people haven't accomplished in weeks?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111104_1.text: Ha. Go ahead. I want to see that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111104.text: I will take care of the grain thieves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806_0.text: Don't tell me you sent them all running.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806_2.text: Amazing. That was no mean feat!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806_3.text: Wouldn't you like to work for ME?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806_5.text: Ha. That's true. And not for free, either.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806_6.text: I will pay YOU the money that my people were going to get. Just don't spend it all on booze.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217111806.text: You won't lose any more sleep over those grain thieves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217112200_0.text: He is an orc mercenary, just like me. Marik is our leader here in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217112200_1.text: He sees to it that everybody works and doesn't just do what they damn well want to.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217112200_2.text: I'd like to know how he does that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217112401.text: Elber is having massive problems leading his people on the grain farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217113124.text: Mmh. You think I should replace him?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217113604_0.text: Go to Montera. He's there most of the time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217113939_0.text: This is getting better and better. Is there no end in sight?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217113939_1.text: All right, YOU take care of it. I can't do everything, can I?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217113939.text: One of your slaves is in contact with the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217114758_0.text: Oh, damn. I have a feeling that I'm going to regret this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217114758_1.text: First show me what you've got. Then maybe I'll think about it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217114758.text: I think you may need my help.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217115707_0.text: If you follow the path to the east, it will take you to the old paladin stronghold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217115707_1.text: It's nothing but ruins these days, but still inhabited, if you get my drift.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217115707_2.text: I wouldn't go too close to the castle if I were you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217120004.text: I can't even handle the handful of people here on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217140136.text: I'm halfway expecting to wake up with a slashed throat while my own people are snoring in the hay, sleeping off a hangover.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217140318_0.text: Take them to Montera, together with the ones here on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217140318.text: What about those stolen sacks of wheat?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217140622_0.text: What do you know. There are some reliable people left after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217140622.text: I took your sacks of wheat to Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141043.text: The boys must be waiting for them by now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141332_0.text: You don't work for the orc mercenaries, do you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141332.text: Psst. Hey, you. You look different from the others here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141353.text: I'll work for anyone who pays enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141519.text: Mmh. Then you aren't the one I'm looking for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141744_0.text: Unfortunately. That wasn't always the case.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141744_1.text: But today, there isn't much choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217141744.text: You're one of the slaves, aren't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217142009_0.text: Alright. Then I didn't say anything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144439.text: I'm not a mercenary for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144508.text: Then maybe you are the one I'm looking for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144717_0.text: I must get out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144717_1.text: But the mercenaries are watching my every step.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144717_2.text: I need someone strong who can distract them while I make a run for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144956_0.text: Ah, what have I got to lose?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217144956.text: It's pretty brave of you, telling me something like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150215_0.text: The rebels are waiting for me there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150215_1.text: I have a very important message for them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150215.text: I have to get to Okara. And as fast as possible.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150301.text: Either you help me now, or I'm done for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150458_0.text: Forget it. I was careless enough telling you about it at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150458.text: What sort of message for the rebels?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150739.text: Alright. I'll get you out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217150846.text: How are you going to do that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217151916_0.text: Run, he said. And like an idiot, I did, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217151916.text: Holy crap, what kind of ingenious plan was that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152122.text: The mercenaries at the grain farm have other worries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152239.text: That's enough of that. You want to go to Okara, don't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152330_0.text: Okara is awfully far away and the area is full of dangerous beasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152330.text: Yes, but I'll never make it alone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152941_1.text: Say, are you trying to mess with me? Run already, you idiot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217152941.text: I'll accompany you to Okara. Run.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217153235_0.text: All right, you can relax now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217153235_1.text: Thank you, friend. I will never forget this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217153235_2.text: Thanks are nice. Rewards are better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217153235_3.text: Mmh. You can have everything I still own. Here, take it all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217153235_4.text: This is Okara. Yes, this is it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217172010_0.text: Yes, I know. That swine is mocking me, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217172010_1.text: Let him, then. He who laughs last laughs best.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060217172010.text: Dennis set your hay bales on fire.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301131131.text: We need a teleporter stone from Gotha in order to find out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301131738_0.text: It is said that he shows promise. Mmh. I see they do not exaggerate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301131738.text: I heard that a new man had entered our camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301131903_0.text: I hold Okara together as best I can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301131903_1.text: It is hellish. Especially since we have already lost more than half of our men.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301132135_0.text: Montera has decimated us. Since the siege by the orcs, we reconnoiter the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301132135_1.text: Up to now, the orcs have discovered and destroyed almost all of our outposts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301132954_0.text: I am afraid we simply waited too long for the opportune moment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301132954.text: Why haven't you ever attacked Montera?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301133804_0.text: Hah. We would not survive a frontal assault, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301133804_1.text: With these few people, we wouldn't even get through the outer ring of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301134840_0.text: Yes. I was a warrior of the king, like all my comrades-in-arms in Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301134840_1.text: Our arrogance was as great as our ignominious defeat at the hands of the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301135243.text: Nevertheless, I still wear my armor with pride.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301140303_0.text: Once it was the headquarters of the paladins of the land, until it was overrun by the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301140303_1.text: Today, the dead roam the streets of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301140303_2.text: The orc shamans laid a terrible curse on the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301140303.text: Gotha lies in the east, between Faring and Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301142647.text: The stone takes one directly into the king's capital.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301143338_0.text: Damn. Then we are on our own now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153019.text: In order to stay out of the hands of the orcs, he has barricaded himself in the keep of Vengard, the capital.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733_0.text: You actually did it? Very good, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733_1.text: Tell me, how can we best serve Rhobar?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733_2.text: It would be best if you remain entrenched here at Okara for now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733_3.text: Very well. We will wait. For the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733_4.text: Here. Your reward for the good news.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301153733.text: I have spoken to the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301154159_0.text: Then use it. Quickly. Speak to the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301154159.text: I have a teleporter stone to the capital, Vengard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155031_3.text: I hope that Myrtana will soon belong to humans once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155031_4.text: Here. This will help you on your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155347.text: You must find another way to drive the orcs from Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155535.text: Well done. We need more people of your stripe.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155719_0.text: By Innos! The curse of the shamans is broken at last.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155719_1.text: Every honest person in the land owes you his thanks, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301155719.text: The undead in Gotha have been defeated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301160202.text: You will need it to rebuild Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301160315.text: Let the city rise again in all its old glory.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301160519.text: Talk to Shawn. He will make the necessary arrangements.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451_0.text: At first, the battle for Gotha went in our favor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451_1.text: Until the orc shamans conjured up that miserable demon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451_2.text: That spawn of hell swept through the streets of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451_3.text: The monster transformed every honest human into a soulless creature.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451_4.text: It was as though hell itself fell upon us. All we could do was flee.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161451.text: What sort of curse is on Gotha?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161738_0.text: Don't be a fool. The demon is certainly still there. You had better stay away from him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301161738.text: I will take care of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301162331.text: Gotha has been lost to us forever.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301163904_0.text: Alright. I'll go to Gotha and take care of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301163904_1.text: But I need gold for it. At least 1000 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301164055_0.text: Thanks, friend. That will be enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301164055.text: Here is 1000 gold to rebuild Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060301165157.text: Do you really know what a grind it is to rebuild an entire city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302111420_0.text: I'm tending this iron mine here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302111420_1.text: In addition, I'm making sure that we don't sink into poverty despite the difficult situation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302111753_0.text: Before the war, I was a simple farmer in Geldern. Today, I collect artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302111753.text: I see. You're a thief and you steal for the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302112752_0.text: These days, the relics of the Ancient Ones have increased tremendously in value.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302112752_1.text: Some of them are even said to possess magical abilities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302112752_2.text: The divine artifacts seem to be the most valuable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302112752_3.text: They say that the last patrol out of Montera found one of those things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302112903.text: Where is this divine artifact now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113047_0.text: They had the artifact with them. The leader of the patrol thought it would help them in the fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113047.text: Roland sent a reconnaissance patrol to Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113132.text: Ask Roland. He can tell you more about it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113348_0.text: The paladin Roland is sitting in that cave over there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113348.text: Where can I find your boss?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302113936.text: I take from the rich and give to the men here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302115643.text: I have sent any men I could spare to find a way to the capital, Vengard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302120426_1.text: I believe that was the most foolish thing I have ever done.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302120426.text: Where are the people you sent to find a way to Vengard now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302121903_0.text: We can use every man here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302121903.text: A new face. Welcome to Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302122047_1.text: Lately our leader, Roland, has been using up all of our reserves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302122254_0.text: Smith, cook, prospector, and heaven knows what else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302122254_1.text: The fewer people we have, the more tasks I need to take over.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302122819.text: We can use everyone we can get.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302130123.text: There's nobody left out there who will come to Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302130305.text: All right, then we will have to make do with the people we've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302130558_0.text: Mmh. I still need some iron ore. About five pieces.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302130558_1.text: Can you get it for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302130852.text: It'll all work out somehow. Thanks for your help.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131331_0.text: Thanks. You've done enough for me now, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131331_1.text: Take this as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131331.text: Here you go, five pieces of iron ore.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131522_0.text: We can always use more hunters. Thank you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131522.text: Fraser the hunter will work for Okara from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131815_0.text: Very good. I hope he isn't the last man you find for us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302131815.text: Candela the hunter will stay in Okara from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132148_0.text: Mmh. I know that yellowbelly. But fine. Better than nothing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132148.text: I've got a new man for you. His name is Kent.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132609_0.text: Wow. Where did you dig HIM up?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132609_1.text: Good job, friend. Carry on like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132609.text: I found a strong fighter for you. Randall.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132914_0.text: Great! A mage is just what we need.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132914_1.text: We'll certainly give him a hearty welcome. Very well done, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302132914.text: Rakus the Fire Mage wants to join you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302133019_0.text: Bring him here, then. Good work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302133019.text: A prospector named Owen is quite eager to join you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302133337_0.text: Very good. He's probably bringing news from Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302133337_1.text: Thanks for getting him here safely, friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302133337.text: Rufus the farmer has a message for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302135347_0.text: Hah. This here is the largest rebel weapons forge in the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302135347_1.text: I can certainly sell you something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302140936_0.text: This is where we make most of the weapons that the rebels need to fight the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302140936_1.text: Our iron mine provides the raw materials we need.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302140936.text: Tell me more about the weapons forge.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302141250.text: It's nothing like the magic ore mines of Nordmar, but still enough to make the orcs take an interest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302143934_0.text: Look around Okara and on the farms of Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302143934.text: If you know any free humans who would agree to fight for the king, bring them here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302143959.text: I'll get some more people for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302144319.text: I'm sure there must be some lost souls out there who would agree to come here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302144445_0.text: Go down into the mine. He's cave is down there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302144445.text: Where can I find your leader?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302144804.text: You look strong. You're just what I need.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302144931.text: Looks like you're not all that puny yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302145226_0.text: It contains what must be the richest mine I have ever seen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302145226_1.text: Boy, you can find everything there. Gold, iron, sulphur...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302145226.text: Do you see that cave over there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302145743_0.text: The mine is full of beasts. That's why there isn't anyone else here plundering the mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302145743_1.text: But... if we join up, we could clean out the mine. What do you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302153508.text: That's what I want to hear. Get ready and follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302153626.text: Well, did I promise too much?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302153805.text: Just look at the size of those gold nuggets.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302153933_0.text: You go and clear the rest of the mine, and I'll start plundering it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302154912_0.text: You mean there aren't any more beasts alive to bother us?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302154912_1.text: Very good, boy. Now we can ransack the mine undisturbed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302155351.text: I'll give you 300 gold coins. Will you go to Okara now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302155644_0.text: But when I come back, I don't want the WHOLE mine plundered, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302155644.text: Alright, I'll go. In the meantime, you keep an eye on our mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302160201.text: I was on my way to Okara when I stumbled across this mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302160411.text: I'm Randall. I'm a fighter and I want to join the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302160650.text: The rebels in Okara need strong men like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302160732.text: You really think I would abandon the fat booty in this mine!? You're out of your mind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302161106_0.text: Not far. A bit farther east of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162130.text: Hey, stranger. Have you got some decent booze for a miner down on his luck?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162454_0.text: I lost everything that was near and dear to me in the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162454_1.text: I'm waiting for an orc patrol to scoop me up and send me to work in the mines.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162454.text: I'm a homeless miner. My name is Owen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162633.text: I want to drink myself into oblivion.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162851_0.text: Thanks, man. That's just what I need right now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302162851.text: Here you go, a bottle of booze.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163336.text: I have a better idea than handing you over to the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163337_0.text: Okara? Yeah, I know where that is. It's an old iron mine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163337_1.text: But I always thought it was blocked up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163337.text: Join the rebels. Okara isn't far from here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163514_0.text: Well, what am I doing sitting around here, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302163514.text: Okara's mine is still being worked.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302164153.text: I'll give you this healing potion as thanks. I don't like the stuff anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302164538.text: Psst. Are you crazy? Don't be so loud, or do you want to wake the dead?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302164839.text: Since when does a little noise wake the dead?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302165953_0.text: Mmh, let's put it this way: I was experimenting a bit with the ancient magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302165953_2.text: Yes, and I'm afraid I rather lost control of the whole thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302170204_0.text: Yes. I used to be. Just like the others of my rank.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302170204_1.text: But without our rune magic, we are nothing more than shadows of our former selves these days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302170242.text: Tell me. What have you done?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171300_0.text: I wanted to learn to summon the undead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171300_1.text: And I have almost achieved my goal, except for one small detail.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171300.text: I have assimilated the dark magical arts of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171404.text: What went wrong with your experiment?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171459.text: I allowed myself to become involved with the spawn of hell and now I am a part of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171720.text: I am now a prisoner of my own folly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302171956.text: If I attempt to leave this cave, the dead will stop me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302172218.text: I'll get you out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302172306.text: And now I'm trapped in this cave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302172441.text: Do you think you can do that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302172547.text: All right. I will try. But you must cover my back, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302172737_0.text: Innos preserve us, here they come already!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302173515_0.text: If you don't, they will pursue me everywhere, do you hear?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302173515.text: You must destroy the rest of this spawn as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302173719_1.text: I swear that I will never again make such a grave mistake.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302173719_2.text: Thank you, stranger. Take this from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302173719.text: Your undead will no longer prevent anyone from doing anything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174018.text: The rebels in Okara could use your help.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174104.text: The royalists need me, you say? Mmh.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174516_0.text: You have done enough for me. Don't worry, I will find Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174516_1.text: Once again, thank you for your help. Innos be with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174516.text: I have heard of it. I don't think you need to guide me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302174608.text: Fine, then I'll have to find a way to get to them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180459_0.text: Dammit, how did you get in here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180649_0.text: Have you had a look outside of the cave?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180649_1.text: Those malicious ripperbeasts run around up there like they own the place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180649_2.text: I have no idea how you managed to get past those nasty brutes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180649.text: You're rather jumpy for a warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180925_0.text: Bah, you loudmouth. You'll never pull that off.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180925_1.text: I'll wager 100 gold coins on that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302180925.text: Would you feel better if I killed the ripperbeasts for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181248_2.text: Well. Guess I'll have to thank you for this, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181533_0.text: So? Why would that concern me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181533.text: The rebels in Okara need more people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181642.text: I'm not going anywhere as long as those beasts are out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181933_0.text: I'm curious to hear how you plan to persuade me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302181933.text: I want you to go to Okara.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302182101.text: Go to Okara. Here, take 300 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302182406.text: Mmh. Since you're asking so nicely. Thank you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302182625_0.text: No, no. I know you would stop at nothing. I'll go - voluntarily.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302182625.text: Go to Okara, or I'll skin you alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184417.text: Hey. You've got courage, running around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184550_0.text: Well, because of all the nasty beasts in the vicinity.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184550_1.text: Takes quite a bit of nerve to move about here freely.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184550.text: Why would I need courage to come here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184823_0.text: I'm a hunter. I'm after wild boars.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302184928_0.text: Just like I said - you've got nerve.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185015_0.text: Follow me. I know where some of them are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185015.text: But all right. You asked for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185321_0.text: Good thing. You know how to hunt profitably, do you? Ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185321.text: Those nasty wild boars are dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185403.text: Here, take this. That will make it even easier.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185701_1.text: Well, we'll see, maybe I'll go there and have a look at Okara from the inside.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185701.text: The rebels in Okara could really use someone like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060302185946_0.text: All right, since you insist... I'll go have a look at it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103017_0.text: I've hunted everything there is to hunt in this country, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103303.text: Shadowbeast hunting? I could tell you a thing or two about that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103507_0.text: There are two really nasty specimens near these ruins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103507_1.text: Why don't you show me your hunting prowess?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103738_0.text: I'd pay you a very good price for the beasts' horns.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303103905_0.text: Do that. Meanwhile, I'll be waiting here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303104053_0.text: Well then... good luck. You'll need it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303104053.text: All right. I'll deal with the nasty creatures.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303104240_0.text: Well done. I'd say you've really got what it takes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303105710.text: Will you sell me the beasts' horns?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303105812_0.text: Thanks a lot. Here is the gold and 2 healing potions.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303105812.text: Here are your two shadowbeast horns.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303105851.text: I'll give you 200 gold coins and 3 healing potions for them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303110320_0.text: Rebels in the iron mine? So that's where they're hiding.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303110320.text: The rebels in Okara need people like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303110937.text: The boys are clever. I have to give them that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303111237.text: Why don't you work for the rebels from now on?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303111729.text: But I don't want to let the shadowbeasts out there slip through my fingers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303112133_0.text: If you say so. All right. We'll meet there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303112133.text: Go to Okara. The boys need men like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303112233.text: And don't forget, you were going to sell me the horns, weren't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060303171007.text: Hey, you. Why are you running around here free, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101350.text: There you are at last. Get me out of here, dammit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101916_0.text: I tried to find the teleporter stone to the capital Vengard in Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101916_1.text: But unfortunately, it's teeming with skeletons and zombies up there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101916_2.text: They are led by a pretty nasty demon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101916_3.text: Well, and while we were fleeing those monsters, the orcs got their hands on me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306101916.text: Gorn. What have you been up to this time?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306103151.text: How can I get you out of here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306110407.text: Either you take on the entire orc camp, or you pay them my ransom.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306110420.text: I would rather try and fight the demon in Gotha again than slowly rot in here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306110654_0.text: Thanks, friend. I knew I could count on you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306112346_0.text: The rebels of Okara want to get to the king's castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306112346_1.text: They say there's a teleporter stone for the capital in Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306112346.text: Why would you want a teleporter stone?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306113047_0.text: He sent me to find a way to get to the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306113047_1.text: The rebels in Okara seemed to be the best starting point to achieve this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306113047.text: Our friend Lee still has a bone to pick with the king, as you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306113548_0.text: Okara is an iron ore mine west of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306113548_1.text: The rebels are forging weapons there for their fight against the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306115814_0.text: Gotha is the likeness of hell.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306115814_1.text: You will tremble, too, once that demon is after you, believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306115814.text: Since when have you been afraid of the undead?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120157_0.text: Ha! Don't tell me - you did it again!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120157_1.text: I can only hope for both of us that you'll never meet your match, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120157.text: The demon of Gotha will never scare anyone again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120305.text: Let's kill this demon in Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120442_0.text: But what the heck? Who wants to live forever, anyway? Hahaha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306120442.text: I'm really not too keen on going back in there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306121911.text: All right. Follow me. I know the way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306122242_0.text: He's running around somewhere in the icy wastes of Nordmar, beating up orcs and stuff.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306122640.text: Just look at this mess. This used to be a proud paladin stronghold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306123535_0.text: I will try to rebuild Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306123535_1.text: There are enough people out there looking for a place to stay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306123535_2.text: Don't get yourself killed, my friend. That would be a waste.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306123626.text: This mess is more fun when you're in it, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306133704.text: Why would you go and attack a city if you know it's haunted by such a terrible demon?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306134033_0.text: Some idiot talked me into believing that it makes you invincible.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306134033_1.text: Forget it. The demon was still way too strong for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306134033.text: The rebels gave me this divine artifact, you see?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306134727_0.text: Arrgh. I dropped it when I was fighting the demon in Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306134727_1.text: That monster must have taken the artifact with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306135635.text: Tell me when the action starts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306143439_0.text: I am the leader of this outpost of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306144213_0.text: Gotha and its castle of miserable Morra fighters called themselves paladins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306144213_1.text: Once so proud, now they are damned to eternal life and wander through the remains of their buildings in Gotha. Ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306144213.text: Outpost? What are you guarding here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150324_0.text: We used everything we had, but we just couldn't defeat them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150324_1.text: They dug themselves into their castle like ticks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150324_2.text: Only when we called Beliar himself for help were we able to put an end to their arrogance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150324.text: You really have no idea what's going on here, do you? Gotha was the stronghold of the paladins in the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150910_0.text: That's probably too hard for your little birdbrain to figure out, isn't it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150910_1.text: We are here to contain the power of the demon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306150910.text: If a demon rules the city, why are you guarding it, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306151831.text: He will be executed when the time is ripe, with many Morras watching.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152508.text: How much do I have to pay you to release the prisoner?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152647_0.text: It would take a whole lot of gold for me to abandon my principles.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152647_2.text: Ha. More than you can afford. 2000 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152647.text: You must be out of your mind, Morra, to think I can be bribed like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152724.text: Here, take the gold. Release the prisoner.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306152749.text: You would give me that much gold for a dirty rebel, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306155723_0.text: Beat it, Morra, and spread your lies somewhere else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306155723.text: The demon of Gotha is history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306160812_1.text: The castle up there is full of undead, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306160812_2.text: You had better get out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306161442_0.text: Potros is in the house with the tall tower over there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060306161528_0.text: If you have gold, why not?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060307123036.text: The rest of the rebel troop didn't make it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309113910_0.text: Do you need food, clothes, or maybe a hefty swig from the bottle?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309113910_1.text: Marlo will sell you everything you need here on the coast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309113910.text: Welcome, stranger. What can I do for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309114612.text: Items such as silver, gold, and jewels, I take everything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309122904_0.text: Many refugees have joined us in Reddock lately, but your face isn't familiar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123227_0.text: I'm the most experienced man here when it comes to fighting orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123227_1.text: I guess that would make me something like a leader of this rebel camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123456_0.text: I used to be a paladin before the orcs won the war for themselves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123456_1.text: I fought for the king in the last battle for Vengard, the capital.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123524.text: Now I'm just a refugee, just like everybody else here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123627.text: Tell me more about the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123814_0.text: Once we paladins lost our magic and ran out of magic ore, we didn't stand a chance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123814_1.text: We ended up being easy prey for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309123814.text: There isn't much to say about that, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309134836_0.text: In the north. You must cross the mountains that separate the coast from the interior to get there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309145202_0.text: Just walk around here and ask the people in the camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309145202_1.text: We need to prepare for the revolution in Cape Dun.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309152014_1.text: Then, from this moment, we shall devote ourselves to rebuilding the coastal region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309152014_2.text: Here's your share, the fight must go on. For the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309152800.text: Explain this revolution thing to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309160801_0.text: But some of us rebels are lying low within the cities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309160801_1.text: When the time comes, the rebels will mobilize both slaves and free humans for the revolution.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309160801.text: The cities of Myrtana are ruled by orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309161046.text: You must find these undercover rebels and follow their orders if you want to support us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309162137.text: Who is the undercover rebel in Cape Dun?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309162219.text: He's moving among the slaves in Cape Dun so he won't be recognized.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309162616_0.text: So do we. Unfortunately, there is one small problem with that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309162616_1.text: Our last smith died in combat. Since then, our smithy has been abandoned.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309162802.text: If you know somebody who could take his place, send him to us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309163101_1.text: Now we can resupply our weapon stock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309163101.text: Kliff is a blacksmith and will work for you from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309163242.text: There are many possibilities for furthering our cause.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309163609.text: I will not tell you who it is. I don't know you well enough for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309164036_0.text: So, you've already been to Reddock as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309164036_1.text: It's good to know that Reddock still exists.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309172805_0.text: I'm taking care of our forces in Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309172805_1.text: We keep training and trying to prepare as best we can for a battle with the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309173123.text: I'll show you how to handle weapons if you make yourself useful for our camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309173459_0.text: Our smithy has been shut down for days, but the battles with the orcs haven't decreased.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309173459.text: What should I do for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309174410.text: If you bring us five bundles of weapons, that would help our cause tremendously.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309174628_0.text: Where there are orcs, there are weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309174628_1.text: Mostly they can't do anything with human weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309174628_2.text: So they collect those, pack them in bundles, and store them somewhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309174628.text: Where can I find bundles of weapons?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309175742_1.text: Here is some gold for your trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309175742.text: Here are five bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309182907.text: Is this a former mine, by any chance?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309182951.text: It's possible. But if that is the case, then nothing has been mined here for years.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183140.text: We found these caves the way they are now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183240.text: We just had to clean them of some cave beasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183411.text: If I were you, I wouldn't venture too far into this cave system.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183600_0.text: We haven't completely explored them yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183600_1.text: There's supposed to be another exit somewhere to the east.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309183600_2.text: Unfortunately, the eastern caves are teeming with beasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184047_0.text: That's insane, stranger! You should prepare if you want to have any chance at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184047.text: I will eliminate the beasts from your eastern passage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184343_0.text: You mean the beasts are gone? Incredible!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184343_1.text: This will make my guard duty by the southern exit much more relaxed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184343_2.text: Thanks. That's worth a few gold coins to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184534_0.text: I'm on guard duty. I'm watching the southern exit of Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309184843.text: In my spare time, I train in the arena for the real thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185146_0.text: Why not? A little more training can't hurt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185146.text: Would you fight me in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185312.text: Well, that wasn't much to write home about. You should train some more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185455.text: Go to Norris. He can show you a few tricks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185702_0.text: Here, have this healing potion. It'll help with your wounds.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309185702.text: Well fought! You just knocked me off my feet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309190238.text: The closed-off area over there is our training arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309192259_0.text: That's the best training there is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309192259_1.text: Unfortunately, the orcs agree completely. They have an arena of their own in almost every city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309192259_2.text: They value a fighter who wins arena battles very highly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060309192259.text: You fight against each other in your arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_0.text: You challenge someone to fight and meet him in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_1.text: As soon as you enter the arena, it starts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_3.text: Not quite... there are two rules.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_4.text: First - anyone who leaves the arena in the middle of a fight loses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_5.text: Second - when one of the fighters is on the ground and doesn't get back up, the fight is over.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144_6.text: If you kick someone who's down or kill your opponent, you will be called to account by everyone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310101144.text: How exactly does the arena work?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310104841_0.text: All right. But don't forget that this is only a sparring match.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310104841.text: Fight with me in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310105012.text: But first, you should have Norris explain the rules of an arena fight to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310105513.text: Hey. You look like you could take a beating or two.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310105655.text: What about a little fight in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310105842.text: You want to go up against me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310110055.text: Let Norris explain the arena fighting rules to you, and then let the fun begin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310110157_0.text: All right, so let's see what you've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310110547_0.text: Next time you meet someone in the arena, try staying in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310110713_0.text: Looks like you need my help if you want to survive the world out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310110759.text: Ask Norris about it, he's a fighting instructor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310111157_0.text: Good job. You've got what it takes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310111157_1.text: If you need a comrade-in-arms to fight by your side, I'm your man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113014_0.text: You show a lot of promise. All you need is a little more experience.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113014_1.text: I will go wherever you go and fight whoever you fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113014.text: You want to fight at my side?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113703.text: You really should hone your skills.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113853_0.text: Looks like you need my help if you want to survive the world out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310113853.text: You're not all that experienced yet, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310114144.text: Once you no longer need me, just send me back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310114301_0.text: I need some training, and you look like you might be an equal opponent.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310114301.text: You're among friends here. We humans must stick together against the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310121305_0.text: What can I do for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310121305.text: What? Ah, yes. I... I am a bit jumpy. I'm sorry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310121511_0.text: My name is Sebastian. I am the alchemist here in Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310121906_1.text: Then came the day when we Fire Mages lost our rune magic, and soon after that the war was over.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310121906.text: You wear the clothes of a Fire Mage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310124706.text: Why did you Fire Mages lose your magic?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310124858.text: The robe is all that I have left of my rank.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310125616_0.text: All I know is that we could no longer hold off the orcs without our rune magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310125616_1.text: Many Fire Mages were killed and those that survived the debacle fled to the woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310125616.text: I have spent many sleepless nights trying to answer that question.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310130508_0.text: I will stay here in Reddock and study the ancient writings of our ancestors.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310130508_1.text: Legend has it that the Ancient Ones possessed their own kind of magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310130508_2.text: It was completely independent of aids such as the runes from which we drew our magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131316_0.text: All that is certain is that the Ancient Ones existed and that their artifacts can be found everywhere in the ruins, even today.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131316_1.text: The only way to learn more about their magic is to unravel the mystery of those ruins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131316_2.text: All the surviving Fire Mages are researching the ancient knowledge.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131316.text: Tell me more about the magic of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131733_0.text: It is the only way of healing and strengthening yourself without magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131733_1.text: I am no expert, but my abilities are enough to supply Reddock with what is absolutely necessary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310131901.text: Teach me what you know about alchemy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310140719_0.text: If you can get me ten healing plants, I will share my knowledge with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310140719.text: I would gladly do that. But unfortunately, I don't have enough ingredients to teach you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310141526_0.text: These plants grow almost everywhere. I don't think you will have a problem finding them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310141526.text: I'll get you some healing plants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310141625_0.text: Wonderful. Now I can share my knowledge with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310141625.text: Here are your ten healing plants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310142009.text: Before the war, I was a high Mage of the Fire.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144336_0.text: Orc scouts are everywhere in this region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144336.text: Be very careful when roaming through the woods here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144807_0.text: This is the largest rebel camp on the coast. We call it Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144807_1.text: Many royalists who haven't yet been enslaved by the orcs are hiding here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144807.text: Tell me more about this place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310144905.text: The orcs don't know about this rebel camp?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310145000.text: If the orcs knew we were hiding out here, they would have certainly killed us by now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310145232.text: Tell me more about the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310153054_0.text: Orc patrols are our biggest problem here on the coast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310153054_1.text: Last night, they came dangerously close.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154146_0.text: One orc patrol is constantly on the move, right now, they are between us and Ardea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154146_1.text: Another has parked itself on a farm to the east, between here and Cape Dun.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154146.text: Where are the orc patrols now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154600_0.text: Be careful. If they take you for a rebel, they will chop you to pieces.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154600.text: I will go visit the orc patrol on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154858_0.text: Thanks be to Innos. That troop really gave me a headache.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154858_1.text: I really don't want to know how you did it. Well done, anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154858_2.text: Here's a share of our gold, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310154858.text: The orc patrol on the farm is no more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310155603.text: I'll take care of the roaming orc patrol.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310155715.text: Do that. But be careful so they don't find our camp here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310160157_0.text: That's great. They were coming dangerously close.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310160157_1.text: Good job. Here's your share of our gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310160157.text: The roaming orc patrol has been destroyed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310161429_0.text: Most of them are slaves. But there are some human orc mercenaries as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310161429_1.text: Within certain limits, they are allowed to move freely among the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310161429_2.text: I can only hope you're not going to mingle with them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310161429.text: What about the humans working for the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310162138.text: Why should I avoid the orc mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310164721_0.text: The path of the orc mercenary is the easy way, with no freedom and against Innos, our god.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310165706.text: We are the only free humans in Myrtana who are still fighting the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310165822.text: If we don't take care of them now, they will stumble upon Reddock sooner or later.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310165901.text: People who team up with the enemy ARE the enemy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310170128_0.text: I think your place is with the warriors down in the cave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310170128.text: You don't look like a woodcutter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185516_0.text: Not so good. We were chased away from our post by aggressive wild boars.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185516_1.text: I already told the warriors, but they only think about fighting the Orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185627.text: What will you give me if I kill the wild boars at your post?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185710.text: If those beasts don't disappear soon, we won't be able to keep working.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185819_0.text: But if you help us out, I'll give you 30 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310185819.text: I'm just a simple worker. I don't have much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310190014.text: I'll deal with the wild boars. Where are they?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310190357.text: Go up these stairs and go east into the woods a bit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310190648_0.text: Finally one of you who worries about our problems. Thanks, warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060310190648.text: The aggressive wild boars are dead. You can go back to work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314171402_0.text: Then go. Quickly. And don't come back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314171402_1.text: I'm keeping an eye on you, Morra. You better not be lying to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314171402.text: I have to go. My owner is waiting for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314171859.text: I have come to challenge you to a duel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314172003_0.text: But whatever you want. You'll have your fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314172003.text: Ha ha ha. Pretty cocky of you, little man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173441_0.text: What prize do you want for winning your fight?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173544_0.text: You'll get it. Here is your gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173544_1.text: And now go. I have things to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173749_0.text: He isn't worth a successful fight, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173749_1.text: You disappoint me. But if you want him, you can have him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173749_2.text: And now go. I have things to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314173749.text: I want your slave out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314174309.text: You weakling, you'd better get out of here, or do you want another beating?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314174354.text: Beat it, before I forget myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314175900.text: I want your slave out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314175952.text: You're in no position to want anything. You're going to give me a full explanation, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314180610.text: I hope for your sake that you already have an owner. Otherwise you belong to me now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314180631.text: What are you doing here, Morra? Shouldn't you be working in the fields?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314180919.text: Don't fool around here, stranger, or the orcs will punish us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314181203_0.text: I'm a slave to the orcs. They make me work as a woodcutter on this farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314181203_1.text: I'm working my butt off here, even though I'm actually a blacksmith, dammit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314181401.text: But a smith doesn't count for much with the orcs if he's only human.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314181511_0.text: Balderdash. The orcs are going to skin you alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314182020_0.text: What? Really? How did you do that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314184722.text: It's better if you don't ask.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185017.text: Fine. But what will you do with me now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185044.text: Alright. I will wait for you here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185216.text: The rebels in Reddock are in need of a blacksmith.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185330_0.text: But I don't even know where to find this place, Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185330.text: Hey, that's wonderful. Finally I get to work as a smith again!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185756_0.text: Thank you very much, stranger. Let me know when it's time to go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314185756.text: I will take you to Javier. He's in charge in Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314190159_0.text: Take this as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314190159.text: Thank you very much, stranger. I will never forget what you did for me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314190434_0.text: Thank you. I thought I was going to die.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060314190620.text: Alright. I will wait for you here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150220_0.text: We have been waiting for a sign from outside for so long. Welcome, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150444_0.text: The king's protective barrier sealed the orcs in here with us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150444_1.text: The orcs have captured half the city. We need help.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150613_0.text: It is the old Temple of Innos for this city. We retreated here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150613.text: What sort of place is this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150732.text: I have to get to the king.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150927_0.text: Only a madman would try to make his way through the city to the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316150927.text: There is a whole garrison of orc warriors between here and the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151321_0.text: When you leave the temple, look south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151321_1.text: The high walls and towers are part of the king's castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151321_2.text: But to get there, you have to pass through the orc-infested city, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151321.text: Just tell me how to get to the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151549.text: What can be done against the orcs' superior numbers?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151834_0.text: They're led by five commanders who occupy the most important positions in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151834_1.text: The commanders would have to be eliminated before we stand any chance at all of reconquering the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316151834.text: Absolutely nothing. They are dug into the streets like ticks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152012.text: I'll take care of the five orc commanders.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152155.text: I hope your fighting skill is as great as your arrogance, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152526_0.text: Good luck. I hope to see you again in one piece.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152526.text: The commanders have settled in the large houses of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152826_0.text: Thank Innos! You really are a hero, you know that, stranger?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152826_1.text: Here is everything I was able to save from the possessions of the city's inhabitants.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152826_2.text: I will get straight to work rebuilding the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316152826.text: The five orc commanders are dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161148_0.text: I hope you've got more guts than all the other cowards around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161148.text: You've come from the outside, haven't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161305_0.text: The question is, how can we help each other, brother. I need to get inside the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161613.text: And I suppose you could use a comrade-in-arms with whatever lies ahead of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161814.text: What's your business in the castle?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161948_0.text: He needs to know that there are some people left here, struggling to survive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316161948.text: I must report to Cobryn, the commander-in-chief of the royal guard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162210_0.text: You're a good sort. Here. Take these healing potions.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162210_1.text: The way you are carrying on, you'll need them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162322.text: Let me fight by your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162934_0.text: Crikey! So there are really some warriors left out there!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162934_1.text: We'll take care of them as soon as we secure this part of town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162934_2.text: Useful gold for useful news. Here, take it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316162934.text: I brought you the paladin Georg.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316163848_0.text: I heard that a man with a lot of promise arrived from outside.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316163848_1.text: Looking at you, I must say they didn't exaggerate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316164037_0.text: Yes, dammit. And it's one helluva job.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316164345_0.text: He'll be happy to see the daredevil who made his way here from outside.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316164345_1.text: Go up to the castle. He'll be expecting you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316164955.text: How are things up here in the castle?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316165142_0.text: We're simply taking too many losses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316165142_1.text: Even a tough man like me is beginning to have his doubts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316165142.text: It is damn well much worse than it looks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316170934.text: Last night, we had a skirmish with those damned orcs from the eastern part of town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316172819_0.text: His name is Thordir. He's hiding somewhere in the eastern part of town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316172819_1.text: If you want to help us, go find him and bring him back in one piece.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316172819.text: Those brutes drove us apart. One of my men didn't make it back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316173120.text: I have found the paladin Thordir.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174252.text: Go and help him reach the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174345.text: Thordir got back to the castle safe and sound.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174448.text: Good gold for good work. Here, take it, you devil you. Ha ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174833_0.text: Dammit. I knew you would stir things up here, but, my oh my... ha ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174833_1.text: You are the best fighter I've ever met. And I have met plenty.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174833_2.text: Glorious gold for a glorious victory.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316174833.text: The five orc commanders are dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316175513_0.text: Mmh. I'm not sure whether there's anything left that I can teach a crazy dog like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316175513_1.text: But I'll give it a try.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316175513.text: Would you teach me how to fight?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180008.text: I hope the situation out there isn't as hopeless as they all claim, confound it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180443_1.text: Stupid question. I was stranded here during the fight against the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180443.text: Well, finally. I thought I'd croak out here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180608_0.text: How charming. Stop babbling. Get me out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180608.text: They've missed you in the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316180734.text: Come on, move it. I'll take you back to the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316181025_0.text: All right. I don't have a choice. Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316181136.text: If it weren't for you, I would have died up there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316181219.text: Here, take these healing potions as thanks for my rescue, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060316181717.text: Now I can't get back to the castle by myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317102142_0.text: Alright. But be careful with it. Don't let them take it from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317103334.text: This Fire Chalice must be taken to Karrypto, the highest ranking Fire Mage in the king's castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317103419.text: Someone must break through the orcs' position and reach the castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317103901_0.text: You're asking ME? All I know is that the Fire Mages are crazy for the things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317103901.text: What is so important about this Fire Chalice?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317104617_0.text: That's good. We have been trying for days without success.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317104617.text: I talked to Karrypto about the Fire Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317104939_0.text: Markus is a loyal soul. Not particularly brave, but completely reliable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317104939.text: The paladin Markus has been trying for days to bring you a Fire Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317122727_0.text: Let us not waste any valuable time. We need to talk, redeemer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317122727.text: There you are at last. I am Karrypto, the highest Fire Mage in the realm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317122744.text: What do you want with me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317122914.text: The rune magic as we mages knew it no longer exists.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317123119.text: Xardas has done a thorough job. His betrayal of the Order of Fire is unforgivable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317123307.text: We must explore the ancient knowledge and find out how we can work magic again without the aid of our runes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317125425_0.text: You know we've been cut off from the outside world, redeemer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317125425_1.text: If anyone can find out his whereabouts, it is you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317130055_0.text: The artifacts of the Ancient Ones are found throughout the country.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317130055.text: Tell me more about the ancient knowledge.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317130354.text: The monastery needs every single one of them, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317131522.text: The more you learn, the more we, too, will benefit from your experience.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317131614.text: You need to find artifacts that bear the power of magic within themselves, and learn to work the old magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317131659.text: And you must help the paladins find another way to use their magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132016_0.text: My brethren in the monastery in Nordmar are working on a plan.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132016_1.text: They want to restore magic to the paladins using so-called Fire Chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132016_2.text: I'm sorry I don't know much more about it. I've been secluded here for too long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132016.text: What should I do for the paladins?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132113.text: There are twelve chalices, distributed throughout the land. Find them and take them to Nordmar, redeemer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317132216.text: My brethren will be able to tell you more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317133357_0.text: Over there on the alchemist's bench, I keep a teleportation stone that will take you safely out of town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317133357_1.text: So far, I haven't entrusted it to anyone or used it myself because I knew you would come, redeemer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317133357.text: What's the best way to leave this town again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317154328_0.text: Let me see what a no-good hero looks like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317154328.text: Well, if it isn't the problem solver. Come over here, scumbag.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317154631_0.text: Ever since that ship, the Esmeralda, came in sight, every idiot here has been talking about you and nothing else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317154631_1.text: You are going to free us, they say. You will drive back the Orcs, they say.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317154631_2.text: So far, we have only gone hungry here, that's all I know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155035.text: Looking at you, I really don't think you are worth all this trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155239_0.text: Ha ha. I can't wait to see how you're going to solve our supply problem, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155239.text: Relax. I have come to help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155649_0.text: We're cut off from the outside world, man. We're starving.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155649_1.text: We need at least 30 loaves of bread.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155839_0.text: We need some 30 chunks of roasted meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155839.text: Anyway, we are all going to keel over from starvation if we don't get some meat between our teeth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317155943_0.text: I see? Is that all you've got to tell me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160037.text: Where can I get food for you, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160139_0.text: They seem to be much better supplied than we are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160139.text: Why don't you get it from the orcs that are out there, besieging the town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160417_0.text: Well, I'll be... You brought us bread?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160417_1.text: Mmh. Looks like I might want to reconsider my opinion of you, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160417_2.text: Arrh. Thanks. Here's something that will be of good use to you in the world out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160417_3.text: Thanks. Here's something that will be of good use to you in the world out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160417.text: Here you are - 30 loaves of bread.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160633_0.text: Unbelievable. You're starting to impress me - bringing us meat. Just like that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160633_2.text: Here. This might come in handy out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160633.text: Here are your 30 chunks of roasted meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160949_0.text: Pah. May you choke on your mockery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060317160949.text: Some can, others can't. I can, you cannot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320113834_0.text: I'm no merchant. My job is just to see to it that everybody here gets fed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320113834_1.text: If you want to buy something, go to the inner fortress.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320114001.text: How can I help you, stranger?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320114130_0.text: But maybe you'll still find something you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320114130.text: Since the orcs have besieged us, the quality of my goods hasn't improved.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320114322_0.text: Are you joking? We're out of pretty much everything here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320114322_1.text: We've been bleeding dry here for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320124405_0.text: Our city was leveled. If we want to rebuild it, we need all kinds of things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320124405.text: What I need the most is tools. Hammers, saws, just everything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320125024.text: And last but not least, we need around 20 pickaxes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320125159.text: Hey. Don't look at me like that. I didn't start the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320125310_0.text: Terrific! I knew I could count on you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320125603.text: Thanks. That will help us along.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320130135_0.text: Welcome. Let me show you my weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320130135.text: Finally, someone from the outside! We had all but given up hope.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320130428_0.text: My skills aren't all that great. And certainly not my skills as a teacher.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320130428_1.text: You will find the true masters and teachers of the art in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320130428.text: Can you teach me how to be a smith?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131000_0.text: We need weapons. The paladins are constantly fighting the orcs in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131000_1.text: I can barely keep up with repairs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131000_2.text: If I had 20 bundles of weapons, I could fully equip our troops again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131000.text: Is there anything you need for your smithy?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131355_0.text: There are still many weapons in the besieged areas of town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131355_1.text: The orcs are storing many weapons of human origin there that they collected, but cannot use for themselves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131355_2.text: They are guarding the weapons so that we humans cannot wield them against orcs again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131355.text: I will get the weapons for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131905_0.text: Thanks. If it weren't for courageous people like you, we would have been lost long ago.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131905_1.text: Here, let me give you this to make up for your expenses.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320131905.text: Here are your 20 bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320135558_0.text: Very good, redeemer. I knew you could do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320135558.text: I found all of the Fire Chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320143245_0.text: I only hope for all our sakes that you know what you are doing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320143245.text: I regret to observe that you have chosen a path that is more than questionable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060320143415.text: I regret to observe that you have chosen a path that is more than questionable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321112617.text: I will continue to strengthen the resistance here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321112729_0.text: I fought against the orcs there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321115846_0.text: Reddock is the only refuge for us rebels here on the coast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321115846_1.text: I would sooner die than tell anyone where my brothers are hiding.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321115846.text: What do you know about Reddock?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321123736.text: They want me to betray the location of the rebel camp Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321132635.text: Excellent. And? Will he help with the revolution?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321133258_0.text: Very good. Then go and make him your comrade-in-arms.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321133258_1.text: I shall mobilize the rest of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321133555.text: We will help you when you take the battle to the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321135025_0.text: Who among us is what he was before the war?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321135025_1.text: Ask all the humans who refuse to give up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321135025_2.text: I belonged to the militia of this city before the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321135025.text: You weren't always a swineherd, were you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321135342.text: Innos knows I would give anything for the good old days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321145817.text: Life out here is not without its dangers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321150703.text: And drop that silly grin, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321150904_0.text: Why? The orcs made me do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321150904_1.text: I told you wipe that stupid grin off your face.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321150904.text: Why don't you do something other than shoveling manure?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321151332_0.text: Well. If you still want to free Cape Dun, you're going to have to do it yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321151332.text: Damn. Wenzel was the only one I trusted to maybe beat the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321151638_0.text: Thanks, stranger. I shall include you in my prayers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321151638.text: That was a complete success. Cape Dun is free.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321151750.text: Take this. It should help you on your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321153529.text: Here. I'll pay you for them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321154621_0.text: You are the first whom I trust to succeed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321154621_1.text: But nevertheless, it will be awfully difficult for just the two of us. Think hard about it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321154621.text: There are many who proposed to do that with me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321155601_0.text: In the name of Innos. Follow me, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321155601.text: We don't need any help. Let's fight NOW.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321160125.text: The underground will support us. Let's fight NOW.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060321160323.text: Then what are we waiting for? Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322120649.text: And remember: we only have a chance of success if you kill the leader of the orcs in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122450_0.text: We orc leaders don't deal with just any Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122450_1.text: We have important tasks to perform for our people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122450_2.text: We don't have time for the affairs of slaves. That's what our mercenaries are for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122832_0.text: I'm looking for a way to smoke out the rebels in the coastal region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122832_1.text: They are everywhere, even in this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322122832_2.text: So far I haven't managed to find their hideout.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123226_0.text: Ho ho ho. Big words for a little man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123226_1.text: I thought you were a simple mercenary, but now I'm starting to wonder.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123226_2.text: Show me what you can do by killing the leader of Reddock.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123226_3.text: I will reward you richly for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123226.text: I will destroy Reddock for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123626_0.text: Have you managed to achieve what I was not able to, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123626_1.text: This is embarrassing, but I believe you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322123626_2.text: Here is your just reward, mercenary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322124220_0.text: My squads are patrolling the coastal region night and day.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322124220.text: What have you done to try and find Reddock?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322124408.text: So far without success. He still won't talk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322124753.text: I want to talk to the captured paladin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322125017.text: Do whatever you want with him. I can't get any more answers out of him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322125614.text: The slaves call it Reddock. I call it Ratsnest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322130002.text: What about the rebels within the city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322130216_0.text: The bastard has a brilliant disguise. Find him and take him out of circulation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322130216.text: They have a leader. I still haven't been able to find out who it is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322131616_0.text: Faring is a high mountain fortress at the pass to Nordmar, near your capital Vengard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322131616_1.text: Our strongest warriors are stationed there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322131616_2.text: The journey to Faring is only worthwhile for a Morra if you are a famous gladiator.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322131616.text: Will you tell me more about this Faring?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322133130_0.text: What are you saying? You're betraying me, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322133130_1.text: Very well, do what you must. But I won't make it easy for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322133130.text: I have the support of the rebels in this city and now I am going to kill you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322133929.text: What goods are you waiting for?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322134324.text: You stupid mercenaries let those lousy bandits on the coast steal them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322134446.text: My goods are bound to still be there. Go and get them!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322134613.text: And you better not come here again before you do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322145743.text: You must take the Fire Chalice to the Fire Mages. They are looking for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322145910.text: Well done. I am proud of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322152137.text: Hey, you! You look like you could use a few extra pieces of gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322152820.text: What do you expect me to do in return for your gold?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322153145_0.text: It's with Urkrass. He gave me a measly 50 gold coins for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322153145.text: What became of the captured paladin's equipment?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322153235.text: He fetched a decent price here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322153343.text: Some broken armor, a worthless chalice, and a few odds and ends.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322154201.text: I've got somebody for you here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322155720_0.text: You can fight in the arena for fame and glory, or you can serve them in other ways.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322155720_1.text: We Hashishin of the desert provide them with fresh workers for everyday jobs, and for the digs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322155720.text: There are various options to gain reputation with the orcs as a human.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160225_0.text: Their digs are everywhere across the country.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160225_1.text: If you want to know what exactly they are looking for, ask them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160225.text: What are the orcs digging for?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160609_0.text: Hehehe. Maybe you should pay a visit to our cities in the desert, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160609_1.text: Then you will see for yourself what role the people of the Hashishin are really playing in this world.
