INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322160609.text: So you Hashishin are nothing but mercenaries for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322161508_0.text: It's a job like any other.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322161508_1.text: Just recently, I even sold the orcs a real paladin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322161508.text: You're enslaving humans for the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322165510.text: Why are YOU running around here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322165550.text: What? Who? What do you want? Go away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322172639.text: Fine with me. Here, take these potions at least. You will need them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060322175437.text: Have you lost your way, or are you headed for the village?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323110819_0.text: Yes, but only over the mercenaries. The Orcs are the masters of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323110819_1.text: But it's not so bad living as a mercenary for the Orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323111103.text: What about you? I can use a strong fellow like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323111348.text: What have you got for me to do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113758_0.text: Right, listen. Your reputation is your hardest currency with the Orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113758_1.text: An Orc sits at the top of every city in the kingdom. Here in Cape Dun, that's Uruk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113758_2.text: If you can get the Orcs to let you talk to the top Orc, you've got it made.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113758.text: What if I wanted to join the mercenaries?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113927.text: How do I increase my reputation with the Orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323113955.text: Make yourself useful. Show the Orcs that you've got it, even though you're only a human. Very simple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323114012.text: Eventually, you'll be admitted to Uruk's presence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323120703.text: You took care of the wolves? Not bad.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323120818.text: Find the hungry wolves and do them in.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323121450_0.text: You did it. You're no longer a stranger to the Orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323121450.text: Are the Orcs pleased with me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323132821.text: I need some healing potions. Three should be enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323133411.text: First you work for me, and THEN we can talk equipment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323133623_0.text: Look at what I've got, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323133712.text: There's nothing to be had here for free, you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323134817.text: The only entertainment we ever get is the arena fights up by the tower.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323135605.text: Deckard won't part with anything, that skinflint.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323135758_0.text: That swine must have his cave somewhere here in the coastal region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323140106.text: What would you rather do besides being on guard duty at night?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144547.text: Never heard of Ortega? He's the boss of the bandits in the coastal region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144615.text: Wage a hefty battle against that bandit scum, that's what I would like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144638.text: Tough bunch, those bandits. I would just love to sort them out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144716.text: Very well. Time to pay a visit to Ortega.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144946_0.text: What? Really? Too bad. And I thought we were only just getting started.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144946_1.text: Oh well. It's back to the night watch, then, I guess.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323144946_2.text: It was my pleasure. See you around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323145208.text: This is the cave belonging to Ortega, the bandit leader. I can almost smell it!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323150516.text: Takes a lot of courage to drag an orc mercenary to Reddock, mate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323152802.text: Aah. So this is supposed to be the rebel leader, huh? Mmh. I had imagined him somewhat stronger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323153536.text: And then I'll show you how to hunt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323155132_0.text: I'm the town alchemist. And I'm very busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323155419_0.text: Do I look like I would sell my goods to just anyone?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323155419_1.text: You will have to do something for that, Master of Audacity.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323155641_0.text: I need a bag of ingredients for my work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323155641_1.text: Fetch me a dozen healing plants, and maybe we can get into business.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323160824_0.text: Do something for me, then I will see what I can do for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323160824.text: Can you teach me about alchemy?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323161332.text: Do you belong to the desert people, the Hashishin?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323162012_0.text: The weather near the coast is just too cold and unpredictable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323162012_1.text: I need the burning sand under my feet and the scorching sun on my skin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323162012.text: Yes, I'm an Hashishin, and some day I will return to the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323163055.text: Or else you'll wind up feeding the fish.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323163311_0.text: Uruk lives here. He is the boss of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323163311_1.text: Don't get any ideas about going through this door without permission, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323170731_0.text: We thieves are always on the lookout for people who have a better command of our craft than we do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323170731_1.text: Who knows, maybe I could learn something from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323170731.text: Why should I steal for you, if you don't even want the booty?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171051_0.text: We usually know where there is good stuff to be had, and we also like selling our knowledge.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171051.text: We are everywhere and nowhere. Always on the lookout for an opportunity.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171413.text: Isn't it? That's why I became a thief.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171641_0.text: You will only recognize men of my stripe if you ask the right questions.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171641_1.text: Just the sort of answer I expected.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323171641.text: How do I recognize one of you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323172230.text: Harrumph, what is it now, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323172535_0.text: Town? Cape Dun is a filthy backwater slum.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323172535_1.text: I would rather join my brothers outside Vengard, the capital of your marionette king, than guard this place here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323172535.text: What's your job in this town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323173118_0.text: Oh yes. I need peace and quiet in this town. So don't you start any trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323173118_1.text: Stay away from things that aren't yours, and don't beat anyone up unless we say you can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323173118_2.text: I hope you get my drift, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323180532.text: Are you here to fight in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323180933_0.text: Go to Arokkh and tell him that you want to fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323180933.text: Meet me in the arena if you dare, milksop.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181054.text: Hey, you devil, you're damn good. You'll go far among the gladiators. Much respect!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181136.text: You're not good enough to be a gladiator.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181203.text: Go and learn how to fight before you come back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181300.text: Go see Arokkh if you want to fight in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181432.text: You had better go and learn how to fight before you enter another arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181757.text: I heard you're now champion of the arena. Respect.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181950_0.text: I'll give you a bonus for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323181950.text: You dealt with Ortega's bandits. That was quite a feat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060323182333.text: Go straight to Uruk. He wants to talk to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327174844.text: If you need me as a comrade-in-arms, you know where to find me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327181722.text: The orcs weren't all that strong. There must be other, tougher ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327181923_0.text: I will go search for the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327181923_1.text: I bet they're not all dead yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327181923.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327182321_0.text: It's not far from here. Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327182525_0.text: I really hope the orcs never find this hideout.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327182525.text: See, here they are. I knew it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327182820_0.text: Hang in there. See you around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327182820.text: I will stay here for a while and then be on my way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327183544.text: Show me where the rebels are hiding.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327183940.text: I can't help it, I don't like orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327184323_0.text: I'm going to set out and try to learn the ancient, true magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060327184323.text: My runes have lost their power. I don't think it's any different for the other Fire Mages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328114022_1.text: Go look for the ship. You're not going to find it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328114022_3.text: Pirates! It was all over in a moment.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328114022.text: Bad news! There will be no reinforcements!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328114245.text: What are you gonna do now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328114959.text: I'm going to try and make it to the south somehow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328125431.text: Another fine mess we got ourselves into.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328130544_0.text: Quite obviously, the orcs have won their war against King Rhobar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328130544_1.text: And now the orcs are sweeping through the land, enslaving the humans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328130738.text: I had a talk with the village elder.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328132008_2.text: You mean we should take on all the orcs in the world, NOW, ON THE SPOT?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328132842.text: I think you had better take care of Xardas.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328133802_0.text: But you know how this works.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328133802_1.text: Collect whatever you can find and don't let anyone take it from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328133802_2.text: And, since the orcs are now the rulers of Myrtana, we will get some fine equipment from them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328133802.text: And where will we get new equipment now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328134450_0.text: You know me. I will be wherever there is something to be had.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328134450_1.text: Myrtana is now orc territory. But kissing up to orcs just isn't my thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328134450_2.text: I will go south. I bet there are some opportunities left in the vastness of the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328134450.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328152421.text: Ahoy, matey! Headed for a great adventure?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328152741_0.text: Yeah. It's just right for an old salty dog like me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328152741_1.text: But it's a dangerous neighborhood, I tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328152741_2.text: These bilge rats are everywhere. They don't give an old sea dog a moment's peace.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328153745_1.text: Just walk up the coast a little ways to the northeast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328153745_2.text: They set up camp there and they can't wait to cut my throat while I sleep.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328153745.text: What bilge rats would those be?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154059_0.text: You know, matey, I've no idea how I could ever make that up to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154059_2.text: You take care of yourself, will you? Those scoundrels are dangerous.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154059.text: I'll take care of your bilge rats.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154228_0.text: Ah, I knew you would help me out, matey.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154228_1.text: I don't have a whole lot I can give you, but take this as a reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328154228.text: The bilge rats will never bother you again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160258.text: Heaven forbid. I hope they have better things to do than scare an old man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160752_0.text: Ahem. Yes. I think I can trust you with this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160752_1.text: They were here and asked me to let them know as soon as I see another ship.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160752_2.text: I think they're still hopeful that help will come from the sea someday.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160752.text: I heard you took gold from the rebels?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160940_0.text: Yes, all right. What's an old sailor to do with that much gold?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328160940_1.text: But promise me you won't squander it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328180159_0.text: Don't tell me you slipped through the lines of the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328180159.text: Wait a moment. I've never seen YOU here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328181956_0.text: Really, do you think I'm afraid of you, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328181956_1.text: If you won't work, I'll make you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328181956.text: That's a big mouth you've got there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328182519_0.text: From the look of you, I would say you're up to something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328183627_0.text: If you take the path up to the north, you'll get there faster, but you're sure to be attacked by bandits.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328183627_1.text: The path to the west is better for you. It's longer, but not so dangerous.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328183627.text: How do I get to Montera?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328184013.text: You will report to Marik, the leader of the orc mercenaries in Montera, within three days, or you're in trouble, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328184715_0.text: Looks like you need a little obedience training, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328184715.text: Hey you! Didn't I tell you to report to Marik?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328185155_0.text: You did. Well, it was time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328185155.text: I went to see the orc leader in Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328185712_0.text: Ah yes. He told you that? Oh well. You're here now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328185712.text: A rather unfriendly mercenary named Domenik told me to report to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328190555.text: That lazy bum still owes me the revenue from his farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328190618.text: Tell him to give you the gold or I'll have his head, okay?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328190834_0.text: Great. Scared the living daylights out of that lazy pig, did you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328190834_1.text: Keep the gold as your pay. I consider the payoff well worth it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328190834.text: I've got the rent from Domenik.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328191122.text: He's still waiting for the rent from this farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328191149.text: You are to hand me the gold at once, or he'll come out here and have your head.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060328191211.text: Ummm... all right, all right. Here it is. No hard feelings, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060329151744.text: You will report to Marik, the leader of the orc mercenaries in Montera, within three days, or you're in trouble, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330110808.text: Stop right there. Not a step further.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330111005_0.text: By Innos. I almost took you for one of those wretched Orc mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330111005.text: Calm down. I'm not out to get you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330111105.text: What have we got here? Another filthy rebel?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120051.text: I knew it. You're an Orc mercenary after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120319.text: What else do you want? Why don't you just get lost, Orc mercenary?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120725_0.text: Orcs are careless and noisy when they roam the woods. I can hear them half a mile away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120725_1.text: The only plague that is getting to me is those horrible goblins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120725.text: Aren't you afraid the Orcs might get you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330120954.text: You are more afraid of goblins than of Orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330121256_0.text: The goblins will creep around the camp at night and steal everything I've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330121256_1.text: There must be a whole nest of those cowardly goblins somewhere close by.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330121256.text: Scared? I am not scared at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330121349.text: I will do away with those cowardly goblins for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330124037_0.text: Don't let them surround you or you're done for.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330124037.text: Well, have fun then. Goblins are awfully nimble little bastards.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330124214.text: Tell me about the area here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330124840_0.text: That mountain range to the North separates the coastal region from the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330124840.text: You are in the wilderness here. No cities anywhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125032_0.text: Provided the bandits don't cut your throat first, that is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125032.text: Keep following the path to the West, and you'll eventually get to Montera.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125222.text: I finished off those cowardly goblins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125455_0.text: You mean, so I wouldn't have to keep an eye on my things all the time?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125455_1.text: Mmh. I guess that would be worth 100 gold coins to me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125455.text: What will you pay me to get rid of the goblins?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125705_0.text: Well, I'll be. You've got what it takes, my friend. This is certainly worth 100 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125705.text: And the bastards didn't skin you alive?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330125910_0.text: Depends on what you have, really.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330164858_0.text: I'm a hunter. I make a living from whatever I find here in the coastal region.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330165148.text: Can you teach me how to hunt?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330170353.text: What do you think? Is that a fair deal?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330170921_0.text: Well done. What about their meat?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330171541_0.text: You bring me the meat of the shy deer over in the east, and I'll show you a few tricks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330171541.text: Sure, but not for free. We all have to look out for ourselves these days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330171742.text: I'll get you the deer meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330172028.text: Here you are, five joints of raw meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330172157_0.text: What about it? You wanted me to teach you something?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330174520.text: If the orcs catch sight of you outside of Vengard, you have gone too far, savvy?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330175330_0.text: Why not? I don't feel like being enslaved by the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330175330_1.text: The bandits are nobody's fools, either. They attack anyone on sight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330175330.text: You live out here all by yourself?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330175712_0.text: Sure. Everybody knows Ortega. He's the boss of the bandits on the coast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330175712_1.text: Their headquarters are in a cave, northwest of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330180304.text: Let me know when the fun is going to start!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330181659.text: You're too late. Everything's already gone..

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330182017_0.text: The bandits took all my things. Curse Ortega and his gang of filthy swine.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330182017.text: Look at this mess on the road.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330182725_1.text: I'm waiting for a miracle or, even better, for the next orc patrol that will send me to the mines.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330182725.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330183235_0.text: Ortega doesn't give a hoot for the orcs or anybody else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330183235_1.text: He's the terror of the entire coastal region. His bandits keep murdering and pillaging like there's no tomorrow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330183235.text: That Ortega... what kind of a person is he?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330183329.text: Somebody ought to give him what he has coming if you ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330184024_0.text: The pig is hiding out in some den of thieves along the coast here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330184024.text: Where is Ortega the bandit boss now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330190320.text: If I knew where he was, I would set the orcs on him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330190739_0.text: I was on my way to Ardea with five crates of lamp oil.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330190739_1.text: Ortega's bandits took all the crates. I'm ruined without my oil.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330190739.text: What did they take from you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330191435_0.text: Yes, it is, But there were five crates. This isn't all of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330191435.text: Would this be your lamp oil?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330191900_0.text: Really? Thank you, stranger. I will always remember your kindness.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330191900_1.text: Take this as a reward for your selfless deed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330191900_2.text: I will immediately head for Ardea before they steal my oil once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330192337_0.text: Is he really? Now that's good news for a change.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330192337_1.text: The orcs are bad enough already, why do we have to have bandits too?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060330192337.text: Ortega, the boss of the bandits, is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331142856.text: When you talk to Porgan, show him some respect, or you'll deal with me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143004_0.text: I am a ranger and martial arts instructor. My name is Arakos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143111.text: I am a personal guard of the druid Porgan. So think before acting, understood?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143416_0.text: A place of destruction and despair.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143416_1.text: This valley was once the largest village of the rangers of Myrtana.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143416_2.text: People came from everywhere and were restored through the healing hands of our druid, Porgan.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143416.text: What kind of place is this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143706_0.text: The Orcs destroyed our village and stole whatever they could find.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143706_1.text: I am one of only a few who survived the massacre.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331143706_2.text: Cursed be all those who wreak havoc with the plants and creatures of Adanos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144342_0.text: We rangers are a peaceful people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144342_1.text: We make it our task to serve the druids and protect them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144342_2.text: But those wretched Orcs came to us with the blade of war unsheathed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144342_3.text: And now we are taking back what is rightfully ours. No more, no less.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144342.text: You are at war with the Orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144738_0.text: They retreated to the big cities of Myrtana. We cannot reach them there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144738_1.text: All that is left of them is a small Orc patrol to the north. They are watching us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144738.text: Where are the Orcs who did this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331144819.text: Let's rough up that Orc patrol.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145109_0.text: Don't fret, we can do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145109.text: There's nothing I would rather do, but I don't know whether we are strong enough.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145244_0.text: I am ready. Follow me. For Porgan!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145244.text: All right. You seem to know what you're talking about.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145645_0.text: Here, I want you to take this with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145832_0.text: We should respect each other, not fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331145832.text: Orcs are creatures of Adanos, just like you and me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331155305_0.text: I can, wanderer. Come to my fire and I shall ease your pain.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331155320.text: What can I do for you, wanderer?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331155522_0.text: Light of Adanos illuminate this body.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331160210_0.text: I am no ruler. My children, the rangers, are with me of their own free will, wanderer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331160210_1.text: I am a preserver of creation. We druids are guardians of the world and its nature.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331160210_2.text: We draw our power from the strength of Adanos' creatures.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331160210.text: I suppose you are in charge here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161158_1.text: But alas, my stone was stolen by the orcs, wanderer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161158_2.text: It is more than disturbing to know that it is in the hands of these foolish creatures.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161158.text: What creature is the source of your power?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161509_0.text: Thank you, wanderer. But I see that it is pale and powerless.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161509_1.text: If it is to regain its old strength, I shall have to recharge it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161824_0.text: I can. But I am lacking ingredients for the procedure of renewal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161824_1.text: You have returned the stone to me, wanderer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331161824.text: Can you recharge the druid stone?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331162641_1.text: They grow exclusively in very damp places.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331162641_2.text: You will only find them near river beds. Good luck.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331162641.text: I will help you in your search for the ingredients for your druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331162850_0.text: Very good. But I need more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331163225_0.text: For the service you have done me, I will share my power with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331163225_1.text: Take my druid stone and keep it better than I could.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331163225.text: Good work, wanderer. Now I can recharge the druid stone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331163905.text: If you help me to recharge it, I will share my power with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060331165833.text: My druid stone possesses the power of the Ripperbeast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403113314.text: I see you're playing gatekeeper again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403113432.text: Spare me your sarcasm, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403113506.text: I guarantee you I'm the only human in Myrtana who has managed to make orcs obey his orders.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403113701.text: If you wreck everything for me again, this time I'll kill you, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403114859_0.text: I was afraid you'd say something like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403114859_1.text: Let me set you straight. I am the top dog out here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403114859.text: I want to work for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403115409.text: So if you screw up just once, that will be your last mistake, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403123408.text: Are you still mad about that old business?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403124454_0.text: The orcs rule the world now and YOU will obey their rules or die.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403124454.text: Every time you show up, everything goes to hell. I've had enough of that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403124600.text: The orcs let you, a human, order them around?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403125818_0.text: The orcs captured the island of Khorinis and brought us humans to the mainland in their galleys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403125818_1.text: We were given the choice to become slaves or fighters for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403125818_2.text: I won fights in every arena in Myrtana and adopted the orcs' ways as my own.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403125818_3.text: Once you learn to think like an orc, the rest is easy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403125818.text: You're impressed, huh? Ha ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403130417.text: You're a commander of the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403131556.text: The job is hard enough as it is. Now that you're here, I'll really have to watch out.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403132051.text: Let me tell you, if they get their hands on you, they'll make mincemeat out of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403141259_0.text: The only one here who could overthrow the city is you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403141259_1.text: I will kill you the instant I suspect that you intend to harm Trelis, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403141259.text: It's possible that Trelis will soon be attacked.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403143955.text: At last. High time you moved your butt over here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403144623_0.text: I accepted an assignment from a rich Hashishi merchant.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403144623_2.text: He wants them and he's willing to shell out an incredible amount of gold for them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403144623.text: So - where is there anything to be had here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403145809.text: You disappeared pretty quickly after we got here with our ship.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403150048_0.text: Open battle against pirates is more YOUR cup of tea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403150048.text: I saw the attacking pirates from the Esmeralda's deck, so I decided to make myself scarce.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403154547.text: He's a wealthy Hashishi from the desert. Boring fellow, but he's loaded.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403154959_0.text: A huge amount of gold. Enough for both of us, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403154959.text: How much will you get for the shamans' golden plates?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403155154_0.text: Bring me the six gold plates, and I'll give you a pile of gold coins for them. What do you say?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403155154.text: I just can't get into the damn temple. But I know you'll be able to pull it off somehow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403155437_0.text: See? I knew you'd get your hands on them somehow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403155437.text: Here are the six gold plates of the shamans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403155615.text: He says that the shamans set up six very valuable golden plates in the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160123_0.text: Once I've finished my business here, I will go see the Hashishin in the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160123_1.text: As soon as they get word that the gold plates are missing and they don't hear from me for a while, I'll be in trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160123_2.text: I hope you've stopped getting yourself into trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160123.text: What are you going to do next?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160337_0.text: Of course I will. You know that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160337.text: Will you help me brush up on my thieving skills?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403160736.text: I hope we're not in trouble now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403161059_0.text: Looks like you're raising hell, as usual.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403161059_1.text: The orcs in the other cities will not take this sitting down.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403161059_3.text: Oh well. I'll just assume you know what you're doing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403162549.text: Who is this merchant you work for?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403163946_0.text: The area here is primarily controlled by bandits.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403163946_1.text: The boss of the gang is called Ortega. He collects his booty in a cave somewhere in the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403163946_2.text: If there is any loot to be had on the coast, then that's the place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403163946.text: What is in the wilderness of the coastal region?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403175455.text: Come here. I can restore your magical abilities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180754_0.text: So, the great day is almost come.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180754_1.text: Innos guard you on all the roads you walk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180754_2.text: Take this to make your tasks easier to complete.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180840_0.text: This is a wondrous gift. Thank you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180840_1.text: Here, take my gift for you. May Innos preserve you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403180840.text: Thank Innos. I have waited so long for deliverance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403181830_0.text: Without it, I'm not half the man I used to be.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403181830.text: If only I hadn't lost my rune magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403182523_0.text: Faith can move mountains, they say.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403182523_1.text: Thank you. Now I once again have hope that everything will turn out for the best.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403182523_2.text: Take this and use it in the spirit of Innos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183409_0.text: May Innos give you strength for your mission in this world.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183409_1.text: And I will give you this to refresh your strength.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183409.text: Thank you. You've got a lot of promise.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183554.text: Here. A little magic will make your job much easier.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183814_0.text: Here, I've got something for you. Keep up the good work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403183814.text: Confound it! We need more people like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403184314_0.text: I don't think I will ask how you did that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403184314_1.text: Innos be with you. Thanks. Here, do you need any more healing potions?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403185744_1.text: You are a true hero. Did you know that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403185921.text: Here, take this as a gift from me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190237_0.text: Knock me down with a feather. How is that possible?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190237_1.text: Thank you. Here. I'm sure you have a use for this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190711_0.text: You did extraordinarily well, my son.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190711_1.text: Our paladins will be happy to regain their powers, and reward you well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190711_2.text: I am very proud of you. Take this gift to help you on your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403190711.text: The ritual of the Fire Chalices has been a complete success.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403195434.text: Can I go see your leader?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403195556.text: You are no longer unknown to us. You may pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403195747_0.text: You have done a lot for Geldern. You can go see him.
INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403195747_0.stageDirection: Is this supposed to be Nemrock?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403195747.text: Can I see your leader Grok now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403200009.text: Can I talk to Vak now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060403200102.text: You are a good Morra. You may go see him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404093712.text: What do you provide to the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404105738.text: They say many treasures are hidden in the castle of Gotha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404110137.text: Supposedly, even the helmet of the first paladin is in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404111325_0.text: I would love to have that helmet. I could cut a really big deal with it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404111325.text: Rumor has it that they're keeping the helmet of the very first paladin there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404111737_0.text: Incredible! I'll give you 2000 gold coins for it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404111737.text: Here. I will sell you the first paladin's helmet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404112706_0.text: They say that the seven ancient rings of the alchemists are hidden here in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404112706_1.text: They are worth more than 3000 gold on the black market.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404112706.text: What artifacts interest you the most?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404112831.text: I would really like to call the seven rings of the alchemists my own.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404113054.text: I will give you the minimum amount of gold they would fetch on the black market, all right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404113329.text: But I've never been there myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404113749_0.text: I know many thieves. It's part of dealing with artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404113749_1.text: However, I don't know too much about these things myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404113749.text: You talk like someone who knows a lot about thievery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114130_0.text: Would you do that? I wouldn't mind paying 1000 gold coins for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114130_1.text: I'll see what I can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114130.text: I know Lares. I could introduce you to him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114539_0.text: The great Lares, here in my shop. That I should live to see the day.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114539_2.text: Thanks, friend. Here's the gold I promised you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114539.text: I talked to Lares. He will get in contact with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114931_0.text: I've heard of Jared. He'll give you a decent price.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114931_1.text: I think I should pay him a visit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404114931.text: Jared the artifact trader would give his right arm just to meet you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404115238.text: But I heard that Lares, one of the greatest thieves in Myrtana, is in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404140553.text: I heard about a farmer named Farmon who is still stashing a heap of gold, or so they say.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404141839_0.text: Nice. If you pull that off, I might show you a couple of tricks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404141839.text: I will plunder the castle of Trelis sooner or later.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404143647.text: Have you already been in the castle in Trelis? There are supposedly great riches hidden there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404144224.text: Well then, don't let the orcs catch you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404162826.text: I will fight to the death.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404162907.text: I will fight to the death.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404164138_0.text: To be honest, I never thought I would survive this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404164138_1.text: The gratitude of the humans in this valley will be yours forever, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404164138_2.text: Take this as thanks. If you want to train with me some more, just let me know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404165438_0.text: Innos be praised. Many thanks to our great liberator.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060404165438_1.text: May this be useful on your journey. Farewell, and don't ever stray from the right path.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406110844.text: I've got customers in the desert. Some of those wealthy bastards are really into shiny dishes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406112432_0.text: One must never use a barrier spell frivolously.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406112432_1.text: But nevertheless - when the orcs attacked this city, we had no other choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406112432_2.text: The qualities of such a powerful spell are very unstable and unpredictable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406112432_3.text: Just think of the barrier in the Valley of Mines in Khorinis. What a disaster.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406112432.text: Tell me more about the barrier surrounding the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406113600_0.text: That will only happen once the orcs have been defeated and are no longer a threat to us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406113600_1.text: Innos alone knows when that will be.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406113600.text: When are you going to remove the barrier?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406144421.text: Xardas sent me. I'm supposed to find out how your search for the divine artifacts is going.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060406144816.text: Is that so? Well, naturally the shamans are the ones with an overview of our excavations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412141443.text: I hope they haven't found him out yet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412141536.text: But if you can gain his trust, tell him that Javier sent you to support him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412142401.text: I really hope for your sake that you aren't a spy for the orcs, or we'll make short work of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412143925.text: One of the swineherds belongs to the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412144137.text: That may be, but I've got enough problems.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412145301.text: You'd better tell the Orc leader Uruk yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412150807_0.text: Look up by the lighthouse. I saw some there yesterday.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412150807.text: Where can I find healing plants?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412151218_0.text: Don't get my hopes up. I'm a desperate man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412151218_1.text: But if you can really retrieve my crates, I'll make it worth your while.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412151218.text: I'll get your lamp oil back for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412152108.text: No talking. You will follow me now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412152109.text: All right. If you can't be persuaded, I will do what you tell me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412154238.text: And as for you, I'll deal with you later, pal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412154359.text: What else do you want? Just get lost.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412154751.text: The chalice must be taken to the Fire Mages. It is a Fire Chalice. Very rare and extremely valuable.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412154836.text: Alas, I don't know anything else about the thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412155807_0.text: The orcs are obsessed with searching for these valuable relics.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412155807_1.text: Every dealer in the land knows that and will offer you a correspondingly high price.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412155807.text: Tell me more about the artifacts of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412161823.text: I must take an important discovery I made in this cave to the monastery in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412163436_0.text: It is extremely important that it be brought to my brethren in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412164136_0.text: Yes. Here, take the chalice. I am too weak to travel to the icy north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412164136_1.text: I hope that YOU are strong enough to do so.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412164136.text: I will take your Fire Chalice to the monastery in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412164303.text: But be careful. Nordmar is dangerous.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412164622.text: But as you see, I have one or two small problems to deal with here first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180459_0.text: I hope my relief gets here soon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180459.text: My goodness. I'm working my ass off here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180946_0.text: Oh, man. I'll give you everything I have if you get me out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180946_1.text: All right. What have you got?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180946_2.text: I found this artifact here. A strange chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180946_3.text: I would let you have that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412180946.text: What's a short break worth to you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412182534_0.text: Oh, yeah. Here's the chalice I found.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412182534.text: Wait a moment, you forgot something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412182739_0.text: What do I know? I don't understand these things, pal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412182739.text: Mmh... you say you found a chalice? A fire chalice, maybe?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412190501_0.text: Forget it. I'm staying here on the farm.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412190501.text: You haven't come to send me back to town, have you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412190732_0.text: Especially when I think of the poor beggars down at the excavations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412190732.text: Working on the farm here isn't that bad at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412191134.text: Here are your sacks of wheat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060412191224.text: Very good, but I need 15 of them. Go get the rest!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413115000.text: If only they weren't so strong.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413115151.text: Once the orc mercenaries notice that we are killing off their guards, they will have our heads.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413115507.text: Oh well. Maybe the orcs aren't quite as clever as I thought.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413120605.text: We need to carry on until Montera falls.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413123206.text: We don't have any other choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413123707.text: What about the smaller rebel outposts outside of the city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413123956_0.text: But if new rebels keep coming from Okara, that doesn't help us at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413125412.text: Go and deal with Okara first, before you bother me with niggling details.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413140448_0.text: I should think so. I gave him a slave, after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413140448.text: Dan the gladiator is very pleased with your work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413140804_0.text: Yes. Goose is a good man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413140804.text: Goose the gladiator appears to be loyal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413143919.text: I remember. Your name is Thorus.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413143953.text: You're the last person I expected here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413144527_0.text: The last time we met was in the sunken city of Jharkendar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413144527.text: I was a guardsman in the Valley of Mines on the island of Khorinis long before the orcs won the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413144816.text: Now, don't go acting like you don't remember me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413144833.text: What's it gonna be? Should I make you a slave, or kill you on the spot?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413145220.text: So here you are, Lares. On the lookout for booty again?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413145257.text: Old habits die hard. That's especially true for thieves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413145332.text: I've got a really big score going right now. I bet this will interest you, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413145601_1.text: I came here with you, on the good ship Esmeralda.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413145601_2.text: The two of us lived through countless adventures on the island of Khorinis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413165117_0.text: Then my mission here has failed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413170146.text: Don't worry, you'll be quite safe.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413171237_0.text: Very good. Here, this is for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413171237.text: Ah. The man from Nordmar I've been expecting for so long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413171943.text: I want the head of the leader of the rebel camp outside Nordmar. His name is Anog.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413173807.text: Why are you coming to ME about this? Go and kill him. Now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413174100.text: The undercover rebel Inog is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413181407.text: I can give you no more than 100 gold coins per person.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413183125_0.text: But somehow, I just can't pull myself together.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060413183125.text: Why are you here in the city?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415152809.text: Talk or I'll have your hide.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415153736_0.text: Now he's sitting in my cell, whimpering for mercy. So mind your tongue.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415153736.text: Ha. That's what the other prisoner said, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415154153_0.text: Who sent a weakling like you to this accursed place as support?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415154416.text: Don't try to fool me, Morra, or I'll put you in my cell with the other prisoner.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415154818.text: You weaklings have no business in this accursed place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415155426_0.text: Well, well. Will you? Just wait. It won't be long before you're lying in the muck, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415155426.text: I'll show you which of us is a weakling.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415155903.text: Try that again and I'll kill you. Understand, weakling?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415160118.text: All right. You win. What do you want?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415160745.text: And you will kindly treat me with respect, weakling.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415161221.text: The demon of destruction swept through its streets and damned them all to living death.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415161517.text: Xardas, the bearer of the power of Beliar, assigned us to this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415161604.text: What do you think would happen if the beast swept across the land, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415162204.text: Grrr. All right. Take him, but then the two of you get out of here and don't come back. Is that clear?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415162627_0.text: Ha ha ha. Why should I do that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415162756.text: I can't wait to see how you're going to try to convince me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415165120.text: Take this gold as a humble tribute from us all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415172813.text: And if he did, kill him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415180634_0.text: Or else what will you do? File a complaint with our leader?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415180634_1.text: Hahaha. Just think about it, you weirdo.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415180634.text: Tell me the name of your leader. Now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415182935_0.text: One less problem. Good news, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415182935.text: The druid Torn in the south has been eliminated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415183235.text: The druid Runak in the north is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060415192159.text: May it serve you well, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060418131931.text: But there's almost nothing that would be worth more than what they pay for it in the market.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060418132546.text: But be quick about it. I don't like to be left waiting, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060418135158.text: Take it from me, you don't want to mess with Gunock. So watch it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060418151259.text: I prefer to fade into the woodwork, as you're well aware.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060419192155.text: Then you'll know what sort of mine this is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060419193321.text: Find a way of getting rid of them, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060419193623.text: The beasts have been lurking outside the sulphur mine for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060419195654_0.text: This will restore some hope to the human people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060420193702.text: If you see my smith's hammer, you bring it to me, do you understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060421134005_0.text: You can train a little more with me if you'd like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060421134005.text: We can really use someone like you around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424133618.text: I'm afraid we cannot enter the temple if we don't have the other four keys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424134714.text: The keys will be there, too. I want you to find them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424135559.text: Bring me the other four keys to the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424140504.text: Take him away. I cannot use an orc mercenary.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424150555.text: The temple is made of ancient, massive stone. I cannot tear it down.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424150809_0.text: I bet it does. If it isn't in this monument of the Ancient Ones, where else would it be?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424150809.text: Do you believe that this temple contains a divine artifact?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424151120.text: I could get inside through the gate, but I'm still missing a few keys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424151511_0.text: Those beasts are everywhere in the fields of ruins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424151511_1.text: The fearless ones are the worst.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424151511_2.text: Those beasts are not afraid of my warriors and keep attacking my camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424151511_3.text: I need to get back to the camp and check on everything there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424152117_0.text: It would be nice if we didn't have to watch our backs all the time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424152117_1.text: But be careful and don't lure them into the camp, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424152117.text: I will take care of the fearless desertbeasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424152450_0.text: The beasts are dead? Good. Suddenly things don't look quite so hopeless around here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424152450_1.text: Here, take this as a reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424153227.text: You will find the beasts to the east of the temple in the fields of ruins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424153902.text: I must fulfill my task here and you were a convenient tool.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424154230.text: You are not going to steal my glory, scumbag.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424163008_0.text: None of that. I want to talk to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424163008_1.text: All right. You made it into my presence, so your effort shall be rewarded.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424163008.text: Have you come to bring me a present?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424164501_0.text: That's a steal, in my humble opinion. What do you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424164501.text: Given current developments, I would relinquish it to you for 10000 gold coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424164739.text: Here's the gold. Give me the temple key.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424164857_0.text: I hope you'll be smart enough to get your gold back from the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424164857.text: It was a pleasure doing business with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165430_0.text: And incur the wrath of the entire city? Hahaha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165430_1.text: But if that's what you want, have it your way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165430.text: I will tear the temple key from your cold dead hands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165940_0.text: They are driven by an iron will that led them all the way here. Pitiful creatures.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165940_1.text: The orcs have come to the desert although they cannot bear the climate and the scorching sun.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060424165940_2.text: If you ask me, they will all perish in the burning sand of the desert before the next summer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425183408.text: I'm worried about the nomads and their spiritual leaders, the Water Mages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425183713_0.text: The nomads follow them and their false god, Adanos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425183713_1.text: We are enslaving the nomads, and yet their numbers only seem to be increasing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425183713.text: What's the problem with the Water Mages?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184044_0.text: To drive our people, the Hashishin, from the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184044_1.text: If we killed their leaders, the Water Mages, they wouldn't be half as bold and confident.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184044.text: They are pillaging our houses, raiding our caravans, and only have one thing on their minds:

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184250_0.text: Hah. That's easier said than done.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184250.text: I will find and kill all the Water Mages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184815_0.text: Follow the tracks of the nomads in the fields of ruins, and you will find their spiritual leader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425184815.text: They are distributed all over the desert, the nomads hide and protect them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425190254_0.text: Hahaha. That's the best news I've ever heard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425190254_1.text: Saturas was the head of the Water Mages as far as I know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425190627_0.text: Very good. That bastard has been a thorn in my side for too long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425190628_0.text: Very well done. Here's your pay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425190628.text: He should have stayed on the island of Khorinis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425191039_0.text: You've really got what it takes, huh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425191227_0.text: Wonderful. I knew I could count on you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425191353_0.text: That's what I like to hear.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425191502.text: Speak up, quick. What do you have to report?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425191717_0.text: Good job. I am proud of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425192312_0.text: This brought you closer to our people than I ever thought possible, Son of Vengeance.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425192312_2.text: May Beliar line your pockets with gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425192312_3.text: I will pay you your first bonus.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425192312.text: All Water Mages have been killed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425192420.text: I shall watch your future progress with great interest. Carry on like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193243_0.text: There's seven of them, as far as I can tell.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193243_1.text: Saturas is their leader and the most important of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193243_2.text: One of them is called Vatras, he, too, plays an important role in their circles.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193243_3.text: The others are Myxir, Nefarius, Riordian, Cronos, and Merdarion.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193243.text: How many Water Mages are here in the desert?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193755_0.text: Well, in that case I guess you know the best way to do away with them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060425193755.text: Yes. I remember. I met all of them on the island of Khorinis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426141621.text: What are you doing out here? Are you a runaway slave?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426141640.text: No chance of passing for anything else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426141705.text: You won't betray me, will you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426150102.text: There's bound to be something I can give you, but please let me go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426150257.text: I'm sure I can be useful to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426150322.text: I accepted the mission to kill you and that's what I'm going to do now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426150550.text: You filthy swine. May your remains shrivel in the sands of the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426152234.text: I sold one to Ilja. And the third to the boss of the city, Gonzales.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426154855_0.text: Yes. But I don't know how many of them there are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426154855_1.text: But if it's more than four, the rest still must be somewhere near the temple of Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426154855.text: You said you had four temple keys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426162052_0.text: Good. But to do that, you'll have to find him first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426162052.text: I will kill Yussuf the artifact thief.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426162118.text: Take a look around the excavation. If you're lucky, he's hiding nearby.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426162406.text: Yussuf the artifact thief is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426171106_0.text: Good work. I knew you could do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426171106_1.text: You also get a fat reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426171726.text: But be careful. You can't fool around with these guys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426171909.text: Gonzales will be proud of us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426172052.text: May this bring joy to your heart.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426172234.text: Anyway, Gonzales WILL be pleased to hear this good news.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426174955.text: You have come at the right moment, Father of Competence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426175058.text: You let your own guards steal from you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426175114.text: If you want to do me a favor, hunt down those guys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426175219.text: I already told Bandaro the bounty hunter about this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426192807_0.text: That can be a profitable business, Master of a Thousand Adventures.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426192807_1.text: A traveler who's dying of thirst would give anything for a cool drink from my well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426192807_2.text: You can have a cool drink, too, if you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426193233.text: You must hunt them down, do you hear me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426193717_0.text: There were at least 700 gold coins. I want them back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426193717.text: What did the guards steal from you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426193836_0.text: That would be extremely kind of you, Master of Generosity.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426193836.text: I will bring back your gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426194538.text: My prayers will go with you on every scorched path that you walk, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426195701.text: Now, if you bring back my gold as well, you can be sure of my undying gratitude.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426195944.text: But that was the last time I ever heard from him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426210658_0.text: Maybe you should talk to him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426211101.text: Well, this will cost you a little.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426213131.text: Those stupid things are worth a heap of gold here. I already got my hands on one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426213148.text: I bet you already secured a key or two for yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426213506.text: And I'm going to beat them out of you now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215056_0.text: You appear to be looking for something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215056_1.text: Are you a raider of the lost temple keys of Mora Sul?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215056_2.text: Or is it a fate other than mere hunger for profit that leads you to our hot country, my pale friend?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215056.text: Greetings, Keeper of a Thousand Coins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215649.text: I happen to have one here in my possession.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215831_0.text: Very perceptive of you. I trade in artifacts, like so many people of my kind in this country.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426215831_1.text: Would you perhaps be interested in my goods?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426220321.text: I give you the key and you bring me the vase. How about it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225153.text: Here's your gold for Masil's promissory note.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225451_0.text: At last! You have no idea for how long I've been after this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225451_1.text: So we're even now. But I'll tell you what:

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225451_2.text: I will give you something extra because you kept your promise.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225451.text: Show me the thing. Yes, this is it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060426225550.text: People like you are few and far between. It's been a great pleasure to meet you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427111449_0.text: Everyone knows that Gonzales only receives people who impress him and bring him gifts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427111449.text: How can I do Gonzales a favor?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427111829.text: So be careful not to arouse the wrath of Gonzales, or things will go badly for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427112214.text: Ah, yes, Gonzales will be pleased by this gift.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554_0.text: A special, hard-won weapon, a beautiful woman?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554_1.text: Maybe even if long overdue debts were finally paid?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554_2.text: You'll think of something. Mora Sul is large.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554_3.text: You're sure to find some suitable gifts here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554_4.text: Mmh, I'll take a look around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113554.text: Well - what could possibly please a man of the world?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427113847_0.text: Speak. What do you have to offer?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427114225_0.text: Then come back when you think of something appropriate.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427114225.text: At the moment, I have nothing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427121541.text: Gold is always good. But gold isn't everything.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122017.text: A useful gift. Gonzales will accept your gift with thanks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122027.text: I am bringing him the moonblade.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122247.text: What an extremely fetching gift. Gonzales will enjoy himself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122442.text: I have something here for Gonzales.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122513.text: I think that is an extremely clever gift. Gonzales will be pleased.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427122816_0.text: Don't talk nonsense. A man like you is here to make a profit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427123026.text: That's why they all come to Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427123500.text: Gonzales is very impressed with your deeds.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427123617.text: If you ask me, you will go far with the Hashishin if you keep this up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427123821.text: Thanks. That's what I wanted to hear.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427123849.text: It is best if you go straight to him. He is expecting you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427130647_0.text: I can assure you that this is probably the most coveted weapon in all of Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427130706.text: Even Gonzales, the most powerful man in town, would love to own the moonblade, I bet.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427131432_0.text: If you leave the arena before the fight is over, you lose, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427131432.text: So what do I do next?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427131605.text: People are starting to like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144450_0.text: Go to Felipe and tell him you want to fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144450.text: If you're looking for a challenge, I'm your man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144505.text: Tsk. One thing I must admit. You had a good fighting instructor.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144607.text: Right. If you want to fight me, go talk to Felipe.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144647.text: You are fighting in the arena?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144719_0.text: Here. Take this, my liberator. May it help you with what lies ahead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144719.text: Someday the desert will be ours.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427144732.text: Well, you certainly know how to fight. Respect!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427145548_0.text: Those orcs rattled your skull something fierce, didn't they?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427145548_1.text: You shouldn't keep sticking your neck out, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427145548_2.text: We came here on the same ship.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427145548_3.text: We fought together on the island of Khorinis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427145729.text: I used to belong to the Sect Camp, and I was a templar in the mining colony.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427150142.text: Maybe it's time I retired after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427151221.text: The only interesting part is the prize for the champion. The moonblade.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427151324.text: But you know that for yourself. YOU are the champion now, after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427152705.text: Too bad you didn't see me fight against Orknarok.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427153751.text: Go to Felipe and tell him you want to fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427154418.text: Well, what do you know, boy. Me, too. Want to trade?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427155819.text: They will avenge themselves on the living, because their eternal rest has been disturbed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427160558_0.text: A man from the north. He has fought many battles.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427160558_1.text: He has done many a great deed. He will be the one who decides between good and evil.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427160558_2.text: At first, I believed the fighter Kirk from Mora Sul would be this man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427160558_3.text: But I am no longer sure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427161337_1.text: Mmh. Seeking to make a profit, too?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427161337.text: I don't know you. Are you from up north?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427161537_0.text: And as long as things don't go wrong all the time, I'm pleased enough with my humble existence.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427161537.text: I sell. I buy. What would you like to hear? I'm an artifact trader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163522.text: I will help you get your business going once more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163605.text: Tell me more about that artifact thief, Yussuf.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163752.text: I want the slaves to work for me again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163814.text: Sure. You want them to pilfer artifacts for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163838.text: Go to the temple and talk to the fat man. He's supervising the slaves there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427163908.text: Persuade him! I don't care how you do it, as long as business goes on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164640_0.text: He even stole the keys to the temple of Mora Sul and sold them in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164640_1.text: Those are the most valuable items that the orcs have dug up out there so far.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164640.text: He was the best thief among the slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164641_0.text: That's right. But the orcs want to get inside the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164641_1.text: That's why they would pay any price to get their hands on those keys.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427164751.text: Where is this slave Yussuf now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427171156.text: He fled to the desert. Last I saw him, he ran northeast from Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175047.text: Beat it. We don't need any filthy mercenaries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175256_0.text: What do you think of that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175256.text: I ought to punch you in the mouth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175422_0.text: I oversee the slaves at the excavation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175422_1.text: You got a problem with that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175614.text: What is it now? Are you still in business with Faesul, or what?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175726.text: Hmph. All right, you win... we'll keep doing business with him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427175933.text: But I don't give a rat's ass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427180143_0.text: You dirty idiots from Mora Sul have no business here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427180143.text: We're all under the Orcs' command here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427180551.text: All right. How many endurance potions do you need?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060427181714.text: A few endurance potions is the least they deserve.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428194407.text: I will get you the amulet from Ilja.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428194502.text: Here, take this gold. It should be enough if you use it wisely.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428194728.text: Why don't you go and simply buy the amulet?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428194756.text: That's not so easy, Son of Frank Speech.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428194829.text: If Ilja learns it's for me, he will inflate the price.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428195645.text: How much is in it for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428195703.text: I'll give you a heap of gold... and I will recommend you to Gonzales.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428200204.text: Give me the amulet and I will get Yasmin for you from Murat's oasis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428200340.text: You changed your mind? Thank you a thousand times.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428200454.text: But listen, don't let him pull a fast one on you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428200524.text: Yeah yeah. Give it here, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060428201412_0.text: Not far from these walls to the west of the city, Son of Disorientation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429135639.text: Mmh. Very nice. That is something very special.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429140039.text: Here is Hamid's amulet. Now let us negotiate YOUR gift.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429140322.text: Wait... you will receive five hundred gold pieces from the treasure of the oasis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429140509.text: What do YOU have to offer?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429140622_0.text: Take a look at my wares and you will see that I speak the truth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429140622.text: I am a slave trader. I deal only in the most beautiful women in the country.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429142825.text: You're welcome to go closer and talk to the girl of your choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429142936.text: Oh, I see you have excellent taste, young man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429150820_0.text: Gonzales, the boss of the city himself, has an eye on her.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429150820_1.text: Go to her. She will follow you from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429150820.text: She's good for many a memorable night.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429151001_0.text: Mmh... Yasmin is the most beautiful dancer you will find in this country, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429151001.text: I would like to buy Yasmin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429151219_0.text: Come back when you can make me an offer worthy of her.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429151219.text: She is something special and cannot be bought for gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429153246_0.text: Mmh. Indeed. A beauty. A good gift.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429153246_1.text: She will find her place at the side of my master.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429153246.text: I am bringing a beautiful dancer. (Alima)

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429154056_1.text: Too bad. I would have loved to become a rich merchant's wife.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429154056.text: Mmh. What a handsome fellow you are. A merchant from Mora Sul, by any chance?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429154805_0.text: Belonging to the richest man in town is a huge step towards my goal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429154805_1.text: Mark my words. Some day, I will be the wife of Gonzales.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429154934.text: Being the wife of the richest merchant in town would put me in good stead, don't you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429162229_1.text: I hope that soon I will belong to someone who admires more than just my dancing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429162229.text: People say you are the most beautiful dancer in the land.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429163055.text: Thank you. Hamid is an honest fellow. I will do well here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429163210.text: What is beauty worth without freedom? Can you tell me that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429165510.text: I will never forgive you for this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429172004.text: I'll take a look into the business with your promissory notes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429172111_0.text: I would sell it myself, but...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429172111_1.text: Well, if I show up just anywhere with it, I'll get a fraction of its value at most.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429172111.text: Good. Here is the ore blank.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429181700_0.text: And good luck with your own business, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429181700_1.text: Don't let them fleece you. That happens all too easily in this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429181715.text: Here, take this. You are now out of debt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429181815_0.text: If I want to do business in this city again, I need all three back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429181815.text: Terrific. But those aren't all of the promissory notes.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200444_0.text: Occasionally. The last one I met said that he was a Fire Mage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200444_1.text: Well, as rundown and starved as he looked...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200444_2.text: It was difficult to imagine that he once was one of those powerful mages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200444.text: Do you see men from the north here very often?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200800_0.text: There isn't much to tell. He croaked in the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200800_1.text: The only thing he had with him was this chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200800_2.text: He guarded it jealously to the very end.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200800_3.text: Apparently the chalice was worth more to him than his life. The fool.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429200800.text: Tell me more about the Fire Mage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201307_0.text: Aha. You seem to be very interested in it, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201307_1.text: Ha. And I thought the thing was worthless.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201307_2.text: The chalice is in my possession.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201307.text: Where is the Fire Mage's chalice now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201456.text: Work for me and I will give you the Fire Mage's chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429201915.text: Give me the Fire Mage's chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429202813.text: In the name of Beliar. Take it and get out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429202922.text: In the name of Beliar. Take it and get out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429213717_0.text: Yeah. That's my fighting name. It comes from my time as a gladiator.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214106.text: Just get him out of here, or I'm gonna lose my mind.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214409_0.text: I'd like nothing better. I need to do something, anything, before I go nuts here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214744_0.text: Hey. I just couldn't take it from him any more, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214744_1.text: The guy has no use for me anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214744_2.text: I gave him a bit of a scare so he won't to get rid of me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429214744.text: You gave Masil a pretty nasty scare.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429221432_0.text: Alright. Then I can finally go and do my own thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429221432_1.text: Thank you. Here, take this. It will help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429221432.text: I don't think I need you any longer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429223231.text: Wow, I made a great profit.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429225031_1.text: In a way, yes. You're peering into every corner as though you've lost something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429225031_2.text: Mmh, or you're looking for an opportunity to bag something here in the city, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429225146_0.text: Mmh, in that case, I might be able to help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429225402_0.text: Well. I might have something for someone like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429230043_0.text: The most influential merchants in the entire desert live in this damn city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429230043_1.text: And their great wealth matches their position.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429230043_2.text: If you help me to lighten their burden somewhat, I could teach you how to really line your pockets.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429230043.text: Alright. What do you have to offer?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429230330.text: Alright. I'll help you. What exactly am I supposed to steal?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_0.text: He told the merchants here stories of a great evil demon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_1.text: It always comes by night and steals the souls of unbelievers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_2.text: Naturally, there is a remedy. The Soul Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_3.text: It would protect it's owner from the demon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_4.text: Five of the merchants here paid a fortune to obtain the Soul Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_5.text: Since then, every one of them has had one standing next to his pillow.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_6.text: Bring me the five Soul Chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125_7.text: The fools will also pay a second time when they notice that the things are gone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234125.text: A while ago, this quack came to Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234237.text: Who exactly has a Soul Chalice?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234527_0.text: For the others, I am not quite so sure.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234527_1.text: Just take a look beside their beds.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234527_2.text: And don't get any ideas about selling them the items yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234527_3.text: That requires a bit more sales talent, if you know what I mean.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234527.text: Faesul bought one, and Ilja as well, that I know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234800_0.text: Ha! You are great. You've got what it takes. Congratulations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234800_1.text: Here. I'll give you some gold now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234800_2.text: Some time will have to pass before I can show up at the merchants with these things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060429234800_3.text: They need to stew for a while first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430002253.text: It's time to attack Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430002257.text: Yes, that's right. Let's put an end to the slave drivers.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430002830.text: Merdarion! What are you doing here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430002857.text: I'm studying the writings of the Ancient Ones. What can I do for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430002931.text: I'm one of the Water Mages you met on the island of Khorinis.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003308_0.text: If you are planning on attacking Mora Sul, you can count on the help of the nomads.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003308_1.text: They all want to fight at your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003308.text: When they heard of your heroic deeds, I could barely hold them back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003801_0.text: Yes, that was impossible to miss.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003801_1.text: The dead are wandering across the land, razing everything and everybody to the ground.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003801_2.text: We must put an end to the chaos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003801.text: The temple of Mora Sul is open.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430003833.text: Come back to see me once you have opened the temple.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430004016_0.text: The hordes of the undead are led by 4 undead commanders.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430004016_1.text: If they fall, we can prevent the worst.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011004_0.text: Very good. Then the dead will soon rest in peace once again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011004_1.text: Well done. I am proud of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011004_2.text: Take care of yourself. We all still need you.
