INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011004_3.text: Take this with you on your way. Adanos be with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011004.text: The commanders of the undead are history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011400_0.text: The commanders of the Ancient Ones do not belong in this time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011400_1.text: Their rule has long since passed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011400.text: Yes. Let us go forth to battle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011616.text: Stay close behind me. We've got to catch them all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430011742.text: We must not hesitate. That would be the death of us all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430012214.text: The undead simply do not belong in this world.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430012345.text: I shall devote myself to my studies once again. There is still much to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430021448.text: Now you can move about the city freely.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060430021810.text: You can go in. Uruk is expecting you, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505182403.text: This horrible desert is really getting to me now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505182555_0.text: As if the awful heat weren't enough, one has to deal with those stupid beasts as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505182555_1.text: I had a campsite over to the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505182833_0.text: And one of those things ended up eating all of my stuff.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505182833.text: Then the sandcrawlers came one night and almost killed me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183027_0.text: That sandcrawler should be badly injured.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183027.text: But I slugged that beast a good one before I ran for my life.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183337_0.text: I am here on a holy mission.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183337_1.text: The Fire Mages sent me on a quest for the fire chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183337_2.text: Yes. And I found one, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183337_3.text: That was no piece of cake, believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183337.text: What's a paladin doing in this land?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183544_0.text: Good thing, too. That beast was possessed by Beliar himself, believe me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183807_0.text: I am going to need your help again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183807_1.text: Cut open that sandcrawler and get the thing out of him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183807_2.text: Then take the wretched chalice to the Fire Mages in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505183807.text: So what about your fire chalice?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505184004.text: Let's go look for your injured sandcrawler.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505184107_0.text: I know exactly where it is. Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505184107.text: I don't need to go looking for that horrid beast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505184141.text: Will you look at this. This is my old campsite.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505184958.text: Oh well. I'll never go back there by myself. It's hell out there, let me tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505185258.text: And now my chalice is in the belly of that sandcrawler from hell, happily roaming the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505185844.text: I will keep looking around here, maybe I'll find some more after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190135_0.text: Praised be Innos. There are some honest people left in this land.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190135.text: I have come to give you back your magic!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190513_0.text: You are playing an essential role in this war of madness.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190513_1.text: I am quite sure about that now. Just watch your back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190513_2.text: I can help you like you helped me if you want me to.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190513_3.text: I will be your comrade-in-arms if you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060505190513.text: Take this as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508114749.text: Here, take my fire chalice. It is better if you keep it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508114820.text: I'll see what I can do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508120045.text: Now find the remaining eleven and bring them here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508120352.text: How exactly are you going to restore the power of the fire chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508120453.text: I already found one of them. Now we need the rest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508121552_0.text: Go and look for them. Perhaps some of them know more by now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508121552.text: We have sent out some paladins, and some of our brothers as well, to find the chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508122517_0.text: I knew you wouldn't disappoint us, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508122517_1.text: Throw them into the sacred fire now. Hurry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508122517.text: I found all the fire chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508132629_0.text: The Fire Chalices are ancient, and were thought to have been lost for many years.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508132629.text: What is so special about the Fire Chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508132639.text: It is said that they possess powerful magical capabilities, but I am no expert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508132703.text: If you should find a Fire Chalice, take it to my brethren in Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508132942.text: Many artifacts are of great value to us mages as well, such as the Fire Chalices, for example.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508133303.text: They will be able to tell you more about it than I can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508135230_0.text: Mmh. Not much. Only that the Fire Mages are looking for them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508135230_1.text: I think that Kurt once carried one of those things. But I may be mistaken.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508135230.text: What do you know about the Fire Chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508164343.text: Even the great plans of the Fire Mages aren't going to change that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508164612_0.text: Some mages in Nordmar think they have found a way to restore our magic.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508164612_1.text: That's why they're searching for those old Fire Chalices and having them taken to their monastery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508164612.text: What great plans of the Fire Mages would that be?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508164848.text: What else do you know about the Fire Chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508165122_1.text: In my pocket. I found it among the junk belonging to the soldiers who were driven from this castle.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508165122.text: Nothing. I only know where one of them is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508170051_1.text: Whatever you don't seem to be able to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508170051_2.text: Mmh. All right. Here, take the thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508170234.text: Who knows? If you take it to the Fire Mages in Nordmar, maybe some good will come out of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508173541_0.text: I don't know a whole lot about it. I'm not a Fire Mage.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508173541_1.text: The orcs took the chalice away from me and let Zapotek have it for safekeeping.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508173541.text: Tell me more about the Fire Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508174156.text: I don't know whether it is still in Zapotek's hut.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180327.text: How much do you know about the ancient magic?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180432_0.text: And one thing in particular. I have found a Fire Chalice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180432.text: Mh, I have already learned a great deal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180631_0.text: It must be taken to Nordmar, you see.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180631.text: Unfortunately, I have no one to whom I can entrust it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508180844.text: I will take your Fire Chalice to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508181002.text: You would do that? Hmm, a tempting offer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508181212_0.text: Nordmar is awfully dangerous and the chalice mustn't fall into the wrong hands, you see?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508181212.text: But first I need proof that you are strong enough and I can trust you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508181830_0.text: Very well. I shall entrust you with this precious artifact.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508181830_1.text: I hope it reaches my brethren in the monastery in one piece.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508183513_0.text: I've heard of those. I certainly hope they haven't found all of the chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508183513_1.text: I would feel more at ease if we could get ahold of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508183513.text: The Fire Mages are looking for some old artifacts they call fire chalices.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508183839_0.text: Go find all the fire chalices and bring them to me before the Fire Mages can get their hands on them, all right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508183839.text: All right, you know what you need to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508190424.text: Here are the twelve fire chalices of the Fire Mages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508190612_0.text: Here, take this. You have rendered a great service to the orc people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508190612.text: Ah. This calls for a fat reward, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508191214_0.text: How could you let the orcs have the fire chalices?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508191214_1.text: Innos is angry. Now the holy fire will no longer aid us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508191214.text: Say, are you out of your mind?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508191606.text: Relax. Everything will be all right.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508191835.text: Well done. Keep up the good work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508192340_0.text: And there's no mistaking that you were somehow involved.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508192340_1.text: Now don't tell me you just couldn't prevent it, Morra?!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508192340.text: I heard that the ritual of the Fire Chalices has been completed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508192739.text: This calls for a sound thrashing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508193402.text: Here, take this. It will be useful.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060508193408.text: My brethren in Nordmar will certainly be proud of you if you restore the magic to the paladins.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510182334_0.text: Xardas turned around and left. Without a word.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510182334.text: Nobody could look at it. It would blind you on the spot.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510182352.text: Then, suddenly, everything was quiet and the glow had disappeared.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510183522.text: You are a strong warrior and you deserve respect.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510184211_0.text: But that damn barrier the king set up just won't allow it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510184211.text: I am waiting for a chance to attack the capital, Vengard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510191557.text: But I'm sure that there is a way to get into the king's castle, and that the rebels know of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510201745_0.text: If you manage to do that, I will richly reward you, do you hear me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510201745.text: I will break the resistance of humankind for good.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202105_0.text: Did you, really? And what about that joker in Silden who interrupts our chain of supply from Nordmar?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202105_1.text: His camp must be up there in the woods, somewhere between Silden and the pass that leads to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202105_2.text: Mmh. I seem to have forgotten about him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202105.text: I eliminated all major rebel leaders.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202300.text: It is true. You are indeed a great warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202412_0.text: What are you telling me? Dead?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202714_0.text: Kill the Morra king, and I will bestow on you the greatest honor that a Morra can ever receive from an orc.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510202714.text: The time has come for you to perform your masterstroke.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510203047.text: Ha ha ha. You're one amazing devil.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510203433.text: The kingdom of humans has fallen for good.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510204812.text: Good. Then go forth and do my bidding.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510204928.text: Then get moving. Go to Silden and kill that Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510205610.text: The king and the rebels have been eradicated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510205902_0.text: You have earned the greatest distinction there is.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510205902_1.text: This honor has never before been bestowed on a Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510205902.text: Hahaha. And all that was your work, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510210808_0.text: I will raze your king's castle to the ground. Nothing shall be left of it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510210808_1.text: Never again shall the people of the Morras rise again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510210808_3.text: And you will set out on your own now that your people are defeated.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510210808_4.text: May your battles be victorious, great warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510210808.text: We will try to get rid of this accursed barrier around Vengard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510212025_0.text: Alright. Then all that's left to do now is to eradicate the remaining rebel spawn.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510212025_1.text: Go take care of that and I will bestow on you the greatest honor that a Morra has ever received from an orc.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060510212025.text: How long have I been waiting for this news?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511213726_0.text: And you look like Morras to me!

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511213726.text: Xardas has ordered that all Morras are to be brought to the excavations.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_0.text: The reign of the orcs is broken.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_1.text: The royal troops and paladins will once again become numerous and grow in power, pride, and strength.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_11.text: Kan will be celebrated as the conqueror of the orcish kingdom and crown himself the new king of Myrtana.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_12.text: But ultimately, the orcs will learn to live in peace with the humans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_13.text: Thorus will find one last gate that he will guard. The gate to the desert of Varant.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_14.text: He will become governor of Trelis and be the only human commander whom the orcs would follow to the death.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_2.text: For many years, Lee thirsted for the king's life, because of Rhobar's betrayal of him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_3.text: King Rhobar is dead. Now Lee's revenge is finally complete.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_4.text: Lee will now become the general of the army. His strong leadership will reunite the scattered bands of humans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_5.text: His war against the orcs will only end when the last city is freed from the orcs, or Lee dies a hero's death.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_6.text: Gorn will stay in Gotha and rebuild the old castle. It will become a place of refuge for all those not destroyed by the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_7.text: Gorn will keep fighting against the orcs on his own account. The orcs will learn to fear his very name.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_8.text: After the death of Rhobar II, I will ascend his throne and become King of Myrtana myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219_9.text: The rule of the orcs will last for many years to come.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215219.text: With the help of the rebels, I was able to free the human cities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_0.text: The survivors of the war will return to their cities and lands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_1.text: A long era of peace will flourish in the kingdom of the humans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_10.text: Diego will become my treasurer. He will manage the wealth that accumulates in my treasuries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_11.text: The culture of the nomads will vanish from the sands of the desert.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_2.text: With the death of Zuben, the rule of the Hashishin over the desert of Varant will soon collapse.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_3.text: I have freed Varant from the rule of the Hashishin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_4.text: Saturas the Water Mage will lead the nomads on a long journey, and once again they will follow the path of the eternal wanderer, as their forefathers did.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_5.text: The nomads will once again roam the land as their forefathers did.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_6.text: Diego will become the richest man in the world. He always had a knack for good deals.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_7.text: Protected by the walls of Mora Sul, he will build a great trading empire.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_8.text: The rule of the Hashishin will flourish and soon spread across the whole land of Myrtana.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504_9.text: The nomads will not long withstand their attacks and will soon sink into oblivion.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511215504.text: And although the last rebelling humans were defeated, one day the humans will rise again and return to their cities.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_0.text: Angar is weary of fighting and will find a peaceful life in isolation among the ruins of Varant.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_1.text: In the mountains of Nordmar, life will soon go on as usual.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_2.text: Of the barbarian people of Nordmar, only the abandoned huts on the snow-drifted hilltops will bear witness to their once proud villages.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_3.text: The surviving orcs will fight long, bitter battles with the barbarians.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_4.text: The barbarians will finally recover the land of their ancestors.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_5.text: It will become quiet in the white mountains of Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_6.text: Milten will remain in the monastery and study the writings of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_7.text: As an old, gray man, he will become the wisest of the wise and pass the ancient knowledge on to his students.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_8.text: It will take some time for him to see that my decision was the right one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626_9.text: And Lares? Well, I am sure he will always be right where there is something to be had.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060511221626.text: Lester will finally find his long-sought rest in Braga and transform the hot sands of the desert into fruitful farmland for his swampweed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060516113107.text: We are ready to fight for you, Decider.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060516120246.text: Right. Here we are. Let me know when you're ready to attack Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060516120455_0.text: Yes. Time to settle the score.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060516120455.text: Here we go. Let's attack Mora Sul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517201451.text: One more thing. If you defeat my best fighter, I can show you a few tricks as well.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517201925.text: Come and receive your reward. I bow my head before you, great warrior.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517203725.text: Can you teach me the art of magic, even though all you do these days is cook?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517203758.text: Alright. I will give it a try.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517204513_0.text: Teach? Yes, yes. Of course, I can do that too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517204513.text: You mean, you could teach me alchemy then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517204523.text: Go and bring it to me, all right? Then we can chat about alchemy some more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517205926_0.text: If you help me, perhaps I could teach you some of my skills.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517205926.text: One hand washes the other. I may lack in courage, but I am rather nimble and agile.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517210516.text: Roll up your sleeves and get to work here, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211218.text: You'll be well rewarded with gold and notoriety, and I will teach you how to fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211749_0.text: We could also train a little more if you want.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211749.text: May the light of Adanos lighten every path that you walk.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211918_0.text: Not before I get to know you better, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211918_1.text: How am I to know you wouldn't use your newly acquired knowledge to attack ME?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517211918.text: Can you teach me your fighting style?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517213715_0.text: For a price, of course. Nothing's free in life, hee hee.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517213715.text: Hey, maybe you're also interested in learning some thieving skills...

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517213814.text: I think I could still teach you a thing or two.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517214029.text: I'm an experienced hunter, and I wouldn't go up against those beasts alone.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517215029_1.text: First, show me what you can do. Maybe you're already a lot better than I am.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517215029.text: Can you teach me anything about hunting?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517215404_0.text: At the moment, I cannot. You can see that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517220048_0.text: Hah. How can I do that without a forge?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517220048_1.text: I'm sorry, but that's asking too much.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517220048.text: You're a blacksmith? Can you teach me your art, then?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517220757.text: Find me a smithy with no orcs around, and I will show you whatever I can.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517223728.text: I can show you how to improve your fighting skills.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517224033.text: But you Morras are just too weak by yourselves. We need more orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517224247.text: I can teach you a thing or two about hunting if you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517224808_0.text: I must admit that I find that somewhat intriguing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517224808.text: Mmh. A Morra interested in the wisdom of the shamans?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517225407.text: Fine. I will teach you if Umbrak, our great commander, agrees to meet you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517225418.text: If Umbrak respects you, so will I.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517225617.text: Now that you are no longer unknown around here, I will teach you some of the art of the shamans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517225851.text: Use this knowledge to defend the city, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517231718_0.text: If I had work as a blacksmith once again, I could show you how I do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517231718.text: Could you teach me how to be a smith?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517232037_1.text: Fine. I'll be on my way, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517232037.text: Hey, come and see me in the smithy sometime if you're interested, kid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517232535.text: If there's any way I can help you, let me know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060517232805.text: But first you'll have to come with me up to the hunting cabin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518001521.text: You are permitted to wield your weapon for the orc people. Isn't that enough for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010254_0.text: Excellent, then I can go back to hunting near the capital. Ha ha ha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010254.text: The orcs besieging the capital, Vengard, are history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010526_0.text: A whole army is camped out there. I wouldn't get too close to them if I were you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010526.text: But there's one place you should stay away from - Vengard, the capital to the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010844_0.text: That is good news. Another victory for Innos.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010844_1.text: Here, take this for your glorious campaign.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518010844.text: The siege ring outside the barrier is history.

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518022131.text: What about Lester, wasn't he going to get some reinforcements?

INFO_BPANKRATZ320060518221439.text: The moonblade, you say. The grand prize of the arena of Mora Sul?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3201.text: It is said that no orc has made it through the forest alive.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3203.text: Do you know a safe path?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3205.text: Alright. I don't have much choice, do I?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3207.text: Thanks, Morra. That sure was something.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3208.text: I hope I won't be sent back to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3209.text: I have an important delivery for the city shaman Grompel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3210.text: Why don't you just go to Grompel?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3211.text: I will take you to the shaman Grompel in Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3212.text: Show me the way to the rebels.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3213.text: The rebels are also interested in your delivery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3214.text: I imagine so. Thanks to you, they didn't catch us!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3215.text: I'll gladly pay a few gold coins for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3217.text: Oh, shut up. I need raw meat. 50 joints.

INFO_BPANKRATZ322.text: You want to fight, Morra? Mmh...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3221.text: Stop yanking my chain and get out. I'm busy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3225.text: Yes. Well. It'll be enough. For now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3226.text: Here's some gold. And now get yourself out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3227.text: You can't imagine how much these apes can fit in their stomachs, kid.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3228.text: Go get your stinking meat yourself!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3229.text: You better leave me alone before I forget myself!

INFO_BPANKRATZ323.text: Hoho. A blowhard. We just love those.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3230.text: Why can't you be more relaxed?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3231.text: If I don't work hard, they will chop off my head.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3232.text: So help me, or get lost. Just don't stand in my way.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3235.text: We orcs will kill all of you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ324.text: Trompok will split your skull if you challenge him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3240.text: Umbrak. He is the lord here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3242.text: Where can I find your lord?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3243.text: Umbrak is in the big house.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3244.text: What should I know about your lord?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3245.text: Go see Grompel the shaman. He can tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3249.text: You're not exactly the brightest light, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3252.text: Don't even think about stealing from me, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3254.text: Sorry. I'm just a little edgy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3255.text: What's a guy like you doing in a place like this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3257.text: What's your job in these backwater place?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3258.text: It's not like there's much to do here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3259.text: I'm just hanging out with the other mercenaries, waiting for something to happen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3260.text: You're a mercenary for the orcs and you have nothing to do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3261.text: Sure I do. Recapture runaway slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3262.text: It's hard work trying to find someone hiding in those dense forests out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3264.text: What do you know about this town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3265.text: Silden lies near the pass to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3266.text: When the war started, the orcs came over the mountains from the northeast.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3267.text: That's why Silden was the first town to be overrun and captured.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3269.text: Since that day, there have been no more major battles here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3271.text: Umbrak. During the war, he was a great commander of the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3275.text: Grompel, the city shaman, is his right hand.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3276.text: Umbrak will do nothing without consulting him first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3277.text: You're not so keen on recapturing the slaves, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3278.text: Those poor beggars barely have a chance of surviving in the woods anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ328.text: That is Jaroll. He is good.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3280.text: Does slave hunting pay well here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3281.text: Much too well. We mercenaries almost fight each other for the privilege.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3282.text: We even let some slaves loose on purpose so that we can collect their bounty later.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3283.text: You mercenaries are helping slaves escape?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3284.text: You never heard me say this, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3285.text: If the orcs get wind of this, we're dog meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3286.text: You're not a mercenary. You are a rebel.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3287.text: Curses. Me and my big mouth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3288.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3289.text: All rebels ought to be slaughtered.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3290.text: Too bad. I expected more from you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3292.text: Join us. We could really use a man like you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3294.text: Finally - someone who has the courage to get things rolling.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3296.text: I saw a lot of them in the mill by the river.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3297.text: Should be about five bundles of weapons.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3300.text: He's holed up in the woods with a few of his people.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3304.text: The ones that haven't been torn apart by wild beasts are hiding somewhere to the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3305.text: Somebody must take them to our refugee camp in the woods near the pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3306.text: A fellow named Freman will take care of them there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3307.text: If we had those it would be a huge step for us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3308.text: I've got some weapons for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3309.text: That's good. More would be even better.

INFO_BPANKRATZ331.text: You're a good arena fighter, right?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3310.text: I have the weapons that you need.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3311.text: You're a good man. We could really use you here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3312.text: Somebody needs to go tell him that we need his help here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3315.text: What am I to do? I cannot leave here now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3317.text: Go to my brother Inog and tell him that HE will have to see to whatever is necessary from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3325.text: By Innos. Unless there is a miracle, we are all doomed to die.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3326.text: When are you rebels going to strike?

INFO_BPANKRATZ333.text: I could use a strong arm to help me clean up the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3334.text: Here in Silden, the orcs are in the minority.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3335.text: And yet, Umbrak still rules with an iron fist.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3336.text: He must have something powerful up his sleeve to make them all fear him like that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3338.text: First we need to know exactly what it is before we go ahead with the uprising.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3339.text: You orcs are in the minority here. Aren't you afraid of an uprising?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3340.text: No. The Morras are too afraid of torture for that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3341.text: In the last war, I had the opportunity of refining my methods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3342.text: I would be happy to show you what I mean...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3345.text: So? What is it? A powerful magic artifact?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3346.text: Umbrak was an especially brutal commander during the war.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3347.text: They all avoid his wrath so they won't end up like his war victims.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3348.text: Umbrak must die or we will never be free.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3349.text: What about you? Would you dare to kill Umbrak?

INFO_BPANKRATZ335.text: Because otherwise I'll punch you in the mouth.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3353.text: He's an orc, not a demigod.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3354.text: Your brother Anog cannot help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3355.text: Dammit. I have no idea how I will do this all by myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3356.text: Oh well. Thanks for your help anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3362.text: Fine, then we will follow you stranger, as soon as you give the signal.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3363.text: I heard about the rebellion. So Silden is really free?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3370.text: I'm taking care of all these escaped slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3371.text: There's more and more of them. Soon I won't know where to put them up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3373.text: Lately, an increasing number of slaves have fled to the woods up here from Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3374.text: They are desperate and have nowhere to go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3375.text: I try to help them as best I can, and find places for them to stay.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3376.text: Let's talk about the gold for the escaped slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3377.text: We're all poor buggers up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ338.text: Ha. I've got a better idea.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3387.text: Innos be with us. Everything will be even worse from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3388.text: I'll get you out of here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ339.text: Show me that you can fight and I'll go monster hunting with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3391.text: You won't survive here for long.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3392.text: I know. What else can I do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3393.text: You have no chance of surviving up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3394.text: Do you have a better idea?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3397.text: Here, I brought an escaped slave.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3398.text: Very good. I will put him up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3407.text: Anything is better than being eaten by beasts here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3408.text: Alright. I thought I'd croak out here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ341.text: You have defeated me. I will fight at your side.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3410.text: What do you want? Can't you see that you're bothering me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3413.text: So you are the master of this city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3415.text: Umbrak is the leader of this sleazy little settlement.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3416.text: And I hope he won't be for very much longer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3417.text: Umbrak seems to be very popular.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3418.text: Popular? Every orc and every Morra in this hole is afraid of him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3419.text: But I don't believe the stories about his heroic deeds.

INFO_BPANKRATZ342.text: Go see Barrack and tell him you want to fight.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3420.text: I would challenge him if I could.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3421.text: What sort of a camp is this?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3422.text: Idiot. It's plain to see. This is a prison camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3423.text: Morras like you come here when they cause us trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3424.text: I suppose you'd like to be in Umbrak's place.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3426.text: The Morras in the city have too much freedom.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3429.text: Bad. You Morras just won't listen to reason.

INFO_BPANKRATZ343.text: Go see Barrack and I'll enter the arena with you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3431.text: And? They arrested YOU for that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3432.text: What's preventing you from challenging Umbrak?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3434.text: Umbrak won't do anything without asking his advice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3435.text: You could almost say that Grompel is the real master of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3436.text: I could kill Grompel for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3437.text: Hohoho. I want to see that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3438.text: Mmh. You're really serious about this, aren't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3439.text: Alright. I will give you a pile of gold if you succeed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3440.text: Would the city be greatly weakened if the shaman Grompel died?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3443.text: Grompel, the city shaman is dead.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3445.text: I'll gladly pay you for that, runt!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3447.text: Hahaha. You can count on it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3448.text: But first I have to sort out the matter with the slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3450.text: But most of the slaves are working.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3451.text: Sure. But only because I make them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3452.text: Your slaves are being torn apart by wild beasts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3453.text: That's right. The idiots run for the mountains where they get eaten by wolves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3454.text: Slaves are escaping from YOUR camp?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3456.text: I'll have the hide of the fellow who set them free...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3459.text: I will bring back your slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3461.text: Kill them. All five of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3462.text: That's the only way to make sure the other slaves remain docile.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3464.text: Very good. Then they can't cause any more trouble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3465.text: Instead of working for me, you prefer being torn apart by wild beasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3466.text: A human named Inog freed some slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3467.text: I knew it. A dirty Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3468.text: I'll think of something special for that guy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3469.text: Here's your gold for your lousy treason, Morra. Haha.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3470.text: The orcs know that you set the slaves free.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3471.text: Dammit. That makes it even more important that we strike soon.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3477.text: I tried to steal a Fire Chalice from the chest of an orc.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3479.text: So now they're keeping me locked up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ348.text: Who's in charge here in town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3483.text: The only chance to avoid the orc patrols lies in the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3484.text: But it's way too dangerous in the woods up there because of all the wild beasts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3486.text: You'd rather be a slave than take a chance?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3487.text: Nonsense. All I'm saying is that fleeing won't get us anywhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3488.text: A few have already run for it. They never made it far.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3490.text: This camp hardly looks like a jail at all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3491.text: Don't let the open palisades fool you, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3492.text: The orcs are watching every step of the people here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3493.text: We must fight the orcs, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3497.text: I know that the orcs are storing weapons in a large cache in the main building.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3498.text: We need at least five bundles of weapons, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ350.text: But I don't know if he has time for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3500.text: Good. Then give us the signal when you want us to strike.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3501.text: Once you engage in battle with the orcs, we will help you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3503.text: Very good. But we don't have quite enough yet, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3504.text: Is there anything your boys here need?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3505.text: Some slaves have escaped and the orcs are not amused.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3506.text: So they punish us by starving us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3507.text: I will get you something to eat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3508.text: Great. You should go see Gambal the cook in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3509.text: He keeps the orcs supplied with roast meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3511.text: I've got some roast meat for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3512.text: Very good. But this is not enough to feed everyone. I need more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3514.text: Thanks. You saved us from starvation.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3515.text: I've got a few potions here for you, brother.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3516.text: Jerek sent me. The convicts are starving out there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3518.text: Meat doesn't grow on trees, you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3519.text: Here, ten roast joints for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ352.text: Maybe you should talk to the town shaman first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3520.text: And now get out before the apes take notice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3521.text: Go and get me some raw meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3522.text: Gambal, that permanently cranky old scumbag - he's your friend?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3524.text: He's always a bit funny with strangers, but deep down he's a kind-hearted soul.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3526.text: A particularly splendid day. Don't you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3529.text: And with whom do I have the pleasure to interact?

INFO_BPANKRATZ353.text: His name is Grompel. He's the right hand of Warlord Umbrak.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3532.text: Indeed? Then I'm sure you also don't know how things work here, eh?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3533.text: No matter. I will take care of you, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3534.text: That's none of your damn business.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3535.text: Why so distrustful? Do you perhaps not like the people of the desert?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3537.text: I am a procurer of valuable manpower, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3539.text: A dreadful word for such a responsible task. Don't you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3540.text: Do you also deal with runaway slaves?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3541.text: Here in Silden, the mercenaries are responsible for keeping what I bring them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3542.text: Where do you get your slaves?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3543.text: Many people are hiding from the orcs in the local woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3544.text: I look for them and convince them to work for the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3545.text: At least, that is one way of looking at it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3546.text: I want to help you hunt slaves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3548.text: I have just learned that a group of woodcutters is roaming about to the west.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3550.text: You should grab at least one of them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3554.text: You don't have any idea what an Hashishin looks like, do you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3555.text: Not exactly. I've only heard that they've come to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3557.text: Don't they scare you? The things you hear are terrifying.

INFO_BPANKRATZ356.text: Ah. I know you. I have met you before.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3568.text: How do you make a living?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3569.text: I'm a woodcutter and sell wood and wild berries.

INFO_BPANKRATZ357.text: Mmh... not that I know of.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3571.text: To the fisherfolk of Silden. They come by here quite often.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3572.text: But no one has come by in a few days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3576.text: I've never seen anyone like you here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3577.text: You aren't an Hashishin, are you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3578.text: I could look into why the fishermen aren't coming anymore.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3579.text: Would you do that for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ358.text: In my dreams. You were alone, and fighting.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3582.text: He ordered them, but never picked them up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3585.text: The Orcs have doubled their guards.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3589.text: I gave the package to Stan the fisherman.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3590.text: Aha. Why don't the fishermen come to us anymore?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3592.text: Thank you. Here, take this gold as a reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3593.text: Then you can take this package of wild berries to Stan the fisherman at the same time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3598.text: I've had it up to here with those stinking things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3599.text: I have a package here for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ360.text: What else do you know about me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3600.text: Mmh, wild berries from Bozep. Marvelous!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3601.text: I haven't been to see him since the orcs doubled the watch.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3602.text: My thanks to the courier. Here, take this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3605.text: No, but mine looks almost exactly the same.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3606.text: The orcs did a good job.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3609.text: I don't know what I would do without the woods.

INFO_BPANKRATZ361.text: Your future is unclear. Many decisions lie before you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3611.text: Yes. I can break a solid beam with my bare hands if needed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3612.text: What's in it for me if I enslave a woodcutter for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3613.text: You won't go away empty-handed, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3614.text: I have a new man for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3616.text: Here, we will share the proceeds from the new man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3617.text: I will now take you to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3618.text: You weakling, you want to enslave me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3619.text: I'm going to squash you, you bastard.

INFO_BPANKRATZ362.text: You are different from the other Morras. You are important.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3620.text: You will do what I tell you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3621.text: I suppose I don't have a choice.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3622.text: You will come with me to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3626.text: So I see. Is that all?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3628.text: Exhausting. We're fishing like mad here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3629.text: Caravans are constantly coming by and taking the smelly things away.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3633.text: I want to see your leader.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3634.text: Access will only be granted to those who enjoy a certain reputation in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3635.text: Umm... would this be the upper quarter?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3636.text: Why else do you think I'm standing guard here, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ364.text: Hush! Your story has not yet been written,

INFO_BPANKRATZ3641.text: How can I improve my reputation in town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3642.text: That's simple. Just make yourself useful. There's enough work to do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3643.text: There's one thing we need in particular. Reinforcements!

INFO_BPANKRATZ3645.text: Look around you. There's almost nothing but humans here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3646.text: And barely an orc who isn't feeling completely overwhelmed.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3648.text: YOU? You're a Morra. Just like most people here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3649.text: If you want to help defend the city, you should train your fighting skills first.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3650.text: What we could really use up here is a blacksmith.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3652.text: Where can I find a blacksmith for this town?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3653.text: Just walk around and ask the orcs.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3654.text: There must be one among them who knows a thing or two about forging.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3655.text: You now have a new blacksmith. His name is Kadok.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3656.text: Finally. Why did that take you so long? Here's your reward, Morra.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3657.text: I'm supposed to come pick up a piece of roast meat.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3661.text: Where are orcs needed the most?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3662.text: We need some guards here within the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3663.text: If we don't watch out, the rebels might overrun us in the end.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3664.text: Got no time. I'm on guard duty.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3666.text: I've been standing here for days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3668.text: I want some roasted meat. Five pieces.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3669.text: I've got some roast meat for you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3672.text: They need guards in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3673.text: Mmh. I'll go have a look, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3675.text: Go to Denpok and tell him that I'll be in town from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3676.text: Frillock is now patrolling the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3677.text: Well done, Morra. Here's your reward.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3679.text: A herd of lurkers has settled on the other side of the river to the south.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3680.text: Strange things have been happening here ever since they showed up.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3681.text: The shoals of fish have been going crazy.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3683.text: If I didn't have to stand guard, I'd deal with the brutes myself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3685.text: Very good. Well, then it's back to guard duty.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3689.text: Could it have something to do with those strange lurkers over there?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3690.text: More guards are needed in Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3692.text: Let Denpok know that I'll be in the city from now on, got it?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3693.text: Brontobb will stay in town from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3695.text: Silden needs more guards within the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3696.text: I'll go, but Denpok should know about this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3700.text: What is it? What do you want?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3701.text: Don't you have anything to do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3702.text: I'm a guard. But my halberd has disappeared.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3703.text: No halberd, no guard. It's as simple as that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3704.text: Here's your halberd. I found it with the fishermen.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3705.text: Ah, yes... thank you. The fishermen must have taken it, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3706.text: You hid the halberd with the fishermen yourself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3708.text: You're a lazy pig, trying to avoid work altogether.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3709.text: If it's a punch in the KISSER you want...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3710.text: Well. Looks like I'll have to report this, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3711.text: Grrr. All right. Tell me what you want.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3713.text: Grrr. Here you go. That's all I have.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3714.text: Denpok needs more guards in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3715.text: I'll go. You let Denpok know, understand?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3716.text: Gancka is staying in town from now on.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3719.text: Watching the prisoners is truly degrading.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3720.text: I would much rather go back to battle and fight against you Morras, instead of guarding you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3721.text: What are the humans doing in the prison camp?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3722.text: The Morras are chopping firewood, from here, it is shipped to all neighboring cities in the midlands.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3723.text: Would you rather stand guard elsewhere?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3724.text: Of course I would. Especially in town.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3725.text: Guarding the city walls is a much more honorable job than this.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3727.text: All the firewood from the prison camp must be taken to Givess in the mill.

INFO_BPANKRATZ373.text: I'm going to keep an eye on you, stranger.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3731.text: All right. Give it here. And get the rest, too. I need ten stacks.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3734.text: I'm the warehouse keeper. My name is Givess.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3737.text: Silden supplies the entire surroundings with those things.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3738.text: Dark are the clouds over the forests of Myrtana.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3743.text: The city of Silden needs a blacksmith.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3744.text: Ah. Very good. Work at last! Then at least I won't be sitting around here feeling completely useless.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3745.text: I found your hammer in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3747.text: Now, at last, I can work as a blacksmith again.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3750.text: Do you belong in the mill here?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3752.text: Since I haven't been able to work as a blacksmith, I've just been adrift, sort of.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3754.text: I have misplaced my beloved smith's hammer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3755.text: Would you believe it, I have no idea where I left the darned thing.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3757.text: Mmh. I went to see the town smithy in Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3758.text: And I fought a little in the arena.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3759.text: I must have lost my hammer somewhere there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ376.text: The legends of his deeds are known far and wide.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3762.text: You work here as a fisherman?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3763.text: All day long and all evening, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3764.text: At night I sometimes get a little sleep.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3766.text: I don't get around to anything else.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3767.text: I wrack my bones and I have so much work I don't know if I'm coming or going.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3769.text: All of these fish barrels have to be taken to the mill.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3772.text: Thank Innos. Then WE don't have to do that any more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3773.text: Thanks a lot, stranger. Here is a bit of gold for your work.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3775.text: Follow the river to the north. You'll find it there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3777.text: Thank you. But those are less than eight barrels of fish. Go get the rest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3780.text: Ah. The barrels of fish. Great.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3783.text: Usually, I hunt up in the mountains instead of hanging around here uselessly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3785.text: I just delivered some of our pelts to the warehouse keeper.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3786.text: Actually, I wanted to go straight home.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3788.text: Basically everything that lives here on our plains.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3789.text: For that you sometimes have to be pretty fast and nimble.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3790.text: If you want, I can teach you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3793.text: So. Here is the hunting cabin.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3794.text: Should I teach you something about hunting here on the plains now?

INFO_BPANKRATZ380.text: Why would I tell you about my affairs? Who do you think you are?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3800.text: My contribution to this community is a rather humble one.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3802.text: Very good. Always plenty of prey for a hunter here up north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3803.text: Snappers, mostly. They fetch a fair amount in Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3805.text: Great idea. I think I'll come along.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3806.text: Tell me when you're ready, and off we go.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3808.text: Mmh... looks like it. Too bad.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3809.text: Oh well. If you want to know anything else about hunting, just ask me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ381.text: I have come to serve you, great warlord.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3810.text: The fattest snappers used to be right here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3812.text: Do you work for the orcs?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3813.text: Any human with half a brain does that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3814.text: Disobeying the orcs would be suicide.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3816.text: You may think whatever you like.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3817.text: I'm not going to meddle as long as I can live in peace up here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ382.text: Is that so? Then answer me one question.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3820.text: Even if the orcs set the prices these days.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3821.text: Back then, the humans in Silden would pay a lot more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3823.text: Fine with me. I hope the price for skins is going to go up, then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3824.text: Thanks for the message. Here, take this, you'll need it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3827.text: We're catching more this season than we can carry.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3828.text: We've barely got time to deliver the pelts we bagged to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3829.text: I could take your pelts to Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ383.text: When will your people finally accept that they are beaten and give up their resistance?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3831.text: Here are eight crates of pelts, all packed up for delivery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3833.text: I gave your fur crates to Givess.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3835.text: Here, I've got pelts from the hunters.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3836.text: All right. But there must be more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3841.text: Take the gold to the hunters.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3842.text: But don't dawdle too long, or they will get mad.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3843.text: Now give me the gold from Givess.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3846.text: An honest man, what do you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ385.text: We will fight you to the last man.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3850.text: You're squandering our hard-earned gold, you scumbag?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3851.text: Have you got anything left for me?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3852.text: For such an honest man? But of course.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3853.text: I can teach you how to hunt.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3854.text: Teach me to be a hunter.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3858.text: The beasts may be dangerous, but their skins fetch a good price.

INFO_BPANKRATZ386.text: Well, well. So you're one of those dirty rebels, too.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3861.text: Well then, let's see what you've got.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3868.text: Sure, if you can already hunt a little, I can teach you properly.

INFO_BPANKRATZ387.text: I ought to kill you on the spot, but I have a better assignment for you - if you can do it.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3870.text: Follow me. I know where to find some really fine wolves.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3873.text: You bastard, you were going to run off with our money for the pelt delivery, weren't you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3874.text: What do you know about Silden?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3875.text: Silden is called the city of hunters.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3876.text: Back then, lots of hunters lived in the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3877.text: But when the Orcs came, we had to clear out of the city.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3878.text: Now only a few of us live out here in the mountains.

INFO_BPANKRATZ388.text: Where can I find this rebel camp?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3881.text: I was once a proud warrior from the highlands of Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3882.text: Why are you in the slammer?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3883.text: I stole from Barrack, the arena master.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3884.text: Those boys don't take kindly to stealing, you know.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3887.text: You can't help me, unless you have plenty of gold.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3889.text: You would have to buy me from Zapotek, the camp commander.

INFO_BPANKRATZ389.text: A whole bunch of insurgents are hiding out there somewhere.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3892.text: Yeah, right. You're just kidding around.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3893.text: Do I look like I would do that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3894.text: Mmh. A man of honor. I'm impressed, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3895.text: I want to buy the freedom of the Nordmarian Lars.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3896.text: Mmh. All right. The Nordman belongs to you.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3897.text: It would be better if he disappeared from here anyway.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3898.text: So far he's caused nothing but trouble here in camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ390.text: They are interfering with our deliveries to Nordmar.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3900.text: Take me to the Nordmar pass.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3901.text: You want to see my home country?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3902.text: But now I'm rotting here in this prison camp.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3903.text: I'll be glad to show it to you, friend. Follow me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3904.text: The pass is over there - further to the north, my friend.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3905.text: I will stay in these woods here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3906.text: I left my home for a reason, after all.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3907.text: Why did you leave your home country?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3908.text: I went on a quest to learn archery.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3909.text: Nobody at home could or would really help me with that.

INFO_BPANKRATZ391.text: Anog is the head of the rabble. Go and kill him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3911.text: Yes. I was the strongest man in my clan back then.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3912.text: Can you make me stronger, too?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3913.text: If I finally get to do what I came to the midlands for - yes, I could.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3914.text: But first, I need to be set free.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3915.text: So where are you headed next?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3917.text: You'll be able to find me with the rebels in the woods here if you need me.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3919.text: Can I go see your leader?

INFO_BPANKRATZ392.text: The others will soon capitulate once their leader falls.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3920.text: Yes. You may see Umrak. Go to him.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3921.text: Someone has to collect the barrels and take them over there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3922.text: Take them to the mill in Silden.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3923.text: That would be a job for you, don't you think?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3924.text: Yes, well. Ask a stupid question...

INFO_BPANKRATZ3926.text: Then go see the hunters up north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3927.text: Where should I get the fish?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3928.text: From the fisherfolk down by the river.

INFO_BPANKRATZ393.text: What can I do to make them see reason?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3933.text: If you find any goods ready for shipping, bring them here.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3934.text: I must be ready for when the next caravan arrives.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3935.text: Where can I get firewood for you?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3936.text: The slaves in the prison camp supply me with wood.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3937.text: They should have delivered their eight crates some time ago.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3938.text: They should have about ten stacks ready for shipping now.

INFO_BPANKRATZ394.text: So. You are the fellow that everyone here is talking about.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3942.text: But ever since the orcs came, it's been used as a storage room.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3943.text: I assemble the goods that are delivered to nearby cities by caravan.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3944.text: Tell me what you want and then go away. I haven't got time.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3947.text: Have you come to mock me, Morra?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3948.text: You can see for yourself just how arduous our excavations are.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3949.text: Every orc in this country is looking for the divine artifacts.

INFO_BPANKRATZ395.text: You are the great warlord that everyone here is talking about.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3950.text: We are digging up tons of garbage from the tunnels in the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3951.text: Where are you looking for divine artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3953.text: We are searching through every temple of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3954.text: If you want to know exactly where those are, look at this map.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3955.text: We follow every clue from old writings and legends, no matter how small.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3956.text: What do you know about the divine artifacts?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3957.text: So far, the significance of the divine artifacts has not revealed itself to us shamans.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3958.text: The only person who seems to know more about this is Xardas himself.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3959.text: Have you got anything for me to do?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3960.text: Mmh. Yes, actually, there is something you could do.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3961.text: We've been told that druids have made themselves at home somewhere in the area.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3966.text: What exactly do you want to know about the druids?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3967.text: So far, the special abilities of druids are an unsolved mystery to us.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3968.text: All we know is that they dedicate themselves to the study of various animal species.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3969.text: They draw their power and fighting strength from this knowledge.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3970.text: We must definitely learn more about this so that we can assess their combat strength.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3972.text: Where did you send your search parties?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3973.text: One to the south, and another to the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3974.text: Ballock leads the search in the north.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3975.text: But it's been a while since he reported back.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3980.text: I already sent out search parties to find them.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3981.text: They even say that the most powerful of all druids is among them. His name is Runak.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3982.text: I need to know more about the druids.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3985.text: Why do you want to know that?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3986.text: Grok is still waiting for your answer.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3988.text: Ballock told me that he is still on his mission to find the druids.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3989.text: Fine. It was well past time that he sent us word.

INFO_BPANKRATZ399.text: And where can I find this great warlord?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3991.text: I'm here on the orders of Grok, the highest shaman in Geldern.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3992.text: I'm supposed to look for druids.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3993.text: And I won't rest until I have combed the entire forest.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3994.text: What does he think? That it's child's play tracking down a druid?

INFO_BPANKRATZ3995.text: I'll stay here and search the area some more.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3997.text: I am convinced that a druid is hiding in the woods down there by the lake.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3998.text: However, I suspect that a band of rangers is also there.

INFO_BPANKRATZ3999.text: I would really like to see that pig of a druid dead.

INFO_FANKRONOS3.text: I'll bring you the Fire Chalices!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510144340_0.text: My name is Hatlod. I am the local shipbuilder, or rather I used to be.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510144848_0.text: Excellent, let me know once you've got them.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510144848.text: All right, I will fetch you the tools.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510144952_0.text: Hmmm, good question. I would start looking around the lake.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510144952.text: Where can I find the tools?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510145031_0.text: Thanks, my friend. At last I can start building again.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510145230_0.text: Hey, great, thanks. Now all that's missing is my saw.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510153349.text: And on top of that, I lost my tools.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510153944_0.text: I think I have some gold coins left somewhere.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154124_0.text: I hope they choked to death on my tools.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154124.text: The two beasts that attacked me must still lurk around there somewhere.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154247_0.text: Whoa there, not so fast. First the saw, then the gold.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154702_0.text: Thanks, pal. Now I'm only missing the hammer.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154702_1.text: How about it, can I get a small cash advance?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510154702_2.text: Sure, as soon as you bring me a small hammer.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510155020.text: Here's the reward I promised you.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160425.text: Used to be? What went wrong?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160517.text: Those filthy orcs have destroyed my entire business.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160714.text: But you have lots of tools left here!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160754.text: That's not the same. My great-grandfather worked with those tools.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160935.text: What exactly happened to your tools?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510160953.text: It was like this: I took my new boat out on a test run.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161022.text: And suddenly there's a crash and my boat is history.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161100.text: All I could do was get to dry land.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161122.text: And where do your tools come into this?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161202.text: I had them with me. As I said, I was testing my boat.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161228.text: There were two beasts that almost ripped me to pieces.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161305.text: I threw the tools at them. Barely managed to get away.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810_2.text: That was a lizard. Man, I was lucky to have my tools.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810_3.text: I tossed the tools right into their open jaws.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810_4.text: And now here I am, with nothing left at all.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810_5.text: Too bad I'm so busy with my new boat, or I would...

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810_8.text: I see. Not the bravest soul, are you?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161810.text: One was a lurker. Nasty things, those.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510161959.text: What do you think of the orcs?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162203_0.text: If I were a warrior, I would fight in the arena.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162203.text: I'm a shipbuilder, not a swordfighter.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162450_0.text: But I shouldn't say that out loud. I leave them in peace and they don't bother me.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162450_1.text: It's just that the demand for boats is no longer there.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162450_2.text: The orcs no longer allow any large-scale ship construction.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162450.text: Bunch of vermin, they are. I hope they get what they deserve.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162715_0.text: Yeah, a right old swashbuckler he was. Came from the southern islands.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162715_1.text: He settled here and brought the art of shipbuilding with him.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162715_2.text: He had his tools from the southern islands.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510162715_3.text: They are truly a joy to work with.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_1.text: Look over there, by the lake. Those huge broken walls.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_2.text: That used to be an old stronghold of the paladins.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_3.text: Then some people in Trelis dammed up the river towards the sea.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_4.text: Must have been a bunch of crazy mages.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_5.text: And whoosh, there went the castle!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163013_6.text: Man, we laughed our heads off when those tin buckets started crawling out of the new lake!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163139_0.text: Quite a few boats went down after they hit those ruins.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163139.text: And now the remnants of the castle pose a hazard for all vessels.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163554_0.text: It's some castle further to the south.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163554_1.text: Walk along the lake towards the south, and then simply follow the river.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163800_0.text: They were mad as wet hens!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163800_1.text: The king let them have the castle near Gotha.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510163800_2.text: I've no idea what became of them.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510171244_0.text: Well, this is going to be a little more complicated...

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510171244_1.text: Go south like you are headed for Trelis.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510171244_2.text: Just before you get to Trelis, take the path towards Montera.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510171244_3.text: Go past Montera and head north.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510173525.text: Don't spend it all in one place.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510173917.text: Give me skins for Sibur Nurad

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510174940.text: Maybe you could help me a little more...

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_1.text: I'm not that good at building boats.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_2.text: That's why the orcs are still letting me work.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_3.text: And? Am I supposed to explain to you how to build a boat?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_4.text: No, of course not, but if you ever meet anybody...

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_5.text: I would make it worth your while.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_6.text: Bring me something that helps me build better boats,

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510175912_7.text: and I swear by my great-grandfather that you will be richly rewarded.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180108_0.text: If I knew how and where to look, I would have gone myself.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180108_1.text: But you won't have much luck in Myrtana.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180108_2.text: The orcs did a thorough job there.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180108_3.text: Maybe you should try further south.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180108.text: Any idea where I should start looking?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180455_0.text: BY THE LONG BEARD OF INNOS!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180455_1.text: You brought me a regular blueprint!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180455_3.text: Ah, wait. You don't want to know. Let's just say this will truly be a dreamboat.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510180455.text: Here, I've got something for you.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200045_0.text: Gentle greetings, my friend. How can Sibur Narad help you?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200045_1.text: The knowing one. The finder among seekers.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200045_3.text: Everything is fine. The sun is warm and the sand is dry.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200045_4.text: Life could not be better. Do you want to buy?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200045_5.text: Good old Sibur has all sorts of things to offer.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200258_0.text: Don't say things like that. Consider it consciousness expanding meditation.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200258_1.text: You would not believe how everything becomes so simple all at once.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200258_2.text: The significance of the small in the large. The large in the small...

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200258_7.text: It is really good stuff, oh word-twisting friend.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200444.text: I saw a boatyard outside of your house.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200445_0.text: No, no. That has become much too taxing for me.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200445_1.text: I prefer to inhale a bit of weed and build in my head.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200445_2.text: Recently I was sooo stoned. I dreamed of a really ingenious boat.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200445_3.text: I had to draw it right away.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200538_0.text: Hey, man, that's my invention. I'm not going to just give it away.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_0.text: Mhhhh, I might have an idea.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_1.text: Bring me five furs from white wolves.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_10.text: I've tried it with lots of different furs. I'm still missing those from white wolves.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_2.text: I think they have those in Nordmar.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_6.text: Furs?? In the desert?? And then from Nordmar??

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_7.text: Sure, friend. You have no idea.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_8.text: Have you ever stretched out naked on a fur and had a little smoke?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510200858_9.text: You really have to try it. It's ... like flying.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201024_0.text: So you better give me the drawing now!!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201024_1.text: Hey relax. Here, have a smoke first.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201304_0.text: In Nordmar, my friend with the short memory.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201304.text: Where can I find those furs again?

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_0.text: Thanks, oh glorious hero of the long road.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_1.text: Conqueror of the rending beasts of the north!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_2.text: The plans! Don't try sucking up!

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_5.text: Hey, it was worth a try.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_6.text: Here is the drawing. I have no idea what I drew there.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510201848_7.text: As I mentioned, I was sooo stoned.

INFO_FEELDAPOWER20060510203740.text: Trust me, oh Son of Distrustfulness.

INFO_FILLER1.text: Here are the healing plants you asked for.

INFO_FILLER10.text: I've never seen you around here. What do you want?

INFO_FILLER107.text: And what are YOU going to do?

INFO_FILLER108.text: I tell you that it is up to us to prevent either Beliar or Innos from winning this war.

INFO_FILLER12.text: Xardas! While I spent all these weeks on the road you have been meddling in a war.

INFO_FILLER129.text: What are you talking about? Tell me more.

INFO_FILLER13.text: So why don't you tell me what's going on?

INFO_FILLER130.text: The war of the gods has been raging for ages - but soon it will be over.

INFO_FILLER133.text: You speak of the decision between Innos and Beliar.

INFO_FILLER134.text: As I see it, those are our only options at the moment.

INFO_FILLER135.text: But perhaps there is still a third option. Another way...

INFO_FILLER159.text: Innos! I want to fight for you!

INFO_FILLER160.text: It is time to end the chaos and reform the world!

INFO_FILLER161.text: I am the Fire of Life!

INFO_FILLER174.text: I shall help you obtain dominion over the world.

INFO_FILLER176.text: I am not ready for that.

INFO_FILLER177.text: Since we were imprisoned behind the barrier, since the moment that Beliar spoke to me.

INFO_FILLER178.text: What a triumph it would have been for him to know that I took his side.

INFO_FILLER179.text: Once the highest of all the Fire Mages, now a servant of the dark god.

INFO_FILLER180.text: I feigned acceptance of his offer. But I used the knowledge which he granted me against him.

INFO_FILLER181.text: Fine. I have been working on a plan for a long time.

INFO_FILLER183.text: But for that you must bring me the artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER198.text: Where should I look for the artifacts?

INFO_FILLER199.text: The orcs are already looking for the artifacts.

INFO_FILLER2.text: Yes, and I can really use them.

INFO_FILLER200.text: I have formed an alliance with them.

INFO_FILLER20060118155830.text: Which men are on your list?

INFO_FILLER20060118155934_0.text: And Abbas, the water vendor. I am expecting a chalice from him. Talk to him - he knows exactly what I want.

INFO_FILLER20060118155934_1.text: And Tufail, what shall we do with Tufail, hmm...

INFO_FILLER20060118155934_2.text: It is his fault the tribute was stolen.

INFO_FILLER20060118155934.text: The three merchants here in Braga. Each of them owes Zuben five hundred gold coins.

INFO_FILLER20060118160151.text: Yes, I am reasonably satisfied. I suppose there's nothing more to be had here.

INFO_FILLER20060118162903.text: Aila, the pearl of the city, has been abducted. I want her back!

INFO_FILLER20060118163528.text: Do you have anything else that needs to be done?

INFO_FILLER20060118164920.text: I want to offer you such a deal. What do you say?

INFO_FILLER20060118181103_0.text: I gave it to Tufail when he collected the tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060118181103_1.text: But that Son of a Jinx allowed them to take it from him!

INFO_FILLER20060118181103_2.text: I humbly beg of you, find the chalice and bring it to Nafalem!

INFO_FILLER20060118181103.text: But, of course, you no longer have it.

INFO_FILLER20060118181443.text: Then take it to Nafalem, I beg you!

INFO_FILLER20060118183453_0.text: I found some more armor in the camp.

INFO_FILLER20060118183453_1.text: You can have it. May it protect you well at all times!

INFO_FILLER20060118183649_0.text: I am inconsolable, but I cannot offer you any armor.

INFO_FILLER20060118183649_1.text: All the hunters who worked for me are dead.

INFO_FILLER20060118183649_2.text: They were caught in a nomad ambush...

INFO_FILLER20060118183649.text: Do you have anything to sell?

INFO_FILLER20060118184020.text: I guess I'll have to beat the tribute out of you.

INFO_FILLER20060118185403_0.text: I was going to hunt for a while.

INFO_FILLER20060118185403_1.text: Luca says they have some dark snappers here.

INFO_FILLER20060118185403_2.text: Their leather is suitable for the manufacture of armor.

INFO_FILLER20060118185403.text: What are you doing here in Braga?

INFO_FILLER20060119142801.text: No wonder they're no longer in the area.

INFO_FILLER20060120212923.text: I can smell those snappers already...

INFO_FILLER20060123181900.text: The desertbeasts are eating my slaves.

INFO_FILLER20060123182018.text: The Morras are stealing my artifacts and taking them to Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060123182148_0.text: No. No, I'll stay here by the temple and guard the one I have.

INFO_FILLER20060123182148_1.text: You're a Morra. One of them. You will go to Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060123182148.text: If I go there, they will steal my key as well!

INFO_FILLER20060124174804_0.text: You've come in vain, then, I'm afraid.

INFO_FILLER20060124174804.text: I am looking for the amulet of sorcery.

INFO_FILLER20060124174859_0.text: Ah, is that it. Yes, that's right, I own it. I'll give you a price.

INFO_FILLER20060124174859.text: Hamid said you had this amulet!

INFO_FILLER20060124174951_0.text: Oh, right. One of the old amulets.

INFO_FILLER20060124174951.text: Really? Why don't you take another look? It is very old.

INFO_FILLER20060124175014.text: Yes, I have that. Tell me, why do you want it?

INFO_FILLER20060124175257_0.text: I see... then I will name you my price...

INFO_FILLER20060124175356_0.text: Of course. So why does it have to be this one?

INFO_FILLER20060124175356.text: Everyone can use a magic amulet.

INFO_FILLER20060124175512.text: I want to increase my magic abilities.

INFO_FILLER20060124175538_0.text: Oh... er... fine. I will tell you my price.

INFO_FILLER20060124175538.text: With this amulet, I've will gain more mana and can cast improved spells.

INFO_FILLER20060124180450_0.text: For many years now, I have been looking for a particular artifact.

INFO_FILLER20060124180450_2.text: Where is it? Somewhere among the ruins?

INFO_FILLER20060124180450_3.text: Not any more. The busy hands of slaves dug it up from the sand.

INFO_FILLER20060124180450.text: What's that deal you want to offer me?

INFO_FILLER20060124180554.text: It is now in the hands of Ilja the artifact dealer.

INFO_FILLER20060124182212_0.text: A man like you must be interested in a good bargain, no?

INFO_FILLER20060124182212.text: How can Hamid be of service to you, Son of Distant Travels?

INFO_FILLER20060125152027.text: I can offer you another deal if you're interested.

INFO_FILLER20060125152527_0.text: Go to Murat's oasis on my behalf and bring him my greetings.

INFO_FILLER20060125152527_1.text: Give him the amulet as a present.

INFO_FILLER20060125152527_3.text: He will not accept it without offering you something in return.

INFO_FILLER20060125152527_4.text: I see. How much should I accept?

INFO_FILLER20060125152527_5.text: You will accept nothing less than the lovely Yasmin.

INFO_FILLER20060125152634.text: She is the price I desire. Yasmin. Nothing else.

INFO_FILLER20060125152826_0.text: You're rejecting my deal? Then leave. Now.

INFO_FILLER20060125153119.text: Take the amulet. And, listen, don't let him trick you.

INFO_FILLER20060125153219.text: If you want to buy water, talk to the slaves.

INFO_FILLER20060125153316_0.text: Hamid! My old friend. How is he?

INFO_FILLER20060125153316_1.text: He is doing good business. And he sends you this amulet as a gift.

INFO_FILLER20060125153316.text: I bring you greetings from Hamid.

INFO_FILLER20060125153358_1.text: Certainly not without giving Hamid a gift in return!

INFO_FILLER20060125153647.text: I think that you are right.

INFO_FILLER20060125153753.text: Wait... take a thousand gold coins from my personal treasure.

INFO_FILLER20060125154114.text: That's a lot of gold. Agreed.

INFO_FILLER20060125154340.text: Very nice. I think all those involved will be satisfied.

INFO_FILLER20060125154519_0.text: I will give him the lovely Yasmin as a gift.
