INFO_FILLER20060125154547_0.text: Then let it be so. Please make sure that Yasmin reaches Mora Sul safely.

INFO_FILLER20060125154547.text: I think that will please him.

INFO_FILLER20060125155947_1.text: Thank you so much, Son of Gallantry.

INFO_FILLER20060125155947_2.text: Take this gold. I will also vouch for you with Gonzales.

INFO_FILLER20060125163710_0.text: I have a beautiful woman here for him.

INFO_FILLER20060125163710.text: I have a beautiful woman for him. (Yasmin)

INFO_FILLER20060125172524_0.text: Now my tent will remain cold and empty...

INFO_FILLER20060125172524_1.text: Go and leave me to bear my sorrow alone.

INFO_FILLER20060125172524.text: The lovely Yasmin is dead! You let her die!

INFO_FILLER20060125172556.text: You took advantage of me, Son of Betrayal!

INFO_FILLER20060125172620.text: You lousy dog, you gave Yasmin away to Gonzales.

INFO_FILLER20060127132705_0.text: A pretty prize. I can already hear the jingle of the gold I'll get for her.

INFO_FILLER20060127132705.text: Look here, if it isn't the lovely Yasmin...

INFO_FILLER20060127132722.text: The only thing you'll hear is your bones breaking!

INFO_FILLER20060127170719_0.text: His name is Yussuf. He stole some artifacts from the excavation.

INFO_FILLER20060127170719_2.text: First, he stole the artifacts that can be used to open the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060127170719.text: Who is this thief you're looking for?

INFO_FILLER20060127171053_0.text: You found him. Good work, Master of the Sharp Eye.

INFO_FILLER20060127180205_1.text: Gonzales takes his cut from every business, every deal, even from the thefts.

INFO_FILLER20060127180205.text: You haven't been in the city long, have you? Then you should know one thing:

INFO_FILLER20060127180310_0.text: Bounty hunting. I'm looking for a couple of really bad guys and a thief.

INFO_FILLER20060127180310.text: What sort of missions do you have?

INFO_FILLER20060127181103.text: His name is Ramirez. He works for the black mage Ningal.

INFO_FILLER20060127182729_0.text: The guards of Kaffu, the water vendor on the east side of town?

INFO_FILLER20060127182729_1.text: They ran off with his gold, just like that.

INFO_FILLER20060127182729_3.text: Kaffu is high in Gonzales's favor. Do I have to say more?

INFO_FILLER20060127182729.text: Tell me more about the bad guys.

INFO_FILLER20060201145614.text: Hey, stranger. Have you got water?

INFO_FILLER20060201150445_0.text: Oh hell, take it easy, friend... please don't do that.

INFO_FILLER20060201150445.text: I've been ordered to kill you.

INFO_FILLER20060201151058_1.text: I stole the keys to the temple of Mora Sul and sold them to some influential people.

INFO_FILLER20060201151058_2.text: But before I could sell the last one, I had to run for it.

INFO_FILLER20060201151627_1.text: The mercenary Kirk paid a lot of gold for one of the keys.

INFO_FILLER20060201151627.text: Who in Mora Sul bought the temple keys from you?

INFO_FILLER20060201154642_0.text: Grrr. Well, that doesn't say much for you, but I'll make sure it doesn't damage your reputation.

INFO_FILLER20060201154642.text: Yussuf the artifact thief has escaped.

INFO_FILLER20060201172400_0.text: Are you now? Trying to score with Gonzales, huh?

INFO_FILLER20060201172400_1.text: All I need is some information. Do you have that, or not?

INFO_FILLER20060201172400_2.text: Don't be so hasty, Son of Impatience. Yes, I know what you need.

INFO_FILLER20060201172400_3.text: And once you find him, you will receive a nice amount of gold. Then you can surely spare a few coins for Fasim?

INFO_FILLER20060201172925_0.text: Not to worry. Yussuf decided not to stay near the ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060201172925_1.text: He has nothing left to lose, and so he chose the path through the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060201172925_2.text: And since he hasn't got much water, he can't have made it far.

INFO_FILLER20060201172925_3.text: I bet he is looking for a shady spot to the northeast.

INFO_FILLER20060201172925.text: Your information had better be correct...

INFO_FILLER20060201173143_0.text: That's a risk I am willing to take, Son of Simplicity.

INFO_FILLER20060201173143.text: Tell me what you know, then I won't have to beat you up.

INFO_FILLER20060201173508_0.text: Yussuf is not near the ruins. He took off into the desert, probably towards the northeast.

INFO_FILLER20060201173508_2.text: Oh my skull... get out of my sight, Son of... whatever, just go away...

INFO_FILLER20060201173508.text: Calm down, Son of Persuasiveness. Yes, I will tell you what I know.

INFO_FILLER20060202132940.text: And? Have you dealt with Yussuf?

INFO_FILLER20060202133230_0.text: See? Old Fasim told you the truth.

INFO_FILLER20060202133908_1.text: He's a thief and there's a bounty on his head.

INFO_FILLER20060202133908_2.text: The whole town is full of thieves.

INFO_FILLER20060202133908_3.text: You want to collect a bounty? You can do that, or not. I don't care.

INFO_FILLER20060202153657_0.text: I can get you a couple of missions to put a bit of gold in your pockets.

INFO_FILLER20060202153657_1.text: Mora Sul can be very expensive, especially for travelers.

INFO_FILLER20060202153657.text: Have you seen the elite warriors running around here? They're under his command.

INFO_FILLER20060202174509_2.text: If you have no gold, you're soon down on your luck here.

INFO_FILLER20060202174509.text: What are you buying? Or are you broke already?

INFO_FILLER20060202184657.text: How can I make some gold here?

INFO_FILLER20060202184724.text: You could try to make a some bargains with the merchants.

INFO_FILLER20060202184734.text: But I think you'd be better off in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060202184744.text: Hey, maybe I should bet on you. Let's see, I think I could risk a few coins.

INFO_FILLER20060202185134_0.text: I would like to borrow your gold.

INFO_FILLER20060202185134_1.text: Hmm, all right, I think I can trust you with my gold..

INFO_FILLER20060202185134_2.text: You've got five days. Then I want my dough back. Plus the four hundred!

INFO_FILLER20060202185300.text: You didn't disappoint me. That was a good investment.

INFO_FILLER20060202185342.text: Hey, where's my gold? You're late!

INFO_FILLER20060202185434.text: Keep your cool, I can pay.

INFO_FILLER20060202185502.text: All right, I almost thought I'd never see my gold again.

INFO_FILLER20060202185625_0.text: You loser! And to think that I counted on you. Just you wait...

INFO_FILLER20060202191028_0.text: That's probably because I come from Myrtana.

INFO_FILLER20060202191028.text: You don't look like an Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060203134908_1.text: I'm working on a big score with Gonzales.

INFO_FILLER20060203134908_2.text: But before that, I have to settle a couple of other matters.

INFO_FILLER20060203134908_3.text: And I could use your help doing that, warrior.

INFO_FILLER20060203134908_4.text: Work for me for a while, and I will make you a rich man.

INFO_FILLER20060203135013_0.text: I have to get this slave off my hands.

INFO_FILLER20060203135013_1.text: Take Orknarok to the temple of the Ancient Ones. Talk to Fasim there.

INFO_FILLER20060203135013_4.text: It's the sun. It makes him crazy.

INFO_FILLER20060203135013.text: What do you want me to do for you?

INFO_FILLER20060203140249.text: What is THAT? Why are you bringing this to the temple? It's bad!

INFO_FILLER20060203140319_0.text: Has Beliar's shadow abandoned you completely? Nothing is settled.

INFO_FILLER20060203140319.text: Masil says it's all settled with you and that Orknarok.

INFO_FILLER20060203141125_0.text: You're bringing me a Nordmar warrior?

INFO_FILLER20060203141125.text: I've got a slave for you here. Orknarok.

INFO_FILLER20060203170844_0.text: He told me what would happen once the man from the north came here...

INFO_FILLER20060203171117_0.text: He's an old artifact hunter. He lives here, among the ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060203171117_1.text: The words he speaks are wise and true. And he warned me!

INFO_FILLER20060203181859.text: There was a problem with your slave Orknarok.

INFO_FILLER20060203181922_0.text: Never mind, we have more important things to worry about.

INFO_FILLER20060203181922.text: Oh! Well, what do you know.

INFO_FILLER20060203182052_0.text: Good, now we can get down to business.

INFO_FILLER20060203184046_0.text: And I happen to know how we can get it.

INFO_FILLER20060203184046_1.text: I have a magic ore blank. If we sell it, we will get a hefty sum of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060203184046.text: Well, first we need a bit of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060203184308_0.text: Well, you should know that I borrowed gold. From a couple of... business partners.

INFO_FILLER20060203184308_1.text: With the ore, it shouldn't be any problem paying off my three promissory notes.

INFO_FILLER20060203184308_2.text: I get the blank and you get your promissory notes... hmm...

INFO_FILLER20060203184308_3.text: A good deal for both of us. What do you say?

INFO_FILLER20060203184308.text: How much are you asking for the ore blank?

INFO_FILLER20060203190137.text: I want Masil's promissory note. How much do you want for it?

INFO_FILLER20060203190226_1.text: Nothing... at least, not YET. I'll come back to that later.

INFO_FILLER20060203190226.text: I won't take your gold. You'll need it with the others.

INFO_FILLER20060203192635_0.text: I hope you know what you're doing. Don't let Masil get the better of you!

INFO_FILLER20060203192635.text: Hmm, all right. Since you insist.

INFO_FILLER20060203194410.text: I have come about Masil's promissory note.

INFO_FILLER20060203194511_0.text: Ah, yes. It's two, lets say three... and a half...

INFO_FILLER20060203194511_3.text: ... or you give me a piece of raw ore.

INFO_FILLER20060203194511_5.text: Hey, everybody here knows that Masil has raw ore.

INFO_FILLER20060203194511_6.text: And now he sends you to repay his debt. So, you've heard my offer.

INFO_FILLER20060203194511.text: Just a moment, I need to see where I put it...

INFO_FILLER20060203194916_0.text: Very good. And here's the note. Enjoy.

INFO_FILLER20060203201919_0.text: I trusted you, stranger, and you screwed me...

INFO_FILLER20060203201919.text: You... you tricked me. You stabbed me in the back after I handed you the sword!

INFO_FILLER20060203202116_0.text: Thank you. Now I am finally free of my debts.

INFO_FILLER20060203202116_1.text: Now I'm free to do business in the city again.

INFO_FILLER20060203202116.text: Here, take this. You are now out of debt.

INFO_FILLER20060209152730_0.text: I have something here for Gonzales. (Masil's promissory notes)

INFO_FILLER20060209153102_0.text: A few promissory notes from Masil... he wants to do business with Gonzales, after all...

INFO_FILLER20060209161112.text: Excellent. And here's the promissory note.

INFO_FILLER20060210151419.text: Last night, he stood before me in my tent with this penetrating gaze.

INFO_FILLER20060210192800.text: Let me take a look at your goods.

INFO_FILLER20060210192804_0.text: I see. You're very busy, then?

INFO_FILLER20060210192804_1.text: You can say that. Almost everybody here is carrying one of my weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060210192804.text: Call me Ismael. I'm the blacksmith here. The ONLY blacksmith around.

INFO_FILLER20060210193052_0.text: Have you already fought in the arena?

INFO_FILLER20060210193052_1.text: Felipe managed to get hold of something special.

INFO_FILLER20060210193052_2.text: The next champion will win the moonblade.

INFO_FILLER20060210193052_3.text: Isn't that right up your alley? If I was ten years younger, I wouldn't miss the opportunity!

INFO_FILLER20060210193052.text: Where can I find the merchants?

INFO_FILLER20060210193423_0.text: It's a valuable ancient weapon. It was forged in Ben Sala.

INFO_FILLER20060210193423_1.text: What I wouldn't give for it...

INFO_FILLER20060210193423.text: Tell me more about the moonblade.

INFO_FILLER20060211171620_0.text: The great prize for the champion of the arena!

INFO_FILLER20060211171620.text: I'm looking for Ramirez. Have you seen him?

INFO_FILLER20060211201620_0.text: The slaves at the temple stole the artifacts from the orcs and sold them here in town.

INFO_FILLER20060211201620_1.text: Every single trader here in Mora Sul made a profit.

INFO_FILLER20060211201739_0.text: See, that wasn't so hard. And you'll get a reward, too.

INFO_FILLER20060211201739_1.text: I should damn well think so.

INFO_FILLER20060211201739_2.text: Here, take this. I suppose this is what you had in mind.

INFO_FILLER20060211201739_3.text: I wish you success with the tasks that lie ahead of you, stranger.

INFO_FILLER20060211201739.text: It's all settled. The fat man is in business again.

INFO_FILLER20060211202601.text: Faesul wants to keep doing business.

INFO_FILLER20060211202611.text: Oh, does he? And why should we agree to that?

INFO_FILLER20060211202729.text: I will introduce you to a world of hurt if you don't keep doing business.

INFO_FILLER20060211202801.text: What is it that you ask?

INFO_FILLER20060211202906_0.text: The boys have a tough job here.

INFO_FILLER20060211202906.text: Faesul should give us a bunch of potions.

INFO_FILLER20060211203009.text: Oh man, don't do that again.

INFO_FILLER20060211203322_0.text: Then go get them for him!

INFO_FILLER20060211203322_2.text: Your affairs are none of my business.

INFO_FILLER20060211203322_3.text: But, fine, you can buy a few potions from me.

INFO_FILLER20060211203322.text: The fat man wants some potions for his slaves.

INFO_FILLER20060211203735_0.text: Thanks, man. You know what? I'll hand these out myself.

INFO_FILLER20060211203735.text: Here you go, eight endurance potions.

INFO_FILLER20060213203822_0.text: Just as long as he gets out of my way.

INFO_FILLER20060213203822.text: Go hunt desertbeasts with him, I don't care.

INFO_FILLER20060213205813_0.text: Well, at least it's better than swinging a pickaxe here.

INFO_FILLER20060213205813.text: Have you heard? We're supposed to hunt desertbeasts.

INFO_FILLER20060214125545_0.text: I ought to have you flogged for such a stupid question.

INFO_FILLER20060214125545_1.text: You are standing in front of the residence of one of the most powerful merchants in Varant.

INFO_FILLER20060214125545_2.text: Gonzales has great influence here in the desert, and YOU will honor his name or die.

INFO_FILLER20060214125545.text: What sort of building is this?

INFO_FILLER20060214125804.text: What else can you tell me about Gonzales?

INFO_FILLER20060214125837.text: What are you doing hanging around here?

INFO_FILLER20060214144411_0.text: I hate to tell you this, but my own guards have robbed me!

INFO_FILLER20060214144411_1.text: Those dogs! May they never find a drop of water again!

INFO_FILLER20060214144411.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060214144525_0.text: I hope they have already withered under Innos' unrelenting sun!

INFO_FILLER20060214144525.text: I will take care of your guards.

INFO_FILLER20060214144635_1.text: Naturally, you have earned a reward.

INFO_FILLER20060214144635.text: I did away with the guards.

INFO_FILLER20060214144847_1.text: Take this water and some of my gold as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_FILLER20060214144847.text: Here are your 700 gold coins back.

INFO_FILLER20060214152107_0.text: Gonzales can't let him get away with that.

INFO_FILLER20060214152107_1.text: The Orcs are still guests in our country, after all.

INFO_FILLER20060214152107.text: And second, he got caught and took off.

INFO_FILLER20060214152719_0.text: Alright. I just hope you let me live!

INFO_FILLER20060214152719.text: That means you still HAVE a temple key. Give it to me.

INFO_FILLER20060214152818_0.text: Just tell the people in Mora Sul that I got away!

INFO_FILLER20060214152818_1.text: Hey, nobody gives a damn about old Yussuf.

INFO_FILLER20060214152818_2.text: I'll just disappear, like water in the sand.

INFO_FILLER20060214152818_3.text: And you will never hear from me again.

INFO_FILLER20060214152818.text: What should I do with you now?

INFO_FILLER20060214155220_0.text: Let me tell you - there's a curse on that temple.

INFO_FILLER20060214155220_2.text: Old Mezir warned me about it.

INFO_FILLER20060214155220_3.text: He said a great disaster would befall us if the temple was opened!

INFO_FILLER20060214155220.text: I have a hunch what you're planning to do. You want to open the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060214160636_0.text: And Zuben's most important man when it comes to business!

INFO_FILLER20060214160636.text: He is the most skilled merchant in the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060214171222.text: I'm sure you have better things to do.

INFO_FILLER20060214171305.text: Yes, dammit. Tell him we're back in business.

INFO_FILLER20060214172103.text: But ever since they caught Yussuf the slave, business has all but come to an end.

INFO_FILLER20060214173349_0.text: And how much is the blade worth to you?

INFO_FILLER20060214173349.text: I want to examine it. Perhaps I can learn from this blade.

INFO_FILLER20060214173424.text: Hmm... let's say, six hundred gold coins.

INFO_FILLER20060214180445_1.text: Here's the reward I promised you.

INFO_FILLER20060214180445.text: I will bring you the moonblade.

INFO_FILLER20060214181132_2.text: Ningal is bound to find that interesting. You'd better tell him yourself.

INFO_FILLER20060214181132_3.text: So, see to it that Nasib lets you in.

INFO_FILLER20060214182443.text: I'm looking for a couple of artifacts here...

INFO_FILLER20060214182541_0.text: Fine, I'm pleased. By the way, I am Mezir. They call me a treasure hunter.

INFO_FILLER20060214182541_1.text: I'm a madman and babbler, they say. But they are blind to my riches.

INFO_FILLER20060214182541_2.text: Except for Zuben. That's right, not him. Old Zuben. But I'm rambling again.

INFO_FILLER20060214182717_0.text: Ramirez... Ramirez, yes yes... hee hee hee...

INFO_FILLER20060214182717_1.text: Do you know where he's hiding, or not?

INFO_FILLER20060214182717_2.text: Yes, I know where he is. I can take you to him.

INFO_FILLER20060214182717_3.text: I'll tell you what. I'm an old man.

INFO_FILLER20060214182717_4.text: My years are passing like the wind sweeping across the dunes.

INFO_FILLER20060214184506_0.text: The horrors have awakened and they cannot be stopped.

INFO_FILLER20060215154351.text: What do you know about the temple out there?

INFO_FILLER20060215154534_1.text: Priests of the ancient people of Innos, I think. Or their magic, at least.

INFO_FILLER20060215154534_2.text: It can be assumed that it will manifest somehow. Undead, ghosts... Much is possible.

INFO_FILLER20060215154534_3.text: And if the ghosts escape, the power of Innos will grow. Provided...

INFO_FILLER20060215154534_4.text: ... they know their enemies. A thousand years of asymmetric currents of magic...

INFO_FILLER20060215154534.text: One of the divine artifacts of Adanos is there. At least I suspect so.

INFO_FILLER20060215154829_0.text: The danger must be contained from the beginning.

INFO_FILLER20060215154829_1.text: We shall try to protect the fields of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060215155203.text: I'm glad that you have come.

INFO_FILLER20060215155554_0.text: You should acquire ancient wisdom. The old magic is a powerful weapon.

INFO_FILLER20060215170436.text: I have told the nomads about you.

INFO_FILLER20060215171544_0.text: If you are looking for Saturas - he is camped near the temple of Al Shedim.

INFO_FILLER20060215171544.text: You found the artifact. Very good.

INFO_FILLER20060215171752.text: I can only give you what I have found. But old Mezir lives in the ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060215172720.text: Welcome. Merdarion has already told us a lot about you.

INFO_FILLER20060215173056_0.text: Once you hold the artifact from the temple in your hands, we will attack Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060215173056.text: No, the time has not come yet.

INFO_FILLER20060215173213.text: Follow me to town. We will meet outside the gates of Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060215173811_0.text: Merdarion the Water Mage sent me. I will take you to him if you want.

INFO_FILLER20060215173811.text: You, wanderer! Finally, you have come.

INFO_FILLER20060215174208.text: Here we are. It's a good thing that you have come, wanderer.

INFO_FILLER20060215174547_0.text: A new era is dawning for us. And we have you to thank for it, warrior!

INFO_FILLER20060215174547.text: Mora Sul has fallen. Our brothers are free.

INFO_FILLER20060215180219_0.text: I see many things. Everything that I have seen so far has also come to pass, my son.

INFO_FILLER20060215180219_1.text: A man will come from the north and lay a terrible curse on the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060215180219_2.text: He will open the temple of Mora Sul, and the dead will wander across the sands of the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060215195014_0.text: I've already sent people North and East. But they haven't found anything.

INFO_FILLER20060215195014_2.text: Somebody bold enough to tangle with Gonzales is also bold enough to stay in the area.

INFO_FILLER20060215195014.text: I will track down Kaffu's guards and kill them.

INFO_FILLER20060215203817_0.text: I did. At least, until Angar took me apart.

INFO_FILLER20060215203817_1.text: And then no one wanted to see me fight any more.

INFO_FILLER20060215203817_2.text: Felipe sold me to Masil for a song.

INFO_FILLER20060215203817.text: Why don't you fight in the arena?

INFO_FILLER20060215210532_0.text: Found your way to the big arena of Mora Sul after all?

INFO_FILLER20060215210640_0.text: Well, I went up the coast and there I was.

INFO_FILLER20060215210640_1.text: Went through a couple of fights here in the arena, and before I knew it I was champion of Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060215210640.text: Angar! How did you get here?

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_0.text: Well, listen then. First we exchange a few blows, testing each other out...

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_1.text: ... then he hits me with some heavy blows, I try to block...

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_3.text: ... then he twirls his axe like it's light as a feather...

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_4.text: ... I stagger back to my feet...

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_5.text: ... knock it aside with a parry...

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_6.text: ... spin around and slug him a good one!

INFO_FILLER20060215210819_7.text: That was it. And then they declared me champion.

INFO_FILLER20060215210819.text: Tell me about your fight with Orknarok.

INFO_FILLER20060215210913_0.text: You're right. I'm still working on my pension fund.

INFO_FILLER20060215210913_1.text: But as long as the war between the gods remains undecided, I may not find any peace either, I'm afraid.

INFO_FILLER20060215210913_2.text: I'm glad that at least we managed to get off that cursed island of Khorinis.

INFO_FILLER20060215210913.text: Looks like you haven't quite retired yet.

INFO_FILLER20060215211110.text: Being champion of Mora Sul is quite a big deal around here, isn't it?

INFO_FILLER20060215211120.text: I guess so. These idiots were never in the mining colony.

INFO_FILLER20060215211315_0.text: Congratulations. You are now the new champion of Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060215211315.text: Man, you've still got it, haven't you?

INFO_FILLER20060216154654.text: Compared to our battles with the guards back then, these arena fights are really a joke.

INFO_FILLER20060217085636_0.text: I knew you were a sure bet!

INFO_FILLER20060217085636.text: Ah, look here, the new champion of Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060217090314_1.text: Let's say, one thousand for you, but then I want four hundred extra back.

INFO_FILLER20060217090314.text: Well, if you need some gold REALLY badly, I could lend you some.

INFO_FILLER20060217090756_0.text: Then you'll have to get past me. I am your first opponent.

INFO_FILLER20060217090756_1.text: That probably means the others are all stronger than you.

INFO_FILLER20060217090756_2.text: You know, I used to be really good. Today, I'm ready for the scrap heap.

INFO_FILLER20060217090756_3.text: But for you, I'll show what I've still got.

INFO_FILLER20060217090756.text: Well, boy? Do you want to fight in the arena?

INFO_FILLER20060217091409_0.text: Once upon a time, I'd have had two like you for breakfast.

INFO_FILLER20060217091409_1.text: And today, I'm sucking sand. Man, I'm getting old...

INFO_FILLER20060217091409.text: And how was the fight for you?

INFO_FILLER20060217091521_0.text: I was a simple soldier in the king's army and fought in the war against the orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060217091521_1.text: The Hashishin attacked us and dragged me off.

INFO_FILLER20060217091521_2.text: Then I had two options - the arena, or breaking rocks. An easy choice.

INFO_FILLER20060217091521_3.text: Well. And then the gave me this title to attract spectators.

INFO_FILLER20060217091521.text: Why do they call you a paladin?

INFO_FILLER20060217091738_0.text: So I am, from Kayor's clan.

INFO_FILLER20060217091738_1.text: Someday my brothers will come and free me.

INFO_FILLER20060217091738_2.text: Do you think it is wise to say that aloud?

INFO_FILLER20060217091738_3.text: The Hashishin do not believe we can ever make it.

INFO_FILLER20060217091738_5.text: I am ready to die for my freedom. That is all that counts for me.

INFO_FILLER20060217091738.text: You are one of the nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060217091921_0.text: I will tell you, although I do not know your intentions.

INFO_FILLER20060217091921_1.text: Therefore, be warned. Do not cross my clan - you would bitterly regret it.

INFO_FILLER20060217091921_3.text: My clan's hideout is a cave near the west end of the fields of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060217092035.text: The Hashishin are defeated. I thank you, Father of Freedom.

INFO_FILLER20060217094454_1.text: And you didn't give it back to him. That wasn't very smart of you.

INFO_FILLER20060217094454.text: You can't just leave Hector in the lurch. He entrusted his gold to you.

INFO_FILLER20060217094642.text: Ah, Mora Sul! Gold, business, and ice-cold beer!

INFO_FILLER20060219231926_0.text: Yes, from way back. He had a couple of really good visions.

INFO_FILLER20060219231926_1.text: But that was seventy years ago...

INFO_FILLER20060219232317.text: I want to enjoy the delights of Murat's oasis once more.

INFO_FILLER20060223211727.text: It's difficult to get in there, but I managed!

INFO_FILLER20060223212350_0.text: I worked for the orcs. That's your only chance.

INFO_FILLER20060223212350_1.text: But watch out - once you get them upset, you can forget about the castle...

INFO_FILLER20060223212350.text: How did you get into the castle?

INFO_FILLER20060223213013.text: Are you running out of supplies?

INFO_FILLER20060223213643_1.text: I've got some fine booze here.

INFO_FILLER20060223213643.text: I can help you with that.

INFO_FILLER20060223214805.text: He usually drinks it himself, but maybe you'll be lucky.

INFO_FILLER20060223220233_1.text: If you want to impress him, lay your cards on the table.

INFO_FILLER20060223220438_0.text: He's a dyed-in-the-wool hunter. He knows his way around up there and always brings back some fine prey.

INFO_FILLER20060223220438_1.text: I think he has spent more time in Nordmar than here.

INFO_FILLER20060223220556_0.text: He's been working for the orcs forever. Used to be an excellent fighter.

INFO_FILLER20060223220556_1.text: But his heyday is over. Today he helps the orcs by running errands for them.

INFO_FILLER20060223220736_0.text: He's a man with a vision. Constantly looking for new attractions for his arena.

INFO_FILLER20060223220736_1.text: And what has he achieved so far?

INFO_FILLER20060223220736_2.text: Nothing. His ideas are impossible to put into practice.

INFO_FILLER20060223225518.text: What did you want in the castle?

INFO_FILLER20060223225545.text: I wanted to get a sword. Not just any sword, a magic ore weapon.

INFO_FILLER20060223225643_0.text: Just think, he told me I should kill three trolls first.

INFO_FILLER20060223225643.text: Do you know what the smith told me?

INFO_FILLER20060223225715.text: I may be crazy, but I'm not insane!

INFO_FILLER20060223230624_0.text: By the way, if you need a nap, there's plenty of room upstairs.

INFO_FILLER20060223230624_1.text: But keep away from the other guests' belongings!

INFO_FILLER20060223230624.text: You can say that. The orcs are guzzling more than the hunters.

INFO_FILLER20060223232035.text: The orcs will like that. Bring them a bottle each, with my compliments.

INFO_FILLER20060308144400_0.text: Most of the city's fighters have fallen.

INFO_FILLER20060308144400_1.text: And the rest of them up and fled. Cowards of men.

INFO_FILLER20060308144400_3.text: I come from Ben Erai. Once we learned what was going on here, we hurried to help.

INFO_FILLER20060308144400_4.text: And what will you do next?

INFO_FILLER20060308144400_5.text: There have been enough dead already. I will not risk my people's lives for an attack.

INFO_FILLER20060308152754_0.text: Have you come to pillage here? If so, you're too late.

INFO_FILLER20060308152754_2.text: Ever since the undead appeared, we've had looters in the area! So, what do you want?

INFO_FILLER20060308163105_0.text: A few guys who think they're oh so smart open up the great temple!

INFO_FILLER20060308163105_1.text: They open the great temple and bring down the wrath of Beliar on all of us!

INFO_FILLER20060308163105_2.text: Now I get to pay tribute for the rest of my life to make up for this disaster!

INFO_FILLER20060308163105.text: So we pay our tribute to Zuben for years, and then what?!

INFO_FILLER20060308163201_0.text: Thanks a hundred times, Father of Fortitude.

INFO_FILLER20060308163201.text: I believe your town is safe once again.

INFO_FILLER20060308163413.text: Before we die, we can at least take care of some business.

INFO_FILLER20060308164051_0.text: I brought some gifts for the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060308164051_1.text: Pieces of raw ore. Ore from the fires of Nordmar!

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_0.text: Hmm. I forge magic ore weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_1.text: Magic ore weapons? Don't you need a big furnace for that?

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_2.text: Yes, to smelt the ore. I can forge a finished blank on any anvil in the world.

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_3.text: And there isn't a single magic ore blank to be found. But there ought to be some here.

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_4.text: Muntasir told me some confusing stuff about some thieves...

INFO_FILLER20060308171032_5.text: And if you can rustle up some ore blanks - bring them to me!

INFO_FILLER20060308171129_0.text: Good. I can work with that. Bring me more if you can.

INFO_FILLER20060308171129.text: I have a few magic ore blanks for you.

INFO_FILLER20060308171215_0.text: Wow, you came up with ten blanks. Stranger, you are good!

INFO_FILLER20060310143136_0.text: I can't use any more guards, and you don't look like a slave. So, what do you want?

INFO_FILLER20060310143240_0.text: I'm already paying enough people to stand around doing nothing.

INFO_FILLER20060310143240_1.text: But if you want real work, then I've got something for you.

INFO_FILLER20060310143240.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060310143356_0.text: I haven't had word from our tunnel in Lago for ages.

INFO_FILLER20060310143356_1.text: Fabio's gold deliveries haven't arrived. Something is not right.

INFO_FILLER20060310143356_2.text: Go to Lago, take a look around.

INFO_FILLER20060310143356.text: What do you have for me to do?

INFO_FILLER20060310143451_0.text: Lago is northeast of here. It's just a couple of huts on the coast.

INFO_FILLER20060310143451_1.text: You couldn't even call it a 'tiny village'. But at least they have a tunnel there.

INFO_FILLER20060310143610_0.text: No. Lago was raided by the nomads, and the slaves are gone.

INFO_FILLER20060310143610.text: I was at the tunnel in Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060313152317_0.text: By Beliar's angry breath! I have had just about enough!

INFO_FILLER20060313152317_1.text: Undead in Ben Sala, nomads in Lago... apparently, the whole world has gone crazy!

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_0.text: Did he now? And what does the bloated swine want?

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_1.text: He wants to know where his gold is.

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_2.text: Have you had a look inside the tunnel?

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_4.text: The nomads have taken all the slaves.

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_5.text: And without any slaves, there won't be any gold.

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_6.text: Hm, I will let him know.

INFO_FILLER20060313152532_7.text: Yes, do that. If he wants HIS gold, let him swing a pickaxe himself.

INFO_FILLER20060313155548_0.text: But of course, there must be a little work left in us somewhere...

INFO_FILLER20060313155548.text: You and your mates, come with me, now.

INFO_FILLER20060313161152_0.text: What do you think? We'll reoccupy the tunnel, of course.

INFO_FILLER20060313161152_2.text: Go to Vasco. Let him lend you a couple of slaves - but not the best ones he's got!

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_0.text: Really? I hear the orcs are looking for those.

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_1.text: You don't look like an orc.

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_2.text: Come on. Are there artifacts here or not?

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_3.text: No. You're in the wrong place. Maybe you should go to Ben Sala.

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_4.text: Oh no, I forgot they already plundered everything there as well.

INFO_FILLER20060313180439_5.text: Looks like there's only the south left for you, Son of Many Steps.

INFO_FILLER20060313180726_0.text: Gold. Fat nuggets of gleaming gold.

INFO_FILLER20060313180726_1.text: And who does the gold belong to?

INFO_FILLER20060313180726_3.text: For that, he also takes care of the tribute for Zuben.

INFO_FILLER20060322152938_0.text: Saturas made it to the ancient temple city of Al Shedim.

INFO_FILLER20060322152938_1.text: He is certain that one of the divine artifacts is there.

INFO_FILLER20060322152938_2.text: Merdarion and a tribe of nomads have set out for the temple of Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060322152938.text: Where are the other Water Mages?

INFO_FILLER20060322153153_1.text: No? Oh, dammit, then I know even more than you do!

INFO_FILLER20060322155617_0.text: The focus stones performed one last service for us.

INFO_FILLER20060322155617_1.text: We used them for a teleportation ritual.

INFO_FILLER20060322155617_2.text: Unfortunately, we had to leave them behind in order to escape...

INFO_FILLER20060322155617.text: How did you get away from the island?

INFO_FILLER20060322160048_0.text: We are here in Al Shedim, a temple city of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_FILLER20060322160048_1.text: According to the inscriptions, the 'Protector of the Body' was kept here.

INFO_FILLER20060322160048_3.text: Armor, a robe, a garment... probably something of that sort.

INFO_FILLER20060322160048_4.text: One thing is certain. It is one of the five artifacts that are necessary to...

INFO_FILLER20060322160048_6.text: We will talk about that later. First, find that armor.

INFO_FILLER20060322160048.text: What do I have to know?

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_1.text: And have you already opened the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_10.text: A lot can happen in a thousand years, so don't expect too much...

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_2.text: We have found out that you need five...

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_4.text: ... correct. I have already acquired one of the keys.

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_6.text: Hopefully, they have survived the last millennium undamaged.

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_7.text: Then I will go look for them. Any clues?

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_8.text: I have marked a few places on this map.

INFO_FILLER20060322160555_9.text: They are calculations based on where the first key was found.

INFO_FILLER20060322160555.text: Where is the artifact? In the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060322160842_0.text: Quite nearby, in a stone chest.

INFO_FILLER20060322160842_1.text: We are in the priests' quarter here.

INFO_FILLER20060322160842_2.text: Which is obvious from the architecture.

INFO_FILLER20060322160842_3.text: The inscriptions and artifacts that we have found indicate it.

INFO_FILLER20060322160842.text: Where did you find the key?

INFO_FILLER20060322161627_0.text: What about them? They certainly aren't here for the sunshine!

INFO_FILLER20060322161627_1.text: They want to get the divine artifacts from the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060322161627_2.text: And we cannot and will not permit that.

INFO_FILLER20060322161627_4.text: They won't go away voluntarily. So, talk to Wutras. He knows what needs to be done.

INFO_FILLER20060322162010_0.text: When the great flood swept across the land a thousand years ago, many people hid in the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060322162010_1.text: The temple stood strong surrounded by water. But no one ever came out alive.

INFO_FILLER20060322162010_2.text: I suspect that the skeletons will be awakened by the strong magic. So you better take a big axe with you.

INFO_FILLER20060322162010_3.text: Or ask Myxir about the artifact of the guardians of the dead. He said something about that. Perhaps he can help you.

INFO_FILLER20060322162010.text: What will happen when I open the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_0.text: Fine. What do you want to know?

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_1.text: What exactly can I do with them?

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_2.text: That is entirely up to you.

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_3.text: Although I did not want to believe it at first, it now seems obvious to me.

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_4.text: YOU are the one who will make the decision.

INFO_FILLER20060322162615_5.text: The decision between Beliar and Innos. Xardas said that, too.

INFO_FILLER20060322162615.text: Let's talk about the divine artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060322162917_0.text: Ha! I am a servant of Adanos!

INFO_FILLER20060322162917_1.text: You must discover that on your own!

INFO_FILLER20060322162917.text: How do I decide for one side?

INFO_FILLER20060322163141_0.text: Indeed? Well, there is much to indicate that Xardas meant it honestly...

INFO_FILLER20060322163141_1.text: ... on the other hand, he plays things close to the vest.

INFO_FILLER20060322163141_2.text: Talk to him. He won't kill you... at least I hope not...

INFO_FILLER20060322163141.text: Xardas spoke of a third option...

INFO_FILLER20060322163342_0.text: Xardas bears the power of two gods.

INFO_FILLER20060322163342_1.text: That alone is reason not to trust him.

INFO_FILLER20060322163342_2.text: But he also surprises me many times...

INFO_FILLER20060322163342_3.text: I think you should make YOUR decision.

INFO_FILLER20060322163342_4.text: Do what you believe. And do not make your decision because of anyone else.

INFO_FILLER20060322163342.text: What do YOU think Xardas is planning?

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_0.text: You have done it again, haven't you?

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_1.text: Take the artifact to safety now.

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_2.text: And what will you do next?

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_3.text: What do you think? Your excursion into the temple has caused even more harm than I feared.

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_4.text: Someone has to see to it that things are cleaned up here.

INFO_FILLER20060322163717_5.text: And that will probably be me.

INFO_FILLER20060322163921.text: Will you give me the key?

INFO_FILLER20060322164923_0.text: And draw no more attention to yourself than is necessary!

INFO_FILLER20060322164923_1.text: Go in, get the artifact, and see to it that you come out again... in one piece!

INFO_FILLER20060322164923.text: We will hold the fort out here while you open the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060322165117.text: It is better if I keep it until you have found the others...

INFO_FILLER20060322170745_0.text: You wouldn't believe how many ancient stone tablets and artifacts we find...

INFO_FILLER20060322170745_1.text: ... and how much trouble it is to sort them all. But now I have an overview.

INFO_FILLER20060322170745.text: I've spent hours bringing order to this chaos.

INFO_FILLER20060322171150_1.text: It is old, but not useful knowledge.

INFO_FILLER20060322171547_1.text: Let me quote from another passage:

INFO_FILLER20060322171547_2.text: ... but he went not to the temple...

INFO_FILLER20060322171547_3.text: ... and his steps led him far from the land of his fathers...

INFO_FILLER20060322171547_4.text: Does that mean he went north?

INFO_FILLER20060322171547_5.text: That can be assumed. But we can only speculate on the reasons...

INFO_FILLER20060322171547.text: Fortunately for us, otherwise this whole story would come to a quick end.

INFO_FILLER20060322171925_0.text: The monastery in Nordmar, too? But - they have a library there!

INFO_FILLER20060322171925_1.text: That's at the other end of the world!

INFO_FILLER20060322171925_2.text: Yes, it is a long way to walk... but you don't have to go there immediately.

INFO_FILLER20060322171925.text: The temples of the Fire Mages have been destroyed.

INFO_FILLER20060322172414_0.text: ...and gave peace to those who found no peace.

INFO_FILLER20060322172414_1.text: And what is that supposed to mean?

INFO_FILLER20060322172414_2.text: Uh... I think this may be something that is certainly of use to you.

INFO_FILLER20060322172414_3.text: Aha. I see. Well, I will examine everything, anyway...

INFO_FILLER20060322172414.text: ... and Yarogol the guardian descended into the crypt...

INFO_FILLER20060322174613_0.text: Come on, out with it. Tell me.

INFO_FILLER20060322174613_1.text: What do I have to do so that you'll let me into the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060322174613_2.text: You will only enter the temple if Amul allows you to.

INFO_FILLER20060322174805.text: Without a good reason, you will never set foot in the halls of Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060322175205_1.text: These are the artifacts that everyone is looking for!

INFO_FILLER20060322175205_2.text: Not me. But Tizgar will certainly be interested.

INFO_FILLER20060322175205_3.text: So, what are you waiting for? Enter the temple already!

INFO_FILLER20060322175205.text: I've got these five ancient artifacts...

INFO_FILLER20060322180138_0.text: You could work for Silvio, of course.

INFO_FILLER20060322180138_1.text: Or you could fight in the arena, provided you are a strong and law-abiding Son of Combat.

INFO_FILLER20060322180138.text: What can I do so that Amul will let me enter the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060322180339_0.text: Of course I shall support your wish, Son of Generosity.

INFO_FILLER20060322180339_1.text: Right, then. What should I do?

INFO_FILLER20060322180339_2.text: You need to convince Jaffar, Carlos, and Aldo.

INFO_FILLER20060322180339_3.text: Once you have their approval, come back to me and I will give you the tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060322180339.text: Let me bring Amul your tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060322182128_0.text: So you won their trust. Great!

INFO_FILLER20060322182128_1.text: Here, this gold should help Amul to stave off the ire of Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060322182128_2.text: And don't you get any ideas - take that gold directly to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060322182128_3.text: If you try and make off with it, you won't be able to enjoy it for long.

INFO_FILLER20060322182128.text: I managed to convince the merchants.

INFO_FILLER20060322182623_0.text: I still have a couple of slaves I can't get rid of.

INFO_FILLER20060322182623_1.text: Listen, Aldo is crazy for ancient artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060322182623_2.text: He already bought some slaves from me that he has digging.

INFO_FILLER20060322182623_4.text: The problem is that danger lurks in the ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060322182623.text: What can I do for you?

INFO_FILLER20060322183119_0.text: No more danger for the slaves?

INFO_FILLER20060322183628_0.text: Do you now? But can we even trust you?

INFO_FILLER20060322183628_1.text: Maybe you're working for the nomads, ingratiating yourself here in Bakaresh so you can steal our gold.

INFO_FILLER20060322183628.text: I want to take your tribute to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060322183925_0.text: Yes, that's good. You've got experience. I saw that right away.

INFO_FILLER20060322183925_1.text: You can go to Amul. You've got my approval.

INFO_FILLER20060322184129_1.text: So we can trust you. You've got my vote.

INFO_FILLER20060322184352_0.text: Hmm, every single one of us has dealt with Sancho at some point.

INFO_FILLER20060322184527_0.text: I am Aschnu. In case you need information - mine is worth gold.

INFO_FILLER20060322195157_0.text: With me, you can always get what you need.

INFO_FILLER20060322195157_1.text: And if Beliar hadn't stricken my slaves with extraordinary stupidity, I could also offer you some artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060322195501_0.text: You want to deliver our gold? This will increase your reputation with the black mages.

INFO_FILLER20060322195501_2.text: Ah, I like it. But certainly you know that you are not the only one who wants that.

INFO_FILLER20060322195501_4.text: You do your business with Amul, and you owe me a favor.

INFO_FILLER20060322195501.text: I want to take your tribute to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060322200306_0.text: Ah, soon I will be the most reputable merchant in Bakaresh!

INFO_FILLER20060322200602_0.text: You mean, regarding my imbecile slaves?

INFO_FILLER20060322200602_1.text: You could slap them all silly, but what's the use? I have seen to that already.

INFO_FILLER20060322200602_2.text: Actually, I meant those artifacts you are looking for.

INFO_FILLER20060322200602_3.text: Ah, yes, of course. I am looking for three special artifacts in particular, you know.

INFO_FILLER20060322200602_4.text: I have read some old inscriptions. They are small caskets.

INFO_FILLER20060323130457_0.text: You have the right to enter the city of Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060323130457_1.text: But first let me explain the city rules to you.

INFO_FILLER20060323130457_2.text: Let me guess. No trouble, or I might run into a fist?

INFO_FILLER20060323130457_3.text: All right. Looks like you know the city rules.

INFO_FILLER20060323130457.text: So, what do you say? May I enter?

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_0.text: I've been nosing around a bit.

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_1.text: Looks like Zuben is still the undisputed ruler of the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_2.text: Zuben? Maybe I should go pay him a visit...

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_3.text: That won't be so easy. Zuben is sitting tight in his palace in Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_4.text: And they won't let you in unless they can be sure you are a friend of the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_5.text: So, what do I need to do?

INFO_FILLER20060323165006_6.text: You will have to do a bit of work for the Hashishin. But it looks like there will be plenty to do.

INFO_FILLER20060323171638.text: We could go together if you want.

INFO_FILLER20060323195651_1.text: You look like a man who wants to make lots of gold, and fast!

INFO_FILLER20060323195651.text: Hey! Hey you! Yes, you - I mean you!

INFO_FILLER20060323200238_0.text: Ah! I present you a marvelous selection of the desert's best fighters!

INFO_FILLER20060323200238_2.text: He's one tough bastard, and he likes to finish off his vict... er, opponents slowly.

INFO_FILLER20060323200238_3.text: Next, I will send you Achmed of All Trades. There isn't a maneuver he doesn't know. Not a move he hasn't mastered!

INFO_FILLER20060323200238_4.text: And the grand finale will be our champion, the undefeated king of Bakaresh - Mufassa the Savage!

INFO_FILLER20060323200238_5.text: In the course of his career, he has fought in over a hundred matches and has not lost many.

INFO_FILLER20060323200310_0.text: Excellent. The mysterious fighter from the north...

INFO_FILLER20060323200310_1.text: Hey - none of this fancy talk. Just let me fight.

INFO_FILLER20060323200310_2.text: All right then, at least try to look good...

INFO_FILLER20060323200310.text: Fine, then I'll knock down the bloody guy first.

INFO_FILLER20060323200441.text: Man, the Bloody is a bloody mess!

INFO_FILLER20060323200617_0.text: Trades. He's Achmed of All Tra- ah, forget it.

INFO_FILLER20060323200617_1.text: You paid, so you can fight.

INFO_FILLER20060323200617.text: Fine. Now let me fight that Achmed. The one of all blades.

INFO_FILLER20060323200727_0.text: Isn't that why I fought him?

INFO_FILLER20060323200727_1.text: Well, yes, you've got a point there.

INFO_FILLER20060323200727.text: What have you done to Achmed? The man's completely worn out!

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_0.text: Whoa there, whoa, I never said THAT...

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_1.text: WHAT? Are you toying with me!?!?

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_2.text: Oh no, of course not, Father of Swift Combat.

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_3.text: But you still need to go up against the temple fighters. Special order from Tizgar.

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_4.text: Only if you can hold your own against the temple fighters will you be named champion of Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_5.text: Why didn't you tell me this before?

INFO_FILLER20060323201143_6.text: Hey, you didn't ask. But it will bring you glory and honor.

INFO_FILLER20060323201143.text: Fine. Now bring on this savage fellow and then I'll be champion, right?

INFO_FILLER20060323201310_0.text: Ah, a great sum for a great fight.

INFO_FILLER20060323201310_1.text: Hey, please slow down a little this time, got it?

INFO_FILLER20060323201310_2.text: The audience expects to see something for their money!

INFO_FILLER20060323201458_0.text: Mufassa the Savage has been defeated. Here stands the victor...

INFO_FILLER20060323201458_1.text: ...and he has come to get his gold.

INFO_FILLER20060323201458_2.text: But of course, vanquisher of Mufassa. I told you I would make you rich!

INFO_FILLER20060323201458.text: Right here in the arena of Bakaresh, the impossible became reality!

INFO_FILLER20060323201921_0.text: Those aren't just any old fighters, oh no - one of them was the gatekeeper of Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060323201921_1.text: And the other used to hunt nomads all over the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060323201921_2.text: Both have earned this job in Bakaresh - and struck down more opponents than all barbarians combined!

INFO_FILLER20060323201921_3.text: Never mind. You know what I want.

INFO_FILLER20060323201921.text: Right, now what about the temple fighters?

INFO_FILLER20060323202121_0.text: So be it. Let the fight for the crown begin.

INFO_FILLER20060323202121_1.text: Eternal fame for the winner - a mouthful of sand for the loser.

INFO_FILLER20060323202121_2.text: Good luck, fighter! I'm curious to see how long you last.

INFO_FILLER20060327155421_0.text: What do you want here, stranger? Are you one of the raiders?

INFO_FILLER20060327155421.text: Halt! This is Bakaresh. Temple city of the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060327155516_0.text: Then stick with it and don't get involved with the raiders!

INFO_FILLER20060327155651_0.text: Careful! Don't push it too far, stranger.

INFO_FILLER20060327155651_1.text: Our city is the sanctuary of Beliar. A venerable site.

INFO_FILLER20060327155651_2.text: And to be sure that you understand, I will now teach you a lesson.

INFO_FILLER20060327155651.text: Of course I'm a raider. I want to see what there is to be found here.

INFO_FILLER20060327160107_0.text: Strangers are not often found here.

INFO_FILLER20060327160107_1.text: Seek out Aschnu. He will help you further.

INFO_FILLER20060327160107.text: Tell me something about the city.

INFO_FILLER20060327161825.text: A long road lies behind you, pilgrim.

INFO_FILLER20060327162107_0.text: Finally. It's time we beat some manners into those boys!

INFO_FILLER20060327162107_1.text: My men and I will handle it. Come on!

INFO_FILLER20060327162107.text: Tizgar sent me. We're taking care of the raiders.

INFO_FILLER20060327162212.text: You certainly showed those damn raiders.

INFO_FILLER20060327162618_0.text: You have helped us immensely. That was good work.

INFO_FILLER20060327162618.text: I dealt with the bandits at the oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060327170222_0.text: We serve no master and take whatever we want!

INFO_FILLER20060327170222_3.text: We... took this oasis with the help of the nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060327170338_0.text: We've been thinking about attacking Bakaresh, but that's a few sizes too big for us.

INFO_FILLER20060327170338.text: And? Have you got any plans?

INFO_FILLER20060327170608_0.text: You know, I can't decide that by myself.

INFO_FILLER20060327170608_1.text: And I wouldn't take this on without my damn partner Redge anyway.

INFO_FILLER20060327170608_2.text: Also, I have no idea what Ateras will think of this.

INFO_FILLER20060327172358.text: Find him. We're going to need his help.

INFO_FILLER20060327180402_0.text: The temple is the sanctuary of Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060327180402_1.text: We donate gold to the black mages so that they may appease his almighty wrath.

INFO_FILLER20060327180402_2.text: If you want to pray, you will have to make do with the statue down here.

INFO_FILLER20060327180402_3.text: The temple is closed to all strangers.

INFO_FILLER20060327180402.text: What can you tell me about the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060327181134.text: I have nothing to say to you, Son of Words.

INFO_FILLER20060327181241.text: I have nothing to say to you, Father of Battle.

INFO_FILLER20060327192954_1.text: Feel free to have a look at my blades. I have only top quality merchandise from Ben Sala.

INFO_FILLER20060328153317.text: I am Muntasir, a servant of Beliar. And steward of Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060328210209.text: Well, traveler, would you like to buy some water?

INFO_FILLER20060328211011_0.text: There was a fellow not long ago who needed water and didn't have any gold.

INFO_FILLER20060328211011_1.text: Do you know who the fellow was?

INFO_FILLER20060328211011_2.text: Hmm, my memory isn't so good...

INFO_FILLER20060328211011.text: Where did you get the raw ore?

INFO_FILLER20060328211427_0.text: Yes... now I remember. That was Sugut from Ben Sala. I think he works for the alchemist.

INFO_FILLER20060328211427_1.text: After got the water, he went straight South.

INFO_FILLER20060328211427.text: Here, maybe this will improve your memory...

INFO_FILLER20060329182552.text: I am Ugrasal, warrior for Zuben, and trainer.

INFO_FILLER20060329192342.text: There is nothing to be said.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_0.text: The orcs caught me near the pass and dragged me through the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_1.text: First they made me dig, but then they found out I could read the ancient tablets.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_2.text: That gave me some kind of special status.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_3.text: Man, those tablets are fantastic! They contain a lot of rubbish, but I can feel my magical powers growing.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_4.text: I can even sense the magic flowing through the ruins...

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_5.text: I let Tamkosch know about the keys.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018_6.text: Now he wants me to open the temple for him.

INFO_FILLER20060330150018.text: Hey Lester! How did you fare?

INFO_FILLER20060330150223_0.text: See, I knew that's what you came here for.

INFO_FILLER20060330150223_1.text: I found one - near the ruins of the healers.

INFO_FILLER20060330150223_2.text: Be careful, Tamkosch wants the amulet for himself.

INFO_FILLER20060330150223_3.text: So if WE want to enter the temple, we should get rid of him and his orcs first.

INFO_FILLER20060330150223.text: Have you found any keys yet?

INFO_FILLER20060330150429_0.text: We're going to need the help of the nomads. You should see to that.

INFO_FILLER20060330150429_1.text: Saturas is here, too. I bet he's going to help you.

INFO_FILLER20060330150541_0.text: Here, take these. I'm finished with them.

INFO_FILLER20060330150541.text: Do you have any stone tablets?

INFO_FILLER20060330150827_0.text: Whatever they may find, it will bring death.

INFO_FILLER20060330150827.text: The orcs are digging into the secrets of the ancient people of Innos.

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_0.text: Fine. I have positioned a few men behind the orcs' camp.

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_1.text: Find them and tell them what we're planning.

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_2.text: I will attack from here with my men.

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_3.text: But you must give us a sign.

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_4.text: A sign? What sort of sign?

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_5.text: The best thing would be to attack the orc leader!

INFO_FILLER20060330151114_6.text: Once they are distracted, we will attack!

INFO_FILLER20060330151355_1.text: Alright. Change of plans. Tell my boys, then come back and we will attack!

INFO_FILLER20060330152423_0.text: Good. The orcs won't have time to regret that they ever came here!

INFO_FILLER20060330152423_1.text: We will fall upon them like a sandstorm!

INFO_FILLER20060330152423_2.text: Yeah, yeah. The main thing is that you fight.

INFO_FILLER20060330152423.text: I come from Wutras. We will attack the orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060330152829_0.text: Really? The orcs? Oh man, have you seen how many there are of them?

INFO_FILLER20060330152829_2.text: Of course I'm afraid! It's our asses on the line!

INFO_FILLER20060330152829_4.text: Great, now I feel so much better.

INFO_FILLER20060330152829_5.text: Are you going to fight or not?

INFO_FILLER20060330152829_6.text: Ah heck, why not. Of course, I'll fight. For Adanos, to the death.

INFO_FILLER20060330152829.text: Wutras sent me. We're attacking the orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060330154122_0.text: Har har har! You're a funny Morra!

INFO_FILLER20060330154122.text: You are an ugly, fat monster!

INFO_FILLER20060330154531_0.text: Har har har! I have a thick hide, Morra!

INFO_FILLER20060330154642_1.text: You're starting to bore me, Morra!

INFO_FILLER20060330154642.text: You are a stinking Morra yourself!

INFO_FILLER20060330154743_0.text: Har har... heh? You insult my tribe, Morra? You will die for that!

INFO_FILLER20060330173516_0.text: We are warriors. We do not bargain with Morras!

INFO_FILLER20060330182202_1.text: Here's the key to the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060330182202_2.text: I am ready to follow you if you should need my help.

INFO_FILLER20060330182531.text: Finally. You found it. Let's get the hell out of here!

INFO_FILLER20060331143036_0.text: Well, I thought I'd take a look around.

INFO_FILLER20060331143036_1.text: Yeah, I know. But you aren't fooling me. You're here because you're hot for some quick gold.

INFO_FILLER20060331143036_2.text: They have a mine in Ben Erai. There must be something there I can get my hands on, right?

INFO_FILLER20060331143036_3.text: But you won't set foot in the tunnels, got it?

INFO_FILLER20060331143036_4.text: In any case, not until you make yourself useful first!

INFO_FILLER20060331143036.text: Hey you! Where do you think you're going?

INFO_FILLER20060331145007_0.text: Crawlers keep coming from the west.

INFO_FILLER20060331145007_1.text: Recently, the beasts have ventured rather close to us. Too close...

INFO_FILLER20060331145007_2.text: They've already eaten a couple of slaves. I want you to deal with them.

INFO_FILLER20060331145007.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060331145116_0.text: Did you take out the whole nest?

INFO_FILLER20060331145116_1.text: Well, I flattened everything that was running around.

INFO_FILLER20060331154559_1.text: Friend, this city is a treasure chest. Albeit a well-guarded one.

INFO_FILLER20060331154559_2.text: If you want to chat about gold for a while, bring me some first.

INFO_FILLER20060331154559.text: I bet you haven't come to break your back working, right?

INFO_FILLER20060331165440_0.text: Is he, really? That thief... creeps in here and...

INFO_FILLER20060331165440_1.text: Good work. And now make sure that the fellow disappears from my city.

INFO_FILLER20060331165814_0.text: I can't believe it - you sold me out?

INFO_FILLER20060331165814.text: Sancho sent me. You better get out of Ben Erai.

INFO_FILLER20060331171509_0.text: Eusebio is a bum. He chops up grass and distills booze!

INFO_FILLER20060331171509_1.text: Maybe he's guzzled too much of his own stuff.

INFO_FILLER20060331184241.text: Especially those tough beasts. They must have a nest somewhere.

INFO_FILLER20060331184926_0.text: Carry on, then. If you need training, come to me.

INFO_FILLER20060331184926.text: So, I see you've made yourself useful.

INFO_FILLER20060331185155.text: And you haven't finished a single job. So I'm asking myself why you're here at all.

INFO_FILLER20060331185421_0.text: The only thing that matters to you is that I'm guarding the gold. Got it?

INFO_FILLER20060331185421.text: I'm guarding the gold and making sure every passing stranger doesn't start digging!

INFO_FILLER20060331200657.text: Sancho sent me. I'm supposed to take a couple of slaves to Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060331200940_0.text: Alright, listen. Take the haggard one. We can spare him and his companions.

INFO_FILLER20060331202032_1.text: And don't give me any trouble!

INFO_FILLER20060331202032.text: Right. Pickaxes out, and get to work.

INFO_FILLER20060331204028.text: To Lago, eh. And of course, the production here can't slow down at all.

INFO_FILLER20060331204218_1.text: Good. Hopefully, there's still gold to be had there.

INFO_FILLER20060331204218.text: Did you take away the slaves?

INFO_FILLER20060331212118.text: Actually, I shouldn't pay anything for this news, but of course you will get your pay.

INFO_FILLER20060331212932_0.text: I am Vasco, steward of Ben Erai.

INFO_FILLER20060331212932.text: Well, have you followed the call of the gold too?

INFO_FILLER20060331213134_0.text: I take care of the slaves, count the gold, organize the guards...

INFO_FILLER20060331213134_1.text: Everything that needs to be done.

INFO_FILLER20060331213134.text: Just what does a steward do?

INFO_FILLER20060331215706_0.text: All my gold is gone! Whatever son of a mangy nomad did that - let him stew in the sun!

INFO_FILLER20060331220009_0.text: I started out just like you, however, that was a long time ago.

INFO_FILLER20060331220009_1.text: I toured the arenas for a while. But that wasn't really my cup of tea.

INFO_FILLER20060401190129_0.text: It's high time I won another match.

INFO_FILLER20060401190129.text: Hey, would you fancy a fight? Go talk to Hernando.

INFO_FILLER20060401190256.text: Talk to Hernando if you want to fight.

INFO_FILLER20060401190442_0.text: You know a thing or two about weapons?

INFO_FILLER20060401190442_1.text: I am master of various fighting styles. If you have some gold, I can teach you.

INFO_FILLER20060401190442.text: I am Achmed. Achmed of all trades.

INFO_FILLER20060403181038.text: Activate the mission - Search for the five artifacts (Xardas)

INFO_FILLER20060403181928.text: Give me the artifact from Al Shedim (robe)

INFO_FILLER20060403182141.text: Give me the artifact from MoraSul (crown)

INFO_FILLER20060403182535.text: Give me the artifact from Nordmar (Ring 02)

INFO_FILLER20060403182709.text: Give me the artifact from Trelis (amulet)

INFO_FILLER20060403194936.text: Give me the rod and scepter!

INFO_FILLER20060404133550.text: The artifacts of Adanos open the gate to the world of the gods. The gate to Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060404133944_0.text: Get the five artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER20060404135718.text: Go and activate the shrine in the temple of Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060404140129.text: Lo, the man from the north has returned!

INFO_FILLER20060404142401.text: Beliar! I have come to fight for you!

INFO_FILLER20060404161243_0.text: You must find them and take them to Nordmar, to the Monastery of Fire.

INFO_FILLER20060404161243_2.text: Then, Innos will reveal himself to you.

INFO_FILLER20060404161243_3.text: I will give you my scepter - the scepter of Varant.

INFO_FILLER20060404161243_4.text: With the scepter and the divine artifacts, you will receive his power.

INFO_FILLER20060404161243.text: The artifacts of Adanos - I thought they were lost forever...

INFO_FILLER20060404183056_0.text: They were in the possession of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_FILLER20060404183056_1.text: The people perished, but I am sure that the five artifacts still exist.

INFO_FILLER20060404183056_2.text: Each of them alone grants great power. But all of them together...

INFO_FILLER20060404183056_4.text: We will talk about that once you have found them.

INFO_FILLER20060404183056.text: There are five. Five divine artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060404183321_0.text: They developed a plan long ago. Talk to them and find out all the information they have collected.

INFO_FILLER20060404183321.text: The shamans there are studying every kind of magic.

INFO_FILLER20060404183711.text: What's the rest of your plan?

INFO_FILLER20060404184939_0.text: Either is possible. With these artifacts, you can decide for Innos or for Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060404184939.text: A power that Zuben and Rhobar want to see on their side.

INFO_FILLER20060404185615_0.text: You want me to destroy the artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060404185615_1.text: So that their power can never again be used. But the decision is yours.

INFO_FILLER20060404185615_2.text: If you decide for Beliar or Innos, then everything I have fought for is lost. At least, for the next thousand years...

INFO_FILLER20060404185615.text: Go to the ore furnace in Nordmar and destroy them.

INFO_FILLER20060404190327_0.text: Be that as it may, my war is over. Yet yours is just beginning.

INFO_FILLER20060404190327.text: Well, I knew the risk. I never would have believed that you would decide THIS way.

INFO_FILLER20060404190825_0.text: Perhaps I underestimated the enticements of power and wealth.

INFO_FILLER20060404193457_1.text: And then we go through. It is just as I said: no one knows the end of the path that we are stepping on to.

INFO_FILLER20060404193457_2.text: Let me know when you are ready. I will be here.

INFO_FILLER20060404193457.text: Ready to leave this world together.

INFO_FILLER20060404194800_0.text: But his power is banished and Innos is weakened.

INFO_FILLER20060404194800.text: That fool. He never would have been prepared to leave this world voluntarily.

INFO_FILLER20060404195104_0.text: Beliar's influence will also become weaker, but it is not yet at an end...

INFO_FILLER20060404195104.text: His power is no longer in this world and that is what matters.

INFO_FILLER20060404200552_0.text: We will leave the world, but the unknown land awaits us.

INFO_FILLER20060404201133.text: It is time to leave this world.

INFO_FILLER20060405161222_0.text: There is nothing keeping me here either.

INFO_FILLER20060405161222.text: I am ready for the unknown land.

INFO_FILLER20060407150647_0.text: You have come late. The test has already begun.

INFO_FILLER20060407150647_2.text: I am searching for a warrior.

INFO_FILLER20060407150647.text: It is said that a warrior has come. A warrior from the north.

INFO_FILLER20060407151149_0.text: Really? It has already started. But if Zuben sent you, you can try your luck!

INFO_FILLER20060407151149_1.text: What do I have to do?

INFO_FILLER20060407151149_2.text: It's quite simple. Everyone in the city has the right to put you to the test.

INFO_FILLER20060407151149_3.text: And believe me - most of them will be thrilled!

INFO_FILLER20060407151149_4.text: I will observe you. We'll see how well you do.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_0.text: You know, I'm not terribly fond of these tests.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_1.text: They're sending good men out at random, just so they can prove their courage or their strength.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_2.text: Does that mean you're not going to test me?

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_3.text: You know, if you insist on proving yourself, you might as well do something that's actually useful.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_4.text: Go see Kafa. He's guarding the wells outside the city.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656_5.text: He's always got things to do. Go see whether you can help him.

INFO_FILLER20060407170656.text: Are you going to put me to the test, too?

INFO_FILLER20060407170925_0.text: Makas? He's been up there for quite a while... wait... what was that?

INFO_FILLER20060407170925.text: Makas sent me, I am supposed to help you...

INFO_FILLER20060407171301.text: Jackals! Come on, let's kill them!

INFO_FILLER20060407171446_0.text: Sometimes they even attack more than once...

INFO_FILLER20060407171722.text: Dammit! They went to the other wells!

INFO_FILLER20060407171942_0.text: Well, we certainly taught them a lesson.

INFO_FILLER20060407171942.text: Ha. Those mangy beasts thought they could fool us.

INFO_FILLER20060407172143.text: Then kill the leaders of these filthy jackal packs!

INFO_FILLER20060407172359_0.text: You can go tell Makas that you helped me.

INFO_FILLER20060407172359.text: Hmm, I don't think the jackals will dare show up here again.

INFO_FILLER20060407172648_0.text: They're coming down the hill. There's a cave up there!

INFO_FILLER20060407172648.text: Where are the jackals hanging out?

INFO_FILLER20060407173601_0.text: Great, then those lousy beasts will probably leave us alone for a while.

INFO_FILLER20060407173601.text: I killed the jackal pack leaders.

INFO_FILLER20060407173703.text: And as far as you're concerned - go tell Makas that you helped me.

INFO_FILLER20060407174338.text: If you want some water, talk to Giacomo.

INFO_FILLER20060407174442_0.text: I am Giacomo. If you want to buy water, I'm your man.

INFO_FILLER20060407174442.text: Welcome to the wells of Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060407174633_0.text: Wonderful, Son of Stalking. Here, have some water and gold as a reward.

INFO_FILLER20060407174633_1.text: And if you need more water, I'll be happy to take back my gold.

INFO_FILLER20060407174633.text: I killed the leaders of the jackal pack.

INFO_FILLER20060407183219_0.text: That's great. Then I won't have to go back any time soon.

INFO_FILLER20060407183219_1.text: I will tell Ugrasal that you passed my test.

INFO_FILLER20060407184718_0.text: The man Zuben is looking for has to be a well-traveled, tough bastard.

INFO_FILLER20060407184718_2.text: He knows how to hunt and never shies from a fight.

INFO_FILLER20060407184718_4.text: It's no problem for him to bring me five lion skins.

INFO_FILLER20060407184718_5.text: But not the regular ones - skins from those rotten beasts!

INFO_FILLER20060407184718_6.text: Because they are the worst lions there are!

INFO_FILLER20060407184718.text: Do you have a test for me?

INFO_FILLER20060407184819_0.text: Those creatures roam throughout the desert and join other prides.

INFO_FILLER20060407184819_1.text: There is an entire pride of them somewhere in the west.

INFO_FILLER20060407184819_2.text: Oh, by the way - I also gave Zarkos this test...

INFO_FILLER20060407184819.text: And where would a tough bastard look for the rotten beasts?

INFO_FILLER20060407185015_0.text: You are one tough bastard. I think Zuben could use you.

INFO_FILLER20060407190003_0.text: No, this is an arena for Hashishin only. Not for travelers.

INFO_FILLER20060407190003.text: I want to fight in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060407190122_0.text: What, you want to be the marvelous fighter Zuben is looking for?

INFO_FILLER20060407190122_1.text: I will give you a chance to prove that.

INFO_FILLER20060407190122_2.text: Of course, each fighter pays his tribute before the match!

INFO_FILLER20060407190122.text: I want you to test me.

INFO_FILLER20060407193833_0.text: Makas will be the first fighter you face. Come on, show us what you're made of.

INFO_FILLER20060407193930_0.text: Your next fight won't be that easy.

INFO_FILLER20060407193930.text: Fine, you passed the warm-up exercise.

INFO_FILLER20060407194039_0.text: Let Musan fight. He'll show you who's boss.

INFO_FILLER20060407194129.text: All right, so you defeated Musan. The next fight won't be that easy.

INFO_FILLER20060407194252_0.text: You will go up against Emet. He has been preparing for weeks. You don't stand a chance!

INFO_FILLER20060407194436_0.text: I'll tell you something - you have passed my test.

INFO_FILLER20060407194436_1.text: There's nobody else I could send to fight you, except for myself, of course - but let's keep this fair.

INFO_FILLER20060407194436_2.text: And another thing - here's your hard-earned gold.

INFO_FILLER20060407194436.text: You just knocked three awfully good fighters to the ground.

INFO_FILLER20060407194944_1.text: Good, then listen. Travel to Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060407194944_2.text: The mages there owe me their tribute. You will fetch it for me.

INFO_FILLER20060407194944.text: I want you to give me the test!

INFO_FILLER20060407201247_0.text: No, I only train Zuben's warriors.

INFO_FILLER20060407201624_0.text: If you want to master Zuben's special mission, you must first master fighting with two weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060407222953_0.text: Well, I want to enter the palace.

INFO_FILLER20060407222953_1.text: If you cause any trouble, I will break every single one of your bones.

INFO_FILLER20060407223741_0.text: Good, you were able to withstand the temptation of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060407223741.text: I bring you the tribute from Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060407230240_0.text: Alright, you know everything about fighting with two weapons. You have passed my test.

INFO_FILLER20060407230617_0.text: Zarkos. He is a good fighter.

INFO_FILLER20060407230617_1.text: He has assembled his own troop and is hunting lions.

INFO_FILLER20060407230617_2.text: And Surus the mage is also participating in the test.

INFO_FILLER20060407230617_3.text: I believe he's also still in the city brewing potions.

INFO_FILLER20060407231222_0.text: And you? Where are you from?

INFO_FILLER20060407231222_1.text: Lago. I have come here to train.

INFO_FILLER20060407231222.text: Hey man, you're not from around here, are you?

INFO_FILLER20060407231315_0.text: Preparing for the fight - mentally, that is.

INFO_FILLER20060407231315_1.text: When body and spirit are in unison, I cannot be defeated.

INFO_FILLER20060407231505_1.text: Go to Lago and get me a package of premium swampweed.

INFO_FILLER20060407232246_0.text: Hey, hey! Will you look at that, a whole package of the finest training materials!

INFO_FILLER20060407232246.text: Your requested goods from scenic Lago!

INFO_FILLER20060407235109.text: Innos is greatly weakened and Beliar is mightier than ever before.

INFO_FILLER20060407235151.text: But the everything hangs in the balance.

INFO_FILLER20060408162513_1.text: Yes. Sure, exactly, it's that awful crap I'm smoking here!

INFO_FILLER20060408162513_2.text: No idea what they're stuffing into their pipes around here, but it tastes of cactus, somehow...

INFO_FILLER20060408162513.text: But I can't really concentrate on my training...

INFO_FILLER20060408163055_0.text: Go to Lago, then, and get me a package of premium swampweed.

INFO_FILLER20060408163055.text: You want me to put you to the test?

INFO_FILLER20060408163205.text: Already told you - get me a package of premium swampweed from Lago!

INFO_FILLER20060408163400_0.text: I think I can say that I tested you enough.

INFO_FILLER20060408163400_1.text: Here, do something towards your training instead!

INFO_FILLER20060408163400.text: You know, you really helped me out with that package.

INFO_FILLER20060408163806.text: Your test was far too easy!

INFO_FILLER20060408180931.text: Beat it, you've got no business in this city!

INFO_FILLER20060408181051_0.text: What? YOU want to be the one to take on Zuben's mission?

INFO_FILLER20060408181051_1.text: I've been honing my skills for years!

INFO_FILLER20060408181051_2.text: How long have you been here? A few days? Punk, you haven't got a chance!

INFO_FILLER20060408181051.text: I will take part in your test.

INFO_FILLER20060408192341_0.text: Oh, is that so? And what are you going to do about it? Run to Ugrasal?

INFO_FILLER20060408192341_2.text: If I were you, I'd be very quiet, otherwise...

INFO_FILLER20060408192341_3.text: Otherwise what? You'll send more killers after me?

INFO_FILLER20060408192341_4.text: Otherwise I will personally see to it that you never leave the desert alive...

INFO_FILLER20060408192525.text: Run. Run as far away as you can!

INFO_FILLER20060408193055_0.text: That was your last mistake! I'm not giving you any more chances, punk!

INFO_FILLER20060408193634_0.text: Indeed? The big, bad Surus sent killers after you? Then why are you still standing around here?

INFO_FILLER20060408193634_1.text: Go out and kill him! That's the way it works here!

INFO_FILLER20060408193634.text: Surus sent a couple of killers after me!

INFO_FILLER20060408194156.text: Read Suru's letter! (activate player knows about killer)

INFO_FILLER20060408214551_0.text: You are taking part in the trial, right?

INFO_FILLER20060408214551_1.text: Don't think I'm not going to try you just because I'm not standing INSIDE the city.

INFO_FILLER20060408214551_3.text: Your competitor, Zarkos, has been out there for quite a while. Lion hunting or something like that.

INFO_FILLER20060408214551_5.text: Fighting in the arena. But he only won because of a trick!

INFO_FILLER20060408214551_6.text: So bring me back that bowl and get rid of Zarkos while you are at it.

INFO_FILLER20060408214907_0.text: He set up camp a little further north.

INFO_FILLER20060408214907_1.text: Once you get to the wells, just go straight ahead.

INFO_FILLER20060408215025_0.text: Very good. Did you take out Zarkos?

INFO_FILLER20060408215322_0.text: Then go take care of it.

INFO_FILLER20060408215803.text: I am Zarkos the lion hunter!

INFO_FILLER20060408220959_0.text: Really? Then you're my competition. And thus a potential problem.

INFO_FILLER20060408220959_1.text: And problems need to be eliminated!

INFO_FILLER20060408221601_0.text: How much did you pay him - what lies did you tell?! Huh?!

INFO_FILLER20060408221601_1.text: It doesn't matter, once I have killed you, I will be Zuben's new man!

INFO_FILLER20060408221601.text: You worm, you actually managed to buy your way in with Zuben!

INFO_FILLER20060408221741_0.text: They will kill you. But since you want to die, there's a cave a bit north of here.

INFO_FILLER20060408221741_1.text: However, if you go there, a few bare bones are all that will be left of you.

INFO_FILLER20060408221741.text: I'm looking for the rotten beasts!

INFO_FILLER20060408231505_0.text: One of our men stayed behind in the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060408231505_1.text: You can flop down in his hut.

INFO_FILLER20060408231505_2.text: First one at the top of the stairs - the one with the skulls over the entrance.

INFO_FILLER20060408231505.text: Hey, I don't suppose you have a place for me to sleep?

INFO_FILLER20060408233516.text: I took the raw ore to Sven.

INFO_FILLER20060408234201_0.text: Am I supposed to pat you on the back because you managed to enter the city?

INFO_FILLER20060408234201.text: What do you want from Nerusul, the great Black Mage of Ishtar?

INFO_FILLER20060408234330.text: I thought Zuben was the greatest mage here.

INFO_FILLER20060408234728_1.text: They were supposed to bring the raw ore to me.

INFO_FILLER20060408234728_2.text: Instead, those morons sold them for a few measly pieces of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060408234728_3.text: Well, raw ore is worth quite a bit...

INFO_FILLER20060408234728_4.text: A few MEASLY pieces of gold. They would be worth ten times as much once they're made into magic ore weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060408234728.text: You ordered the theft of the magic ore!

INFO_FILLER20060408235827_0.text: You dare to reject my offer?

INFO_FILLER20060408235827_2.text: Beliar himself chose me as his servant!

INFO_FILLER20060408235827_3.text: And I'm going to send you straight to him!

INFO_FILLER20060408235827.text: You will pay for your deeds - with your blood!

INFO_FILLER20060409001500_0.text: It's better if we don't talk too much.

INFO_FILLER20060409001718.text: Feel like starting a little revolt?
