INFO_FILLER20060409001853_0.text: Really? Listen, we're not going to start a revolt.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253_0.text: Well, first of all we would need something like a hero.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253_1.text: Somebody who stands a fighting chance against Zuben.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253_3.text: Then we need three bundles of weapons, we can't be expected to fight with broomsticks.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253_4.text: And we need plenty of healing potions. Let's say twenty.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253_5.text: Good. That doesn't sound all that impossible.

INFO_FILLER20060409002253.text: Why would an uprising be impossible? What do you need?

INFO_FILLER20060409002412_0.text: You? Perhaps you could get into the palace, but first you must pass the great test so we know we can trust you.

INFO_FILLER20060409002600_0.text: Yes, that's right. You beat the test, so you must be good enough to beat Zuben!

INFO_FILLER20060409002600.text: I can go up against Zuben.

INFO_FILLER20060409002724_0.text: You really mean business, don't you?

INFO_FILLER20060409002724_1.text: I'm going to pass them out to the boys.

INFO_FILLER20060409002724.text: Here are three bundles of weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060409002826_0.text: Excellent. We can really use them.

INFO_FILLER20060409002826.text: Here you are, twenty healing potions.

INFO_FILLER20060409003056_1.text: You're our leader - we will strike when you give the signal!

INFO_FILLER20060409003206_0.text: Here we go, then! Liberty or death!

INFO_FILLER20060409010719.text: How am I doing with the tests?

INFO_FILLER20060409010916.text: Come back when you have done more.

INFO_FILLER20060409011029_0.text: Yes, if anyone is the man for Zuben, you are. Go to him. I say the test is over.

INFO_FILLER20060409011029.text: I must say, you amaze me. For a man from the north, you have acquitted yourself quite well.

INFO_FILLER20060409153542.text: Give me three bowls of the gods.

INFO_FILLER20060409154247.text: Give me five skins of the rotten beasts.

INFO_FILLER20060410154404_0.text: Well, be that as it may. For now, you have passed my test.

INFO_FILLER20060410154404.text: Or maybe the stakes just weren't high enough.

INFO_FILLER20060410204105_0.text: What? My bag! Who, where... Oh, I don't even want to know!

INFO_FILLER20060410204105_1.text: How can I ever thank you, Son of Honesty? Well, I know - I am going to wield my influence in your favor!

INFO_FILLER20060410204105.text: Look, I've got a bag of gold with your name on it.

INFO_FILLER20060410204555_0.text: Oh, right, the tribute. Wait, I've got the gold right here.

INFO_FILLER20060410204555.text: I have come to fetch your tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060410205013_0.text: My bag of gold, somebody stole it!

INFO_FILLER20060410205013_2.text: I've been robbed - in my very own city.

INFO_FILLER20060410205013.text: But I still had... dammit, my bag...

INFO_FILLER20060410205253_0.text: If you let them steal your gold, that's your own problem.

INFO_FILLER20060410205253_1.text: Wait... I've got a few coins left here under my robe...

INFO_FILLER20060410205253_2.text: Here, take this. It is all I have...

INFO_FILLER20060410205253.text: Hey, I'm only here to demand the tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060410205412_0.text: No! I bet on a fight at Hernando's. I still had the gold then!

INFO_FILLER20060410205412.text: Any idea who could have done this?

INFO_FILLER20060410205731_0.text: I had no part in that.

INFO_FILLER20060410205731_1.text: Go ask the gladiators - or talk to Aschnu - he's got his eyes and ears everywhere!

INFO_FILLER20060410205731.text: Amul's bag of gold has been stolen!

INFO_FILLER20060410205843.text: What do you know about Hernando's bag of gold?

INFO_FILLER20060410211603.text: I may just have seen something...

INFO_FILLER20060410212736_0.text: I would try Achmed if I were you.

INFO_FILLER20060410212736_1.text: He clung to Amul's skirts like some obnoxious brat.

INFO_FILLER20060410213009_0.text: Nonsense... Amul preaches down here every day.

INFO_FILLER20060410213009_1.text: Did you come up with that all by yourself, you sly dog?

INFO_FILLER20060410213226_0.text: So I pilfered it. What's the big deal?

INFO_FILLER20060410213226_1.text: They're stealing from us, too - only they call it donations!

INFO_FILLER20060410213226_2.text: But I'll tell you what, I can teach you if you like...

INFO_FILLER20060410213226.text: I found Amul's bag of gold hidden in your chest!

INFO_FILLER20060410213350_0.text: Really? Hmm... what else do you know about this?

INFO_FILLER20060410213350_1.text: Amul still had it back at Hernando's...

INFO_FILLER20060410213350_3.text: Hmm... whoever took it wouldn't be stupid enough to carry the gold around.

INFO_FILLER20060410213350_4.text: I would look through the gladiators' chests if I were you, Son of Efficiency.

INFO_FILLER20060410213350.text: Amul's bag of gold has been stolen. I need your advice.

INFO_FILLER20060412144607_1.text: You have come far, Son of the North.

INFO_FILLER20060412144607.text: I'm here to fetch Zuben's tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060412150251_0.text: You dare to demand my tribute?

INFO_FILLER20060412150251_2.text: Very well. Then visit my cave. There you will find a chest.

INFO_FILLER20060412150251_4.text: And if the chest is empty?

INFO_FILLER20060412150251.text: I have come to collect Zuben's tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060412150401_0.text: Behind the temple, in the rock face.

INFO_FILLER20060412174304_0.text: So far, pretty good. I can't complain.

INFO_FILLER20060412174304_1.text: Although... I could use some help anyway.

INFO_FILLER20060412174519_0.text: So he'll let you into the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060412174519.text: I want to take your tribute to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060412174638.text: Yes. There is something you could do for me first...

INFO_FILLER20060412174819.text: Deal with this business in the ruins and I'll have nothing against it.

INFO_FILLER20060412175320.text: One hand washes the other. Of course, you can take our tribute to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060412175609.text: And as for the tribute for Amul - I think we can trust you with it.

INFO_FILLER20060412181523_0.text: There are just too many of them.

INFO_FILLER20060412181523_1.text: They lurk beyond the paths and hide in caves.

INFO_FILLER20060412181523_2.text: They can be found in the south and in the north, everywhere near the city.

INFO_FILLER20060412181523_3.text: The best thing is to stay away from the caves!

INFO_FILLER20060412181523.text: What do you know about the nomads?

INFO_FILLER20060412182712_0.text: Welcome to Bakaresh, the city of Beliar, pilgrim.

INFO_FILLER20060412182712_1.text: My name is Amul, I am one of the black mages.

INFO_FILLER20060412182712.text: ... and Beliar knew his enemy, and his wrath was great!

INFO_FILLER20060412182901_0.text: Yes. You want to see the inside as well, don't you?

INFO_FILLER20060412182901_1.text: But you will not set foot in the temple unless I permit you to do so.

INFO_FILLER20060412182901_2.text: And what do I have to do for that?

INFO_FILLER20060412183018_0.text: Casting the spells of Beliar requires great wisdom.

INFO_FILLER20060412183018_1.text: And I will not teach you before you have rendered outstanding services to the city of Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060412183123_0.text: You have served the city well, Son of the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060412183123_1.text: I am willing to let you partake of my wisdom.

INFO_FILLER20060414164653.text: Hey, I'm Knut, and these are my men.

INFO_FILLER20060414165539_0.text: If you make sure that Redge and that Ateras fellow are going along with it, I'll be willing to risk my neck.

INFO_FILLER20060414165539.text: I mean, the nomads helped us with the oasis. But who knows what's really going on in their heads?

INFO_FILLER20060414172810_0.text: Bakaresh? Hmm, there's a lot to be had there.

INFO_FILLER20060414172810_1.text: Well... and how are we going to divide the loot?

INFO_FILLER20060414172810_3.text: While one man is still fighting, the next one is already opening the chests.

INFO_FILLER20060414172810_4.text: And afterwards, nobody remembers who pocketed what, and how much.

INFO_FILLER20060414172810_6.text: You get ALL of the loot. But you pay us for the attack in advance.

INFO_FILLER20060414172810.text: We want to raid Bakaresh. Are you in?

INFO_FILLER20060414173355_0.text: What, those few coins are all you're offering?

INFO_FILLER20060414173355_1.text: Those few coins? Take it or leave it.

INFO_FILLER20060414173355_2.text: I hate deals that don't pay.

INFO_FILLER20060414173355_3.text: But I won't leave Knut in the lurch.

INFO_FILLER20060414174538_0.text: Good. You give the signal, and off we go.

INFO_FILLER20060414174538.text: All right. We're ready to attack.

INFO_FILLER20060414175734.text: Here we go! Let's liberate Bakaresh!

INFO_FILLER20060414175927.text: Get up, you lazy dogs - there's work to be done!

INFO_FILLER20060414215956.text: Knut sent me. We are planning to attack Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060414220135.text: We are not ready for an attack yet.

INFO_FILLER20060414220255.text: Sinikar isn't here yet. He was going to scout the town.

INFO_FILLER20060414221347_0.text: We want to take Bakaresh. How does it look? Are you in?

INFO_FILLER20060414221347_1.text: Have you really thought this over?

INFO_FILLER20060414221347_2.text: As soon as we attack the first guard they'll sound the alarm.

INFO_FILLER20060414221347_3.text: And there are plenty of guards in the temple, too.

INFO_FILLER20060414224217_0.text: Fine. I don't know about you fellows from up north, but we nomads are ready.

INFO_FILLER20060414224529_0.text: Well, it's not hidden well enough.

INFO_FILLER20060414224529_1.text: Obviously not. You can rest here for a while.

INFO_FILLER20060414224529.text: I am Sinikar. And actually, this is supposed to be a hideout.

INFO_FILLER20060414224918.text: Hey, get your hands off of my... oh, what do you want?

INFO_FILLER20060414225048_0.text: I have to divide up the loot.

INFO_FILLER20060414225048.text: No questions, stranger. If you want to ask questions, ask Knut.

INFO_FILLER20060414225236.text: This land may be dangerous - but it is also very rich!

INFO_FILLER20060418201203.text: Amul sent me. Now, let me through!

INFO_FILLER20060418201357_0.text: You can find out everything else for yourself.

INFO_FILLER20060418201357.text: What do you think? Make yourself useful!

INFO_FILLER20060418211548_0.text: It doesn't look good. Nomads are roaming around outside the city.

INFO_FILLER20060418211548_1.text: Those damn raiders have attacked the oasis!

INFO_FILLER20060418211548_2.text: Go to the city and report it to Silvio.

INFO_FILLER20060418211945_0.text: You want to make yourself useful?

INFO_FILLER20060418211945_1.text: Akrabor is guarding the northern entrance to the city.

INFO_FILLER20060418211945_2.text: He hasn't reported to me for a long time. Go and see what's wrong.

INFO_FILLER20060418211945.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060418213021.text: And while you're at it, check on Benito, too. He's holding the position in the south.

INFO_FILLER20060418213238_0.text: What does he have to report?

INFO_FILLER20060418213238_1.text: The oasis outside the city was raided by nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060418213238_2.text: Damn! That's bad news. Tizgar isn't going to like that at all.

INFO_FILLER20060418213238_3.text: We'd better be careful in the south...

INFO_FILLER20060418213238_4.text: Here, this is for you. And carry on!

INFO_FILLER20060418213419_1.text: I think we both know that we don't have Akrabor to thank for that.

INFO_FILLER20060418213419_2.text: Here, you should be paid for your work.

INFO_FILLER20060418213633_0.text: Leave your weapons sheathed as long as you are in the city.

INFO_FILLER20060418213633_1.text: And keep your hands to yourself, then we'll get along just fine.

INFO_FILLER20060418213633.text: I am Silvio, and this is Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060418213807_0.text: This is a beautiful, serene temple city, and that's the way it should stay.

INFO_FILLER20060418213807_1.text: If you want to go into the temple, talk to Amul.

INFO_FILLER20060418213807_2.text: And if you want to gab for a while, go see Aschnu. He likes to talk a lot.

INFO_FILLER20060418213807.text: What can you tell me about the city?

INFO_FILLER20060418213958_0.text: Sandcrawlers have shown up behind the arena again. There are more and more of them.

INFO_FILLER20060418213958_1.text: The beasts must have a nest somewhere.

INFO_FILLER20060418213958_2.text: So track down the beasts, find their cursed nest, and smoke it out.

INFO_FILLER20060418213958.text: Do you have anything else that needs to be done?

INFO_FILLER20060418214934_0.text: I assume you took out the whole nest.

INFO_FILLER20060418214934_2.text: You've done pretty well so far. Keep at it. Here, this is for you.

INFO_FILLER20060418214934.text: I dealt with your crawler problem.

INFO_FILLER20060418220507_2.text: There are savage nomads who attack everybody on sight.

INFO_FILLER20060418220507_3.text: You'll also find a lot of lurkers over there.

INFO_FILLER20060418220507_4.text: And when I say a lot, I mean a whole lot.

INFO_FILLER20060418220507_5.text: We can only hope that they're all going to kill each other off!

INFO_FILLER20060418220945_0.text: Boy oh boy, you did really well!

INFO_FILLER20060418220945_1.text: Here's a little something for you.

INFO_FILLER20060418220945_2.text: This is how the city of Bakaresh shows its appreciation.

INFO_FILLER20060418221337_0.text: Er, well, Silvio sent you, right?

INFO_FILLER20060418221337_2.text: I can't give you that report - if Silvio finds out what is going on here, he'll have my head!

INFO_FILLER20060418221337_4.text: So help me deal with those nomads, and Silvio can have his report.

INFO_FILLER20060418221337.text: I have come to get your report.

INFO_FILLER20060418221725_1.text: Go to Silvio and tell him that we have the situation under control!

INFO_FILLER20060419123549_0.text: There's only a handful of them - but they're armed to the teeth.

INFO_FILLER20060419123549_1.text: We, er, kept an eye on them. They're sitting in a cave, right over there.

INFO_FILLER20060419123549_3.text: Are you out of your mind? Those are nomads! Tell you what - better flush them out!

INFO_FILLER20060419123549_4.text: And then we finish them off here.

INFO_FILLER20060419123549.text: Tell me all about those nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060419124712_0.text: So? I'm warning you. If you are planning something dirty - I'm watching.

INFO_FILLER20060419124712.text: Silvio sent me. He wants your report.

INFO_FILLER20060419150444.text: Let this serve as a warning for others. No one who tangles with us goes unpunished!

INFO_FILLER20060419151314_0.text: As long as your intentions benefit our community, no road is ever in vain.

INFO_FILLER20060419151314_1.text: Quite the contrary - we reward everyone who works for us.

INFO_FILLER20060419151314_2.text: With gold, with fame, and with the knowledge of dark magic.

INFO_FILLER20060419151314.text: I hope I haven't come in vain.

INFO_FILLER20060419155027_0.text: And? What did he say? Are there new orders?

INFO_FILLER20060419155027_1.text: Yes. He wants us to settle the score with the bandits at the oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060419155027_3.text: Then arm yourself and let me know when you are ready.

INFO_FILLER20060419155803_0.text: They won't raid any more oases!

INFO_FILLER20060419155803.text: Ha! Those damn raiders got what they had coming!

INFO_FILLER20060419172731_0.text: There's no question that you have made efforts on our behalf.

INFO_FILLER20060419172731.text: How is my reputation with your group?

INFO_FILLER20060419173830_0.text: I will teach you the art of dark magic.

INFO_FILLER20060419174133_0.text: How did you get in here?

INFO_FILLER20060419174133_1.text: Amul said it was all right.

INFO_FILLER20060419174133.text: But those who met Beliar's wrathful gaze never again found peace!

INFO_FILLER20060419174335_0.text: What? What have I done that you disturb me?

INFO_FILLER20060419174335_1.text: If you are looking for work, go out into the desert and kill nomads!

INFO_FILLER20060419174335.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060419174437_0.text: You ask that I share my art, our gift, our power with you?

INFO_FILLER20060419193854_0.text: If you bring Amul our gold, he will know that we trust you.

INFO_FILLER20060419193854.text: Well, we merchants of the city must pay our tribute to the black mages.

INFO_FILLER20060420152052.text: Amul! Amul is old. He would let anyone who jingles a few coins into the temple!

INFO_FILLER20060420152441.text: And now, delay me no longer!

INFO_FILLER20060420152715_0.text: There is no reason why I should share it with you!

INFO_FILLER20060420152715.text: Black magic is the highest form of the faith of Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060420152930_0.text: What? Do you think you can buy the power of Beliar?

INFO_FILLER20060420152930_2.text: Oh Son of Many Coins, you really have not been with us for very long!

INFO_FILLER20060420152930_3.text: But you have grasped a few fundamentals.

INFO_FILLER20060420152930_4.text: Very well, I will teach you.

INFO_FILLER20060420152930_5.text: But do not think that it will be fun! It requires the utmost concentration!

INFO_FILLER20060420155257_0.text: Then I will have to assume that you wish to cheat me.

INFO_FILLER20060420155257.text: In that chest, you will find the gold. Here is the key.

INFO_FILLER20060421162220_0.text: Fair enough. Give to the mages, so that they may turn away the wrathful gaze of Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060421162220.text: I bring the tribute from the merchants.

INFO_FILLER20060421163057.text: Behold, the north wind brings us a warrior.

INFO_FILLER20060421163348_0.text: A druid? I am a hunter of the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060421163348_1.text: I once received the stone from one who was wiser than I.

INFO_FILLER20060421163348_2.text: And since I have carried it, the power of the lion has been with me.

INFO_FILLER20060421163348.text: Are you a druid, then? Tell me more.

INFO_FILLER20060421163546_0.text: Another prisoner? I thought we had released them all.

INFO_FILLER20060421163546_1.text: This prisoner is locked up in a hut.

INFO_FILLER20060421163546_2.text: Do you know who it is?

INFO_FILLER20060421163546.text: There is still a prisoner in Lago!

INFO_FILLER20060421163800_2.text: We will go down and attack them. That is my plan.

INFO_FILLER20060421163908_0.text: We shall slake our thirst on our enemies.

INFO_FILLER20060421163908.text: I am ready. Let us attack Lago!

INFO_FILLER20060421164119_0.text: I sense that you speak the truth.

INFO_FILLER20060421164119_1.text: The stone of the lion. I have borne it for many years.

INFO_FILLER20060421164119_2.text: You have proven yourself worthy of carrying it. Use its magic for your battle.

INFO_FILLER20060421164119.text: I have spoken to your brothers.

INFO_FILLER20060421164747_0.text: It is time to share the breath of Adanos. We will smoke the pipe.

INFO_FILLER20060421164747_1.text: Yet the battle goes on. If you call the lion, he will fight with you.

INFO_FILLER20060421165012_0.text: The lion will fight at your side.

INFO_FILLER20060421171757_3.text: That stuff is in demand. So don't pass up a chance to take some with you.

INFO_FILLER20060421171757_4.text: Anybody who's had a taste will pay a fortune for it!

INFO_FILLER20060421173230_1.text: But take a look around - it grows faster than I can smoke it.

INFO_FILLER20060421173230_2.text: The conditions are ideal - lots of sun, fresh breezes...

INFO_FILLER20060421173230_3.text: That makes the pollen unbelievably fine.

INFO_FILLER20060421173230_4.text: I manage a harvest every couple of weeks.

INFO_FILLER20060421173230.text: I thought swampweed grew in swamps.

INFO_FILLER20060421173422_0.text: Those bums! They freed the slaves and stole my harvest.

INFO_FILLER20060421173422_1.text: I mean, sure, I can understand THAT, but...

INFO_FILLER20060421173422_2.text: ...a couple of them trampled right through my plants! Bums!

INFO_FILLER20060421173422.text: What do you know about the nomads?

INFO_FILLER20060421173613_0.text: Free me? And who would take care of the plants if I weren't here?

INFO_FILLER20060421173613_1.text: No, I'm not going anywhere. There's enough here for me to do.

INFO_FILLER20060421181153_1.text: All right, my boys may not really be the cream of the crop...

INFO_FILLER20060421181153_2.text: I have a few guards, an orc, and a gladiator who is always stoned.

INFO_FILLER20060421181153_3.text: But, dammit, we grow the best swampweed in the entire desert.

INFO_FILLER20060421181153_4.text: And I have a gardener. Does Zuben have a gardener? Or King Rhobar? I don't think so.

INFO_FILLER20060421181153.text: And you? What are you doing in these backwaters?

INFO_FILLER20060421181341_0.text: Sure, we dug a pit just for that.

INFO_FILLER20060421181341.text: Have you got something like an arena?

INFO_FILLER20060421181626_0.text: Fine. You can fight against Grubuz, or Mamuk.

INFO_FILLER20060421181626_2.text: No, it doesn't work that way. You will take on Mamuk first.

INFO_FILLER20060421181626_3.text: After that, you get to face Grubuz.

INFO_FILLER20060421181626.text: I want to fight in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060421181823_1.text: But I wonder whether Mamuk is even up to it.

INFO_FILLER20060421181823_2.text: Ever since Rasul started growing that weed, he's been permanently stoned.

INFO_FILLER20060421181823_3.text: Oh well, a few good whacks can't hurt him.

INFO_FILLER20060421181823_4.text: Do your best to drag him to the arena!

INFO_FILLER20060421181956_0.text: What? Arena? Say, wouldn't you rather have a smoke?

INFO_FILLER20060421181956_2.text: Hey, stay calm, Father of Agitation.

INFO_FILLER20060421181956.text: The two of us are going to fight in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060421182049_0.text: You've never been really stoned, huh? Father of Abstinence...

INFO_FILLER20060421182130_0.text: You know what? Whenever I want a smoke, I simply pick some weed.

INFO_FILLER20060421182130.text: Come on, you'll get a reefer if you win!

INFO_FILLER20060421182214_0.text: Alright, alright, I'm coming. I'm so stressed out...

INFO_FILLER20060421182214.text: If you don't want to enter the arena, we'll simply beat each other up right here.

INFO_FILLER20060424125756_1.text: Yes. For one of us, anyway. I'm gonna go lie down for a bit.

INFO_FILLER20060424125756.text: Man, my skull aches. Are you happy now?

INFO_FILLER20060424130344.text: What do you want here? Have you lost your way?

INFO_FILLER20060424130611.text: Only slaves or raiding nomads will come here. And you don't look at all like a slave.

INFO_FILLER20060424131519_1.text: Dammit. I just keep forgetting that. No wonder they stuck me out here in these backwaters.

INFO_FILLER20060424131519_2.text: I won't let that happen again...

INFO_FILLER20060424131519.text: Ah, so you gave Mamuk a thrashing. But wait - did you even pay for this fight?

INFO_FILLER20060424135410_0.text: We've been assaulted. How do you think things are?

INFO_FILLER20060424135410_2.text: Yes... but it's a treacherous calm.

INFO_FILLER20060424135410_3.text: The nomads were led by Shakyor.

INFO_FILLER20060424135410_4.text: And I bet he is still somewhere in the vicinity...

INFO_FILLER20060424140245.text: What do you know about this Shakyor fellow?

INFO_FILLER20060424151522.text: I have seen him fight. And I say he's a raider.

INFO_FILLER20060424154311_0.text: Yes, he had a lion by his side. But that doesn't make him invincible.

INFO_FILLER20060424154311.text: Some claim he isn't even human, but a manbeast. A druid.

INFO_FILLER20060424154512_0.text: As long as he's nearby, we won't get a good night's sleep.

INFO_FILLER20060424154512_1.text: He needs to disappear. Preferably for good.

INFO_FILLER20060424154512.text: What should we do about Shakyor?

INFO_FILLER20060424154634_0.text: I told you he wasn't invincible. Lion - hah!

INFO_FILLER20060424154634_2.text: Good thing the swampweed trade is flourishing right now.

INFO_FILLER20060424154634_3.text: Here, I think this will please you.

INFO_FILLER20060424154634.text: I have taken care of Shakyor.

INFO_FILLER20060424161342_0.text: Dolok ordered me to find the artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060424161342_1.text: What - you think there are artifacts here in Lago?

INFO_FILLER20060424161342.text: The great temple in Ben Sala has been raided. The artifacts were stolen.

INFO_FILLER20060424161436.text: Do you know who the prisoner is?

INFO_FILLER20060424161551_0.text: Yes. But he said nothing. He's a tough old man.

INFO_FILLER20060424161551.text: Have you talked to the prisoner already?

INFO_FILLER20060424161812_0.text: Is that really what you want, Morra?

INFO_FILLER20060424161812_2.text: You paid for me to knock you around? Such idiocy cannot go unpunished.

INFO_FILLER20060424161812.text: Let us fight in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060424162956_0.text: Hey, this orc is our guest. And I shelled out a lot to make sure he would stay here.

INFO_FILLER20060424162956_1.text: If you really manage to defeat him, that will cost me even more. And you are going to pay for that.

INFO_FILLER20060424162956_2.text: Does that mean I can't win anything here?

INFO_FILLER20060424162956_3.text: But of course you can win something. A whole package of premium swampweed.

INFO_FILLER20060424162956.text: I want to fight against Grubuz.

INFO_FILLER20060424163344_0.text: Fine. But you arrange that with him directly.

INFO_FILLER20060424163344_1.text: And remember - I still need the fellow.

INFO_FILLER20060424163344.text: I want to go up against Grubuz.

INFO_FILLER20060424163621_0.text: What would the hashishin say? You're - a Son of Combat, Morra!

INFO_FILLER20060424163621.text: Oh Morra - you're one good fighter.

INFO_FILLER20060424163942_0.text: Oh yeah, right. Here. Take this package of swampweed. It's more valuable than you may think...

INFO_FILLER20060424165753_0.text: Hey, apparently the damn things know what's good!

INFO_FILLER20060424165753_1.text: They've already screwed up a couple of my harvests.

INFO_FILLER20060424165854_0.text: Oh man, I was afraid to ask.

INFO_FILLER20060424165854_1.text: But you know what, I'll cough up a package of 'Original Lago Swampweed' if you drive the beasts off!

INFO_FILLER20060424165854.text: Maybe I should take care of the bloodflies for you.

INFO_FILLER20060424171618_0.text: Here, light up. And take your time. The beasts won't fly off by themselves... unfortunately.

INFO_FILLER20060424171618.text: Hey, somebody who works for me ought to enjoy himself.

INFO_FILLER20060424171725_0.text: Then my next harvest is safe!

INFO_FILLER20060424171725_1.text: Here, take a package of swampweed, Father of Relaxation.

INFO_FILLER20060424171833.text: That is, if the bloodflies or the nomads don't get into it.

INFO_FILLER20060424181538_0.text: There's no need for you to know.

INFO_FILLER20060424181801.text: Which part of 'no' didn't you understand?

INFO_FILLER20060425134524_1.text: Fabio has a Morra locked up. If he knows anything, he will tell us.

INFO_FILLER20060425134524.text: No, Morra. But there's a man here who might know something about them.

INFO_FILLER20060425134902_0.text: So many Morras - so many names. I can't remember them all.

INFO_FILLER20060425140714_1.text: And as long as I've got the key, nobody will talk to him.

INFO_FILLER20060425140714_4.text: And no, I won't tell you who my prisoner is. Too many people know already.

INFO_FILLER20060425140714_5.text: Now stop asking me about things that are none of your business.

INFO_FILLER20060425142105_0.text: Hey now, that's a really uptight question.

INFO_FILLER20060425142105_2.text: All I know is that Fabio doesn't want any trouble.

INFO_FILLER20060425142105_3.text: That's why he doesn't want anybody blabbing about it.

INFO_FILLER20060425142105_5.text: Hey now, what do you think? I'm the gardener here, not the torturer!

INFO_FILLER20060425142105.text: Do you know anything about the prisoner?

INFO_FILLER20060425155433_0.text: He has sent me a fearless liberator!

INFO_FILLER20060425155433.text: Adanos has not forgotten his servant.

INFO_FILLER20060425155643.text: You've taken on the entire village, haven't you?

INFO_FILLER20060425160000_0.text: They believed that as the spiritual leader of the nomads, I would betray their secrets.

INFO_FILLER20060425160000_1.text: There was so much they wanted to know. About the locations of the individual tribes, about artifacts, and about magic.

INFO_FILLER20060425160000_2.text: Those fools! I had barely set foot on the mainland when they grabbed me!

INFO_FILLER20060425160000.text: Why have they locked you up?

INFO_FILLER20060425160117_0.text: Now don't you get started, too!

INFO_FILLER20060425160117_1.text: All I know is that the other Water Mages are out searching for them.

INFO_FILLER20060425160117_2.text: And if I know the Water Mages, they'll be trying to study the secrets of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_FILLER20060425160117.text: What do you know about the artifacts?

INFO_FILLER20060425160306_0.text: I have grown old. No one could have taken me prisoner in the past.

INFO_FILLER20060425160306_1.text: But before I die, I want to return to my old tribe once more.

INFO_FILLER20060425161637_0.text: You are searching for the ancient magic?

INFO_FILLER20060425161637_1.text: Fine. I will teach you what I know.

INFO_FILLER20060425165055_0.text: Here man, now it's time to relax.

INFO_FILLER20060425165055.text: Hey, Lago is free! What a battle!

INFO_FILLER20060425185659_0.text: Come and drink a sip of water with me.

INFO_FILLER20060425185824_0.text: It was entrusted to me long ago.

INFO_FILLER20060425185824_2.text: His stone - I bear the stone of the lion.

INFO_FILLER20060425185824_3.text: It is one of the ancient druid stones.

INFO_FILLER20060425221821_0.text: Some clans have succumbed to the wrath of Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060425221821_1.text: They roam the land, murdering and pillaging, never distinguishing between friends and enemies.

INFO_FILLER20060425221821.text: We are now traveling on the path of combat.

INFO_FILLER20060425222033.text: Talk to the others before you go. They will tell you what remains to be done.

INFO_FILLER20060425223050_1.text: You can come with us or choose your own path.

INFO_FILLER20060425224140_0.text: Braga is a good bit from here.

INFO_FILLER20060425224140_1.text: Before we attack, we'll assemble in the field of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060425224140_2.text: Make sure the fields of ruins are secure.

INFO_FILLER20060425224316_0.text: I'll teach you everything I know about hunting.

INFO_FILLER20060425224355_0.text: Good. Talk to Asaru when you're ready for the attack.

INFO_FILLER20060425224355.text: The fields of ruins are secure.

INFO_FILLER20060425224531_0.text: Excellent. This means that Nafalem will be feeling quite safe.

INFO_FILLER20060425224531_1.text: Now help us with the other preparations for the attack on Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060425231639_1.text: Let us drive the Hashishin from the city!

INFO_FILLER20060425231639.text: How is everything? Are you ready to attack?

INFO_FILLER20060426161936_1.text: Then we finally have a chance to free Braga!

INFO_FILLER20060426161936_2.text: But before we attack, we still need to make a few preparations.

INFO_FILLER20060426161936_4.text: We need better weapons. Get us three bundles of weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060426161936_5.text: Then we will take the risk. Before that, forget it.

INFO_FILLER20060426161936.text: So, you are our new man?

INFO_FILLER20060426162020_0.text: The merchant Bernardo deals in weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060426162020_1.text: We know that he secretly supplies the feuding tribes.

INFO_FILLER20060426162020_2.text: Maybe you can find something with him.

INFO_FILLER20060426162020.text: Where do I get three bundles of weapons?

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_0.text: The Hashishin store a lot of treasures in their cities.

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_1.text: Silver, gold, bring me everything you find. I'll give you a good price for it.

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_2.text: What do you do with the junk?

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_3.text: We take it back to their cities and sell it to them again.

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_5.text: Ha! No nomad can enter a city of the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060426162342_6.text: But many of the slaves are nomads. They funnel the stuff back into the cities.

INFO_FILLER20060426162416_0.text: Very good. With these, we can risk an attack.

INFO_FILLER20060426162416_1.text: Talk to Asaru when you're ready to attack Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060426162416.text: Here are the bundles of weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060426162833_0.text: We are leaving now for the field of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060426162833_1.text: We are going to meet you there - and then we attack.

INFO_FILLER20060426162833.text: I am ready to attack Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060426182916.text: Does that mean he worked magic?

INFO_FILLER20060426183102_1.text: Yes. Have you noticed the dead trees?

INFO_FILLER20060426183102_2.text: You mean they are the remains of the green valley?

INFO_FILLER20060426183102_3.text: Exactly. There we will find his tomb and, with a bit of luck, his magic.

INFO_FILLER20060426183102.text: They took him to a stone tomb in the green valley.

INFO_FILLER20060426183309.text: Are you sure? I thought I heard something...

INFO_FILLER20060426210356_0.text: I'm beginning to understand the context.

INFO_FILLER20060426210356_1.text: It will be enough to teach you the necessary components.

INFO_FILLER20060426210356_2.text: I will teach you the ancient spell.

INFO_FILLER20060426210356.text: And? Have you learned the magic?

INFO_FILLER20060426215604_0.text: I am Riordian, the Water Mage.

INFO_FILLER20060426215604_1.text: We... oh, never mind. Let's not rehash old stories.

INFO_FILLER20060426215717_0.text: And what are you looking for here?

INFO_FILLER20060426215717_1.text: Actually, I'm looking for ancient knowledge.

INFO_FILLER20060426215717_2.text: Stone tablets, artifacts... anything that the Ancient Ones left behind.

INFO_FILLER20060426215717.text: I wonder that myself - it isn't safe here, in any case.

INFO_FILLER20060426215753.text: You should look for him - or better yet, talk to Saturas first.

INFO_FILLER20060426220247.text: And Nefarius is far to the northwest. He is on the trail of an ancient legend.

INFO_FILLER20060426220408.text: I don't know anything about the others.

INFO_FILLER20060426220800_0.text: I know the way. So follow me!

INFO_FILLER20060426220800.text: Alright. I'll accompany you to Asaru.

INFO_FILLER20060426220922_0.text: I can't give you much, but if you like, I will share my knowledge of the ancient magic with you.

INFO_FILLER20060426220922.text: Here is the hideout. Thanks for your help.

INFO_FILLER20060427192811_0.text: Then you probably also know that the Hashishin Ramirez has disappeared.

INFO_FILLER20060427192811.text: So you rendered Mora Sul a great service.

INFO_FILLER20060427192949_0.text: That is extremely regrettable. The ruins are very dangerous.

INFO_FILLER20060427192949_1.text: But he knew the danger. He could appreciate it.

INFO_FILLER20060427192949_2.text: I cannot imagine that he was eaten by sandcrawlers.

INFO_FILLER20060427192949_3.text: No... his death is connected to his mission.

INFO_FILLER20060427192949.text: I found Ramirez in the field of ruins. He is dead.

INFO_FILLER20060427193223_0.text: A shipment of raw ore was stolen from Ben Sala.

INFO_FILLER20060427193223_1.text: Some of it has surfaced at the merchants here in Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060427193223_2.text: I put Ramirez on the matter.

INFO_FILLER20060427193223_3.text: He was following a clue. He believed he had found the ore thief.

INFO_FILLER20060427194023_2.text: He worked for Nerusul, who is currently staying in Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060427194023_3.text: See to it that you are granted admission to Ishtar and sort out that Nerusul.

INFO_FILLER20060427194023_4.text: I will exercise my influence with Zuben for you. I can do no more.

INFO_FILLER20060427194211_0.text: Then the death of Ramirez is avenged... good!

INFO_FILLER20060427194211_1.text: Here, take this gold. You have earned it.

INFO_FILLER20060427194333_0.text: If you continue working as you have here in Mora Sul, you will soon stand before Zuben.

INFO_FILLER20060427194333_1.text: Convince a few of the other mages, then you will be as good as admitted into Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060427194723_0.text: Good. All I know is he was on his way to the fields of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060427194723_1.text: And he has been gone a very long time.

INFO_FILLER20060427215422_0.text: You believe that the ore thief is also the murderer.

INFO_FILLER20060427215422_1.text: I want you to stay on this matter.

INFO_FILLER20060427215422_2.text: Find his killer and avenge Ramirez.

INFO_FILLER20060427215422_3.text: But be sure that you catch the right one!

INFO_FILLER20060427215813_0.text: He set out for the field of ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060427215813_1.text: But so far he has not returned.

INFO_FILLER20060427215813_2.text: He works for me - and I want to know what is wrong.

INFO_FILLER20060427215813_3.text: Good, I'll take care of it.

INFO_FILLER20060427215932.text: Where did you get the magic ore blank?

INFO_FILLER20060427220451.text: Get me my promissory notes, then I will tell you.

INFO_FILLER20060427220540_0.text: You know what? Welcome to Mora Sul, you bum!

INFO_FILLER20060427220540.text: What? First you betray me, and then you want my help?

INFO_FILLER20060427220628_0.text: Hassan the Hashishi sold it to me.

INFO_FILLER20060427220628.text: Well, one hand washes the other, so I will tell you.

INFO_FILLER20060427220914_0.text: Hassan the Hashishi sold it to me.

INFO_FILLER20060427220914_1.text: He was in the city for a while, and he also did business with Ismael.

INFO_FILLER20060427220914.text: So, where did you get the magic ore blank?

INFO_FILLER20060427221111_0.text: I found it. Pretty, isn't it?

INFO_FILLER20060427221111_1.text: Yes, yes, old Mezir finds all kinds of things.

INFO_FILLER20060427221111.text: Where did you get the raw ore?

INFO_FILLER20060427221510.text: If you need another weapon, I can sell you one.

INFO_FILLER20060427221701_0.text: I'm but a poor old blacksmith, and my pockets are empty...

INFO_FILLER20060427221701.text: I cannot remember, Son of Nosiness.

INFO_FILLER20060427221805_0.text: Funny, now that you say it, I do indeed remember.

INFO_FILLER20060427221805_1.text: Hassan the Hashishin sold it to me.

INFO_FILLER20060427221805_2.text: But he left town a while ago.

INFO_FILLER20060427221805.text: Now do you remember anything about that ore?

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_0.text: Are you, now? Many people look for many things in these ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_1.text: But very few of them find what they seek.

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_4.text: But this is a dangerous place.

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_5.text: You had better look for your friend elsewhere, or...

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_7.text: Or they might have to send somebody to look for YOU.

INFO_FILLER20060427222855_8.text: And then that person will come to me and bother me... and so forth...

INFO_FILLER20060427230408_0.text: Find out if he really is behind the ore theft.

INFO_FILLER20060427230408_2.text: Then teach him a final lesson.

INFO_FILLER20060427230408_3.text: My people may be a group of gold-hungry bastards, but...

INFO_FILLER20060427230408_4.text: ...we will never allow miserable thieves like Hassan to gain power and wealth.

INFO_FILLER20060427230408.text: What exactly should I do with Nerusul?

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_0.text: Then he was behind the ore theft.

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_1.text: Yes. He wanted to set himself up as ruler.

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_10.text: Hahaha - here, this is for you!

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_3.text: Zuben has the power of Beliar. He is the chosen one!

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_5.text: Ah, now it dawns on me. Now I see clearly! He fell victim to Beliar's power.

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_6.text: Beliar must have spoken to him -

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_7.text: But not to set him on the throne in Ishtar - rather to call him to Beliar.

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_8.text: Yes. Beliar is great and his power is destruction!!!

INFO_FILLER20060427230929_9.text: And those who are not steadfast, he calls them to their end.

INFO_FILLER20060428004517.text: Excuse me for being so upset, Son of Pluckiness, but I find this matter truly distressing.

INFO_FILLER20060428004837_0.text: That's the bravery of a man who fears no peril! It's a true hero speaking!

INFO_FILLER20060428004837_1.text: Never mind. Get to the point.

INFO_FILLER20060428004837_2.text: I implore you - save my city!

INFO_FILLER20060428004837.text: Will you listen to that - he fights his way through to us and asks how he can help!

INFO_FILLER20060428004902.text: But there's another important issue - a business deal that was entrusted to me.

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_0.text: We got ten ore blanks, a delivery from the orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_1.text: They were destined for Ishtar - but they've been stolen.

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_2.text: But I know who the thief is and I want him to be punished for his nefarious deed.

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_3.text: Let him die of thirst under Innos' scorching curse - let the vultures feast on his eyes...

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_4.text: Yeah, yeah, I get the point. I'll see to it. Who is he?

INFO_FILLER20060428005114_5.text: Sugut, one of our own people! That traitor - may Beliar's furious wrath overtake him!

INFO_FILLER20060428005155_0.text: He left the city in the direction of Ben Erai. And he wasn't alone!

INFO_FILLER20060428005155.text: Can you tell me Sugut's whereabouts?

INFO_FILLER20060428005311_0.text: There was another fellow with him, but I couldn't make out who he was.

INFO_FILLER20060428005311_1.text: But when you find him, make him pay for this crime as well!

INFO_FILLER20060428005353.text: First of all, I need to find him.

INFO_FILLER20060428005546_0.text: Excellent. Let him stew in Beliar's realm for his sacrilege!

INFO_FILLER20060428005546_1.text: You have done a good job - and good work is rewarded with good gold.

INFO_FILLER20060428005646_1.text: Did you give him his just deserts?

INFO_FILLER20060428005646.text: I found the other ore thief!

INFO_FILLER20060428005847_0.text: If you find them, pick them up.

INFO_FILLER20060428005847_1.text: Keep them safe and take them to Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060428005847_2.text: My cousin Muntasir is the steward there. He will take care of them.

INFO_FILLER20060428013505_0.text: No one - not even Zuben! And I would be the new ruler of all the Hashishin!

INFO_FILLER20060428013505.text: No one could stop a handful of Hashishin equipped with those weapons!

INFO_FILLER20060428013713_0.text: You don't have the raw ore. Not a single piece.

INFO_FILLER20060428013713_1.text: Uh... damn. All right. Look - let's forget this trivial matter.

INFO_FILLER20060428013713_2.text: I'll pay you two thousand gold coins and we'll never ever mention this again.

INFO_FILLER20060428013713_3.text: What do you say? Do we have a deal?

INFO_FILLER20060428013825_0.text: Done. You have made a good deal!

INFO_FILLER20060428013825_1.text: And you had better keep this to yourself in the future...

INFO_FILLER20060428013825.text: Good. Two thousand gold pieces for my silence.

INFO_FILLER20060428015158.text: Then we shall meet in the arena! A fight to the death!

INFO_FILLER20060428022032_1.text: Undead, nomads... there are plenty of reasons to be on the run.

INFO_FILLER20060428022032_2.text: But never mind. Drink a bit of water and rest.

INFO_FILLER20060428022032.text: Well, traveler, are you on the run?

INFO_FILLER20060428022214_0.text: Well, you know, the nomads are making life difficult for us.

INFO_FILLER20060428022214_1.text: They're always ready to attack us... especially that Hurit.

INFO_FILLER20060428022214_2.text: Perhaps you could take care of it.

INFO_FILLER20060428022214.text: Me? I am the boss here. This is my oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060428022345_0.text: Hurit and his band are lurking nearby. They are waiting to steal our water.

INFO_FILLER20060428022345_1.text: So, go and wipe them out!

INFO_FILLER20060428022418.text: Not far from here, in the east. Mostly they hang around ancient ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060428022545_0.text: You did... good, that is good.

INFO_FILLER20060428022545_2.text: Reward, of course. Here, that should be sufficient.

INFO_FILLER20060428022545_3.text: So, now just get out of here!

INFO_FILLER20060428022648_0.text: And so what? What are you going to do about it?

INFO_FILLER20060428022722_0.text: I sold them a long time ago.

INFO_FILLER20060428022722_1.text: Now beat it - otherwise I'll have to hurt you!

INFO_FILLER20060428022722.text: Tell me what you did with the ore blanks!

INFO_FILLER20060428022842_1.text: He knows every hideout in the desert and has plenty of friends in Mora Sul - you'll never find him again!

INFO_FILLER20060428022842_3.text: So what? That won't help you at all. Write it down if you like - he left the city long ago anyway!

INFO_FILLER20060428022842_4.text: And don't think you'll learn his name from me, Son of Simplicity!

INFO_FILLER20060428024716.text: So, first I take you to Ramirez, and then you will accompany me to Murat's oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060428024754_0.text: Then follow me, Father of Delights.

INFO_FILLER20060428024754.text: Hmm, all right. Take me to Ramirez.

INFO_FILLER20060428024931.text: Here we are. He's down there!

INFO_FILLER20060428025004_0.text: What was left of him, anyway.

INFO_FILLER20060428025004_1.text: Then let us head for Murat's oasis now, before we end up like him.

INFO_FILLER20060428025212.text: I know the way, but you must protect me!

INFO_FILLER20060428025443_0.text: Now we can rest for a while.

INFO_FILLER20060428025443_1.text: Here, take this. I'm sure you will like it.

INFO_FILLER20060428025443.text: Ah, here we are. Wonderful. Many thanks for your help.

INFO_FILLER20060428142836_1.text: Aha... hmhm... what? Ah... I see... hmm...

INFO_FILLER20060428142836_2.text: Yes, if that is the case, then of course I will put in a good word with Zuben for you.

INFO_FILLER20060428142836.text: I have a letter here from Sancho.

INFO_FILLER20060428155704_0.text: No. You have been very helpful. I think you could go far in the desert.

INFO_FILLER20060428155704.text: Do you have anything else for me to do?

INFO_FILLER20060428202323_0.text: If you place those artifacts in the temple of Beliar, you will receive a part of his power.

INFO_FILLER20060428202323_3.text: Provided you possess the right focus to guide the power.

INFO_FILLER20060428202323_5.text: My staff - the Staff of the Eternal Wanderer.

INFO_FILLER20060428202323_6.text: I want to offer you a deal...

INFO_FILLER20060428202323.text: With the help of the artifacts, his power can manifest itself.

INFO_FILLER20060428202438.text: Then I will give you the Staff of the Wanderer - and you can receive the power of Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060428202548_0.text: Then you are also worthy of carrying my staff.

INFO_FILLER20060428202548.text: I have found the five artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060428203453.text: You should make friends with the Black Mages - they are the most influential group.

INFO_FILLER20060428203820.text: Oh, and I assume that Hassan has received his just punishment... ?

INFO_FILLER20060428205301.text: It is probably better if I stay here and keep the peace.

INFO_FILLER20060428210228.text: Stop! No entering the city unless you're a friend.

INFO_FILLER20060428222508_0.text: He's up there, by the other wells.

INFO_FILLER20060428231328.text: Do you have work for me?

INFO_FILLER20060428231702_0.text: With these weapons they will defeat all our enemies!

INFO_FILLER20060428231702.text: Wonderful. Soon we will equip our fighters with magic ore weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060428234736.text: A fighter who is ready to take on an important mission.

INFO_FILLER20060428234904_1.text: But as I already said, the test has begun. Therefore, you must take part in it.

INFO_FILLER20060428234904_2.text: Speak to Ugrasal, he is taking care of the details.

INFO_FILLER20060428234904.text: You can stop looking. I will accept your mission.

INFO_FILLER20060429000439_0.text: Good. Then you are now my new man. Congratulations.

INFO_FILLER20060429000439.text: Ugrasal sent me. I have completed your test.

INFO_FILLER20060429000926.text: Go to the temple in Bakaresh and demand what is yours from Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060429005901_0.text: I am Delazar, alchemist and mage.

INFO_FILLER20060429005901.text: Welcome to Ishtar, Son of the North.

INFO_FILLER20060429005934_0.text: Of course. My knowledge is available to anyone who made it all the way to Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060429005934.text: I want to learn from you.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608_0.text: He was completely out of his mind.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608_1.text: I heard that he was also behind the theft of the raw ore.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608_3.text: I know a lot of things.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608_4.text: Well, we don't like it much here when high-ranking mages go mad.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608_5.text: Here's a little something from a satisfied alchemist.

INFO_FILLER20060429010608.text: So you got into a fight with Nerusul?

INFO_FILLER20060429010801_1.text: Well, I can't say anything bad about that, really.

INFO_FILLER20060429010801_2.text: But couldn't you have given him enough time to brew all those potions for me?

INFO_FILLER20060429010801_3.text: Now I'm going to have to do it myself, again.

INFO_FILLER20060429010801.text: So you did away with Surus.

INFO_FILLER20060429012216.text: He took an ancient bowl from me.

INFO_FILLER20060429013502_1.text: There are some really evil fellows lurking out there. I think they're looking for you.

INFO_FILLER20060429013502_3.text: Well, looks like you made a few enemies in town.

INFO_FILLER20060429014019_0.text: You are going to make your mark in the world, Father of Trials.

INFO_FILLER20060429141238.text: But do not follow the path, keep to the mountainside instead.

INFO_FILLER20060429152321.text: I will give it to you as soon as you have found the five artifacts.

INFO_FILLER20060429152405.text: Xardas is seeking the artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER20060429152629_0.text: Xardas has the orcs searching throughout the world for them.

INFO_FILLER20060429152629_1.text: The path to the artifacts of Adanos leads through the orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060429152629_2.text: Talk to their leaders, do whatever is necessary - and gain possession of the divine artifacts!

INFO_FILLER20060429152629.text: Where can I find the five artifacts of Adanos?

INFO_FILLER20060429153323_2.text: Go to the Monastery of Fire and receive the divine power of Innos!

INFO_FILLER20060429153731.text: I have found the artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER20060429153806_0.text: Now take my scepter and make yourself the Chosen One of Innos.

INFO_FILLER20060429190943_0.text: Your fate is fulfilled. Now fulfill the will of Innos!

INFO_FILLER20060429190943.text: You entered the monastery as a servant of Innos and, you have returned as his Chosen One.

INFO_FILLER20060429191417_0.text: The slave of Beliar has fallen! That fills my heart with joy.

INFO_FILLER20060429191704.text: I did it. Myrtana is free!

INFO_FILLER20060429192550.text: Innos will be victorious in the war of the gods, just as his Chosen One is victorious.

INFO_FILLER20060429192747_0.text: Glory and honor to the Chosen One!

INFO_FILLER20060429192747.text: You have freed our people and our land from slavery!

INFO_FILLER20060429195132_0.text: The king was old and weak. Not even his magic barrier could save him.

INFO_FILLER20060429195132_1.text: The power of Innos is vanishing from this world like sand blown by the wind...

INFO_FILLER20060429195550_0.text: Ha! Xardas has made a fool of them.

INFO_FILLER20060429195550_1.text: They were so close to gaining everything and yet they have lost it all.

INFO_FILLER20060429195550.text: The chieftains of the orcs are dead.

INFO_FILLER20060429201235.text: This is a very dangerous area here.

INFO_FILLER20060429201321_0.text: I can do that. I know a lot about hunting.

INFO_FILLER20060429201321_1.text: However, you will pay me for my knowledge.

INFO_FILLER20060429201434_0.text: The best teacher is at your service.

INFO_FILLER20060429201434.text: I want to learn from you.

INFO_FILLER20060429213649_0.text: I know why you are here and you have come to exactly the right place!

INFO_FILLER20060429213649_2.text: You have come to buy a superb weapon.

INFO_FILLER20060429213649_3.text: And if you haven't - I have even more goods to offer.

INFO_FILLER20060429213858.text: Maybe you should try the next city.

INFO_FILLER20060430000852.text: Move along, stranger. Marauding nomads are lurking everywhere around here.

INFO_FILLER20060430001048_0.text: I was the boss there. But now, Nafalem is sitting in my place.

INFO_FILLER20060430001048_2.text: I collected the tribute for Zuben - but then the nomads ambushed me and stole everything!

INFO_FILLER20060430001048_3.text: And that's why they kicked you out?

INFO_FILLER20060430001048_4.text: Yes. I'm lucky I'm still alive!

INFO_FILLER20060430001048.text: I have been banished from my own city. From Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060430001143.text: One of Zuben's Black Mages. He came to get the tribute.

INFO_FILLER20060430001240_0.text: He sits in the palace of Ishtar and he bears the power of Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060430001240_1.text: We pay him tribute - so that he keeps the wrathful gaze of Beliar from us.

INFO_FILLER20060430001406.text: But wait - before you kill me, let me suggest a deal.

INFO_FILLER20060430001604_0.text: If we are victorious, you will have more gold than my life is worth.

INFO_FILLER20060430001604_1.text: You can keep all of the loot we get.

INFO_FILLER20060430001604_2.text: And then I'm supposed to let you go?

INFO_FILLER20060430001604_3.text: And pay my tribute to Nafalem. That is my offer.

INFO_FILLER20060430002012.text: Well, my pockets are empty. I don't have a single coin.

INFO_FILLER20060430002723.text: Fight with me against Malir and his raiders!

INFO_FILLER20060430002913_0.text: You will not regret this, Son of Valor!

INFO_FILLER20060430002913_1.text: I know where Malir and his raiders are hiding out. They have a cave here.

INFO_FILLER20060430002913_2.text: We can go as soon as you are ready!

INFO_FILLER20060430002913.text: Alright. We will fight against the raiders.

INFO_FILLER20060430003127_0.text: I will not die without a fight!

INFO_FILLER20060430003127.text: You can't pay, so suffer the consequences!

INFO_FILLER20060430005136.text: Armor made by me is worth much more than that!

INFO_FILLER20060430010220.text: As for you, I shall recommend you in Ishtar.

INFO_FILLER20060430010718_0.text: And the pass is the only way into the desert...

INFO_FILLER20060430010718.text: He sold slaves to all of the orcs that came by.

INFO_FILLER20060430013300_0.text: I assume that Asaru will pose no more problems for us?

INFO_FILLER20060430013300_1.text: Asaru is no longer an issue.

INFO_FILLER20060430013300_2.text: Good, then go take care of something... else.

INFO_FILLER20060430013300_3.text: Here, hand out a little gold!

INFO_FILLER20060430013300.text: Excellent. She will sweeten my nights with her dancing.

INFO_FILLER20060430014009_0.text: Good. That will serve as a warning to the others!

INFO_FILLER20060430014350_1.text: I cannot imagine that he came up with the gold by himself.

INFO_FILLER20060430014350_2.text: You should be careful, traveler. Generosity can be a great weakness.

INFO_FILLER20060430014350_3.text: But tribute is tribute. Good, I accept the gold.

INFO_FILLER20060430021440_0.text: Yes, Son of the Hashishins. You did us a great service.

INFO_FILLER20060430021440_1.text: Now we can attend to our business in peace.

INFO_FILLER20060430021440.text: I think I finished all of the tribe leaders.

INFO_FILLER20060430022311_0.text: Malir and Taklar are the leaders of these bands of raiders.

INFO_FILLER20060430022311_1.text: They're ambushing travellers in the ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060430022311_2.text: They were the same ones who attacked Tufail and stole our tribute!

INFO_FILLER20060430022311_3.text: We haven't seen hide nor hair of Asaru's tribe in a while.

INFO_FILLER20060430022311_4.text: That's the way those nomads are - you never know where the bastards are hanging out!

INFO_FILLER20060430022546.text: He's probably sitting in his camp right now, watching her dance! That Son of a Scoundrel!

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_0.text: Right before my eyes? That mangy son of a jackal!

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_1.text: I ought to kill him for that!

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_2.text: Hmm... but if I have him killed, the village will soon be empty.

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_3.text: Besides, he is the only weapons merchant far and wide.

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_4.text: I shall grant him his life - but he will pay for it through his nose.

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_5.text: And believe me - the next one who tries to play us for fools will curse the day he was born!

INFO_FILLER20060430160624_6.text: As for you, you have earned a reward. Here.

INFO_FILLER20060430160624.text: Bernardo is providing the nomads with weapons.

INFO_FILLER20060430162141_2.text: You betrayed me! I should never deal with you again!

INFO_FILLER20060430162141_3.text: But I need gold to pay my debt. So I continue to be at your service.

INFO_FILLER20060430162141_5.text: You are sure to go far, Son of Business.

INFO_FILLER20060430171624_0.text: Zuben is our great leader. He is ancient and possesses the power of Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060430171624_1.text: We pay him tribute, and he keeps Beliar's wrathful gaze away from us.

INFO_FILLER20060430171624_2.text: And his warriors and black mages protect us from the nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060430171624_4.text: Gold and precious goods. We pay him so that no harm may befall us.

INFO_FILLER20060430173220_0.text: Allow me to thank you, Son of Courage. You have saved me from great evil.

INFO_FILLER20060430173220_1.text: Here, take this as a token of my gratitude.

INFO_FILLER20060430173220.text: I took your chalice to Nafalem.

INFO_FILLER20060430182850.text: Whatever - now you're going to get a little taste of what will happen if you try to steal our gold!

INFO_FILLER20060430182948.text: You have worked. Good, then carry on.

INFO_FILLER20060430184139_0.text: I'll pay you a bounty for every nomad leader you get.

INFO_FILLER20060430184139.text: Work? The damn nomads are hanging around here everywhere!

INFO_FILLER20060430184140.text: If that's what you mean by work, then I've got work for you!

INFO_FILLER20060430184218_0.text: Shakyor the Lion - he raided Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060430184218_1.text: Hurit, he raids the oases in the South with his people.

INFO_FILLER20060430184218_2.text: And Yespas. He lurks on the roads and ambushes travelers.

INFO_FILLER20060430184331_0.text: You've dealt with all the nomads here in the area.

INFO_FILLER20060430184331_1.text: You've earned a bonus for that.

INFO_FILLER20060430184331_2.text: Here, take this, Hunter of Nomads!

INFO_FILLER20060430184331.text: Is there anything else to do?

INFO_FILLER20060430184653_0.text: Good thing you dealt with him. Now the road to Braga is safe once more.

INFO_FILLER20060430184653.text: Yespas will never ambush anyone ever again.

INFO_FILLER20060430184838_0.text: Good. He's been causing us problems for a long time.

INFO_FILLER20060430191111_0.text: You are prepared? Very good. I've been waiting for this for a long time.

INFO_FILLER20060430191205_0.text: Then you're a greater idiot than I thought.

INFO_FILLER20060430191205_1.text: Because first, you need to earn access to the tunnels.

INFO_FILLER20060430191205_2.text: But hey, if that's what you want - I've still got a pickaxe I could sell you.

INFO_FILLER20060430191205.text: What if I want to swing a pickaxe?

INFO_FILLER20060430191318_0.text: You will go instead - directly to Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060430191318.text: You filthy swine - no, I won't go.

INFO_FILLER20060430193235_0.text: You've made yourself useful. All right, go dig a little.

INFO_FILLER20060430193235_1.text: But don't think you can push the slaves around!

INFO_FILLER20060430193235.text: Can I go into the tunnels?

INFO_FILLER20060430195117_1.text: And distiller of top notch moonshine!

INFO_FILLER20060430195117_2.text: Whatever you need - I can get you anything.

INFO_FILLER20060430195342_0.text: Man, we're sitting right on a gold vein - and there's not a nugget in it for me!

INFO_FILLER20060430195342_1.text: How I would love to creep round here at night and empty all the chests.

INFO_FILLER20060430195342_3.text: Are you nuts? I'm glad when I can drag my belly out of bed in the mornings.

INFO_FILLER20060430195423_0.text: And, believe me - you don't want any trouble with him either.

INFO_FILLER20060430195423_1.text: So you had better find some work soon, or he'll think you're only here to pilfer.

INFO_FILLER20060430195423.text: Moreover, Navaras and his guards are watching here. And I don't want any trouble with Navaras.

INFO_FILLER20060430195704_0.text: But before you can have that, you must bring me ten cactus blossoms.

INFO_FILLER20060430195704.text: Sure. Brewing potions is my business. And I have a recipe for some really fierce booze.

INFO_FILLER20060430195742_0.text: Oh, good. I almost thought I would have to walk all the way and get them myself.

INFO_FILLER20060430200438_0.text: The mage Sigmor from Bakaresh still owes me.

INFO_FILLER20060430200438.text: I see. Good. My influence doesn't reach as far as Ishtar, but I can help you nevertheless.

INFO_FILLER20060430202745_0.text: Come drink some water with us.

INFO_FILLER20060430202828_0.text: We have been hunting and now we are headed for the oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060430202915.text: But a few Hashishin have made themselves at home there.

INFO_FILLER20060430203004_0.text: Fine, we can attack as soon as you are ready.

INFO_FILLER20060430203004.text: Let us attack the oasis together.

INFO_FILLER20060430203202_0.text: We share our water and we share our knowledge.

INFO_FILLER20060430203716_0.text: Is Gonzales also interested in swampweed? I have a whole package here.

INFO_FILLER20060430203716_1.text: You are a man of taste. Yes, that will please Gonzales.

INFO_FILLER20060430203716.text: Is Gonzales also interested in swampweed? (Give package)

INFO_FILLER20060430203944.text: Here, the stuff comes from Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060430203950.text: Gonzales will be very pleased with this.

INFO_FILLER20060430205310_0.text: Hey, wait a minute... What's that I smell? You smell like you walked through a field of swampweed.

INFO_FILLER20060430205310_1.text: Oh, that. Yes, I've got some here. Brought it from Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060430205310_2.text: Hey, I took a little gold from the orcs. I don't suppose you would sell me some?

INFO_FILLER20060430205604_1.text: Thanks man, that's what I call a true friend.

INFO_FILLER20060503150240_0.text: The desert is a dangerous place - you will not get far without any water.

INFO_FILLER20060503150240_1.text: Beyond the paths lurk nomads and wild beasts. I don't know which is worse.

INFO_FILLER20060503150240_2.text: So, before you go off into the wilderness, get yourself a decent weapon.

INFO_FILLER20060503150240_3.text: And, of course, you need to carry enough water at all times.

INFO_FILLER20060503150240_4.text: We Hashishin live in the cities - you will be safe there.

INFO_FILLER20060503150406_0.text: Follow this path - it will take you directly to Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060503150406_1.text: It is only a small village, but you cannot miss it.

INFO_FILLER20060503150406_2.text: You will get everything you need there.

INFO_FILLER20060503150406_3.text: Their water is not as fresh as what I can give you, of course.

INFO_FILLER20060503150406.text: Where can I get a weapon?

INFO_FILLER20060503150530_0.text: We Hashishin are a humble people, oppressed by Innos' scorching curse.

INFO_FILLER20060503150530_1.text: The merciless sun lets almost nothing grow in this country.

INFO_FILLER20060503150530_2.text: You could say that we live hand-to-mouth.

INFO_FILLER20060503150530_4.text: Naturally, there are some creature comforts - but those are reserved for Zuben and his black mages.

INFO_FILLER20060503151506_0.text: You take the loot and give it to Nafalem.

INFO_FILLER20060503151506_1.text: He won't welcome me back to the city, but at least I won't die!

INFO_FILLER20060503151506.text: Malir has been defeated. Good work!

INFO_FILLER20060503164212.text: Hey, welcome to Braga. I am Luca.

INFO_FILLER20060503165203.text: I don't want to give away our presence because we need to fight snappers or robbers.

INFO_FILLER20060503170420.text: Give me eight snapper hides (dark and fresh)

INFO_FILLER20060503170707.text: Give me three bundles of weapons. (for Ayitos)

INFO_FILLER20060504223539_0.text: Since you're going to Lago anyway, could you bring me a package of swampweed?

INFO_FILLER20060504223539_1.text: I'll pay you a good price for it.

INFO_FILLER20060504223643_0.text: Very good, Father of Helpfulness. Let me show my gratitude.

INFO_FILLER20060504223643.text: Here is your package of swampweed.

INFO_FILLER20060505121615.text: Tell me, have you come to discover the secrets of Beliar?

INFO_FILLER20060505122048_0.text: Therefore, they should all pay again.

INFO_FILLER20060505122048_1.text: And you will handle this affair for me.

INFO_FILLER20060505122048.text: But it is high time Zuben received what he is due. It is time for the merchants to pay.

INFO_FILLER20060505122732.text: Carry on like this and you will soon be a friend of the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER20060505132147_0.text: If he can pay - which I do not believe - he can live, as far as I'm concerned.

INFO_FILLER20060505132147_1.text: If not - make short work of him. That will serve as a warning to the others.

INFO_FILLER20060505132147.text: I have already banished him from the city, but he is still in the vicinity.

INFO_FILLER20060505155542_0.text: I want out of here! I've got raiders behind me and Hashishins in front.

INFO_FILLER20060505155542_1.text: This is not a good place to look for stone tablets!

INFO_FILLER20060505155542_2.text: But there is a nomad hideout in the cliffs to the west.

INFO_FILLER20060505155542_3.text: Asaru's tribe is staying there. They have discovered a couple of ancient inscriptions.

INFO_FILLER20060505155542_4.text: The way is dangerous. I could use your help...

INFO_FILLER20060505173735_0.text: Fine. There are basically three ways to get your hands on the gold.

INFO_FILLER20060505173735_1.text: Either you swing a pickaxe, you go up against everybody at once, or you use stealth.

INFO_FILLER20060505173938_0.text: You must have nimble fingers - and you had better wait until everyone's asleep.

INFO_FILLER20060505173938_1.text: I can show you how to get to the chests, but it'll cost you.

INFO_FILLER20060505173938.text: What exactly do you mean by 'stealth'?

INFO_FILLER20060505174306_0.text: You're a strong fellow and I'm no wimp myself.

INFO_FILLER20060505174306_1.text: I also know a few slaves who would surely fight with us.

INFO_FILLER20060505174306.text: What if I want to take on everyone at once?

INFO_FILLER20060507161651.text: Slay the undead - do whatever it takes to lift this curse from us!

INFO_FILLER20060507162123_0.text: And go talk to Daro. I'm sure he'll be able to tell you more.

INFO_FILLER20060507171539.text: We will protect this city for as long as we can. THAT is our job.

INFO_FILLER20060507171648_0.text: I sent a few men up the mountain.

INFO_FILLER20060507171648_1.text: They never came back. Go and see whether any of them are still alive.

INFO_FILLER20060507171648_2.text: They raided tunnels as well. The slaves never stood a chance.

INFO_FILLER20060507171648.text: What can I do to help?

INFO_FILLER20060507171731_0.text: There are two tunnels in the mountain. One of them is directly behind the city.

INFO_FILLER20060507171731_1.text: The other one is further Southwest. Take care of yourself!

INFO_FILLER20060507171731.text: I'm going to have a look at the tunnels.

INFO_FILLER20060507171813_0.text: Great. We owe you our gratitude, Father of Bravery.

INFO_FILLER20060507171813.text: The tunnels are free once again!

INFO_FILLER20060507171918_0.text: Be careful, Son of Boldness. And look out for my scouts!

INFO_FILLER20060507171918.text: I'm going to take care of that mountain.

INFO_FILLER20060507172007_0.text: Damn that undead spawn! Will this madness never end?

INFO_FILLER20060507172007.text: Your men are dead. I have set them free.

INFO_FILLER20060507172229_0.text: That's where the disaster started. That's where the source of evil is.

INFO_FILLER20060507172229_1.text: But nobody in their right mind would dare go in there!

INFO_FILLER20060507172229_2.text: If we ever want peace and quiet here, we must attack the temple as well.

INFO_FILLER20060507172229_3.text: You've got a point. Right, you won't have to enter the temple by yourself - but first, the surroundings must be safe.

INFO_FILLER20060507182852_0.text: This is a dangerous venture - if anyone can pull it off, you can.

INFO_FILLER20060507183136.text: Go see Dolok. He will accompany you.

INFO_FILLER20060507183306_0.text: So evil has been conquered! We are in your debt.

INFO_FILLER20060507183306_1.text: Go to Julio and tell him this wonderful news!

INFO_FILLER20060507183306_2.text: He will pay back our debt to you.

INFO_FILLER20060507183533.text: Why have you come to this wretched place?

INFO_FILLER20060507185811.text: I was going to get an artifact from the temple in return - but it was stolen!

INFO_FILLER20060507185925_1.text: We are going to watch the city!

INFO_FILLER20060507185925.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_FILLER20060507190025_0.text: Morras like you made this happen in the first place! I don't trust you!

INFO_FILLER20060507190025_1.text: You just raid whatever you can, and then you run for it. You have no honor!

INFO_FILLER20060507190135_0.text: I trust none but Daro. He's a good fighter! He's got honor!

INFO_FILLER20060507190135_1.text: If he trusts you, then I will go to the temple with you.

INFO_FILLER20060507190135.text: What can I do to make you trust me?

INFO_FILLER20060507190324_0.text: You have proven your worth, Morra.

INFO_FILLER20060507190324_1.text: We will go to the temple and fight the damned!

INFO_FILLER20060507190324_3.text: Morras have started this mess, Morras will end it!

INFO_FILLER20060507190324_4.text: You give the sign, and then we leave.

INFO_FILLER20060507190324.text: Daro trusts me, so come fight on my side!

INFO_FILLER20060507190430_0.text: It's a good day to die. Let's go!

INFO_FILLER20060507192816_0.text: If that is indeed true, you are a brave man.

INFO_FILLER20060507192816_1.text: Let me know if you need a weapon.

INFO_FILLER20060507192816.text: I have come to fight the undead!

INFO_FILLER20060507192934_0.text: This minor problem with the undead has completely shut down our work.

INFO_FILLER20060507192934_1.text: Most of the blacksmiths are dead - and I need more steel!

INFO_FILLER20060507192934_3.text: Yes. The shipments from the tunnels.

INFO_FILLER20060507192934_4.text: You want to help me? Bring me six crates of steel, then.

INFO_FILLER20060507193826_0.text: Excellent. Our work can continue. And bring me more!

INFO_FILLER20060507193947_0.text: Thank you. This is a good omen. Things are picking up again!

INFO_FILLER20060507193947_1.text: Here, take this as a token of my gratitude!

INFO_FILLER20060507193947.text: I've got the steel that you wanted.

INFO_FILLER20060507194604_1.text: Thank you - and please forgive me my initial mistrust, Father of Righteousness!

INFO_FILLER20060507195158.text: Fine, I'll take you to Enzo.

INFO_FILLER20060507195224_0.text: Back to Ben Sala. Enzo will need my help - if he's still alive.

INFO_FILLER20060507195224.text: Where do you want to go?

INFO_FILLER20060507195418_0.text: It's terrible! They... they're all dead - but they aren't!

INFO_FILLER20060507195418_1.text: They died, but they got up again right before my eyes!

INFO_FILLER20060507195418.text: What do you think? I'm hiding!

INFO_FILLER20060507195444.text: I beg you - take me away from here!

INFO_FILLER20060507195715_0.text: Before the undead came, there were some raiders in the tunnel!

INFO_FILLER20060507195715_1.text: They dragged off a couple of chests!

INFO_FILLER20060507195715_2.text: But I was able to save one - here, you take it!

INFO_FILLER20060507195715.text: Do you know anything about crates of steel?

INFO_FILLER20060507201554_0.text: But I managed to escape to town.

INFO_FILLER20060507201624_0.text: Well, I'm going to stay here. I already talked to Julio.

INFO_FILLER20060507201624.text: What are you going to do next?

INFO_FILLER20060507201735_0.text: I am inconsolable, Father of Transactions.

INFO_FILLER20060507201735_1.text: But those pillaging nomads robbed me of everything!

INFO_FILLER20060507201735_2.text: And then there were all those undead, out of the blue! It was horrible!

INFO_FILLER20060507201735_3.text: They all fought, and so I got out of there as fast as I could.

INFO_FILLER20060507201735_5.text: If you are a brave man, bring back my goods!

INFO_FILLER20060507201840_0.text: There are eight crates. I think I wrote my name on them.

INFO_FILLER20060507201840_1.text: They attacked me on the path outside the city!

INFO_FILLER20060507201840.text: All right. What kind of goods are they?

INFO_FILLER20060507201925_0.text: You are truly a hero! Thank you very much!

INFO_FILLER20060507201925_1.text: Now we can get down to business.

INFO_FILLER20060507201925.text: These should be all of your crates.

INFO_FILLER20060507203338_0.text: Yeah, yeah, just stop it. Enough said.

INFO_FILLER20060507203338_1.text: Let me shower you with gold, then!

INFO_FILLER20060507203338.text: I knew it! The moment I saw you I knew - this man is going to save us!

INFO_FILLER20060507204451_0.text: It was Basir. That Son of a Thief opened the temple!

INFO_FILLER20060507204451_2.text: He had five keys - Beliar knows where he dug them up.

INFO_FILLER20060507204451_3.text: He wanted the divine artifact and promised treasures to his men.

INFO_FILLER20060507204451_4.text: Their eyes were sparkling with greed. But Basir betrayed them all in the end.

INFO_FILLER20060507204623_0.text: He's paying a high price for the divine artifact.

INFO_FILLER20060507204623_1.text: All those who entered the temple are dead.

INFO_FILLER20060507204623_2.text: But his business is not finished yet. Beliar is furious.

INFO_FILLER20060507204734_0.text: And Beliar's power continues to grow.

INFO_FILLER20060507204734_1.text: I will see to it that the word gets out.

INFO_FILLER20060507204734.text: The deal is completed. Basir is dead.

INFO_FILLER20060508133006_0.text: You showed courage, Morra. You've got honor.

INFO_FILLER20060508133006_1.text: Here, take this. You will need it.

INFO_FILLER20060508140325.text: Give me six crates of steel.

INFO_FILLER20060508173807.text: Whatever. Leave him alone, we need him.

INFO_FILLER20060509013828.text: What else do you know about Xardas?

INFO_FILLER20060509013844.text: He destroyed the rune magic, that filthy swine!

INFO_FILLER20060509013935.text: Deprived of their magic, paladins and Fire Mages never stood a chance against the hordes of orcs.

INFO_FILLER20060509014217.text: You need to go to Reddock.

INFO_FILLER20060509014537.text: The rebel camp. It's in the middle of the forest.

INFO_FILLER20060509014801_1.text: Yes, but those beasts are awfully aggressive. And you won't be able to find it by yourself.

INFO_FILLER20060509014801_2.text: I think your buddy Gorn knows where it is. You should go talk to him.

INFO_FILLER20060509212323.text: Beliar, your will has been fulfilled.

INFO_FILLER20060509212805_0.text: They no longer follow my call.

INFO_FILLER20060509212805_1.text: I want them to pay for this. Every single one of their chieftains must pay!

INFO_FILLER20060509212844_0.text: Kill his servant. Kill the king.

INFO_FILLER20060509212844.text: To win this war, the power of Innos must be erased from the face of the world!

INFO_FILLER20060509212928.text: Zuben has served me long enough.

INFO_FILLER20060509213155_0.text: It is time that he lose it again!

INFO_FILLER20060509213155.text: Xardas has cheated me of a part of my power.

INFO_FILLER20060509213257_0.text: So fare all who oppose me!

INFO_FILLER20060509215242_0.text: Soon you will rule the world in my name!

INFO_FILLER20060509215242.text: I shall now give you power!

INFO_FILLER20060509222901_0.text: Kill the leader of my enemies! Kill Zuben!

INFO_FILLER20060509222901.text: The servant of Beliar must fall so that the flame of order may shine brightly.

INFO_FILLER20060509223002_0.text: You will bring it to them.

INFO_FILLER20060509223002_1.text: Terminate the rule of the orcs and free the land from oppression!

INFO_FILLER20060509223002.text: The people of Myrtana are thirsting for freedom.

INFO_FILLER20060509223104_0.text: Now we shall see whether you are strong enough to take his place!

INFO_FILLER20060509223104.text: My chosen servant, the king, is dead.

INFO_FILLER20060509225329.text: Take it. Take the Staff of the Eternal Wanderer.

INFO_FILLER20060509230702_2.text: He said your time is over.

INFO_FILLER20060509230702.text: What news do you bring me?

INFO_FILLER20060509232622.text: I will not make it easy for you. Believe me.

INFO_FILLER20060509232921.text: Our time together ends here. There is no more to say.

INFO_FILLER20060511215242_1.text: And before King Rhobar sent us to the island of Khorinis, we roamed the land of our fathers together.

INFO_FILLER20060511215242.text: What exactly do you Water Mages have to do with the nomads?

INFO_FILLER20060511215603_0.text: Well, Nordmar and Myrtana were being fought over. The orcs conquered one city after another.

INFO_FILLER20060511215603_1.text: We believed we could end the war with the ore from the island.

INFO_FILLER20060511215603_3.text: No. The war of the gods now rages worse than ever before.

INFO_FILLER20060511215603_4.text: ... because it is close to being decided...

INFO_FILLER20060511215603.text: Why did you answer the king's call?

INFO_FILLER20060511220155_0.text: I only know that the tribes have ended their wandering.

INFO_FILLER20060511220155_1.text: They have gathered at the slave fortresses and are fighting against the occupation.

INFO_FILLER20060511220155_2.text: Fight with them and free our people.

INFO_FILLER20060511220155.text: What do you know about the locations of the Nomads?

INFO_FILLER20060511220228_0.text: Many of our brothers have perished for this.

INFO_FILLER20060511220228_1.text: The sand covers their bodies, but their spirits drift with the wind.

INFO_FILLER20060511220228.text: The land is free again. As are its wanderers.

INFO_FILLER20060511221420_0.text: Yes. If you know where he is, take me to him.

INFO_FILLER20060511221420.text: Shall I take you to him?

INFO_FILLER20060511221507_0.text: Some exercise will do my old bones good. I will follow you.

INFO_FILLER20060511221744_1.text: If you wish, I will bless you.

INFO_FILLER20060511221744.text: You have guided me safely. Thank you.

INFO_FILLER20060511221843_0.text: As the wind has always accompanied you, Adanos will be with you on your path.

INFO_FILLER20060511221843_1.text: May you find the strength to defy the storms of life.
