INFO_FILLER20060511221843_2.text: Go with the blessing of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER20060511222419_0.text: We will share what we have with you.

INFO_FILLER20060511222419.text: You have brought Vatras back to us. My entire tribe thanks you.

INFO_FILLER20060511223012_0.text: Be that as it may - there is nothing more to be said.

INFO_FILLER20060511223012.text: You have decided - but do you really believe that your decision was wise?

INFO_FILLER20060511223214_0.text: You did WHAT? Does that mean that the artifacts are lost forever?

INFO_FILLER20060511223214_2.text: Then the war of the gods will not be decided in favor of Innos or Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060511223214_4.text: That was well done. I always knew that you could be counted on!

INFO_FILLER20060511223214_5.text: But it still isn't over. Now we'll see if you are strong enough to finish your work.

INFO_FILLER20060511223214_6.text: If you want, I will give you my blessing!

INFO_FILLER20060511223214.text: I have destroyed the artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_FILLER20060511223259_0.text: May you always find a source to give you strength on your way.

INFO_FILLER20060511223259_1.text: The blessing of Adanos be upon you.

INFO_FILLER20060511223901_0.text: Grab whatever you can carry! You've earned it!

INFO_FILLER20060511230508_0.text: I will go to Abbas, the water merchant. At least I won't die of thirst there.

INFO_FILLER20060511230508.text: What are you going to do now?

INFO_FILLER20060511230857_0.text: Ben Erai is to the east. Sancho holds the mining village tightly in his grip. There's always something to do there.

INFO_FILLER20060511230857_1.text: And if you're tough enough, you could also try making your way to Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060511230857_2.text: The great slave fortress lies south of here. But the way is very perilous.

INFO_FILLER20060511235045.text: And I'm not getting any more gold from there! Dammit all!

INFO_FILLER20060511235628_0.text: You haven't heard about the risen corpses? Nothing about the restless and accursed?

INFO_FILLER20060511235628_2.text: Don't let yourself get distracted by that. There's more than enough for you to do here.

INFO_FILLER20060511235628_3.text: Just stay here, and stay away from Ben Sala.

INFO_FILLER20060512000123.text: I'll give you this letter for him - maybe that will help you along. Good luck!

INFO_FILLER20060512000647_2.text: My mates and I, we've been toiling in the tunnels for weeks.

INFO_FILLER20060512000647_3.text: I'm at the end of my rope, stranger. But that's how it is. Some people have swords and others do the digging.

INFO_FILLER20060512001801_0.text: Listen, we've just about had it, so no jokes at our expense.

INFO_FILLER20060512001801_1.text: No, I mean it. I'm setting you free. Shoo, make yourselves scarce!

INFO_FILLER20060512001801_2.text: Hey friend, we're gonna get out of here before you change your mind!

INFO_FILLER20060512001801.text: Ah, you know what, just get yourselves out of here.

INFO_FILLER20060512002118.text: Oh goody. We get to hack some more.

INFO_FILLER20060512002232_0.text: All right. We're going to work.

INFO_FILLER20060512002758_1.text: You brought some slaves into the tunnel?

INFO_FILLER20060512002758_3.text: Damn! The tunnel is unguarded! Somebody needs to watch it!

INFO_FILLER20060512002758_4.text: I have to see to every little thing myself around here...

INFO_FILLER20060512003012.text: If you want to fight, come talk to me.

INFO_FILLER20060512004807_0.text: And that is good. You fight and you have courage.

INFO_FILLER20060512004807_1.text: You can be proud of your deeds.

INFO_FILLER20060512005544_0.text: You desire it? Then earn it.

INFO_FILLER20060512005544_2.text: No. Freeing Lago was courageous. But I will not give up my stone for that.

INFO_FILLER20060512005544_3.text: So what do you want for the stone of the lion?

INFO_FILLER20060512005544_5.text: I am a nomad. And I fight for my people. This fight is important. I want you to understand that.

INFO_FILLER20060512005544.text: Isn't it time to pass on the stone of the lion?

INFO_FILLER20060512010033_0.text: Then speak with my brothers. Seek out the tribes which fight against slavery and talk to their leaders.

INFO_FILLER20060512010033_1.text: Then you will be worthy of bearing the stone.

INFO_FILLER20060512010258.text: Use its magic to free our brothers and drive the Hashishins from their slave fortresses!

INFO_FILLER20060512010756_0.text: Speak with Asaru, he leads his tribe near Braga.

INFO_FILLER20060512010756_1.text: Seek out Kayor. He fights near Mora Sul.

INFO_FILLER20060512010756_2.text: You will find Wutras by the ruins of Al Shedim.

INFO_FILLER20060512010756_3.text: You will find Hurit and his tribes south of here. Keep an eye out for an oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060512010756_4.text: And Sinikar has moved to the east. Seek him near the temple city of Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060512010756.text: Which tribes should I seek out?

INFO_FILLER20060512011000.text: If you speak with these brothers, I will pass the stone to you.

INFO_FILLER20060512143117_0.text: Who, me? Umm... er... no. I know nothing.

INFO_FILLER20060512143117.text: Do you know who the prisoner is?

INFO_FILLER20060512143158_0.text: Hey man, I may be smoking too much, but I'm not an idiot.

INFO_FILLER20060512143158.text: Come on. I won't tell anyone.

INFO_FILLER20060512143300_0.text: You can beat me up, but you can't make me tell.

INFO_FILLER20060512143300_3.text: I've been beaten up so many times - sorry, but that's stating a fact.

INFO_FILLER20060512143300_4.text: So you can take your wonderful threat and shove it.

INFO_FILLER20060512143300.text: Spit out the name of the prisoner, or I'll beat you senseless!

INFO_FILLER20060512143357.text: What do you want for the name?

INFO_FILLER20060512143504_0.text: Didn't Fabio want me to... hmm, what was that again?

INFO_FILLER20060512143504_2.text: Ah, now I remember! I was supposed to take care of the lurkers on the coast.

INFO_FILLER20060512143504_3.text: So bring me a few lurker skins and claws... let's say, ten of each.

INFO_FILLER20060512143504_4.text: I can show them to Fabio, and you'll get the name. Agreed?

INFO_FILLER20060512143504.text: You know, there is nothing you could... wait a minute.

INFO_FILLER20060512143857_0.text: On the coast. Just walk along the coast for a bit, there are PLENTY of those beasts there.

INFO_FILLER20060512143857_1.text: Oh, and one more thing. Bring me all of the trophies at once, or I'll forget how many you already gave me.

INFO_FILLER20060512143857.text: Where can I find the lurkers?

INFO_FILLER20060512144046_0.text: Hey, hey, hey! Thanks, man! You've got what it takes. Yeah.

INFO_FILLER20060512144046_1.text: Now tell me what you know.

INFO_FILLER20060512144046_2.text: What would you say if I don't even know the name?

INFO_FILLER20060512144046_3.text: Then I would say nothing at all. I would hurt you very, very badly.

INFO_FILLER20060512144136_0.text: He's pretty old, and his name is Vatras. So, now you know.

INFO_FILLER20060512144136_2.text: But be careful. If Fabio finds out, he'll get us BOTH.

INFO_FILLER20060512144136.text: The prisoner is one of the Water Mages.

INFO_FILLER20060512145552_0.text: Really? And who do you think he is?

INFO_FILLER20060512145552_2.text: Oh great. And how do you know that?

INFO_FILLER20060512145552.text: I know who your prisoner is.

INFO_FILLER20060512145628_0.text: Haha. Very funny. Get lost and make yourself useful for a change.

INFO_FILLER20060512145628.text: It was written on an old stone tablet.

INFO_FILLER20060512145737_0.text: That guy is just as stupid as he is stoned.

INFO_FILLER20060512145737_1.text: Hm... if I have him killed, I will be one fighter short.

INFO_FILLER20060512145737_2.text: I can't afford that. I am surrounded by idiots, but I need them.

INFO_FILLER20060512145737_3.text: Oh well, at least I've got a gardener!

INFO_FILLER20060512150056_0.text: What? Get lost! There's nothing you 'must' do here!

INFO_FILLER20060512150056_2.text: Now listen up. This prisoner belongs to me - not Gonzales, Julio, Sancho, or whoever else.

INFO_FILLER20060512150056_3.text: If they insist on killing a Water Mage, let them catch their own!

INFO_FILLER20060512150056_4.text: Gonzales won't be terribly happy about this.

INFO_FILLER20060512150056_5.text: So what? If you keep bugging me about this, very soon I won't be terribly happy.

INFO_FILLER20060512150056.text: Give me the key - I must kill Vatras.

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_0.text: What are you waiting for, then?

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_1.text: Fabio won't let me near him.

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_3.text: So what am I to do now?

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_5.text: And when I said, kill them ALL, I thought I was expressing myself clearly.

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_6.text: And you come babbling about this Fabio?

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_7.text: Listen - Fabio wasn't sent to Lago because of any terrific job he did.

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_8.text: If he prevents you from carrying out your orders, he's a problem.

INFO_FILLER20060512150326_9.text: And problems are there to be solved. Is this clear enough for you now?

INFO_FILLER20060512150326.text: Vatras is a prisoner in Lago.

INFO_FILLER20060512152720_0.text: Otherwise talk to Fabio. But be careful with him. He's really uptight.

INFO_FILLER20060512152720.text: Since Rasul has been here, weed has been growing everywhere!

INFO_FILLER20060512152833.text: Do you know who the prisoner is?

INFO_FILLER20060512171744_0.text: Vatras is a wise man. We will free him.

INFO_FILLER20060512171744.text: The prisoner is Vatras, one of the Water Mages.

INFO_FILLER20060512171953_0.text: We will follow the call of the lion.

INFO_FILLER20060512171953_3.text: Yes. That is the good thing about the plan. It is simple. It will work.

INFO_FILLER20060512171953.text: Do you have anything resembling a plan?

INFO_FILLER20060513013735_1.text: Otherwise I'll have to assume that you're only here to steal the gold.

INFO_FILLER20060513013735.text: Go to Sancho and let him give you work, otherwise...

INFO_FILLER20060513013753.text: And I wouldn't want to be in your shoes then. So you'd better hurry up!

INFO_FILLER20060513013830.text: Let me tell you. I don't like you. So I'm going to keep an eye on you.

INFO_FILLER20060513014403_1.text: I'm worried about my men. Being that close to gold will make anyone weak eventually.

INFO_FILLER20060513014403_2.text: So talk to them and keep your ears open. If anyone acts suspicious, then tell me.

INFO_FILLER20060513014403.text: Do you have anything else for me to do?

INFO_FILLER20060513015013_0.text: Oh no! And all the gold is...?

INFO_FILLER20060513015013_2.text: Those damn nomads! They are worse than all the crawlers in the desert - oh Beliar, punish them with your wrath!

INFO_FILLER20060513015013.text: I was supposed to buy slaves for Vasco and I got held up!

INFO_FILLER20060513015240.text: Vasco offered me a shady deal.

INFO_FILLER20060513015748_0.text: Look for them west of here. Near the mountains.

INFO_FILLER20060513015748.text: Where should I look for the beasts?

INFO_FILLER20060513015819.text: And remember - I want you to kill the TOUGH ones.

INFO_FILLER20060513022508.text: Well, he wanted to cheat you out of a goodly sum of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_1.text: Well, I've been working for Sancho for a pretty long time.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_10.text: If I weren't sure of it, I wouldn't make you the offer.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_11.text: Think about it. One little lie to Sancho, and we're in business.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_2.text: Sure, HE takes care of the tribute for Zuben.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_3.text: But believe me, there's enough left over for him.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_5.text: Well, I could send you to Braga, to the slave trader, with a princely sum of gold.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_7.text: Naturally, we'd just be pretending. And on the way you would, alas, be attacked by nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_8.text: If you tell Sancho that, you'll get five hundred gold coins from me.

INFO_FILLER20060513030318_9.text: Are you sure he'll believe that from me?

INFO_FILLER20060513030318.text: Now, that cost me quite a bit again. I wonder...

INFO_FILLER20060513030521_1.text: Here's your share. And now we will never ever speak of this again.

INFO_FILLER20060513030521.text: Alright. Sancho fell for the story.

INFO_FILLER20060513030601.text: Ah, you betrayed me. You miserable dog!

INFO_FILLER20060513030636.text: And you can forget your reward for the crawlers!

INFO_FILLER20060513031120_0.text: But I won't let him get away with that.

INFO_FILLER20060513031120_1.text: I will deduct every single one of those coins from his pay!

INFO_FILLER20060513031120_2.text: As for you - I am very pleased with you.

INFO_FILLER20060513031120.text: When I've known him for so long, and always paid him well! Why is he doing this to me?!

INFO_FILLER20060513031407.text: You made me look bad. Lemme tell you...

INFO_FILLER20060514130511_1.text: Actually, I seem to remember those were his last words.

INFO_FILLER20060514130511_2.text: There was only screaming after that.

INFO_FILLER20060514130511.text: I know that YOU stole the ore blanks.

INFO_FILLER20060514132419_0.text: I sold them some time ago.

INFO_FILLER20060514132419_1.text: Ha! And I got a fair sum of gold for them.

INFO_FILLER20060514132419_2.text: But you will never find it!

INFO_FILLER20060514132419.text: Where are the raw ore blanks?

INFO_FILLER20060514132600.text: This is a dangerous place. Beat it!

INFO_FILLER20060514134543.text: But don't try anything stupid, and leave me alone.

INFO_FILLER20060514141832.text: We'll need the help of the slaves. We have to make contact with them.

INFO_FILLER20060514141842.text: You can move about the city freely.

INFO_FILLER20060514141853.text: Find a slave who is ready to fight with us.

INFO_FILLER20060514141905.text: One who can motivate the other slaves to start an uprising. THEN we'll attack.

INFO_FILLER20060514141928.text: Do that. I'll go to the oasis. We'll meet there.

INFO_FILLER20060514142146.text: It's better if we don't talk to each other.

INFO_FILLER20060514142438_0.text: I believe I know what you're talking about, but I don't think I can help you.

INFO_FILLER20060514142438_1.text: Listen - you are the ONLY one who can help me.

INFO_FILLER20060514142438_2.text: You have to convince the other slaves to join in. And you will.

INFO_FILLER20060514142438_4.text: Of course it is. But it's about your freedom.

INFO_FILLER20060514142438_5.text: This is a unique opportunity. So think about it.

INFO_FILLER20060514142623_0.text: What do you need and how much?

INFO_FILLER20060514142623_1.text: Weapons. We need weapons. At least three bundles.

INFO_FILLER20060514142623_3.text: And armor. And healing potions and a few artifacts wouldn't hurt.

INFO_FILLER20060514142623_4.text: Get your head out of the clouds.

INFO_FILLER20060514142623_5.text: Fine, just get me the weapons. That will have to do.

INFO_FILLER20060514142623.text: All right. But words alone aren't enough. I need better... arguments...

INFO_FILLER20060514142756_0.text: All right, I'll hand them out.

INFO_FILLER20060514142756_1.text: Go to your friends and tell them we will be ready.

INFO_FILLER20060514142856_1.text: Or Silvio. He manages the guards' equipment.

INFO_FILLER20060514142856.text: Where do I get bundles of weapons?

INFO_FILLER20060514143059_0.text: Then we shouldn't make them wait.

INFO_FILLER20060514143059_1.text: Get ready and then we'll attack.

INFO_FILLER20060514143059.text: The slaves will fight with us.

INFO_FILLER20060514143630.text: We will be ready whenever he is.

INFO_FILLER20060514152116.text: Since that business with the trolls, animal fights have been forbidden in the arena.

INFO_FILLER20060514152145_0.text: Yeah. It was Amul's idea. He wanted to make things more spectacular.

INFO_FILLER20060514152145_1.text: It was quite a spectacle all right. But not exactly the way he imagined...

INFO_FILLER20060514152815_0.text: Of course. We can start whenever you're ready.

INFO_FILLER20060514173148_0.text: You have served the city of Bakaresh well. You now have access to the temple.

INFO_FILLER20060514173148.text: So what about it? Will you let me enter the temple?

INFO_FILLER20060514180951_0.text: I think we shouldn't trust you with our gold unless you've pulled off some good deals outside of Bakaresh.

INFO_FILLER20060514180951_1.text: What have you got to show for yourself?

INFO_FILLER20060514225939_0.text: Some come as our guests, others as our enemies.

INFO_FILLER20060514225939_1.text: They kill our people and steal our gold!

INFO_FILLER20060514225939_2.text: Recently, that happened right outside our city. The oasis was plundered.

INFO_FILLER20060514225939.text: But many strangers have come to our land.

INFO_FILLER20060514230253_0.text: Good. I have heard that the raiders from the north have allied themselves with the nomads.

INFO_FILLER20060514230253_1.text: Let them feel the wrath of Beliar!

INFO_FILLER20060514230253.text: I'll take care of the problems at the oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060514230533_0.text: Really? Then take Silvio with you.

INFO_FILLER20060514230533_1.text: He is a good fighter, a bit of a change will do him good.

INFO_FILLER20060514230533_2.text: So be it. Silvio shall accompany you.

INFO_FILLER20060514230533.text: I could use some help at the oasis.

INFO_FILLER20060514230804_0.text: We will see to it that word of your deeds gets around.

INFO_FILLER20060514230804.text: We are very satisfied with your work.

INFO_FILLER20060514231326.text: And here is the pay for your trouble.

INFO_FILLER20060515044200.text: As long as the ruins are unsafe, Aldo won't buy any more slaves.

INFO_FILLER20060515044310_0.text: Go ahead and do that. If Aldo buys my slaves, you'll get a cut.

INFO_FILLER20060515044310.text: I'll take a look around those ruins.

INFO_FILLER20060515044448_0.text: As for you, you helped me out. Thank you.

INFO_FILLER20060515044448.text: Good! I'll offer a deal to Aldo.

INFO_FILLER20060515050303_0.text: And once I own those caskets, I, too, will be well-respected.

INFO_FILLER20060515050303.text: They belonged to a priest of the Ancient Ones. He was certainly a well-respected man.

INFO_FILLER20060515050304.text: If you bring them to me, your reputation in Bakaresh will go up as well!

INFO_FILLER20060515050713_0.text: Once you have access to the temple, you will recommend me to the black mage Sigmor.

INFO_FILLER20060515050713_1.text: You want me to recommend you?

INFO_FILLER20060515050713_2.text: Exactly. Let him know what a competent fellow I am.

INFO_FILLER20060515050713_3.text: I'll see what I can do.

INFO_FILLER20060515050713_4.text: I put my trust in you, Son of Obligingness.

INFO_FILLER20060515050713.text: Just a moment! What kind of favor?

INFO_FILLER20060515051226_0.text: Aldo? The merchant Aldo? What about him?

INFO_FILLER20060515051226_1.text: I think very highly of him. He sends his regards and... he is a good man.

INFO_FILLER20060515051226_2.text: I see. He asked you to say that.

INFO_FILLER20060515051226_3.text: But what is your opinion of him? Is he a good man or not?

INFO_FILLER20060515051226.text: Ah, by the way, do you know Aldo?

INFO_FILLER20060515051341.text: He's just not on the ball.

INFO_FILLER20060515051411_0.text: I do not care how you do it. But say nothing to anyone.

INFO_FILLER20060515051411.text: Hmm... yes, that is correct. Kill him.

INFO_FILLER20060515051602_1.text: He may continue to enjoy our favor.

INFO_FILLER20060515051639_1.text: You may now go back to your own business.

INFO_FILLER20060515052636_0.text: You have betrayed our trust! There is no excuse for that.

INFO_FILLER20060515052636.text: You dare to show your face here again?

INFO_FILLER20060515052832_0.text: You were about to abscond with the merchants' tribute, weren't you?

INFO_FILLER20060515052832_1.text: Do you know what we do with people like you?

INFO_FILLER20060515060009.text: Yes, all right, I think I've got it.

INFO_FILLER20060515060908_0.text: Yes, you know how to do business.

INFO_FILLER20060515060908_1.text: We can send a man like you to Amul with an easy mind.

INFO_FILLER20060515060908.text: I can show you quite a few recommendations. How's that?

INFO_FILLER20060515062513_0.text: The mages take care of everything. They pray to Beliar for us.

INFO_FILLER496.text: Be warned. The area east of Vengard is full of orcs. Plenty of orcs!

INFO_FILLER498.text: They're not really the laid-back kind, you know...

INFO_FILLER499.text: They are just waiting for an opportunity to fight. If they set eyes on you, you're dog meat!

INFO_FILLER500.text: Is there a way to get past the orcs?

INFO_FILLER501.text: Forget about getting to the pass behind Vengard. You'll run into even more orcs there.

INFO_FILLER502.text: You could try getting through to Faring. Just keep as far away from the orcs as possible.

INFO_FILLER508.text: No more than everyone else does. He's in cahoots with the orcs, or so they say.

INFO_FILLER509.text: If you want to find out more, try their shamans.

INFO_FILLER510.text: The only problem is getting them to talk to a human in the first place.

INFO_FILLER511.text: Do you know anything about Xardas?

INFO_FILLER512.text: Yes. He managed to stop the war. The way he stopped the rune magic was a good idea.

INFO_FILLER513.text: He's a brilliant man. I am glad he's not my enemy.

INFO_FILLER515.text: Hmm, the last person looking for Xardas was a paladin.

INFO_FILLER518.text: It didn't seem like it was a friendly visit.

INFO_FILLER519.text: Most of all, it wasn't a long visit.

INFO_FILLER520.text: The path below my cabin will lead you there. You must go up into the mountains.

INFO_FILLER526.text: Is he from Nordmar? I never heard of him.

INFO_FILLER530.text: The tower to the north? I cannot help you with that.

INFO_FILLER531.text: But be careful. The sounds of war have attracted some goblins. They're roaming around here somewhere.

INFO_FILLER545.text: What do you do with the junk?

INFO_FILLER546.text: I know ways to convert the stuff into shiny coins. And we need them.

INFO_FILLER549.text: You take what you like, just like a thief. And I like that.

INFO_FILLER550.text: Would you be interested in a job?

INFO_FILLER555.text: I have made the golden goblets disappear.

INFO_FILLER556.text: I knew that would appeal to you.

INFO_FILLER561.text: There are a couple of golden goblets in Urkrass's warehouse. They want to use them to pay for new slaves.

INFO_FILLER562.text: If you see to it that they disappear, I will teach you how to pick locks.

INFO_FILLER563.text: What else have you got for me?

INFO_FILLER564.text: Well, you can exchange the golden goblets for lots of gold coin with any merchant.

INFO_FILLER565.text: And if you're still looking for a job, go to Ardea.

INFO_FILLER566.text: Jack the tower guard collected a fat lump of gold from the rebels.

INFO_FILLER567.text: So, you're supporting a good cause when you bring me the stuff.

INFO_FILLER568.text: Where do you get your goods?

INFO_FILLER569.text: We have people in the cities who take care of our supplies.

INFO_FILLER570.text: Once you have brought us a few valuables, they will let you know who they are.

INFO_FILLER595.text: If you have gold or silver, bring it to me.

INFO_FILLER596.text: I'll give you a good price for it.

INFO_FILLER606.text: What is there to be had in Geldern?

INFO_FILLER607.text: I haven't been there in a long time.

INFO_FILLER609.text: But there's bound to be a couple of fine artifacts lying around.

INFO_FILLER625.text: Welcome to Geldern, stranger. What can I do for you?

INFO_FILLER627.text: Exactly. I deal mainly in artifacts. So, if you find any, bring them to me.

INFO_FILLER628.text: What do you know about artifacts in this town?

INFO_FILLER629.text: There's a storeroom in the fortress on the south side of town where they have some valuable pieces.

INFO_FILLER631.text: Hey, it has come to my attention that the helmet of the paladin has disappeared.

INFO_FILLER633.text: I would pay whoever took it 2000 gold coins to deliver it to me.

INFO_FILLER636.text: Here are the seven rings of the alchemists.

INFO_FILLER638.text: Where else are there items to be had?

INFO_FILLER642.text: I take care of provisions and supplies.

INFO_FILLER644.text: We need valuables. Goblets, plates, no matter what.

INFO_FILLER645.text: I see. You're dealing with hot goods.

INFO_FILLER646.text: Well, perhaps one could call it that.

INFO_FILLER650.text: This used to be called the granary of the country.

INFO_FILLER651.text: And the farmers knew how to hold on to their riches.

INFO_FILLER656.text: Do you know where I can find some artifacts?

INFO_FILLER657.text: Have a look around the temple in Trelis.

INFO_FILLER658.text: The say that Kamak the shaman is carrying some amulet that enhances his magical powers.

INFO_FILLER659.text: That should be worth a bunch.

INFO_FILLER660.text: So you robbed the farmer Farmon.

INFO_FILLER661.text: Did I? Well, it won't ruin him.

INFO_FILLER662.text: You are completely without a conscience. I like that.

INFO_FILLER666.text: I cleaned out the castle of Trelis.

INFO_FILLER667.text: I bet the orcs aren't going to like that. Ha ha ha.

INFO_FILLER668.text: If you want, I'll show you a couple of tricks now.

INFO_FILLER673.text: Where can I get something really valuable?

INFO_FILLER674.text: The shaman Kamak at the excavation in Trelis carries an artifact.

INFO_FILLER675.text: It must be some sort of power source. Well, can't hurt for him to lose it, I guess.

INFO_FILLER676.text: Where is the best place to get rid of hot property?

INFO_FILLER677.text: West of here in Nemora is Dudley. He'll buy your stolen goods.

INFO_FILLER684.text: Greetings, traveler. Welcome to Varant, the great desert.

INFO_FILLER686.text: Wanderer, wait, do not pass me by! You might be missing out on your luck!

INFO_FILLER712.text: Here, have a sip of cool water.

INFO_FILLER715.text: I've come to collect your tribute.

INFO_FILLER716.text: I would pay, Son of Forbearance, but I am afraid that mere gold will not suffice.

INFO_FILLER717.text: I promised Zuben my chalice - the chalice of the water vendors.

INFO_FILLER726.text: The nomads have it! Their hideouts are nearby, within the fields of ruins.

INFO_FILLER738.text: We Black Mages command magic spells of great power!

INFO_FILLER739.text: We command the gift of the ancient, divine magic.

INFO_FILLER741.text: And in the city of Ishtar the art of two-handed fighting has been taught for many years.

INFO_FILLER742.text: But only a man who makes good deals is worthy of learning our secrets.

INFO_FILLER746.text: I am offering you the opportunity for a good deal and you ask what is it?

INFO_FILLER747.text: All I want to hear from you is that you're in!

INFO_FILLER749.text: Then listen! These men here owe tribute to Zuben.

INFO_FILLER750.text: It's not as though they do not want to pay, but they managed to have it taken from them.

INFO_FILLER752.text: Tufail, that Son of a Fool, let himself be robbed by a handful of nomads!

INFO_FILLER762.text: I have the chalice of the water vendors.

INFO_FILLER763.text: Ah, this chalice is worth a special token of my gratitude.

INFO_FILLER764.text: I'll pay the tribute for Luca.

INFO_FILLER765.text: I hope you at least made a good deal with him.

INFO_FILLER768.text: Here is the tribute from Bernardo.

INFO_FILLER771.text: He didn't give you any trouble, did he?

INFO_FILLER772.text: Here is the tribute from Jose.

INFO_FILLER773.text: I don't suppose he caused you any trouble. He is a good merchant.

INFO_FILLER779.text: I hope you leave some of your luck with us.

INFO_FILLER780.text: I have come to collect your tribute.

INFO_FILLER781.text: Of course I will pay. Give my compliments to Nafalem.

INFO_FILLER782.text: What do you know about Aila?

INFO_FILLER783.text: Aila! She was the flower of Braga.

INFO_FILLER785.text: It was a raid - Asaru and his tribe simply... stole her away!

INFO_FILLER788.text: I want to make you an offer. You freed Aila. I will give you five hundred gold coins for her.

INFO_FILLER789.text: She is free, what else do you want?

INFO_FILLER791.text: No, I take them back myself.

INFO_FILLER792.text: I have done away with Asaru.

INFO_FILLER793.text: Very good. We live in the shadow of your greatness, Father of Hunting.

INFO_FILLER795.text: Of course I will reward you for your efforts.

INFO_FILLER796.text: I've come to get your tribute.

INFO_FILLER797.text: So? Tufail also said that some time ago. And I trusted him with my gold.

INFO_FILLER798.text: And what did he do? He let a handful of nomads take it away from him.

INFO_FILLER799.text: Does that mean you don't want to pay?

INFO_FILLER800.text: That's the way it is, stranger. I already paid and I won't pay another coin.

INFO_FILLER801.text: How about it? Will you pay now?

INFO_FILLER802.text: You leave me no choice, Father of Heavy Blows.

INFO_FILLER803.text: You're in business with the nomads.

INFO_FILLER806.text: That can stay between us. No need to tell anyone else.

INFO_FILLER807.text: That depends. What is my silence worth to you?

INFO_FILLER808.text: I will pay you five hundred gold pieces!

INFO_FILLER810.text: Good, give me the gold and we'll forget the whole thing.

INFO_FILLER812.text: I have come to demand your tribute.

INFO_FILLER813.text: Looks like you've come in vain, then. I haven't got a single coin.

INFO_FILLER815.text: Wait - let me propose you a deal.

INFO_FILLER817.text: Bring me some dark leather and I can make some armor for you.

INFO_FILLER818.text: And in exchange, you want me to pay the tribute for you?

INFO_FILLER819.text: I don't owe Zuben all that much - only five hundred gold coins.

INFO_FILLER820.text: I suppose I have no choice. Alright, I agree.

INFO_FILLER821.text: Thank you, Son of Judiciousness. You've struck a good bargain.

INFO_FILLER822.text: What if I don't accept this?

INFO_FILLER823.text: Break all my bones if you want - I haven't got any gold.

INFO_FILLER827.text: I have done away with Taklar.

INFO_FILLER828.text: You have earned the bounty, then.

INFO_FILLER834.text: I am Jose, the slave trader. If you're interested in work, I've got something for you.

INFO_FILLER844.text: What do you have to offer me?

INFO_FILLER846.text: Several tribes are wreaking havoc around here.

INFO_FILLER847.text: I will pay you a hefty bounty for each tribe leader that you kill.

INFO_FILLER851.text: You are keeping dangerous company, traveler.

INFO_FILLER852.text: Take this gold as a reward for your deed.

INFO_FILLER853.text: I bow to your bravery, Son of Peril.

INFO_FILLER855.text: There are only two reasons why you should be here.

INFO_FILLER857.text: Either you want my head, or you intend to join us.

INFO_FILLER858.text: What exactly do you mean by 'join'?

INFO_FILLER859.text: We need someone who has access to the cities.

INFO_FILLER860.text: With your help, we could prepare for battle against the Hashishin.

INFO_FILLER862.text: What am I supposed to do?

INFO_FILLER864.text: Nafalem must be pining away for her already.

INFO_FILLER865.text: This will make him careless - he is going to think that we are dead.

INFO_FILLER866.text: I have come to collect the bounty that is on your head.

INFO_FILLER867.text: Then draw your weapon and fight me!

INFO_FILLER871.text: Listen, then - the clans of the nomads have left the path of tranquility.

INFO_KALVERAMX220060629171853.text: There he is, the swine. Let's get him!

INFO_NEWM20070624180101.text: Take me to the Fire Clan for the last time.

INFO_SKALVERAM30.text: Hmm, it looks as if I might be able to unlock the door.

INFO_SKALVERAM3101.text: Do I look like a slave trader to you?

INFO_SKALVERAM3102.text: His name is Harek. He's from Cape Dun.

INFO_SKALVERAM3103.text: Well, nobody came past my hut.

INFO_SKALVERAM31032.text: Yes, yes. Most of it is useless crap. Recipes and love letters, that sort of thing.

INFO_SKALVERAM31033.text: Here: Oh thighs, oh juicy thighs...

INFO_SKALVERAM31035.text: What about the artifact of the guardians of the dead?

INFO_SKALVERAM31036.text: Guardians of the dead, guardians of the dead, ...should be under AV 37...

INFO_SKALVERAM3104.text: He's probably still somewhere near the city.

INFO_SKALVERAM31040.text: Here it is: ...he bore his...his...eh... artifact...blessed with the power of the light and of life...

INFO_SKALVERAM31041.text: Tell me about useful ancient knowledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM31042.text: Ancient knowledge is the key to ancient magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM31043.text: Without that knowledge, you will never be able to learn the ancient spells.

INFO_SKALVERAM31044.text: Stone tablets, artifacts, inscriptions - useful knowledge could be hidden anywhere.

INFO_SKALVERAM31045.text: Here, I can give you these tablets.

INFO_SKALVERAM31061.text: And, have you already found something?

INFO_SKALVERAM31062.text: Yes, I have succeeded in deciphering some magic formulas.

INFO_SKALVERAM31063.text: I will teach them to you if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM31064.text: It's good that you are here. You came at just the right time!

INFO_SKALVERAM3107.text: What is it you mercenaries actually do all day?

INFO_SKALVERAM3109.text: Silence! I want you to bring my goods back to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3111.text: I think this stuff belongs to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM31110.text: Haran Ho was a great warrior of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_SKALVERAM31111.text: His travels led him deep into the desert.

INFO_SKALVERAM31112.text: There he learned the nomads' way of life and came to cherish it.

INFO_SKALVERAM31113.text: Finally, he gave up his old life and joined the nomads.

INFO_SKALVERAM31115.text: His decision angered the rulers of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_SKALVERAM31116.text: On their orders, the hunt for Haran Ho began.

INFO_SKALVERAM31117.text: And now comes the good part - Haran Ho recognized the wisdom of the Water Mages and understood the power of Adanos.

INFO_SKALVERAM31119.text: Ultimately, the warriors of the Ancient Ones succeeded in killing Haran Ho.

INFO_SKALVERAM3112.text: Well then, give it here. Good. What else do you want? Go on, beat it!

INFO_SKALVERAM31120.text: But the nomads stole his corpse and took it to a tomb.

INFO_SKALVERAM31121.text: And do you know where the tomb is?

INFO_SKALVERAM31122.text: Let's look for the tomb together!

INFO_SKALVERAM31123.text: Good, I'm ready. But you go first!

INFO_SKALVERAM3114.text: Reward? Alright. Here, take this gold. And now - beat it!

INFO_SKALVERAM3116.text: Three large packages with my name on them! Big, sturdy wooden crates.

INFO_SKALVERAM3123.text: Sure! You can run a few errands for me right away.

INFO_SKALVERAM3125.text: It's been rather quiet lately here in Cape Dun, but it can't hurt to be prepared.

INFO_SKALVERAM3133.text: Ah, thank you. That's enough for now. If you need equipment, you know where to find me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3137.text: Where can I find Deckard the quartermaster?

INFO_SKALVERAM3138.text: Go towards the lighthouse. We have a small hut behind Urkrass's large warehouse.

INFO_SKALVERAM3139.text: Our quartermaster keeps an eye on our stuff there.

INFO_SKALVERAM3147.text: Tell me, where can I find healing plants around here?

INFO_SKALVERAM3148.text: Well, if you go further up the mountain you might get lucky.

INFO_SKALVERAM3149.text: Just make sure that you don't end up as a feast for the wolves.

INFO_SKALVERAM3174.text: The underground rebellion in the city is destroyed.

INFO_SKALVERAM3175.text: Hah! I knew those good-for-nothing mercenaries were useless.

INFO_SKALVERAM3176.text: Nothing happens for weeks, then you show up and solve the problem.

INFO_SKALVERAM3177.text: Good work. The shamans will be pleased with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3179.text: I'm supposed to get a reward here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3180.text: You wiped out the rebel underground here in the city. That's good.

INFO_SKALVERAM3182.text: Go to the warehouse keeper Urkrass. He will give you a reward.

INFO_SKALVERAM3185.text: I have come to your country to offer the orcs my services as a slave hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM3186.text: My name is Wenzel. I am a paladin and come from Montera.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118145354_1.text: This isn't the first cave I've entered.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118145354_2.text: Then go take a look. I'll... cover the rear.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118145354_3.text: Just tell me when you're ready.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118145354.text: Of course you heard something. Caves like this are always full of monsters, undead, or the like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118150454_0.text: Then we can look around in peace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118155008_0.text: You're joking! You must remember me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118155008_1.text: I am Nefarius, mage of the Circle of Water and servant of Adanos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118155008_2.text: We even worked together in the colony. Back when you defeated the Sleeper.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118155008_3.text: And we also opened the way to Jharkendar for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118161421.text: I am just about to unravel the mystery of Haran Ho!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060118162111.text: Thus, he was able to hold off his pursuers again and again.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123114915.text: And I need someone who can move among the Morras without drawing any attention.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115415_0.text: That city is full of sneaking thieves.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115415.text: Why don't you go to Mora Sul yourself?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838_0.text: Give them here, right now, do you hear?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838_1.text: Just a moment. What's in it for ME?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838_3.text: But now that the keys are here, you are no longer of use to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838_4.text: I see. In that case, I won't give you anything at all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838_5.text: Give me the keys or I'll chop off your head, filthy Morra.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123115838.text: I've got the four remaining keys.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123123939.text: You found the artifact! I'm not going to let you get away with that, Morra!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123151404_0.text: Oh, I see I caught your attention!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123151404_1.text: I can tell you how to get your hands on one of the temple keys of Mora Sul.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123151404.text: What do you have to offer?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123152605_0.text: They took it during a raid and are now looking for a buyer.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123152605_1.text: Do you know where those raiders are?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123152605_2.text: Yes, I can lead you there if you want.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123152605.text: Fine. Now, the temple key is outside of town. Desert raiders got their hands on it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123152851.text: Lead me to the desert raiders.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123154525_0.text: I see. You're a desert raider YOURSELF, huh?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123154525_1.text: You had better give me all the temple keys you found, and quick.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123154525_2.text: What makes you think I've got any?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123154525_4.text: And someone like you hasn't come to Mora Sul to sell slaves.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123154525.text: Right, my friend. Time to say your final prayers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123170636_0.text: You buy a combat partner from me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123170636_1.text: If you win, you get twice the amount back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123170636_2.text: And the champion will receive the moonblade.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171051_1.text: Come to the arena!!! Featuring now:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171051_2.text: The challenger! The stranger from up north, versus:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171051_3.text: The well-known, formidable, and much revered:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171051_4.text: P A L A D I N ! ! !

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171051.text: I'm ready. I want to fight.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171501_1.text: Well, we both know that the paladin's heyday is over.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171501_2.text: You'll have to beat some stronger opponents if you really want to go far.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171501.text: Oh, quite impressive, really. But I still believe you've just gotten really lucky.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171738_0.text: A hero of the people. Handles a sword quite deftly.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171738.text: Anktos is a different story altogether.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171910_0.text: If you're not going to chicken out, you must enter the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123171910_1.text: That's where the Paladin awaits you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123172407_0.text: You've got courage, I'll give you that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123172407_2.text: The challenger, the lone wanderer of the north, versus:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123172407_4.text: He came from the desert to avenge the death of his brothers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123172407_5.text: Will the challenger be strong enough to hold his own against him?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123172937.text: You can always score with them if you beat up a nomad.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173443_0.text: Big as a wardrobe and strong as an ox.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173443_1.text: They say he can snap a bear's neck with his bare hands.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173443_2.text: Whatever kind of animal that may be.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173443.text: But your next opponent is a veritable bear.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173609_1.text: And now go. Anktos will be waiting in the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173609.text: Have you got a hint for me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173855_0.text: You've got your work cut out for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173855_2.text: Don't miss out on this spectacle!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123173855.text: I want a really good fighter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123174147_1.text: The title! Just one more fight, and you'll be the champion of Mora Sul!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123174545_0.text: I knew you wouldn't settle for just a piece of the pie.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123174545_4.text: It is with great pleasure I give you the upcoming fight:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123174545_5.text: The current, undefeated arena champion of Mora Sul...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123174545.text: I want to challenge the champion!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123175643_0.text: You are truly a worthy champion.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123175643_2.text: You have beaten the champion. Nobody will challenge you for a while, I'm afraid.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123175643_3.text: But I put my gold on you. You earned me a tidy sum.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123181111_0.text: I'm Felipe, and I run the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123181111_2.text: ... interested in fame, glory, and gold?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060123181111_3.text: Then you've come to the right place.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060124174621_1.text: There's only one topic in this wretched town: The artifact keys to the temple of Mora Sul.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060124174621.text: Hey, you. Are you looking for the temple keys, too?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060124174849.text: The fellow in my pub asks a lot of questions about the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060124175253.text: What's a mercenary doing in Mora Sul?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060124175604.text: You're here to get on the gravy train too, aren't you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060125125949_0.text: Here, this noble blade is now yours.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201172538.text: Do you know anything about the fifth temple?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173144_0.text: Ah, the lost one. AT 13... I have compiled all the information on that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173144_2.text: Fine. We believe there are five temples, and each one contains an artifact. Correct?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173144_4.text: And so it should have been, but it was not so.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173144_5.text: The final artifact, a ring, never made it to the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173245_0.text: Look for it in the north. Perhaps the Fire Mages still have records.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201173245.text: Where should I look for the ring?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201174232_0.text: It all happened some thousand years ago, and our records are sparse.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201174232_1.text: It probably grants its wearer magical abilities.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201174232.text: What abilities does the ring of magic grant?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183701_0.text: There are no temples here. Just ice, mountains, and orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183701_1.text: I cannot help you, I'm afraid.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183701.text: I am looking for the fifth temple of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183909_1.text: A ring. It was brought north from the desert a thousand years ago.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183909_2.text: Hmm, no, never heard of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060201183909.text: I am looking for an artifact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202134911_0.text: Akascha, a warrior of the Ancient Ones, brought it all the way from the desert to here, Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202134911_1.text: How interesting. Does the book also say where to find the ring?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202134911_2.text: Perhaps. Akascha was buried here - along with his ring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202134911.text: Now I know how the ring came to the north.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202135117_0.text: Go to the Fire Clan. Their warriors are guarding the cave tombs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202135117.text: So you are looking for his grave.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202145330_0.text: Akascha is long dead. He was the founder of our clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202145330_1.text: He was buried here in Nordmar. Along with an artifact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060202145330_2.text: He rests within one of the cave tombs. You will have to search for him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208161343_0.text: And so I have to go to Nordmar. See?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208161819_0.text: Yes. And that's exactly why I'm standing here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208161819_1.text: To make my life more difficult?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208162143_1.text: Stay away from the orcs and from the big smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208162143_2.text: Got it? Now go to Nordmar and try to survive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208162143.text: I'm a hunter. Can I go through now?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208171922_0.text: You know the fat desert merchant Ali?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208171922_1.text: He's always bragging about an artifact he wants to sell to the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208172356.text: I was right. He did steal it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208175625.text: Do you know what this is?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208175948_0.text: The Nordmarians place them outside the cave tombs of their ancestors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208175948_2.text: Ali is nothing more than a miserable grave robber.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208180328_0.text: As far as I'm concerned, you can join us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208180328.text: You are a man of action.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208181330_0.text: I want you to sell it to Gnar, the orc in front of the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208181330.text: I want you to sell this shadowbeast skin for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208182005_0.text: Very good. Give me the gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208182138_0.text: You aren't just a liar! You're also trying to pull a fast one on me!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208182501_0.text: You'll never be a good skin trader, but at least you're honest.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208183757_0.text: Gnar was tough, but I finally brought him around.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208183757_1.text: If you make a mistake, then own up to it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208183904.text: I'll keep the 100, because you lied to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208185306.text: Tom has no problem with me joining you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208185338.text: Fine, then you're only missing one thing to make you a hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060208190050_0.text: Lurkers keep showing up on the other side of the river, near the cemetery.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209141207_0.text: The pass is closed. No Morra may pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209141207.text: I want to cross the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209144825.text: I want to enter the castle!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209145419.text: We have no need for Morras in the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209145538_0.text: You are strong and have done honorable service to the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209145538.text: Will you let me into the castle?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150048_1.text: The hunter has my respect. There is honor in this skin.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150048.text: Would you like to buy this shadowbeast skin?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150409_0.text: You're lying. I know this skin.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150409_1.text: It belongs to Wilson the hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150409_2.text: I'll give it back to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150625_0.text: I know this skin. It belongs to Wilson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150802_1.text: Here you are, 400 gold coins. I'm buying it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209150802.text: I am selling it for Wilson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209151116_0.text: Usually he stands in front of the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209152440_0.text: You were trying to pull one over on him! Better drop that habit, or you'll get in trouble sooner or later.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209152440_1.text: There are people like you on every street corner.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209152440.text: No, he just took it from me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209152915_1.text: I paid you. The skin is mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209153909_0.text: Are you headed for the castle as well?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209154123.text: What do you mean, a gift?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209161813_0.text: A stone. Those ignorant barbarians simply left it lying around in the landscape.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209171050_0.text: Sure, here, have a cool draught.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209171050_1.text: There isn't much left, but it should be enough to rinse the dust from your throat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209172932_0.text: Ever since Kan and his fighters arrived, they've been admitting only a hand-picked selection of humans.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209172932_1.text: They're not even letting me in. And I could certainly do some great business in there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209172932.text: I want to know more about the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209173231_0.text: Hm... me, too. Look here, I know something that will benefit us both.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209173231_2.text: In order to get into the castle, you need to persuade the orcs out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209173231.text: I will find a way into the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209173450_0.text: I know all the people hanging out here in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060209173450_1.text: If you help me, I could give you some useful advice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161035_0.text: I get it, you've been to see Mojok.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161035_2.text: Where can I get the stuff?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161035_3.text: Go to Tippler, that old moonshiner.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161035_4.text: He's making the stuff in his hut in the woods, south of here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161244.text: Fine. Give me your booze, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161313.text: Take a bottle each to Mojok, Gorok, and Gnar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210161331.text: But don't forget to say hello for me!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210165340_0.text: I just hope you don't want to enter the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060210170416_0.text: Go see Flint, he runs the pub.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172118_0.text: This isn't going to be pretty.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172118_1.text: Believe me, I've seen those monsters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172118_2.text: Think long and hard about it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172322_0.text: Hmm, I still have a bottle. You can have it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172322_2.text: Well, I'm completely broke at the moment. Let's say two hundred gold coins.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211172545.text: I want to buy your booze.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181326_0.text: Only warriors may carry my weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181326.text: I want to trade with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181437_1.text: Down on the mountain near the hills are three trolls.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181603.text: Kill them. Then I'll believe you are a warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181854_0.text: You certainly act like a warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211181854_1.text: You would do me honor if you carried my weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182053_0.text: Then you are indeed a great warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182053_1.text: I would be honored if you carried my weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182723_0.text: You have proven that you are a great warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182723_1.text: But that is not enough to be a good smith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182723_2.text: To shape steel, you must be strong above all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182723_3.text: Do you see that big stone over there?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211182723_4.text: If you can lift it, then you are strong enough.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211183119_1.text: I will teach you my craft.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211183918.text: I want to fight in the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184015.text: My fighters don't fight against Morras.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184122_0.text: They have proven their strength and courage in the largest arenas in the world.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184122_1.text: Once you have accomplished what they have, you may fight here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184122.text: But humans fight in your arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184331_0.text: Then you really are a great fighter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184331.text: I am the champion of the great arena of Mora Sul.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184702.text: My fighters feel honored to measure themselves against you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211184940.text: When will you let me fight?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211185140_0.text: It is in Mora Sul, and only the best fighters leave it alive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060211185140.text: When you have won in the big arena in the desert.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212145852_0.text: I distill the best booze in the area. It'll rot your brains!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212145852_1.text: I'll sell you a couple of bottles if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212150951_1.text: Of course, but I don't have the ingredients.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212150951.text: I only have one bottle left myself. I sold the rest.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212155157_0.text: Very nice. With that stuff, I can mix up a whole kettle of booze.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060212160039.text: Here are a couple of plants.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214133942_1.text: He should be right up your alley.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214134040_0.text: Go to the arena and wait for your opponent.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214134040_1.text: I want a clean duel, no magic and no dirty tricks.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214134234_1.text: Carry on like that, and you'll be a real gladiator some day.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141520_0.text: Trying to strut your stuff in front of the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141520_3.text: Watch out, though, he packs a mighty punch in his right arm.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141754_0.text: Never mind, maybe you're just in the wrong arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141754_1.text: If you want to go up against some really good fighters, you should go to the desert.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141754.text: Was Moff the best you've got?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141853_0.text: Be my guest, it's your bones that you're risking.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214141853.text: I want to fight against Spike.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214142058_0.text: I've almost run out of people.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214142058_1.text: Spike is the only one left who is willing to fight you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214142058_2.text: He can't wait to show everybody who's boss here in the ring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214142528_0.text: Well, now, you beat them all. There's nothing left for you to do here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214142528_1.text: If you still want to be a gladiator, you will have to move on.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214145625_0.text: For the next fight, give me a REAL opponent.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214145625.text: Vigo was no match for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214145857_1.text: There is no dishonor in losing to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150010_0.text: You will fight against a human.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150010_1.text: Mortis is a strong and dangerous fighter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150010.text: I am ready to fight in the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150316_0.text: Now you are the strongest human in my arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150316_1.text: Only a few humans have made it as far as you have.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150521_0.text: You have courage. You will challenge Rozhov.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150521_1.text: He will meet you in the ring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150521_2.text: If you win this fight, you will be my champion.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150521.text: I want to compete against the best.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150854_0.text: You have my respect. From now on, everyone in this arena will measure himself against your deeds.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214150854_1.text: You have reached the pinnacle of your career as a gladiator. There is no one left for you to defeat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161746_0.text: Actually, I'm a hunter, but I spend most of my time repairing my rotten shack.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161746_1.text: When that gets too boring, I enjoy my homemade booze.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161746.text: What are you doing out here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161825_0.text: To be honest, I'm a bit rusty.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161825.text: Can you show me how to hunt?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214161932.text: There were only a couple of goblins in the ruins.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214162023.text: Did you take care of them?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214172446.text: You're pretty far off the beaten track here and you don't look like a runaway slave.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214172923_0.text: Here, take it, but be careful. That stuff burns like a snapper fart.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214173032_0.text: You're missing out. You don't mind if I take a little swig, do you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214173208.text: And I have a thousand things to do.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214180811_0.text: Faring is an old stronghold of the paladins, and now the center of the occupation.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214180811_1.text: Kan, the leader of all the orcs, is there and hordes of tough fighters, of course.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060214180811.text: What do I need to know about the village?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215130932_0.text: What would I do up there in the village?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215130932_1.text: I'm completely broke. I lost the last of my gold to Curtis in the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215135139.text: At least I still have a bottle of Nordmar Nogginfog.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215171748_0.text: Here you go, don't drink it all at once.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215194455.text: Have you come to make a few pieces of gold?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215194456.text: Or are you trying to gain the respect of the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215194709_0.text: Each fight will cost you 100 gold coins. If you win, you'll get 150 back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060215194709_1.text: That's not a very big prize.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216130607.text: Hi, do you fight in the arena, too?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216130714_0.text: Talk to Curtis. He organizes the matches.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216130714.text: I want to fight against you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216131201_0.text: Then you need to talk to Curtis. He decides who fights who.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216131326.text: How about if you take down Goran first?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216131456_0.text: I'll fight you in the arena if you want.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216132121_0.text: If you want to fight against me, talk to Curtis.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216132240_0.text: I understand that. But you should practice a bit first.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172230_0.text: Good. If you want to know anything about the people here, just ask.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172459_0.text: Good, I've been waiting for that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172633_0.text: There isn't much you can do, but your booze is good.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172633.text: I've got booze. Would you like a swig?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172844_0.text: Flint knows what decent booze is like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060216172844_1.text: Strong and clear as the eternal ice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217131418_1.text: It's pretty strange, all the things you can find in the debris after a war.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217131418.text: What are you digging around here for?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217131608_0.text: Yeah. I found a great ring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217131608_1.text: I think it's magic. Ever since I found it, the digging has gone a lot easier.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217131608_2.text: Do you want to buy it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217132243_0.text: Hmm, now that I'm supposed to give it up...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217132243_1.text: Somehow, I've grown really fond of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217132243_2.text: Ah no, I'll find a new ring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249_0.text: No, but might you be interested in a little deal?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249_1.text: There's a cave very close to here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249_2.text: I'm sure there is a lot to be had there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249_4.text: There is something in that cave. Beasts, monsters, something.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249_5.text: You take care of that for me and I'll give you a fat chunk of ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134249.text: Do you have anything else to sell?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134504_0.text: Next to the tower, above the village, is a small, overgrown valley.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217134504_1.text: The cave is all the way at the end.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217141235_0.text: It was just a couple of gobbos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217141235_1.text: Good. I'll head over there right away.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060217161059_0.text: The skin belongs to the hunter Wilson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220124626_0.text: Hmm, so you want to cross the pass?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220131449_1.text: You show me you can pull your weight and I won't have any objections.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220140855_0.text: No, the orcs won't let me enter. Kan is very busy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220140855_1.text: But I'm sure that it won't be much longer now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220140855.text: Have you been to the castle already?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220160544_0.text: Whatever you can take from your opponent is yours as well.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220160544.text: Well, it's not a very big arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220160710.text: It also pays better there. Here's your gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220161008_0.text: However, this fight will cost you 200. The winner will get 300.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220172505_0.text: No. I won't sell anything to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220172505_2.text: No problem. You are a Morra and I don't sell to Morras.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220172845.text: Is there anything I can do to make you will trade with me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220173356.text: Bring them to me. Then we can trade and discuss alchemy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220173735_0.text: You have shown that you have courage and are willing to help me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220181335_0.text: I was lucky that I still managed to cross the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220181923.text: Since Kan has been holding the castle, the orcs won't let anyone in any more.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220182808_0.text: Sure, but then I've been here longer than most people.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220182808_1.text: I stuck out my neck for the orcs on the battlefield before I ended up here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220184045_1.text: You could go to the arena like everybody else, and slowly rot out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220184045_2.text: Or you could directly persuade the three most important orcs outside of the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220184045_3.text: I can assist you with all three of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220190047.text: If you go down, you lose. If you leave the ring, you lose.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220192816.text: Can YOU get into the castle?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220193303_0.text: The whole village is full of mercenaries trying to get into the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220193954_0.text: Gorok, first of all. He's down here in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220193954_1.text: Then Gnar, he's right by the entryway to the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220193954_3.text: He's the commander of the guard tower above the city.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220193954.text: Who do I need to persuade?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220194139.text: How do I get Mojok's approval?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220194556.text: Bring him a few bottles of decent booze, and he will not refuse you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220194847.text: Could you help me get into the castle?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220195054_0.text: Gorok is stuck with all the work around here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220195054_1.text: He must see to it that all is quiet in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220195248_0.text: Tough one. Took me a long time to figure out how to win him over.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220195248_2.text: With skins - wolfskins, to be exact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220201226_0.text: Kan. He has assembled his best warriors there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060220201226_1.text: Together, they're planning their victory over the king.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221121753.text: But if you help me out a bit, I can show you how to handle a bow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221123315.text: Well done. If you want, I can show you how to shoot a bow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221132539.text: Another Morra trying to get into the castle...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221144039_0.text: Fine, so I'm supposed to take you over the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221144712.text: I saw you arrive in the village and knew you'd want to cross the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221151727_0.text: Hunting in Nordmar is not the same as it is here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221152617.text: If you want to learn something, go see Wilson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221153112_0.text: There's a pack of wolves down in the woods.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221153112_1.text: Gnar will be happy to take the skins.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221170108.text: I want to get through here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221170920_0.text: Well, now... Even wild snappers couldn't drag me there again.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221170920_1.text: It is awfully cold, and you lose your way all the time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221170920_2.text: If it hadn't been for my guide, I would probably be dead now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221170920.text: All right then, what happened in Nordmar?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221191328_1.text: Their kind can be found anywhere, and the orcs know that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221191328_2.text: They want to hit it big without doing much in return.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221191328_3.text: Gnar is aware of that and keeps them out of the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221192315.text: I am Curtis, the boss of this little arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221194624.text: What are you doing down here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221194934_0.text: All right, we'll give it a try.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221201258_0.text: Above all, I don't want that guy getting into the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221201258.text: What do you want with the artifact?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221201438.text: If his artifact really is from Nordmar, then he stole it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221201525.text: It's said to appease the ghosts.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221203324_0.text: You may only enter the castle if we all agree.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060221203324.text: Listen, I'm only saying this once:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222124041.text: It helps me get through the long hours.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222124144_0.text: He owns the arena up in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222124144_1.text: It isn't very big, but it's enough to make an impression on the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222164552_0.text: All those mercenaries, and then Ali.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222164552_1.text: He's from the desert, he is also trying to get into the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222164552_2.text: He's running around every night, talking to the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222164552_3.text: But nobody ever got far with the orcs by talking. He's going to realize that at some point.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060222164552.text: What other guests do you have?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223154247.text: Not far from here is an old ruin. I often camp out there when I'm hunting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223154307.text: Unfortunately, goblins like to settle in there if I don't check on the place once in a while.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223155549.text: What do you want for your bottle of Nogginfog?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223160859.text: Take care of them for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223161959.text: If you bring me everything on the list...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223183759_0.text: You have no business here. Turn around and go back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184019_0.text: There's war in Nordmar. You would be dead in a hurry. Got it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184019.text: To keep Morras from being eaten.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184854_0.text: We came over the mountains to Nordmar and saw the king's troops.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184854_1.text: They were occupying the big smelter and making weapons from magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184854_2.text: It was easy to defeat them. Now the big smelter belongs to us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184854_3.text: No Morra is allowed there. We kill any of them that get close to the smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223184854_4.text: That's why I can't let you go to Nordmar. Got it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185049_0.text: Hmm,...if you're REALLY that stupid, then you might have a chance.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185049_2.text: Become a hunter. Tom and Wilson, the Morra hunters, go to Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185049_3.text: They know how to survive. If they say you can go, I'll let you through.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185049.text: There must be a way I can get to Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185526_1.text: A bottle for my men, and one for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185526.text: You want a different kind of booze?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185828_0.text: Morra, you amaze me. That wasn't completely stupid.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185828_1.text: What about the pass? Can I go over the pass?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185828_2.text: I can't just let someone like you go.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185828_3.text: Go to Gnar and tell him to let you into the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185828_4.text: There's a lot of thirsty warriors there, too.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223185913.text: Just because you're a hunter doesn't mean you will survive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223190306_0.text: We hunters are the only ones who are allowed to enter Nordmar to hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223190306.text: I've been wondering when you'd come.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223190705.text: What should I do for you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223190801_1.text: Ambush him, punch him in the face a few times, or steal it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223190801.text: And how am I supposed to do that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223191844.text: Work out the rest with Wilson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223192110.text: I can give you a tip on where to hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223192723_0.text: It's the best possible country for hunting...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223192723.text: The entire country is criss-crossed with deep gorges and death lurks around every corner.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223194042_1.text: I can only take you up there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223194042.text: Fine. I don't know if you will survive in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223194550.text: And I want 500 gold coins for it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223195806_0.text: For 50 gold, I will show you how to hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210124_0.text: Yes, do you have any wolfskins?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210124.text: I heard that you want some pelts.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210521.text: I've got a few wolfskins here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210613_1.text: We need somebody like you in the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210613.text: Do you need any more wolfskins?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210833_0.text: His enemies tremble whenever they hear his name.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210833_1.text: He conquered this castle, and your feeble paladins were unable to defeat him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223210833_2.text: It won't be long now before your king will writhe in the dust at his feet.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223211346_1.text: ... and Mojok, who guards the pass...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223211346_2.text: ... and Gnar, the guardian of the castle. Got it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223211346_3.text: If you give us any trouble, that is that. No entry for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223211807.text: Will you give me your approval?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223211839_0.text: Really? So is there anything I can do to get it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223212321.text: I passed out the booze for Flint.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223212637_0.text: Those beasts are a nuisance. Not quite as bad as Morras, but still obnoxious...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223212733.text: Show me that we need you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223212955_0.text: As far as I am concerned, you may enter the castle. Talk to Gnar, he will let you in.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214006.text: I hope that you carry a suitable gift.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214120_0.text: It cost me a large sum of gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214120_1.text: But this investment will pay for itself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214120.text: I brought an artifact from Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214242.text: But it is extremely valuable. It contains magic ore!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214615.text: Everybody can be bought. I only need to find out what it takes to buy the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214752_0.text: Good thing it was only that Nordmar rotgut.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214752.text: Cost me three bottles of booze, it did.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223214930.text: He's also the one who sold me the artifact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223225955_0.text: Seems to be really important to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223225955_1.text: Whatever, I can really use the gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060223225955.text: Here are 200 gold coins for the Nogginfog!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224003940.text: Do you want to trade with me, or is this about the pass?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004037.text: After that, you're on your own.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004222.text: Alright, then you know what it's all about.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004325_0.text: Fine, this is how it goes:

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004325_1.text: You take care of our tasks and then we'll go hunting with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004325_2.text: Then you will be a hunter and can cross the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004445_0.text: You'll be on your own over there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004445_1.text: The orcs will attack you and the cold will most likely turn you into an icicle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004445_2.text: So don't come whining to me later.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004445.text: I hope you know what's waiting for you in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004606_0.text: Alright. I sell pelts and buy booze.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224004606_1.text: I have only the best and I want only the best.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224005025.text: I want to learn from you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224012406_0.text: The orcs have sealed the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224012614_0.text: If we are going to take you through there, first we have to make sure you are the right one.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224012614.text: Only hunters can get through now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224020649.text: We are also the only ones who can get you over the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224124702_0.text: That's more than they would have ever given me in the royal army.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224124702.text: After the great battle for Faring, they let me have this store.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224124819.text: It will cost you 100 gold pieces each.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224125225.text: Help him out a little, and he will support you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224125358.text: Bring him enough, and he won't be a problem.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224125535_0.text: But you know that some fat jobs are waiting for you behind those castle walls.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224125535_1.text: Why else would you be here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_0.text: I wasn't there in the first battle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_1.text: Back then, the paladins managed to stop the vast army of orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_10.text: When he stood at the foot of the castle wall, the stone could be seen across the entire battlefield.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_2.text: In the second, decisive battle, our troops were led by Kan himself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_3.text: At first, it looked like we were going to fail again.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_4.text: The siege of the castle went on for days, and we didn't win a single foot of ground.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_5.text: It was the Black Mage who turned the tide.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_8.text: He carried this stone. It was glowing.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930_9.text: With every step Xardas took towards the castle, the glow became stronger and brighter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224130930.text: Tell me about the battle for Faring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224131201_0.text: Probably to Nordmar, back to where he came from.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224131201.text: Do you know where Xardas went after that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143250.text: I see, you really want to get inside the castle, like most people here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143346_0.text: I've given up on the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143346_2.text: I hope I can at least make some gold in the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143443_0.text: He's the best fighter of us all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143443.text: If they let anyone enter the castle, it'll be Spike.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143841.text: It could be that you'll have to fight somebody else first.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224143925.text: You can register with Curtis. The arena belongs to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224144548_0.text: If you're good enough, maybe I'll fight against you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224144548.text: Report to Curtis. He will arrange a fight for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060224171646.text: You all gave me your approval.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225164330_0.text: Where's the stuff he brought last week?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225164330.text: Bah, are you trying to poison me, Morra?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225164522.text: If you can rustle that up, then you'll have my respect, Morra.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225164832.text: I need some booze. Nordmar Nogginfog.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225165501_0.text: Up by the tower. Just follow the path.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060225170259_0.text: Follow the path above the village all the way up, and you'll get to the tower.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301130542.text: Will you also fight in the arena?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301132551_0.text: You've already convinced Tarok. He doesn't let just anyone fight.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301132551_1.text: I've even travelled in the desert just to be allowed to fight here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301132710.text: If you want to fight, report to Tarok.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133359_0.text: Then find someone you can beat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133359_2.text: Try it. Tarok arranges the fights.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133611_1.text: If you want to fight, talk to Tarok.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133814_0.text: You, a worm? Why would I want to fight a worm?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133814_1.text: A victory over you would bring no honor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133814_2.text: Tarok will tell you when you are ready.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301133814.text: I would like to fight against you...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301134213.text: If you want to buy something, you will need gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135014_1.text: The best orc warriors are fighting at the arena.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135014_2.text: You want to fight there? Then show me you're good enough.
