INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135014_4.text: The Morras in Tarok's arena have won in many arenas throughout our realm.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135014_5.text: He will let you fight once you're good and ready.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135351_0.text: He's our shaman. He knows the powers of plants and magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135351_1.text: He won't want anything to do with you. He doesn't like Morras.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135351_3.text: Ask him. He will put you to the test before he'll deal with you at all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135756_0.text: Many would like a weapon from Zakosh. His blades are strong and sharp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135756_1.text: Just as strong as his pride.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135756_3.text: He only gives his weapons to warriors he deems worthy of wielding them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301135756_4.text: Many a warrior needs to do great deeds before he's allowed to bear Zakosh's weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301140114_0.text: No Morra may enter the inner castle. Orders from Kan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301140114_2.text: Because you're bothering us. The war isn't over by a long shot, and no Morra may enter the castle before it is.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060301140114.text: I want to get into the inner castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060306175820_0.text: Just walk through the village, and then take the path up into the mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060306175820_1.text: You will find him by the tower.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060306175925.text: He's on the path to the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060306192117.text: But it should be really good booze, to be sure.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060306193130.text: Go inside. We can use someone like you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060308162354_0.text: Ahh, I'm sitting here and nothing's happening.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060308162739_1.text: I don't know what he's waiting for. The odds won't get any better.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060308162739_3.text: Crappy. But if we don't do anything, we'll still die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060308162739_4.text: We are the Hammer Clan. But without a mine? Without a mine, we're nothing.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060308162739.text: Why don't you storm it, then?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309152628_1.text: Why don't you grab a couple of people and clear the mine?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309152816_0.text: Because you would like to have one of our swords.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309152816_1.text: The orcs have the furnace. No furnace, no swords, that's the way it is.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309152939_0.text: You and your men storm the lower valley. The other entrance to the mine is there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309152939.text: What am I supposed to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309153144_0.text: Good. You and your men will take the place from below.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309160123_1.text: You have helped me many times in the past. Now I am going to help you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309160123.text: I want to free the Hammer Clan's mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309162243_1.text: I want to free the mine of the Hammer Clan. I still need fighters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309162243_2.text: I'm in. I will follow you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309174830_0.text: Come here, let me take a look at you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309174830_1.text: You look strong, like a man should in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175139_1.text: Orcs have occupied our mine, including the furnace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175140_0.text: Our forefathers would be spinning in their graves if they knew.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175140.text: The pride of our clan is in the hands of those hairy bastards.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175449_0.text: We're going to finish off the orcs!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175449.text: What are you doing about the mine?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175552.text: In the meantime, Reto is holding the orcs in check.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175645_0.text: Sure, anyone who can hold an axe is heartily welcome.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309175825.text: Report to Reto! He'll tell you what needs to be done.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309180025_1.text: You'll get an entire chest full of gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309180025.text: What will I get for my help?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309180733.text: I am Ingvar, blacksmith and ore smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181211_0.text: I had to leave my goods behind at the mine when the orcs came.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181211_1.text: I'll be happy to sell you the few things I have left.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181456_0.text: I assume that you mean weapons made of pure ore. Weapons for heroes.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181456_2.text: Most of all, you will need experience. That, and a good teacher.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181456.text: What must I do in order to forge magic ore weapons?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309181714_0.text: Many blacksmiths have come to learn from me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309182141_0.text: But I shouldn't be the only one to decide whether you are worthy or not.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309182141_2.text: No. You seek the knowledge that made us Nordmarians strong.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309182141_3.text: I need to be sure that it will not be used to strengthen our enemies.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060309182141.text: You have the talent. And my approval.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115055_0.text: Why? I have nothing more to do with my clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115055_1.text: Ingvar sent me to seek out and learn from all the smelters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115055_2.text: No! He is repeating the mistake I once made.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115055_4.text: Yes. Your training will bring you nothing but death. Just like my apprentices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115238.text: What if I complete the quest of your apprentices?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115938_0.text: You really did it! And you are alive!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115938_1.text: Yes, now all you have to do is forge the sword.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115938_2.text: I shall. And you go back to Ingvar with my best wishes.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310115938.text: Here is the stuff. Now you can make the weapon.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310140855.text: He should teach you, as far as I am concerned, you are ready to learn the art.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310141845_0.text: A sword such as a man can forge only once in a lifetime.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310141845.text: What sort of weapon did you want to forge?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310141943_0.text: No, too many good people have died.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310141943_1.text: If you want to learn, go to the Hammer Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310141943.text: Can you show me how to forge a sword like that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310143655_0.text: You did, huh? And what do you want?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310143836_0.text: He did? I've got no time to teach you anything. I'm searching for something myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310143836.text: Ingvar sent me to seek out all of the smelters and learn from them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144003_0.text: Pure ore. Many nights ago I dreamed of a cave full of pure ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144003_1.text: You're going on a quest because of a dream?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144003_2.text: Why else should a man go on a quest?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144003.text: What is it that you're looking for?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144102_0.text: You don't even know where I'm going and yet you want to come?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144102_1.text: That's what I call plucky. I like it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310144102_2.text: Fine, you can come. Just make sure you don't die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310145154_0.text: Go back to Ingvar and tell him I believe you will make a skilled ore smelter!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310151550_0.text: I thought they were going to wring my neck!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310151840_0.text: Ingvar sent me. I need the approval of all smelters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310151840.text: I want to learn the ancient art of forging.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310151952_0.text: Find it and you may keep it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060310151952.text: I hid my steel hammer in the bushes, not far from here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315122522_1.text: What about you? Aren't you a smith?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315122522.text: I bet you're looking for Ingvar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315122915_0.text: All I have is standard goods.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315122915_1.text: You can get good weapons from Ingvar or the other smelters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315122915_2.text: But if you have magic ore, I can sell you armor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315123156_0.text: Fine. That will cost you 100 lumps of ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315134856_0.text: The orcs have taken the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315134856_1.text: I'm looking for warriors to win it back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315134856.text: The Hammer Clan needs your help.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315135946_0.text: Once the hunting party has returned, you can take two of the warriors with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315135946.text: I need the warriors from the village for myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140016.text: When will the hunting party be back?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140201_0.text: If you're in a hurry, go help them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140201_1.text: That will make it go faster.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140201.text: As soon as they are done.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140305_1.text: Follow the path, past the woodcutters' camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140609_0.text: Hunters from Faring used to drop by all the time, but those days are over.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315140609.text: Welcome, wanderer. Are you a hunter?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315142931_0.text: The village is safe for now. But the orcs keep occupying the bridge to the south.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060315142931_1.text: That's the path that leads to the pass.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316125151.text: The orcs are barely letting anyone pass now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316131215.text: You aren't one of the hunters from Faring.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316143804_1.text: The bridge to the south. The orcs keep hanging out there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316143804_2.text: I can deal with a couple of orcs before breakfast.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316143804.text: Grim sent me. He said you could accompany me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316145606.text: Ha! We showed them who's boss.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316160704_0.text: Do you have any pelts or game trophies?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316160832_0.text: You should ask one of the hunters. Bogir would be my first choice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316160832_1.text: He's the best of us, and the most experienced.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316191608.text: Did you just get here or are you leaving?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316191808.text: I'm looking for someone to go hunting with me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316191832.text: I'm looking for someone to go hunting with me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316191853.text: Ah! Would you be interested in a little hunting trip?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316192044_0.text: There is a small hunting cabin on the other side of the mountain.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060316192044.text: Where do you want to go?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317125853_0.text: The best place for hunting is north of here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317125853_1.text: You can sleep in the cabin.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317125853_2.text: You can sell your pelts to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317144713_0.text: I haven't been able to restock for a while, but I still have a few good blades left.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317145207_1.text: Go to the Hammer Clan. They have the best blacksmiths.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060317145207.text: I want to learn how to be a smith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173340_0.text: Crap! I need someone who will help me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173437_0.text: Yes, I followed the thief here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173437_1.text: He went down to the city.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173437_2.text: I can't get past the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173530_0.text: A fat man in a dress.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173530_2.text: There the deserts aren't made of ice, but of sand.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320173810_0.text: An ancestor stone. The legacy of our forefathers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320185602_0.text: Hurry. The spirits of the dead won't rest.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320185602.text: I'll get you the ancestor stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320185702_0.text: Very good. But I'm not sure if I can do it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320201814.text: I can take the ancestor stone to Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320201933_0.text: Here, take good care of that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320202014.text: We'll talk about that once you're one of us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320202239_0.text: Agreed. Here, take good care of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060320202239.text: I will take the ancestor stone to Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321113943.text: There's an opening below it where something could be inserted.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321115546.text: Right, here it is. Here is the tomb.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321115635.text: You must enter the tomb with the ancestor stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321115847_0.text: A magic stone. You can use it to gain the abilities of the deceased.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321115847_2.text: Believe me, nothing is good. The dead are awake and won't let you into their tombs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321120006.text: You have to fight. And I'd rather take on a dozen orcs than a ghost.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060321165802.text: Ingvar, the ore smelter of the clan, can show you how to make weapons from pure magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322122824_0.text: I curse the day I sent them out to search.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322122824.text: For that alone, my two apprentices had to die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322122841.text: There is blood on my hands.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322123630_0.text: The ingredients I need to fulfill my dream.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322123630_1.text: I sent them out, although I know the search is dangerous.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322123630_2.text: They paid for it with their lives.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322123630.text: What were your apprentices supposed to seek?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322125848_0.text: If you succeed in acquiring the ingredients, then you have my blessing.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322125848.text: All right, but I warned you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133353_0.text: You're joking. Ingvar is the best blacksmith in the world.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133353_1.text: Whenever someone comes by here, he either wants to buy magic ore, or he wants to see Ingvar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133431.text: And believe me, most of them want to see Ingvar. He's up in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133549_0.text: Yes, they have occupied our mine - and our smelting furnace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133549.text: You have trouble with the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133655_0.text: Our mine! We are the Hammer Clan!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133655_1.text: For generations we have mined magic ore here and smelted it into ore blanks - real magic ore blanks - using the great ore furnace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133817_0.text: Reto is taking care of that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133817_1.text: He is our best fighter. I don't know what he's planning, exactly.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322133817.text: What are you doing about the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322135145.text: Let me see. Yes, this is a good sword. Strong, yet lightweight.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322135526_0.text: It's decided, then. I shall teach you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322135526.text: The other smelters all approve of me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322143217_0.text: You've come from the outside, right?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322143217_2.text: Have you got news from the prospectors?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322152117_0.text: Dammit, I sure hope they haven't run afoul of the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322152404_0.text: I'll go anyway and check up on them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322152404.text: Whew! I was fearing the worst. I'm an experienced prospector, I should have gone with them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322153207_0.text: Hmm, perhaps it's not such a bad idea if we both go.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322153207_1.text: Go get your things. I know where we need to go.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322153207_2.text: I'll be waiting for you here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322153314.text: Let's go to the prospectors' camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322154614.text: I'll lead the way. We had better hurry.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322161036_0.text: I thought I would never get out of here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322161422.text: You have to go in the cave! Maybe the prospectors are still alive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322161523_0.text: I'm a prospector. And I haven't even got a pickaxe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322165334_0.text: Yes. We will have to work hard to make up for lost time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322165334_1.text: Here, I have something for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322170814.text: Would you like to buy something?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171450_0.text: One could say so. The orcs are messing everything up.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171450_1.text: I ordered a batch of pelts from the Wolf Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171450_3.text: Stejnar needs raw materials for some new armor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171856_0.text: Buffalo skins, heavy leather, you know?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171856_1.text: He needs a dozen of those things.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171856_2.text: If you bring them to me, I will share my profit with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322171856_3.text: Let's say... twelve lumps of ore, one for each pelt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322172558_0.text: I don't care where the pelts come from.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322172558_1.text: From the Wolf Clan or from you, it's all the same to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322172558.text: Where can I get the pelts?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322172725_0.text: I hope you didn't have too many problems.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322173315_0.text: Yes, but I only buy them from Ketil.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060322173337.text: If you have any, take them to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323140938_0.text: With all those orcs, it's a miracle that you made it here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323140938.text: Hello! I'm Jensgar, the leader of this party.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141128_0.text: Pelts! We belong to the Wolf Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141128_1.text: Our pelt stashes are empty, and we must meet our obligations.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141128_2.text: It's a shame! Because of these orcs, we can only go hunting in large parties these days.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141128_3.text: We're armed to the teeth, as if we were going to war.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141249_0.text: If you can handle a bow and know how to skin an animal, you're welcome.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323141249_1.text: Rune promised a bow to the best hunter in the party.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323142126_0.text: We collect it all here, with me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323142126.text: At least 30 ice wolf skins, and ten buffalo skins.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323143236.text: Here are a few pelts for starters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323144438_0.text: We couldn't have done it without you. The Wolf Clan owes you a favor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323144806.text: You're right. Here, you have earned this bow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323145240_0.text: Well, actually, we discovered an orc camp not too far from here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323145240_1.text: Their stupid drumming scares off all the game.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323145240_2.text: If you know how to crack the skull of an orc...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323145240.text: Is there anything else that needs to be done?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152305_0.text: Excellent. We'll stay in this area a little longer, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152305_1.text: It won't be long until the game comes back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152305.text: The drumming will no longer bother you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152349.text: Here, I suppose you can use this.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152730_1.text: The orcs took over their mine. They want it back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152730_2.text: I imagine they do. But you're asking the wrong person.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323152730_5.text: But only once we're done here. The pelts must be taken to the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323153059_1.text: He's the best hunter in the party.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323153059.text: I want to learn how to hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323160351_0.text: ... problems with orcs. Yes, I've heard about it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323160351_1.text: Do you want me to train you, or are you looking for someone to help you chase off the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323160711.text: I need a few good fighters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323165810_1.text: Once that is taken care of, you can count on me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323165810.text: I'm in. But for now, I'm still stuck here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170032_1.text: But we need to make preparations.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170032.text: It's time we showed the orcs the true meaning of pain.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170252_0.text: There's an alchemist living not far from here. He makes arrows.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170252_1.text: They're not just pointed sticks, either. They explode on impact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170252_2.text: I suggest you pay a visit to that fellow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170252_3.text: Get me a dozen of those things. We're going to need them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170740_0.text: I can teach you how to hit a wolf in the eye from 30 feet away.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323170740.text: I want to get some training.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323171127.text: With these arrows, I'll take on 20 orcs by myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323171654_0.text: Vibald's hut is on the other side of the canyon.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323171654_1.text: Just stay between the rock face and the canyon.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323171654_2.text: Then walk towards the Hammer Clan. His hut is directly next to a rocky ledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172040_0.text: I should warn you in advance...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172040_1.text: This is more like a wartime raid than a hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172040_2.text: Because of the orcs, nobody can go out there alone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172040.text: Have you come to help us hunt?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172348_0.text: I'll give you scared! I'm not scared of anything or anyone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172348_1.text: But these orcs are strong. They will chop you to pieces if you don't watch out.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323172348_2.text: And that doesn't sound fun to me, understand?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323173103_0.text: Kill any orc that gets in the way of your axe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323173103_1.text: And, most importantly, kill him before he kills you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323173103.text: How are you going to solve that problem?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184148_1.text: Yes, alas, not everyone sees it that way. If they did, I would certainly not live out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184148.text: You belong to no clan, but neither are you an orc.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184443_1.text: I used to be with the Wolf Clan and conducted research there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184443_3.text: I blew up a hut. Grim said I was a danger to the clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184443_4.text: That is why I live out here now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184443.text: Why do you live out here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184823_0.text: I am an alchemist. I study fire and anything that goes bang.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323184823_2.text: Explosives of every kind. I am looking for new uses for them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185110_1.text: That sounds good. Tell me more.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185110_2.text: It is very simple. You shoot the arrow, and as soon as it strikes, it explodes.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185110_3.text: No annoying fuse! Shoot, hit, explode, done. Very simple.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185110.text: What do you use the explosives for?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185847_0.text: You have recognized the ingenuity of this invention.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185847_1.text: If people had listened to me back then, we wouldn't have so many problems with the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185847_3.text: The arrows. Will you sell me any?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185847_4.text: Oh yes, of course. I also have some other things. Would you like to take a look?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323185847.text: I want to buy some exploding arrows.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323190003_0.text: Ah, he needs a fresh supply.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323195338_0.text: To the north, as I told you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323195338_1.text: He often hunts on a plateau between the two big mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060323195338_2.text: Not far from the Hammer Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324163541_1.text: Everywhere you go, the orcs have taken over.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324163541_3.text: I will flush them out of there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324163541.text: The orcs have occupied the mine of the Hammer Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324163627.text: Yes, let's smoke the nest out.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324173715_0.text: The swine have occupied our mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324174110.text: And I have to find a way to get them out of there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324175508_0.text: You should look for a couple of people to help you. Alone, you haven't got a chance.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324175508_1.text: Where am I going to get the people?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324175508_2.text: I don't have anyone left, otherwise we would have done it already.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324175508.text: Well, if it were that easy, I could even do it myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060324175744.text: Ask the Wolf Clan. They travel throughout the land.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327123933.text: Maybe you can find something in the 'Chronicles of Dominion'.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327124239.text: If anyone can help you, it will be them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327132300_0.text: They contain the entire history of our order.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327132300_1.text: In particular, they deal with the order's early years.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327132300_2.text: Great, where can I find the book?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327132300_3.text: In the library. But there is a problem.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327133449_0.text: Only our mages were able to read the book.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327133449_2.text: Because the magic was lost, nobody can predict what will happen when we open the book.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327133449.text: This book contains many secrets. Therefore, we have sealed it with magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327134123.text: Where can I find the chronicles?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327134947_1.text: Here's a map. It shows all of the tombs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327134947_3.text: Watch out. The dead are powerful in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060327134947.text: How can I find the caves?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123049_0.text: Are you...? No, that is impossible!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123049.text: What is it? Oh, we have company.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123353_0.text: The one who will rescue us all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123624_0.text: Milten already told me you wouldn't be too happy about this.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123848_0.text: Ah, Milten will be really pleased about this.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123848_1.text: You should take them directly to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328123848.text: I have brought some fire chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328131712_1.text: There are stairs leading into the mountain from the front court of the monastery.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328131712_2.text: Just follow them - they will lead you straight to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328133815.text: I am on a quest for ancient knowledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328133921_0.text: Our library contains treasures of untold value.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328133921.text: This monastery is a hoard of ancient knowledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328134015.text: Dargoth, our librarian, will help you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328144949_0.text: The chapel is open to you at any time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328144949.text: I want to pray to Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328145718_0.text: I've been wondering when you would turn up here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328150214_0.text: You have a talent for it. Great things may come to pass in this place.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328150214_1.text: Therefore, you couldn't be far away.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328150445_0.text: I don't know. But now that you are here, I am more convinced than ever that something will happen here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328150445_1.text: Once, Innos descended to our world in this place.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328150445_2.text: Perhaps he was only waiting for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151635_0.text: At the moment, it seems that fate keeps waiting for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151635_1.text: The Sleeper could still be a coincidence.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151907_0.text: No, it is so. I am sure of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151907_1.text: You are more important than you think.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151907_2.text: Just consider everything we have experienced together...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151907_3.text: The Sleeper, the dragon, all of that was no coincidence.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328151907_5.text: Fate. You have been chosen by fate to change the world.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328152127_1.text: But as long as you don't know either, you can help me recover the fire chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328152326.text: Tell me more about the fire chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328153110_0.text: The chalices were forged for the first paladins. Here, in this cave, in the purifying fire of Innos, powerful magic was bound into the chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328153110_2.text: Over the years, their power grew ever weaker and was eventually forgotten.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328153110.text: I have found out how we can use them to restore the paladins' magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155252_1.text: That's what I call bad luck.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155252_2.text: Their power is now dormant, but not destroyed.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155252_3.text: Here, in this place, we can give them back their old power.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155252.text: A paladin who drank from one of the chalices would be so filled with the power of Innos that it enabled him to perform magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155812_1.text: Then they will be filled with the power of Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155812_2.text: Afterwards, we simply take them back to the paladins.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328155812.text: Once we have all twelve of them, we must throw them into the sacred fire.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328173527_0.text: Hmm, perhaps I can use it to melt the Fire Chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181027_0.text: With the chalices, you can restore the paladins' magic to them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181127_1.text: If you want, I can now accompany you, my friend.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181127.text: What are you planning to do now?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181540.text: Where should I look for the fire chalices?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181913_1.text: I met him in Myrtana. He told me about the monastery and the fire chalices.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328181913_3.text: Maybe I wouldn't even have made it without him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184726_0.text: I am praying. For myself and for my brothers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184726_1.text: Many of us paladins have turned away from Innos and lost their faith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184726_3.text: No, for me it is a test.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184726_4.text: A test of faith and resolve.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184726_5.text: With the help of Innos, I shall pass this test.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184936_0.text: If he needs me, I will follow him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328184936.text: I don't know yet. Altus told us that someone will come to rescue us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328185318_1.text: Nobody who doesn't have permission from Master Altus.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328185318.text: Halt, none shall approach the sanctuary!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328185522_0.text: Hmm, I mustn't let anyone in without permission.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060328185522_2.text: Oh well, you may pass, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329125034_0.text: What is it you seek in the library?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329125904.text: I'm looking for magic and ancient knowledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130106_0.text: I have spent a lot of time in these catacombs, studying the wisdom of our forefathers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130106.text: You have come to the right place, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130528_0.text: The upper chambers are at your disposal. But please be careful and do not take anything.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130528_1.text: The lower chambers contain the oldest scriptures of the library.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130528_2.text: Only trained staff may enter there. The risk that something might be destroyed is just too high.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130528.text: I just want to look around.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329130701.text: Once you know what you are looking for, come back and see me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329134656.text: The savior! You will lead us humans back to the light.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329142708_0.text: You are our first guest since...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329142708.text: Greetings in the name of Innos, wanderer.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329152729_0.text: I am watching for the Chosen One.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329152729_1.text: Master Altus said that he will come.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329153231_0.text: Milten. He hasn't been here long.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329153231_1.text: But you probably won't even see him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329153635_0.text: No. Only Master Altus and Master Dargoth are powerful enough to work magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329153635_1.text: With the failure of rune magic, I lost all of my magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329153635_2.text: I can only use spell scrolls. And even those exhaust me more than before.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329164406_0.text: I hope you're not too disappointed.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329165548_0.text: Milten already told me you wouldn't be too happy about this.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329165548_1.text: But he also told me about your exploits.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329165548_2.text: About the Sleeper, and the fight against the dragon.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329165548.text: Why would I want to do that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329165728.text: No, of course not. I'm sorry.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329172043_0.text: Then I can finally do magic again.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329172043.text: Can you give me five of them?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329172215_0.text: Drat. Then that's the way it is.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329172215_1.text: But if you ever get your hands on any, could you bring me five of them?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329174819_0.text: No, they are very rare here. Do you have some?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329174819.text: Have you ever tried using mana potions?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329180549_0.text: At the moment there aren't a whole lot of us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329180549_1.text: Many of us were killed in the war.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329180549.text: What is there in the monastery?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329182835_0.text: Before this incident with the runes, I used to be a master of transformation magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329182835_1.text: And now? I seem to be nothing but a simple peasant these days.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329182835_2.text: But rumor has it that there are other ways of transforming oneself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329183018_0.text: I heard of people who are able to change, even if they are not magicians.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329183137_0.text: Have you ever heard of druids?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329184718.text: They have a stone that gives them power.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329185013_0.text: They belong to an ancient people. There are only a few of them, and they are quite reclusive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329185013_1.text: They have dedicated themselves to nature.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329185013_2.text: They are masters of transformation magic. They can change into beasts, using their druid stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329185013_3.text: I need one of these stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329191324_0.text: There is a hunter with the wolf clan. His name is Bogir.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329191324_1.text: I am sure that he is a druid.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329191324.text: Where can I find a druid?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060329191608_0.text: Yes! Finally. How I have waited for this moment.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330121240_0.text: It's good to see a fresh face for a change.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330121240.text: ...since the new mage showed up here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330121431_0.text: I am sure the Chosen One will come.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330121431.text: Stop it! You don't joke about things like that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330122707.text: He's always in the Cave of Enlightenment.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123004_0.text: Do you know him? I find him somehow odd.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123004_1.text: He is still so young, and yet...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123004_4.text: As though he had experienced a great deal.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123216_1.text: Innos revealed himself to humans there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123216_2.text: As thanks, they built this monastery and the mighty shrine in the cave.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123351_0.text: Research. He gathered a stack of old books from the library.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123351_1.text: I haven't seen him since then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123351_2.text: Oh yes, and he had this chalice with him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123351_3.text: But what that's all about, I don't know.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123351.text: What is Milten doing in the cave?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123517_0.text: He will be glad to hear news from the outside.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330123517.text: But why am I talking? You should go talk to Master Altus.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330131506_0.text: Innos be praised, you finally came.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330131506_1.text: I must apologize, I had pictured you a little different.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330132550.text: But I assure you that we will help you fulfill your task as best we can.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133028_0.text: We are going to help you as much as our limited powers will allow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133028.text: If anyone can save us, it is you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133303_0.text: He told me about your fight against the Sleeper and how you defeated the undead dragon.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133303_1.text: I cannot imagine anyone who would be better suited to saving the humans than you are.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133303_2.text: Even you will recognize that, sooner or later.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133952_0.text: I am still a master of true magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330133952_1.text: I can try to show it to you if you want.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330134059.text: If you are looking for spells, you should talk to Dargoth as well.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330144728_0.text: No. One must try to appease the dead.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330144728.text: Is there a way to protect oneself?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330145055.text: The orc slayers can tell you more about that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330150221_1.text: No. I'm very worried. They should have been back a long time ago.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330150221.text: What are you planning to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330150822_0.text: The fight for survival of the clans. Orcs roam our lands with impunity, and we hide in our villages.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330155415.text: I sent my six best warriors to the cave tombs. There they will learn everything we need for our fight.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330155859.text: But we're going to put an end to this!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330162649_1.text: There's no better merchandise in all of Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330162748.text: Ingvar of the Hammer Clan may be a little bit better.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163111_1.text: But I cannot show you how to forge pure magic ore weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163111_2.text: For that, you'll have to go to the Hammer Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163111.text: Can you teach me how to be a smith?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500_0.text: Did you bring your tools and raw materials?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500_2.text: Did you think I was going to give you the materials? Steel is expensive.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500_3.text: Too expensive to be ruined by an apprentice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500_5.text: A smith needs his own hammer. That much is obvious.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500_6.text: Just bring 30 steel blanks. That will be enough for ten good blades if you're lucky.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330163500.text: Show me how to be a smith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173300_1.text: Never mind, I don't think I want to know.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173300_2.text: Say, are you very busy right now?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173528_0.text: Some orcs have made themselves at home nearby.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173528_1.text: I don't feel like waiting until the warriors have returned.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173528_2.text: You want to make short work of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173528_3.text: Yes, but I need someone to cover my back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173642_0.text: Great, I need someone to cover my back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173642_2.text: Oh, nothing special. A few orcs are roaming about near the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173642_3.text: I want to take care of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173839_1.text: I want to knock around a few orcs and I need someone to cover my back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173839_2.text: Think about it, it's not far from here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330173839.text: Dammit. You're just the man I'd need.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330181948.text: Let's go beat up some orcs!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330182609_0.text: Ah, this kind of thing makes a man feel alive...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330182609_2.text: No idea what your plans are. I'm going back to the village to get roaring drunk.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330182609_3.text: You can keep all that orc junk.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330213946_0.text: Would you like to go hunting with me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214124_0.text: I had already given up hope of finding anyone here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214124_1.text: Most of our people are out and about, tussling with orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214124_2.text: Let me know when you're ready.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214214_1.text: You're probably just here to crack some orc skulls, like everybody else.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214214_2.text: Oh well, I'm surrounded by ignoramuses.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214214_3.text: If you change your mind, let me know.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214354_0.text: Alright. Follow me, I know where to find something to shoot at.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214508_1.text: Those bastards are making themselves at home throughout the country.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214508_2.text: They raid our tombs, ambush our merchants, and scare away our game.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214508_3.text: The only good orc is a dead orc.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214508.text: Are there any problems with the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214658_0.text: The orc slayers are on their way!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214658_2.text: So it is, but very effective.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330214658.text: Are you doing anything to deal with the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215329_0.text: I can show you a few hunting tricks.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215329_1.text: Oh, and if you ever happen to have ten sabertooth tiger teeth that you don't need, let me know.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215329.text: Of course I'll teach my new partner!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215421_1.text: Ten sabertooth teeth. I need them for my arrows.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215421.text: Yes I can, but it'll cost you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215814_1.text: Hehe, I thought so. I took it from some orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215814.text: Do you have any use for some gold?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060330215936.text: Sure, I can teach you how to become a good hunter in these parts if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331130403_0.text: There's good booze and a warm fire here!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331134905_0.text: Fine, if you want in, you'll have to get past me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331134905_1.text: So come here and I'll show you what a hook is.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331134905_2.text: The first one to go unconscious loses.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140430.text: Me? I welcome the warriors that come from outside.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140616_0.text: Yes. These are hard times, boy!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140616_1.text: The orcs are becoming ever bolder.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140616_2.text: Earlier, all they had to do was stick their noses out of their caves and they got smacked.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140616_3.text: Meanwhile, they've made themselves at home here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140616_4.text: There are just too many of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140750_0.text: That depends on what you're looking for.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140750_1.text: If you want to knock around a few orcs, you're bound to find someone to accompany you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331140750_2.text: Of course, we also have smiths and hunters in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331165723_0.text: Actually, I ought to be out there hunting orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331165723_2.text: Can't you see what I'm wearing? It's not exactly suitable for hunting orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331170213_0.text: Haha, I don't need you to make a fool out of me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331170251_0.text: That's exactly how I see it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331184603.text: Good. In these clothes, I was starting to doubt my masculinity.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331184705_0.text: In my size? It has to be made special.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331184705_1.text: Stejnar of the Hammer Clan makes good armor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331184705.text: Where can I get armor around here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331184810.text: What's in it for me if I get you some armor?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185029_3.text: That's all I can offer you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185029.text: The most valuable thing I own is my axe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185345_0.text: I'll follow you wherever you go in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185345_1.text: I will protect your life with mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185345_2.text: As long as we're in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331185345_3.text: Exactly. Ten shadowbeasts couldn't drag me to the lowlands.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331190046_2.text: Hmm, I have some here. It's used, but it ought to fit.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331190218.text: I want to buy the armor for Thorald.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331201923_0.text: Great. I am waiting for the redeemer.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331201923_1.text: I will join him and help him eradicate the orcs once and for all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331202810.text: You've got your work cut out for you, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203730_0.text: I don't know. I've been to the monastery, and I talked to Pyran.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203730_1.text: He explained it all to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203730.text: Who is this redeemer you are expecting?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203856_0.text: Everything here. The war and the orcs - it's all preordained.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203856_1.text: Innos is putting us to the test.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203856_2.text: If we do not fail him, Innos will send us the Chosen One.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203856_3.text: He will lead us to our final victory over the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331203856.text: What did Pyran explain to you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204021_0.text: Of course I do. Innos showed us the real meaning of strength.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204021_2.text: The first king of the plains was one of us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204021_3.text: Innos gave him strength and power.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204021_4.text: Enough to conquer the plains all by himself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204021_5.text: Nothing is stronger than Innos, and that is why we follow him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331204402_0.text: To you I pledge my loyalty unto death.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060331205553.text: Take this chalice and become my paladin.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403124521_0.text: The Black Mage? He's teamed up with the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403124521_2.text: No. And if I did, I would kill him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403142812_0.text: We should capture it, not guard it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403143002.text: The longer we wait, the stronger the orcs get.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403143900.text: We'll wait until you are ready. Then we'll take them in a pincer movement.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403143947.text: I'll give you Mort to take along. He will show you the lower entrance.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403144422_0.text: You and I will get a few people and storm the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403144422_2.text: I can guide you if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403144422.text: Come with me, there's work to do!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403144645.text: Take me to the Wolf Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403144820.text: Take me to the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403145003.text: Show me the lower entrance to the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403145937.text: Right, so here's the Wolf Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403150040_0.text: They have the best fighters in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403150154.text: We can really use their help. They have the best archers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403150310_0.text: We need to be careful from now on.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403150310.text: This is the way to the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403154034.text: There's an opening here where you can insert a stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403174302_0.text: Ingvar is up at the smithy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403174302.text: If you want to see the smelters, you'll have to go to the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403174912.text: Perhaps the other clans will help. Ask them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060403175030.text: You from below, we from above.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404140815_0.text: The furnace is as old as the world. No one knows who built it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404140815_1.text: It was already here before the clans existed. It is made of pure ore and built right into the mountain.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404140815_2.text: Glowing lava flows through it. Only there can pure ore blanks be created.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404140815.text: What sort of furnace is that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404161224_0.text: That won't buy me the time of day.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404161224.text: That business with the mine was good work.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164100_1.text: They're outside of the village, looking for ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164520_0.text: Yes, and one of the best.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164520_1.text: If I can't find any ore, there isn't any to be found!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164829_0.text: Can you give me ten lumps of ore?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164829_1.text: I see. Ten lumps of ore, you say?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164829_2.text: Yes. But for that, I will make you a dyed-in-the-wool prospector. I promise.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404164829.text: Can you show me how to be a prospector?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404165329_0.text: I will stick to our agreement.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404165329_1.text: I can make you a real prospector if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404183443.text: Sure, but I'm not one of the smelters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184013_0.text: They smelt ore. There are more than enough good blacksmiths in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184013_1.text: What makes the weapons from Nordmar really special is the ore!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184013_2.text: The ore smelters are the only ones who know how to prepare magic ore for forging.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184013_4.text: Exactly. Only the smelters can make true blanks of raw ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184154_0.text: Then you'll have to talk to Ingvar. He decides.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184154_1.text: But he doesn't take just anyone. You have to be good.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404184154.text: I want to become an ore smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404185508.text: I hope it fits. You're not very big.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404195101_0.text: The village lies in the other direction.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404195930_0.text: You're really curious. You'd like to know what's going on here, huh?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404195930_2.text: You get us a nice bottle of booze somewhere and then the two of us will have a little chat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200052_0.text: That hits the spot. I'm dying of boredom out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200052_1.text: What do you want to know?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200254.text: Tell me about the Hammer Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_0.text: That's because of the mine, the furnace, and the ore smelters, of course.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_1.text: We've always had to fight the orcs for the mine, but it's never been as bad as it is now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_2.text: No matter how many of them we kill, two new orcs pop up to replace every dead one.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_3.text: If this doesn't stop, we will all die sooner or later.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_4.text: Sounds like you've got a problem.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850_5.text: Yes we do. I wouldn't want to trade places with Tjalf.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404200850.text: We have the best blacksmiths in all the land.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201236_0.text: They are the only ones who know how to process magic ore so it won't lose its power.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201236_2.text: He's not a bad sort, even if he is a little arrogant.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201236_3.text: But you would be too, if you were the best blacksmith in the country.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201236.text: Tell me about the ore smelters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201643_0.text: He's our boss. A great warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201643_1.text: He is responsible for the survival of the clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404201756.text: I think he is more worried than he's willing to admit.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232_0.text: The village of the Wolf Clan is west of here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232_1.text: They are good hunters and roam all over the country.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232_3.text: The huts of the Fire Clan are far off to the east.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232_4.text: They are good fighters, but they have devoted themselves completely to the god of the plains people.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232_6.text: Yes, him. Their warriors roam the land and take care of our ancestors' cave tombs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202232.text: Tell me about the other clans.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202459_0.text: Here? Well, if you know where...

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404202459.text: Where is there anything to be bought here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202_1.text: That was my stomach. I'm starving.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202_2.text: Somewhere in the village there must be a tasty piece of roast meat that will help make my head work properly.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202_3.text: I'm about to make YOU work properly.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202_4.text: Careful, kid. You want ME to do you a favor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202_5.text: Get me the meat and I'll tell you where you can find things.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203202.text: Wait. Did you just hear that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203351_0.text: Delicious. I would walk through a blizzard for some decent meat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203351_2.text: Ah, yes. I will answer one question for you. What do you seek?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203652_0.text: Gold? Well, now, there really isn't much we can do here with that stuff.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203652_1.text: We usually take it when a stranger buys weapons or armor from us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203652_3.text: Sure. Tjalf is storing it in a large chest in his hut.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203652_4.text: But I can't imagine he would just give you the key of his own free will.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203920_0.text: That's a sore spot, actually. That stuff is really rare at the moment.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203920_1.text: If you know how to swing a pickaxe, I've got a tip for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203920_3.text: Go to the Wolf Clan. There's a small valley at the foot of their mountain.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404203920_4.text: You can prospect for ore there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404204102_0.text: Go directly to the Wolf Clan from here. It's a bit above that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404204102_1.text: You need to climb up over a fallen tree trunk.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404204102.text: How can I find the valley?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404204432_1.text: A little while ago, I saw a small troop of them settle in under our bridge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060404204432_2.text: You can still catch them if you hurry.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405144807_0.text: If you're looking for a place to sleep, there's still room in my hut.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405145639_0.text: I'm Ugolf, the best orc slayer this village has ever seen.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405145639_1.text: So what are you doing up here then?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405145639_2.text: Cooking soup and drinking. I don't go orc hunting anymore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405150616_0.text: I swore an oath. On my axe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405150616_2.text: It sure is. It was a bet.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405150616.text: Is there a reason for your retirement?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405150942_0.text: A bottle of Tunnelrumbler. Without hitting the dirt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405150942_3.text: That swill knocked me out cold and, well, just don't ask.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151107_0.text: It's the most horrendous booze there ever was.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151107_1.text: That stuff is from hell, let me tell you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151310_0.text: What, are you trying to insult me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151310_1.text: Someone who can't even hold his booze has no business going out there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151310_2.text: That's enough! Have you ever drunk Tunnelrumbler?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151310_3.text: If you can manage to choke that stuff down and keep your feet, I'll go out there with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405151310.text: You probably just aren't tough enough.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405152458_0.text: Do you think I store that stuff in my house? It's way too dangerous!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405152458_1.text: We'll just brew some for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405152609.text: Here's a recipe. Bring me the ingredients and I'll mix you up a booze that you'll never forget in all your days.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405152652_0.text: Ha, now you're in for a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160046_0.text: If you want, I'll go orc hunting with you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160046.text: You have the constitution of a wooly buffalo.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160307_0.text: You're just like I used to be.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160307_1.text: Always looking to get your hands on something, no matter how much trouble it causes.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160307_3.text: Sure. What are you looking for?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160307.text: Is there any loot to be had here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160442_0.text: I don't know if Nordmar is the right place for you, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160442_1.text: We don't have much use for gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160442_2.text: We store the junk in Tjalf's chest.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160646_0.text: Not far from here, near the Wolf Clan, there's a small valley.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160646_1.text: The ore comes right up to the surface there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160646_2.text: If you have a pickaxe, all you need to do is dig.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160646_3.text: Since the valley sits a bit higher, you have to climb over a fallen tree.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160831_0.text: Hey, I'm your man. None of these guys can hold a candle to me when it comes to splitting an orc skull.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405160831_1.text: For 50 ore I'll show you how it's done.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405161350_2.text: Sometimes they even settle down under the bridge to our village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405164728_0.text: Very good. I will stay here and help the boys get the ore we need.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405165603_0.text: I thought the crawlers would catch us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405183233_0.text: I keep the area around the camp free of orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405183944.text: That was incredible. We showed those orcs who's boss!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405190320.text: What, you're here? There doesn't seem to be any place where you don't show up eventually.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405191344_1.text: Will I get anything out of this?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405191344_2.text: Here. We store our gold in this chest.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405191344.text: I heard what you did to free the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405212724_0.text: We can use people like you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405212724.text: Of course you can, otherwise you wouldn't have made it this far.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405213002.text: Admittedly, it doesn't look good right now, but we're working on a solution.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405213420_0.text: Oh whatever, even if you take it all. I don't need the stuff.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405213715_0.text: Then you've come to the right place.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405213715_1.text: Even if the orcs do hold our furnace, Ingvar the ore smelter is still a master of his craft.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405213715_2.text: His blades are famous beyond the borders of our land.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214001_0.text: At the moment we're doing all right.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214001_1.text: You have already helped the clan enough. We are deeply in your debt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214001.text: Don't you have anything else to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214915_0.text: You fought well and you helped our clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214915_1.text: Therefore, I'm going to give you a chance.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214915_2.text: When you are ready, I will show you how to forge weapons from pure magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214915_3.text: Weapons of incredible beauty and power. Weapons that are worthy to be wielded by kings and sovereigns.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405214915.text: Show me how to forge magic ore weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060405220227.text: So, what am I to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406113529.text: They weren't good enough. If you want me to teach you, you must go out into the world and gain experience.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406114606_0.text: You? You haven't got the time and endurance it takes to become a smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406114606_3.text: The apprenticeship lasts twelve years at least. Usually even longer. Have you got that kind of time?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406114606.text: I want to become an ore smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406154754_0.text: And they all learned it from me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406154754.text: There are only a few left who still master this art.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406155148.text: Forge the various weapons you find all over the world. Only then will you be ready for the next step.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406155325_0.text: If you do it well, then maybe I will teach you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406155325.text: Here. Once you have learned enough, forge this sword for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406162056_0.text: His smithy is outside of the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406162056_1.text: At the foot of one of the mountains to the west.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406181908.text: I was obsessed with forging a weapon such as there has never been.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406182103_0.text: A weapon of pure magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406182103.text: A sword that would be handed down from generation to generation to the greatest warrior of the clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406182859_0.text: Why should I trade with you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406182859_2.text: What would I do out here with gold? It gives no warmth and does not fill the belly.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406183719_0.text: I need new pelts. The nights are cold out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406183719_2.text: Twenty ice wolf skins, those are nice and warm. And ore, I need magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406183719_4.text: No, I really also need ten lumps of ore. That's all, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406183719.text: What will it take to make you trade with me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406185423_0.text: I have raw ore. That's very rare.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406185423.text: Why should I trade with you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060406185523_1.text: Do you want to trade with me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407150134_0.text: The Black Mage? Yes, he was here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407150134_1.text: He talked to Grim for a long time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407150134_3.text: Ore. Xardas needed ore. In return, he left us these ice monsters.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407153716_1.text: What did he want here in the village?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407153716_2.text: We made a deal with him. We gave him our ore, and for that he helped us defend our village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407153855.text: Hanson, one of our hunters, accompanied him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407154030_1.text: That's a plateau northeast of here. He has a small hunting cabin there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407162211_0.text: Xardas? What a hubbub he caused!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407162211_2.text: One night, he just showed up here out of the blue.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407162211_3.text: He stayed all night, negotiating with Grim, our leader.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060407162211_5.text: He was gone the next morning. And these two giant fellows were here instead.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151419.text: Or else my big friend will whack you around.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151608_0.text: I'm watching so no orcs will get into the camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151608_1.text: Do I look like an orc?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151608_2.text: Not really. I was just trying to impress you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151713.text: It's not every day you have a great big comrade like that by your side.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151904_1.text: We made a deal with a mage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151904_2.text: Now that the orcs are everywhere, one cannot be careful enough.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151904.text: What is the golem doing here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408151946.text: We've got another one, up in the village!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152223_0.text: He suddenly showed up here. He was wearing some kind of black robe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152223_2.text: Yes, his eyes. He was blind, and yet he seemed to be able to see.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152223_3.text: I'm glad that he left again. And that he let us keep those things.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152223.text: A deal with a mage? What mage?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152311_0.text: Is that his name? Could be.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152311_1.text: I prefer to stay away from mages, you never know with them!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152411.text: Go ask Grim, he talked to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408152543_1.text: You'll find him in his hut. It's the big one, at the top of the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408153917_1.text: Even our hunters can't go out hunting by themselves. It's too risky.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408153917_2.text: We're only sending out large parties these days, heavily protected by orc slayers.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408153917_3.text: Obviously, we don't take as much prey as we used to.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408154104_0.text: If you have any pelts, they'll be happy to take them in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408154240_0.text: He's our best and most experienced hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408154240_1.text: But all he currently does is sit in front of his hut, brooding.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408154725_1.text: But I wouldn't say no to a decent shot of booze.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408154725.text: What's wrong with you? Do you need any help?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408155600.text: Here you are, good, clear liquor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408160011_1.text: Wait, here, take these wolf teeth. They will bring you luck.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408160011_2.text: I don't rely on mere luck.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408160011_3.text: No problem. In that case, they'll bring you a few gold coins when you sell them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408160842_0.text: If I do, my golem might melt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408160842.text: I can't even light a fire here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408164951.text: It can be pretty unpleasant out there alone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408165242_0.text: Would I ask if I did? Normally, I would go hunting with Bogir.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408165242.text: Don't you have anyone else who could go with you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408165243_0.text: I think you could lure an entire pack of wolves into camp and he wouldn't even pick up his bow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408165243.text: He doesn't want to. He's just sitting there, moping.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060408172302.text: What are you going to do next?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409150941_0.text: If they all agree, then so will I.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409150941.text: Go see the other smelters. Kalan of the Fire Clan, Larson of the Wolf Clan, and Pedar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409153243_0.text: Now I have to take care of the smithy, too, as if I didn't already have enough to do.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409153243_2.text: I'm no master smith, but I can still turn out a couple of straight blades.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409153823_0.text: The ore smelter of our clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409153823_2.text: He set out to get more magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409154014_0.text: He went north into the mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060409154014_1.text: He suspects there is a rich vein of magic ore there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411142635_0.text: Don't you have anything to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411142852_0.text: Everything the hunters bring into camp winds up with me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411142852_1.text: I decide how it gets distributed.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143045_0.text: It depends. The meat is smoked and stored for hard times.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143045_3.text: We put it in the chest right away. Who knows when we will need it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143045.text: What do you do with the stuff the hunters give you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143305_1.text: That builds muscle and puts real meat on your bones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143305_2.text: The plains people eat too much green stuff. They could never survive up here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143305_4.text: More than that. It's the truth.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143305_5.text: Vegetables will make you thin and limp, you can't survive a blizzard like that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143742.text: What have you got to offer?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143836_0.text: If you don't help supply the clan, you don't get anything.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143836_1.text: We don't need any freeloaders here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143836.text: Why should I give you anything?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143939_0.text: The woodcutters outside the village need something to eat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143939_1.text: Get five bear steaks from the hut and take them to the woodcutters' camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411143939_2.text: Once that is done, we're in business.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411163548_0.text: Good. Here is some meat for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411163548.text: The steak has been handed out.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411164119_0.text: High time, too. The boys are getting impatient.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411164119.text: I've got a load of ham, from Rune.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411164511.text: Hmm, bear, it's been a while since we've had that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411164648.text: Better give the rest directly to the boys.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411165257_0.text: It's about time. What is it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411165605_0.text: I thought Rune forgot about us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411184221.text: Do you want to buy something?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411192328_0.text: You don't look like you've been particularly busy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411192551.text: Mind your own business, will you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060411194300.text: If someone needs something, he comes to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412134150.text: I need somebody to take care of that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412145038.text: Back to the village! We're just freezing off our tender parts out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412150454.text: Sure. I will show you how to wield an axe with great skill!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152106_0.text: My axe is starting to rust.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152106.text: Now that the golems have arrived, they don't even need me for fighting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152324_0.text: Fine, but what shall we fight for?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152324.text: How about a little sparring match?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152615_0.text: Have it your way. Whoever hits the ground first loses.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152615_1.text: But we'll make it a real duel.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152615_2.text: No attacking from behind or dirty tricks like that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152857_2.text: This is a real duel. No surprise attacks from behind, no clawing, spitting, or biting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412152857.text: Fine. Two hundred gold coins. Winner takes all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412155648_1.text: I'm glad I am not your enemy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412155648.text: You're a good warrior. Your enemies should fear you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412160229.text: Once you get to a burned-down hut, enter the woods to your left.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173144_0.text: I'm worried about those tracks that we found.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173511_0.text: Sabertooths. Rather large ones, it seems.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173511_1.text: Are you headed for the village? I sent for Borgir, but he's not coming.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173511_2.text: Somebody needs to take care of those beasts.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173721_0.text: Fine with me. I don't care who gets rid of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173721_1.text: Just as long as we can once again fully concentrate on our work.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173721.text: I'm going to see to it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173958_0.text: Up this hill here. Not far from our camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173958_1.text: Be careful, a fully grown sabertooth is no pussycat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412173958.text: Where did you find those tracks?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412174339_0.text: It's easier to work when you don't have to watch your back the entire time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412174339.text: Now this will make the boys happy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412174441_0.text: Let him give you a reward.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412174441.text: Go see Rune in the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412174638_0.text: You lowlanders can make better use of this than I can.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412184956_0.text: I'm supposed to get a reward here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412184956_1.text: I have a couple of healing potions and a few mana potions. We traded for them at the monastery.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412184956_2.text: What do you want? Or would you rather have gold?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412185911_0.text: Good, they've been lying around here forever. None of us need them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412190011_0.text: Here. I hope you can spend it somewhere.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060412190011.text: You can't go wrong with gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413151844_0.text: Could you be a bit more precise?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413151844_1.text: It is time for the last hunt.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413151844.text: I am old and tired. I sense that 'He' has come.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_0.text: My time is up. I will soon die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_2.text: I am a druid and a hunter - and I sense it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_3.text: I know the tension of the hunt and the exhilaration of the cornered prey.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_4.text: But now I have had enough, I am tired. The hunt is arduous and the taste of victory is stale.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_5.text: It is over. Others are faster, stronger, and hungrier than I am.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123_6.text: It is the course of nature. The old and weak are eaten.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152123.text: Last hunt? What do you mean?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152318_2.text: Since then, I am no longer just a hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152318_3.text: A part of me is wolf. He made me what I am.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152318.text: You're really into this hunting thing, aren't you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152443_0.text: There are many names for people like me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152443_1.text: Most people call us druids, but no name can encompass what it means to be part animal.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152443_2.text: You don't know what it means to range through the woods as a wolf and scent the blood of your prey.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152443_3.text: It's so simple, there is nothing but you and your prey.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152443.text: So you're a wolf? You'll have to explain that to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152647_0.text: Yes. The victory over the Ripper changed me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152647_1.text: I am the bearer of the wolfstone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152647.text: You can change into a wolf?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152830_1.text: Before I set out to die in the woods, I will pass it on to my successor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152830_2.text: Then all that must be done will be done.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413152830.text: What sort of stone is that?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154252_0.text: Kill the Ripper and you will be my successor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154252.text: How can I get the stone?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154438_0.text: Good luck. Be careful or you will become prey faster than you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154825_1.text: This old wolf still has his teeth. I will tear you to ribbons if you try to take my stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154825_2.text: Kill the Ripper and I will give you the stone. Try to kill me and you will die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413154825.text: Hand over the stone or I will kill you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413164732_0.text: For my successor. He has not yet come.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413164825_0.text: The one who kills the White Ripper.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165248_1.text: Larger, stronger, and smarter than a normal wolf. The unswerving hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165248_2.text: He is coming because it is time to seek a new keeper of the wolfstone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165248.text: Who in the names of the three gods is the White Ripper?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165519_0.text: I sense that he is still far away. Far to the North.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165519_1.text: If you are worthy, you will meet him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165519.text: Where will I find the Ripper?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165716_0.text: I know, I felt it when he died.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165716_1.text: Can I have the stone now?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165716_2.text: Yes, it is rightfully yours. Keep it with honor.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165716_4.text: I will go now and die.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165716_5.text: My hut belongs to you, I no longer need it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413165906_1.text: He will take care of your wishes.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413170121_0.text: Yes, I know everything there is to know about hunting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413170537.text: Stop making such an awful din!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413170814.text: You'll scare off all the game.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171133_0.text: I'm a hunter for the Wolf Clan. But I don't feel like running to the village and back all the time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171133_1.text: I spend most of my time out here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171133_2.text: Once I gather enough pelts, I take them to the village. In between trips, I trade with traveling Nordmarians.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171133.text: Why are you living out here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171218.text: Do you have any goods to trade?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171428_0.text: Maybe there's something you could use.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413171428.text: I've always got a little of this and that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172600_0.text: Once in a while, a hunter or two will drop by.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172600_1.text: Most of the time, however, it's orc slayers from the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172600.text: Traveling Nordmarians? Who else passes through here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172733_1.text: Also, there's an old cave tomb nearby. They're checking up on it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172733.text: What are the orc slayers doing here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172955_0.text: Some hero from way back when is buried there. No idea who he was.
