INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172955_1.text: If you want to know more, go ask the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413172955.text: Tell me about the cave tomb.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413182504_0.text: East of my hut, in the large mountain face.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413182648.text: If you have a piece of raw meat, Graypelt will show you the way.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413183156_0.text: He does not belong to me. He is here of his own free will.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413183156_2.text: No, I didn't. He is my friend and companion.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413183156_3.text: I would never force him to do anything. But he is very clever and understands whatever he is told.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413183532.text: Still, you should give him a piece of raw meat. I'm sure you can understand why.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413183728.text: Would you like a piece of meat?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413185937.text: What is there to hunt around here?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191041.text: Deer. This plateau is the best place for hunting deer in all of Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191325_0.text: How many deer should I kill?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191325.text: You can help me if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191535_0.text: Incredible. You're a really good hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191535_1.text: I hope you took their skins. They're worth a lot of gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413191823.text: All of them, if you can.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192549_0.text: Sure, why not? Here, take these ice wolf skins to Rune, the quartermaster.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192549.text: I'm headed to the Wolf Clan. Do you want me to take a delivery for you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192724_0.text: Ah, the ice wolf skins, I've been waiting for those.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192724.text: I have skins here from Hanson.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192851_0.text: Do you need a good bow or a fine sword?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413192851.text: Wait, I've got something here for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413193237_0.text: There are more orcs than game out there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413193237_1.text: It can't hurt to have a good weapon along.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413193416_0.text: Whatever you say. I can give away my weapons elsewhere.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413194201_0.text: Help? Hmm, if you climb down into the crevices back there, you'll find a small orc camp.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413194201_1.text: Jensgar doesn't want me to take care of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413194201_2.text: What about you? If you want to handle this, go talk to him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060413194201.text: Do you need help with the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121210.text: But you managed to get through somehow. What can I do for you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121422_0.text: I am Grim, the leader of the Wolf Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121641_0.text: The wolves are tame and belong to the village, so don't even think about it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121641.text: You can stay here if you like. But don't make any trouble.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121905_0.text: Grave. The orcs are really bothering us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414121905_1.text: The hunters have problems getting to their hunting grounds safely.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122145_0.text: He's our best hunter, but all he does now is sit in front of his hut, moping.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122145.text: But most of all, I'm worried about Bogir.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122358_0.text: His hut is directly above the entrance to the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122700_0.text: I sent off a sizable hunting party towards the south.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122700_1.text: I hope they will be successful.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414122700.text: What are you doing about those problems?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414134041_0.text: Me! Someone ambushed me at night and robbed me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414134041_1.text: They probably thought I was dead. But I'm not going to make it that easy for the thief.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414134241_0.text: For that, I have to get my hands on him first.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414134241.text: What are you going to do with the thief?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414134403_0.text: Have you come to buy a good blade?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150422_0.text: I'm an orc slayer from the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150422_1.text: I'm supposed to get the power of its creator and then use it to kick the orcs' butts.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150422.text: What are you doing with an ancestor stone?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150609_0.text: The creators of the ancestor stones wanted to protect Nordmar even beyond their deaths.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150609_1.text: That's why they created these stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414150609.text: The power of a dead man? How is that supposed to work?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060414171704.text: You must kill those minecrawlers or we are done for.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060417182637.text: But I won't set foot in there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418133258.text: Keep it for now. I'll take care of it later.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151055_0.text: Ejnar, a great warrior of my clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151055_1.text: Orcs fell upon him from ambush.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151055_2.text: He didn't have a chance, but before he died he took thirty of the bastards with him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151223_0.text: That was long ago. But Ejnar's deeds are still praised today around the campfires of my clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151527_0.text: There are tales, but no one knows if they're true.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151527_2.text: Some of us believe that his helmet was buried with him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418151527.text: Is there any treasure in Ejnar's tomb?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418152839_0.text: If you want to find out, you'll have to go see for yourself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418152839.text: I don't know if the helmet is really magic. No one knows.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418153240_0.text: No one can say you lack courage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418153240_1.text: If you managed to get the helmet, you also have the right to wear it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418163205_0.text: Who is this Rathgar? A friend of yours?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418163205_2.text: Oh, did I now? And now he wants it back, I suppose.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418163205_3.text: But I am not going to hand it over. I went through the greatest trouble to get my hands on this artifact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418164133.text: I'm not giving it to some nobody who is chummy with barbarians just because he happens to want it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418164240.text: You can't do anything to me here in town, the orcs would punish you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418170610.text: I'd be glad to have a bit of company.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418170919.text: But I still need this and that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171446_2.text: Very good! We need more people like you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171446_3.text: The whining from our wannabe orc slayers is really starting to bug me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171446.text: There really were orcs under the bridge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171641.text: Here, I'm sure you can use this more than I can.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171852_0.text: I told you. Always keep your eyes open.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171852_1.text: Wait, I have something for you here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418171852_2.text: I think you could really use this now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418172110_0.text: Hey, leave me out of it. I'd prefer it if you helped us kill the orcs out there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418172110_1.text: I don't care about the gold. So don't bug me about it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418174500_2.text: Their hunters roam throughout the land. They see and hear a lot.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418175105_0.text: First of all, we need to get our mine back. We can talk more after that happens.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418175105_1.text: You should help us with the mine.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418175105.text: So, what do I need to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418175756_0.text: He's the Wolf Clan's warehouse keeper.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418175756.text: But if you don't want to go hunting yourself, talk to Rune.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180129_0.text: Yes, I know. He's waiting for the skins. What am I supposed to do? I don't have them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180129_1.text: Tell him he'll get them just as soon as I have them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180129_3.text: No idea. Maybe it would be better if he got them somewhere else.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180411_1.text: What about you? Could you get me the pelts?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180411_2.text: You don't look like a few buffalo skins would pose a problem for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418180411_3.text: I would give you three extra lumps of ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418182905.text: I have a few exploding arrows in stock. Here, see for yourself, maybe there's other stuff you need, too.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418183520.text: I hope you don't have any orcs tagging along behind you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418183753.text: We really don't need any more orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418183951.text: But now the orcs have the mine - and the furnace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418184130.text: If we don't get it back soon, we won't be able to forge any more magic ore weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190117_0.text: Regular ore blanks are always streaked with iron and other substances.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190117_1.text: In pure ore, all of those things have been vaporized.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190117_2.text: Weapons made of pure magic ore are rare and valuable. Even we in the Hammer Clan have very few of them.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190117_3.text: Only the greatest warriors bear such weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190117.text: Pure ore blanks? Aren't other ore blanks pure as well?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190801_2.text: No joke? You really did it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190801_3.text: That is the best news since I don't know when.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190801_4.text: You've really got what it takes! I had already given up hope.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190801_5.text: Wait. Here, I hope you can use this. Otherwise, sell it to some smith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418190953.text: Talk to Tjalf. He will reward you appropriately.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418191031.text: Here. In your country, you can buy a lot with that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060418192110_0.text: Here, this amulet has served me well.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419131641.text: They aren't as good as in the other clans, but I'm sure they can show you a trick or two.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419132143.text: Those beasts must be here somewhere.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419134523_2.text: If you want me to, I will accompany you as long as you are in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419135404_0.text: Usually, it's teeming with game here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419135404_1.text: So keep your eyes peeled, and your weapon at hand.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419140408_0.text: He's our leader. His house is the big one at the very top of the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419140738.text: And you can tell Ingvar that I think he couldn't find a better apprentice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419145100.text: I will buy them if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419145654_0.text: His cabin is nearby, on the plateau.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419145654.text: Just follow the path to the mountains. There you will find a stone circle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150548_0.text: He knows a lot about ancient knowledge.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150548.text: He is a mage in the monastery, and very wise.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150719_0.text: It's not far from here, in the mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150719_1.text: Just follow the path that passes below the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150719_2.text: Then head for the mountains, and there you are.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419150719.text: How can I get to the monastery?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419193927.text: I don't know. Bogir's been funny lately.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060419194015.text: He's completely clammed up, and he no longer goes hunting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420132728.text: There can only be one reason for this.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420155132_0.text: That will certainly impress the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420155132.text: The trolls are dead. Now what?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420155720.text: In any case, I'll go back to the castle for now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420160340_0.text: Hmm, it might be better if we send only one warrior. A really strong warrior.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420160340.text: Is there any way I can help?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420160945.text: I will go get the power of the ancestor stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161053_0.text: You might have to fight the spirits of the ancestors, they are furious.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161053_1.text: But you mustn't make allowances for that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161053.text: I hope that your abilities match your courage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161225_0.text: Then you should hurry and work on improving your abilities.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161225_1.text: Go get some training, and a decent meal or two. Then come back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161225_2.text: I sense that you are the right person for this job.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161342_0.text: Doesn't matter, we will send only one. You!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161342_1.text: One axe is better than six knives.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161342_2.text: Let them give you their ancestor stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420161342.text: What if your warriors are still alive?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162450_0.text: I hope that your abilities match your courage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162450_1.text: You might have to fight the spirits of the ancestors, they are furious.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162450_2.text: Everything is at stake. History will prove us right.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162450.text: I will go get the power of the ancestors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162647_0.text: Of course I can teach you something.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060420162647_1.text: I'm the leader of the best warriors in Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421114749_1.text: I just didn't expect to see you here at the end of the world.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421114749.text: I'm happy to see you, too.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421115450_0.text: I should think so. Did you get too much sun back on the ship?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421115450_1.text: I am Lee - we first met in the colony.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421115450_2.text: Back in the New Camp. I was the leader of the mercenaries.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421115450_3.text: You destroyed the barrier. It'll all come back to you eventually.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421120523_0.text: I was planning to pay a visit to Rhobar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421120523_1.text: But the coward is hiding behind a barrier.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421120523_2.text: You know I've got a bone to pick with him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121039_0.text: Exactly. I'll make him regret that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121039_1.text: Nobody locks me up in jail and gets away with it. Not even the king!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121039_2.text: Not one day passed in Khorinis where I didn't fantasize about meeting Rhobar face to face.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121250_0.text: That bastard had me tossed in the colony.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121250_2.text: I risked my life for him countless times during the war and how did he thank me for it?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421121250_3.text: His toadies saw to it that I fell out of grace with him.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421122105_0.text: I'll worry about that later. The war is lost anyway, nobody knows what will happen next.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421122105.text: What will you do once the king is dead?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421122554_0.text: We need to get into the king's palace.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421122554_1.text: There are some teleporter stones that will take you there. We need two of them! One for you and one for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421122554_2.text: Long ago, they would keep such a stone in every castle of the paladins. For emergencies.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421131806_0.text: One takes you to the temple and the other one directly to the king.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421131806_1.text: Give me the one for the temple. I will wait for you there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421131806.text: I've got the two teleporter stones for the castle.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421132318_0.text: There's nothing left to do, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421132407_0.text: I don't know yet. I need to think.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421132914.text: We must get into the king's palace somehow!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133048.text: I need your help. Have you forgotten who sent you to the colony?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133121.text: The time has come to deliver justice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133208.text: The king is strong, but we could deal with him together.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133434_0.text: I don't know. All I have lived for is no longer important.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133434_1.text: I will stay here for now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421133434.text: Now that the king is dead.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421135826.text: I no longer need the teleporter stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421142513_0.text: Curses! I've been cheated of my revenge at the last second!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421142513.text: You have come too late. The king is dead.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421143223_0.text: Yes, let's go and kill the king.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421151642.text: What are you waiting for? Let's give the pig what he deserves.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421153228_0.text: So my revenge is now complete!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421153228_1.text: What are you going to do next?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060421153228_2.text: I don't know yet. I will stay here for now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422162446.text: Thank Innos, someone finally came by here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422162611_1.text: I was just barely able to get away and hide here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422163805_0.text: The orcs have the ancestor stone of Angir. I'm going to get it back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422163805_1.text: Nobody kills my friend and gets away with it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422163805.text: What are you going to do next?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422164127_0.text: Yes. Together we could try to fight our way through to the shaman.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422164127_1.text: Then we kill him and take the ancestor stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422164127_2.text: But think about it, it's going to be a rough ride.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422170507_0.text: I am an orc slayer from the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060422170507_1.text: We were on the way to the cave tomb to check on it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424124107_0.text: Angir Ironfist was one of the greatest smiths Nordmar has ever seen.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424124107_1.text: Some even believe that he was the first ore smelter.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424124231_0.text: Yes, on my travels through Nordmar I find lots of herbs and so on.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424130549_0.text: My pal didn't make it. They butchered him on the spot.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424130549.text: Who is 'us'? I only see you here!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060424131618_0.text: I don't know. And it isn't important. He was a great man or they wouldn't have buried him that way.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430180830_2.text: Then you have already been through what still awaits us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430181055.text: The Fire Clan will obtain the power of our ancestors and chase the orcs from the country.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430181549.text: To go get the power of the ancestor stones.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430181759.text: Everything is at stake. History will prove us right.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430182320.text: But you mustn't make allowances for that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532_0.text: We are the best warriors in all of Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532_1.text: We fight the orcs, for Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532_3.text: He showed our clan what it means to be strong.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532_4.text: His fire warms our huts and heats our forges.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532_5.text: It is only fair that we should pay him back in orc blood.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184532.text: Tell me about the Fire Clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184809_0.text: Well, the Innos monastery in the mountains used to attract many pilgrims from the midlands.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184809_1.text: But since the war, hardly anyone goes there any more.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184809.text: Pilgrim? Why should I be a pilgrim?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184918_0.text: Just follow the path to the mountains down at the foot of the village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430184918.text: How can I get to the monastery?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430185035_0.text: Pilgrims? No. But a young Fire Mage passed through not long ago.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430185035_1.text: However, he headed straight for the monastery. He seemed to be in a hurry.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430185035_3.text: Milo? No, Milten. That's what he was called.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430185035.text: Have any pilgrims come by here lately?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190002_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190002.text: I have the power of Akascha.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190057_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190057.text: I have the power of Ejnar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190139_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190139.text: I have the power of Snorre.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190220_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190220.text: I have the power of Baldar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190249_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190249.text: I have the power of Angir.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190330_0.text: That's good. What about the other tombs?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190330.text: I have the power of Berek.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430190857.text: I have the power of all ancestors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192044_0.text: A good choice. Here, take my sword.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192044_1.text: You are worthy of wielding it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192200_0.text: I have an ore blank, made of pure magic ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192752_0.text: The ancestors' stones lay in our chests for ages. Long enough for us to forget about their significance.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192752_2.text: I saw the ancestors rise from their graves, full of wrath because of the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192752_3.text: They wanted to fight. Against the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192752_4.text: Then I knew what I had to do.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192752.text: Why did you wait until now to send out your warriors?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192908_0.text: Yes. You need to be careful. In their fury, they cannot tell who's friend or foe.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192908_1.text: You will have to fight them in order to bring the ancestor stones where they belong.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192908_2.text: But do not hesitate. They are dead already.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192908_3.text: Give them the peace they deserve.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430192933.text: You're a fighter, not a pilgrim. I can see that.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193050_0.text: No sum of gold is large enough to pay what we owe you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193050.text: The clans are indebted to you forever.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193259_1.text: Chase the orcs out of Nordmar.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193259.text: Good, I knew you were the one who could pull it off.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193316_0.text: Make sure that no orc will ever dare to invade Nordmar!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430193316.text: Destroy the major orc camps and kill their leaders.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_0.text: In Nordmar, we've always had great warriors, skillful hunters, and the best blacksmiths in the world.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_1.text: Most of them have been forgotten.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_2.text: But the very greatest among them were buried in cave tombs. Their skills were to serve the clans beyond their deaths.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_4.text: Every one of these heroes crafted an ancestor stone before he died. A stone of ancient magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_5.text: The art of making them has been lost, along with the knowledge of their origin.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216_6.text: The ancestor stones grant the skills of their creators to whoever takes them to their designated location.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194216.text: What is the power of the ancestors?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194322_0.text: I have a map that shows all of the cave tombs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194322_1.text: Go there. I am sure you will find traces of my warriors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194322.text: How can I find the ancestor stones?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194554.text: And they snuff out any orc that crosses their path.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194902_0.text: He's got a plan, or so I've heard.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430194902.text: If you want to hear more details, go talk to Kerth.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430202917.text: There's a hole in the pedestal.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430203142.text: Hmm, it looks like something can be inserted into the pedestal.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430203244.text: Ah, something can be inserted there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430210419_0.text: I'm supposed to take the power of the ancestors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430211923.text: There are enough orcs here to keep me occupied for the rest of my life.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430222415_0.text: That knowledge must be found somewhere. I will seek it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430222415.text: Before there were runes, only a very few, very powerful people could do magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430222556_0.text: We should search separately. You find Xardas, if anyone knows about magic, he will.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430222556_1.text: We will meet again. I am sure of it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430223329_0.text: Yes, Innos granted me a few spells.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430223329_1.text: If you want, I can try to teach them to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430224255.text: Just imagine if I could do that, too. Then everything would be like it used to.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430224659_0.text: That is great. I wouldn't survive for an hour out there without my magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430224659.text: I will get you such a stone.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430224934.text: Here, I found this old book in the library. I hope it will help you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430225106_0.text: I... er, borrowed an ancient book from the library. There isn't much I can do with it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430225106_1.text: I will give it to you. You can draw lots of ancient knowledge from it.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430225106.text: What's in it for me if I help you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430225959_0.text: I am at your disposal, if you wish.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430225959.text: Thank you. Thank you very much.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231004_0.text: I see, so you are the Morra of whom my generals spoke to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231004.text: I have come to offer my services to you, great conqueror.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231413_0.text: According to what they say, you are strong enough to rid us of the rebels once and for all.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231413_1.text: Take my personal guard and kill all rebel leaders in my country.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231413_4.text: I've been holding the fort in this castle for a long time.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231413.text: What orders do you have for me, great conqueror?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231535_0.text: Ha ha ha. What a feat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231535.text: All major rebel leaders are dead.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060430231624_1.text: I haven't got time for such things.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509130754.text: He can surely teach you a few spells, too.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134406_0.text: Hmm, I'm just a simple servant of Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134406.text: What will I get for the mana potions?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134559_0.text: Agreed. I have a spell scroll of revitalization.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134559_1.text: It's very valuable, but I can't use it anyway. I'm not strong enough.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134756_0.text: I'll see what I can scrape together.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509134756_2.text: Yeah, yeah, don't worry about it. You'll be satisfied.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509135045_0.text: If you need anything else, drop by and see what I can offer you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509135241_0.text: If you're looking for other things, maybe I can sell them to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060509135619.text: Moreover, I'm rather a decent alchemist.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510132642_0.text: Oh yes, I studied lots of ancient books in order to find out the secrets of magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510132642_1.text: But it's hopeless. I understand the theory, but my spirit is simply not strong enough.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510132642_2.text: I can tell you about this long forgotten knowledge if you like.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510161209_0.text: Be glad that I'm so peaceful.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510161209_2.text: Go on into the village and warm yourself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510161209.text: Someone with a big mouth better have a strong arm to back it up.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183133_0.text: Times are tough, and much tougher still here in the north.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183656_0.text: No, I come from Myrtana. Geldern, to be more exact.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183656_1.text: I fled when the orcs came.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183656_2.text: I found a new place to stay when I came here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183656.text: You're not from here, are you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183840_0.text: I can't offer you much of a selection.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183840_1.text: In Nordmar, it's hard to find the necessary ingredients for potions.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183840_2.text: But what I have, you're welcome to buy.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183943_0.text: I would but, unfortunately, I barely have enough supplies for myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510183943_1.text: I don't have any left over for an apprentice.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184123_0.text: Hmm, perhaps some mana plants? We could really use them here in the monastery.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184123_2.text: Fifty would be great. I'll pay you for them, too.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184123.text: What should I go get so you can teach me?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184246_0.text: Oh, that's excellent. I find it too dangerous out there, myself.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184246_1.text: I'm glad I made it here in the first place.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184246.text: I will get the plants for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184346_0.text: Very good. I can really use these.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184346.text: Here are some of the plants you requested.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184538_0.text: Good. I will keep my promise.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510184538_2.text: And, of course, I will teach you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510185240_0.text: That is good to hear, but I'm not going to go back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510185240_1.text: I'm sure that my lab has been looted already and people need me here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510185240_2.text: Thanks for letting me know anyway.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214408_0.text: A very long time ago, a man came to Nordmar. A man inspired by the fire of Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214408_1.text: He came from far away, from the south. He became one of us, a Nordmarian.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214408_2.text: He accomplished some incredible feats, and soon he won the esteem of all Nordmarians.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214841_0.text: They followed him and started to pray to Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214841_1.text: These people left their clans in order to found a new clan with Akascha.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214841_2.text: A clan that follows Innos. This is how the Fire Clan came to be.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510214841.text: Some Nordmarians were convinced that Akascha got his strength from Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060510220336.text: Are you ready to start your training?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511185750.text: Teach me something about ancient magic.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511185953.text: I want to learn how to resist the cold.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194347_1.text: Why is the clan named for fire?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194347_2.text: The eternal flame of Innos lives within our breast and gives us strength for the battle against the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194347_3.text: We have the best warriors in all of Nordmar here and the orcs fear us.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194347_4.text: Go into the village. There is no man who can match the courage of our warriors.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194347.text: Tell me something about the clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194830_1.text: We need to attack the orcs first, so they won't dare to get close to our village.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194830.text: That's what I'm asking myself. I'm supposed to stay in the village so it won't be unguarded if the orcs come here.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194831_0.text: According to the good old traditions of our clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511194831.text: You know what? Screw my orders. If I see any orcs, I am going to hunt them!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195120_0.text: Innos and orcs. What else do you need to live life to the fullest?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195120_1.text: Well, of course, this lifestyle requires a lot of training.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195120_2.text: How about you? Do you still need some hints on how to deal with orcs most efficiently?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195120_3.text: I could teach them to you.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195120.text: What other traditions do you have?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195727_0.text: Hmm, not much here. Ice and snow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195727_1.text: Oh yes, and there is the monastery, up in the mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195727_2.text: But I haven't heard from them in quite a while now.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195827_0.text: He's at the monastery now and again.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195827.text: If you want to know more, go talk to Frithjof.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195912_0.text: Down by the village, there's a path leading to the mountains.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511195912.text: How do I get to the monastery?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511200514_0.text: It is a sacred place. Innos himself appeared there.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511200514_2.text: You don't believe me, do you?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511200514_3.text: Within the monastery lies the cave where Innos appeared to humankind.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060511200514_4.text: That's where the great sanctuary is.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512115023.text: Teach me something about being a smith.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512121952.text: I want to learn how to resist the heat.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512122055.text: Show me how to protect myself against illness.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512122138.text: Show me how to protect myself against poison.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512123619.text: How can I make exploding arrows?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512123656.text: How can I make fire arrows?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512123740.text: Show me how to make poison arrows.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512123911.text: I want to brew mana potions!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512123946.text: I want to make permanent potions!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124024.text: Teach me how to make poisons!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124109.text: Teach me to brew transformation potions.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124422.text: I want to improve my skill with the bow.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124455.text: How can I become a master marksman?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124553.text: Show me how I can become a game hunter!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124621.text: How can I become a big game hunter?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124656.text: How do I become an orc hunter?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124734.text: How can I sneak up on wild animals?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124916.text: Show me how to skin reptiles!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512124948.text: Show me how to extract teeth, claws, and horns from beasts.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125358.text: I am ready to become a Black Mage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125436.text: I am ready to become a druid.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125514.text: I am ready to become a Fire Mage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125625.text: How can I use light armor properly?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125701.text: I want to draw magic power from within myself!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125734.text: I want to learn staff fighting.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125803.text: I want to improve my skill with the staff.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125841.text: Teach me how to become a master staff fighter!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512125927.text: Show me how to use magical staves.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130019.text: I am ready to become a Water Mage.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130215.text: How can I use heavy armor properly?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130334.text: What do I have to know about mining?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130410.text: How do I sharpen my blade?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130442.text: Show me how to forge a magic ore weapon!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130513.text: Show me how to forge a pure magic ore weapon!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512130842.text: I want to be a stronger swordsman.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131135.text: I want to be a master swordsman.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131251.text: I want to learn to fight with two weapons!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131320.text: Teach me to be a master of two-handed battle!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131402.text: Show me how to handle large weapons!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131439.text: I want to be a strong fighter with large weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131508.text: Show me how to be a master of figthing with large weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131542.text: Show me how to handle heavy crossbows!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131629.text: I want to use the heavy crossbow more effectively.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131700.text: Teach me to be a master of the crossbow!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131746.text: I want to learn the leaping attack.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131816.text: How do I kill an orc?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131819.text: Show me how to heal myself!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131857.text: Teach me how to fight like a paladin!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512131946.text: Teach me how to parry with a shield!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132019.text: Teach me the strong shield parry.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132410.text: I want to learn the death blow!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132509.text: How do I talk my way out of things?

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132606.text: Show me how to knock others down!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132650.text: Teach me how to pick difficult locks.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132723.text: Teach me how to pick impossible locks.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132803.text: I want to be a master thief!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132905.text: Teach me how to pick difficult pockets!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060512132935.text: Teach me how to pick impossible pockets!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060514135359.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

INFO_SKALVERAM320060515113503.text: Here is a bit of ore.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060515113646.text: As long as the orcs are occupying our mine, this is our only chance to get some ore for the clan.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516224902.text: And lots of other stuff too, of course.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516230434.text: I'm going to get my stone back.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516230532.text: But he isn't important. The stone is important.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516231000_0.text: I'll keep the stone and wait near the cave.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516231000_2.text: If you want, we could go together.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516231000.text: Enter the cave. I'm no coward, but I won't let myself be slaughtered either.

INFO_SKALVERAM320060516231320.text: Fine, let me know when we can go.

INFO_SKALVERAM3213.text: And a few healing potions as well.

INFO_SKALVERAM3216.text: I would turn right around and get out of here if I were you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3218.text: There's nothing going here, man. No gold, no women, and we're out of booze more often than not.

INFO_SKALVERAM3239.text: So, you're the Morra who served the city so well.

INFO_SKALVERAM3240.text: My warriors are talking about you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3242.text: They respect you. That's enough for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3249.text: Ah. You aren't an orc. How did you get in here?

INFO_SKALVERAM3250.text: Where can I find rebels, besides in Reddock?

INFO_SKALVERAM3251.text: They are everywhere. Throughout the land, there are groups opposing the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM3252.text: They hide in the woods, in caves, or in the cliffs.

INFO_SKALVERAM3253.text: The orcs will never find them all.

INFO_SKALVERAM3254.text: We will only rest when our kingdom is once again free.

INFO_SKALVERAM3278.text: One morning, shortly before dawn, the orcs surrounded the city.

INFO_SKALVERAM3279.text: And that was that. Almost half of us were killed, all the rest were enslaved.

INFO_SKALVERAM3285.text: I even captured a paladin and I question him every day.

INFO_SKALVERAM3286.text: Do you always whine like that?

INFO_SKALVERAM3287.text: Give me a bottle of booze, and the two of us will be the best of friends.

INFO_SKALVERAM3288.text: Here, I've got a bottle of booze for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3289.text: Thanks, man! That hits the spot.

INFO_SKALVERAM3295.text: What's the matter? Haven't you ever seen anyone shoveling pig manure before?

INFO_SKALVERAM3310.text: How exactly does this revolution work?

INFO_SKALVERAM3311.text: As soon as you start fighting the orcs, we will know that the time has come.

INFO_SKALVERAM3319.text: No, you should get us weapons. Nothing special, just three bundles of weapons.

INFO_SKALVERAM3324.text: I have your three bundles of weapons here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3326.text: You belong to the rebel underground.

INFO_SKALVERAM3328.text: We are simple citizens, trying not to be subjugated in our own country.

INFO_SKALVERAM3335.text: We won't manage it alone. The orcs outnumber us.

INFO_SKALVERAM3336.text: A very powerful paladin named Wenzel is being held prisoner up in the lighthouse.

INFO_SKALVERAM3337.text: With his support, I would take the risk of attacking the orcs here in Cape Dun.

INFO_SKALVERAM3357.text: Why are you a prisoner and not a slave?

INFO_SKALVERAM3358.text: One of their slave hunters dragged me here and sold me to the orcs.

INFO_SKALVERAM3359.text: Since then, the orcs have come every day and interrogated me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3365.text: Behave yourself in this city, newcomer.

INFO_SKALVERAM3366.text: Cape Dun is now free. And so are you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3367.text: Thank you. Without your help, they certainly would have killed me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3369.text: Every city we reconquer will empower the king.

INFO_SKALVERAM3371.text: And one more thing - if you ever go to Montera, look for a wolf cave south of the city.

INFO_SKALVERAM3372.text: There you will find a sword. It has never let me down.

INFO_SKALVERAM3373.text: I hid it there before Gamal took me prisoner.

INFO_SKALVERAM3374.text: If you bring it back to me, you won't regret it.

INFO_SKALVERAM3389.text: Where are you trying to go?

INFO_SKALVERAM3390.text: Just get me past the village, to Jens the hunter.

INFO_SKALVERAM3391.text: I will hide with him for a while and have a couple of decent meals.

INFO_SKALVERAM340.text: Ah, my slave! Very good. Who knows what trouble he would have gotten himself into.

INFO_SKALVERAM3410.text: You had better get used to it, or you won't get far with us.

INFO_SKALVERAM3411.text: You sold a paladin to the orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM3412.text: He's up in the lighthouse, the orcs are interrogating him.

INFO_SKALVERAM3414.text: Do you still have the stuff from the captured paladin?

INFO_SKALVERAM3415.text: Yeah, a bunch of useless junk and a strange chalice.

INFO_SKALVERAM3418.text: Sell me the captured paladin's chalice.

INFO_SKALVERAM3419.text: Here. I can't do anything with it anyway.

INFO_SKALVERAM3423.text: Thank you, friend. Let me reward your service.

INFO_SKALVERAM3425.text: I'm a mercenary. My name is Silas.

INFO_SKALVERAM343.text: Here, you've earned this bag of gold.

INFO_SKALVERAM3434.text: ... another poor devil just trying to get by.

INFO_SKALVERAM3435.text: I know what it's like, it's the same with all of us.

INFO_SKALVERAM344.text: Tell me more about slave hunters.

INFO_SKALVERAM3503.text: Fine. I will send you an easy opponent first.

INFO_SKALVERAM3504.text: If you manage to defeat him, we can talk again.

INFO_SKALVERAM3505.text: What am I supposed to do?

INFO_SKALVERAM3506.text: Enter the arena and fight. If you leave, you lose.

INFO_SKALVERAM3508.text: I can send you a good opponent if you want.

INFO_SKALVERAM3509.text: But this was an easy opponent. So don't get too cocky now.

INFO_SKALVERAM3511.text: You want to fight? You can fight.

INFO_SKALVERAM3512.text: You are going to face my best fighter.

INFO_SKALVERAM3516.text: Nobody else wants to go up against you. You are the champion.

INFO_SKALVERAM3518.text: Yes, this sword. Wear it with pride, for it is a good blade.

INFO_SKALVERAM3522.text: If you don't, leave me alone.

INFO_SKALVERAM3523.text: What can I win in the arena?

INFO_SKALVERAM3524.text: The arena champion receives a sword.

INFO_SKALVERAM353.text: You're new here, aren't you? Did you come to work for the Orcs?

INFO_SKALVERAM3536.text: Really? I never saw you arrive.

INFO_SKALVERAM3537.text: Oh well, I was probably on my way somewhere at the time.

INFO_SKALVERAM3543.text: So you lost your way after all.

INFO_SKALVERAM3544.text: If you keep following the path to the coast, you'll get to Cape Dun.

INFO_SKALVERAM3545.text: And what will I find there?

INFO_SKALVERAM3546.text: Same thing you find everywhere these days. Orcs and mercenaries.

INFO_SKALVERAM3550.text: The mercenaries in the village are bound to need more people, provided you know how to wield a weapon.

INFO_SKALVERAM3553.text: He's the boss here, at least of us mercenaries.

INFO_SKALVERAM3554.text: So, if you aren't exactly an orc and belong to Uruk, he's your only chance to get a foot in the door here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3557.text: I have to watch these slaves.

INFO_SKALVERAM3558.text: One of them ran off not too long ago.

INFO_SKALVERAM3559.text: Since then, we can't leave the slaves unguarded for a moment.

INFO_SKALVERAM3560.text: You'll find him at the end of the main street. He's usually standing outside his hut.

INFO_SKALVERAM3562.text: City? Cape Dun may be a lot of things, but it sure isn't a city.

INFO_SKALVERAM3563.text: There isn't even a decent bar here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3564.text: But at least there's work to be had. You'll be all right.

INFO_SKALVERAM3567.text: If I'm lucky, you'll get my job.

INFO_SKALVERAM3581.text: Maybe you'll find work there if you're lucky.

INFO_SKALVERAM3582.text: There aren't enough. Bring me more.

INFO_SKALVERAM3584.text: Harek needs to lie low for a while.

INFO_SKALVERAM3585.text: All right, he can stay with me for a bit.

INFO_SKALVERAM3586.text: You wouldn't happen to carry a piece of roast meat, by any chance?

INFO_SKALVERAM3587.text: Too bad. Oh well, doesn't matter.

INFO_SKALVERAM3588.text: Guess I will have to eat the plants, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM3589.text: Here are the healing plants. We would make a great team, you and I.

INFO_SKALVERAM3590.text: How can I find plants here?

INFO_SKALVERAM3591.text: Oh, that's easy, provided you know where to look.

INFO_SKALVERAM3593.text: On mountainsides. If you're really lucky, you can find whole fields of plants sometimes.

INFO_SKALVERAM3594.text: Report to Bufford, maybe he's got some work for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3602.text: One of my slaves has escaped - Harek, that mangy mutt.

INFO_SKALVERAM3604.text: He's probably still in the vicinity. Someone may have seen him outside of town.

INFO_SKALVERAM3607.text: What about you? You don't look like you're the squeamish sort.

INFO_SKALVERAM3608.text: If I knew that, I would have brought him back, wouldn't I?

INFO_SKALVERAM3609.text: I can't leave here, and I need someone to go and catch him for me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3611.text: I will catch Harek for you. Where is he?

INFO_SKALVERAM3619.text: A slave hunter's life seems to have its merits.

INFO_SKALVERAM3620.text: Help me, and I might tell you more about it.

INFO_SKALVERAM3626.text: Times have changed. Your king no longer rules here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3628.text: An Hashishin, a servant of Beliar. I come from the south, from beyond your borders.

INFO_SKALVERAM3631.text: I'm supposed to bring his goods back to Urkrass.

INFO_SKALVERAM3633.text: Do you know where I can find them?

INFO_SKALVERAM3634.text: No, but there are lots of rebels and bandits in the woods around here.

INFO_SKALVERAM3635.text: Maybe you should just go along the coast.

INFO_SKALVERAM3636.text: There must be clues around there somewhere.

INFO_SKALVERAM3637.text: What sort of goods are they?

INFO_SKALVERAM3638.text: No idea, but I suspect the usual supplies.

INFO_SKALVERAM3639.text: The whole coastal region is currently being supplied with goods from the Midlands.

INFO_SKALVERAM3642.text: We need to contact the king.

INFO_SKALVERAM3644.text: I do not know what Rhobar is planning.

INFO_SKALVERAM3647.text: Xardas is looking for the artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_SKALVERAM3648.text: The artifacts of Adanos... then it is true. And our enemies shall show us the way...

INFO_SKALVERAM3655.text: Dammit. I'll never be able to pull this off.

INFO_SKALVERAM3665.text: There. I have done everything that was necessary.

INFO_SKALVERAM3666.text: Then we are ready at last.

INFO_SKALVERAM3668.text: With the staff and the scepter, we will open the portal to the unknown land.

INFO_SKALVERAM3693.text: Xardas is seeking the five artifacts of Adanos.

INFO_SKALVERAM3694.text: So that's it! The artifacts of Adanos... the power of the gods... I see...

INFO_SKALVERAM3695.text: What do you know about them?

INFO_SKALVERAM3706.text: Tell me more about the remaining keys to the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM3711.text: The servant of Beliar has fallen. Zuben is dead.

INFO_SKALVERAM3712.text: What mission do you have for me?

INFO_SKALVERAM3713.text: The sand hides ancient and powerful mysteries.

INFO_SKALVERAM3714.text: Some are of use to us, others should remain hidden forever.

INFO_SKALVERAM3715.text: The orcs are digging in the ruins of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_SKALVERAM3720.text: The orcs have paid for their treachery.

INFO_SKALVERAM3722.text: Now it is up to you to choose which power you wish to possess!

INFO_SKALVERAM3726.text: I, too, bear the power of the gods in me - and this power also must be taken from our world.

INFO_SKALVERAM3727.text: And how do you think we can do that?

INFO_SKALVERAM3728.text: When it is time, we will leave the world and go to the unknown land.

INFO_SKALVERAM3740.text: I have the Scepter of Varant.

INFO_SKALVERAM3741.text: Guard it well. We will need it later!

INFO_SKALVERAM3742.text: I have the Staff of the Wanderer.

INFO_SKALVERAM3743.text: It seems somehow familiar... hmm, all right. Keep it. It will be of use to us later.

INFO_SKALVERAM3748.text: We need five keys in order to open the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM3749.text: I found one of them among the ruins. So four are still missing.

INFO_SKALVERAM3751.text: I know why you have come. I know what you have done.

INFO_SKALVERAM3758.text: You have exercised my vengeance on them!

INFO_SKALVERAM3759.text: The king of Myrtana is dead!

INFO_SKALVERAM3760.text: The power of Innos is broken, his people will despair!

INFO_SKALVERAM3762.text: As he served me in life, so shall he serve me in death.

INFO_SKALVERAM3763.text: Innos, I have fulfilled your will!

INFO_SKALVERAM3765.text: Without him, the rule of the Hashishins will soon be over.

INFO_SKALVERAM3766.text: The people of Myrtana are free, and the orcs have been vanquished!

INFO_SKALVERAM3771.text: What do you want for your temple key?

INFO_SKALVERAM3773.text: And nevertheless, you can't understand my decision...

INFO_SKALVERAM3774.text: You have destroyed the divine artifacts!

INFO_SKALVERAM3778.text: At any rate, you have the courage to face me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3779.text: And do you have anything else to say?

INFO_SKALVERAM378.text: How else can I be of use?

INFO_SKALVERAM3782.text: So, you have made your decision. That means nothing.

INFO_SKALVERAM3783.text: Your screams will be the last thing that is ever heard of you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3785.text: So, you were too cowardly to seize the power of Beliar!

INFO_SKALVERAM3786.text: A rash judgment for a wise man.

INFO_SKALVERAM3787.text: Do you really believe you can delay Beliar's victory?

INFO_SKALVERAM3788.text: I see you have decided for Innos.

INFO_SKALVERAM3789.text: I am the Warrior of the Fire.

INFO_SKALVERAM379.text: Talk to Deckard the quartermaster. He always has something to do.

INFO_SKALVERAM3790.text: I think I left you alone among the mages and paladins for too long.

INFO_SKALVERAM3791.text: You have decided in favor of Beliar! I admit, I never expected that.

INFO_SKALVERAM3792.text: But you HAVE decided. So it must be.

INFO_SKALVERAM3794.text: And now you are here because you must bear the consequences of your decision.

INFO_SKALVERAM38.text: Looks like I'll need 5 different keys in order to open this door.

INFO_SKALVERAM380.text: You haven't been around long, have you? Listen up, then.

INFO_SKALVERAM3807.text: We're opening the temple, Morra. And you? Where's your shovel and why aren't you digging?

INFO_SKALVERAM381.text: Whenever you need something, you come to me. The orcs don't trade with just anyone, understand?

INFO_SKALVERAM3822.text: You certainly took your time! Why didn't you come sooner?

INFO_SKALVERAM3838.text: And that is that! The door is open.

INFO_SKALVERAM3852.text: I will get the vase from the temple for you.

INFO_SKALVERAM3853.text: Great. Remember, it is completely covered with writing.

INFO_SKALVERAM3854.text: And if you don't deliver the vase, a bounty hunter will deliver your head to me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3856.text: You know, I purchased this for a reason.

INFO_SKALVERAM3857.text: There's something in the temple that I would like to have.

INFO_SKALVERAM3859.text: An old vase. It is covered with ancient writing.

INFO_SKALVERAM3861.text: Here's your ancient vase from the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM3862.text: You've been to the temple? You really impress me.

INFO_SKALVERAM3881.text: Tell me more about the temple keys of Mora Sul.

INFO_SKALVERAM3882.text: Oh, yes. I don't mind if I do.

INFO_SKALVERAM3883.text: Perhaps we could make a deal.

INFO_SKALVERAM3884.text: I'm looking for the keys to the temple.

INFO_SKALVERAM3885.text: Interesting. And how can I help you?

INFO_SKALVERAM3889.text: Do you know anything about the keys?

INFO_SKALVERAM3890.text: All right, we are both businessmen, and therefore I don't want to beat around the bush.

INFO_SKALVERAM3891.text: One of the keys is in my possession.

INFO_SKALVERAM3892.text: What do you want for the key?

INFO_SKALVERAM3893.text: The orcs want the artifacts of the Ancient Ones, they're leaving no stone unturned in the desert.

INFO_SKALVERAM3894.text: They would pay any price to get into the deepest sanctuaries of the Ancient Ones.

INFO_SKALVERAM3895.text: Therefore, this key is worth a whole lot.

INFO_SKALVERAM3931.text: No excuses! We have great things planned and no time to waste on apologies!

INFO_SKALVERAM3932.text: I will explain everything to you as best I can.

INFO_SKALVERAM3994.text: What do you know, it works!

INFO_SKALVERAM3995.text: Hmm, looks like some keys are still missing.

INFO_SKALVERAM3996.text: But I'll need five keys for that.

INFO_SKALVERAM3999.text: I'm not getting any further with my search for the divine artifacts.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_ResistHeat_01.text: Move as little as possible and save your strength.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_ResistHeat_02.text: The heat can be more exhausting than fighting a whole herd of monsters.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Smith.text: Only an experienced smith can make a truly good weapon!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_00.text: When you fight, fight to win - fight to kill!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_01.text: You are not merely carrying out orders! You are fulfilling the will of Beliar!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_02.text: And with every enemy of Beliar that you strike down, his dominion grows!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_03.text: You execute his judgment! You bring death to his enemies!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_04.text: I can show you how to defeat an enemy, but it is Beliar who gives you the strength to do so!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_05.text: You shall fall upon your enemies like the wrath of Beliar himself!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_06.text: I can teach you to fight, but Beliar will teach you victory!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_07.text: Only Beliar can arouse in you the storm that no one and nothing can stop!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_08.text: With every battle you win in his name, he will grant you great strength!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Speech_09.text: For you are his chosen tool. When you are victorious, HE will be victorious!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Stone.text: This isn't easy on the arms!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_2_00.text: Mastery is not only an art - it is an obligation.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_2_01.text: I see that you are ready to take this obligation upon yourself.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_2_02.text: With mastery, your attacks will become even more dangerous, even harder.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_1H1H_2_03.text: And do not forget - it is practice that makes the master. So perform your exercises!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Crossbow_1.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.
For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.
But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!
Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Hunter_1_0.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.
Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Hunter_2_0.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.
Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.
Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.
Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_JumpAttack.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!
Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.
That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_LightArmor.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.
But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Shield_1_0.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:
Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!
It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!
Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_StaffMagic.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.
Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.
Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_TrophyFur_.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!
The most important thing is: always from back to front!
Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_TrophySkin.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.
Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Ass_Elite_Insidious_Teach_TrophyTeet.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_HeavyArmor_00.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_HeavyArmor_01.text: All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_HeavyArmor_02.text: Not so tightly that you cannot move.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_HeavyArmor_03.text: But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_SharpenBlade_00.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_SharpenBlade_01.text: Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_SharpenBlade_02.text: That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Ass_Old_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_02.text: So pay with your gold - else you shall pay with your blood!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_03.text: Beliar knows no mercy! There is no pity for the weak, only pain and death!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_04.text: But those among you who do good business must pay their tribute!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_05.text: For what use is your gold - in the face of Beliar's inexorable wrath!?

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_06.text: Once HIS wrath is awakened, it is too late - then will your prayers fade away unheeded!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_07.text: Only we Black Mages can appease his wrath!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_08.text: We protect you. We use our power to keep his wrath from you!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Speech_09.text: He will shatter his enemies! He shall reward US. For we are HIS people. The Hashishin!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_LightArmor_00.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_LightArmor_01.text: But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonArrow_00.text: You need poison and a couple of arrows.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonArrow_01.text: Then CAREFULLY dunk the arrowheads in the phial.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonArrow_02.text: You need a steady hand, so take your time.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonBlade_00.text: First, you need a weapon and the poison.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonBlade_01.text: Avoid dunking the whole blade in the poison.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonBlade_02.text: Apply it in a thin coat only on the edge and the tip.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PoisonBlade_03.text: And make sure that you don't cut yourself.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_01.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_02.text: All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_03.text: Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPoison_00.text: Basically, poison is no different than a regular healing potion.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPoison_01.text: You need a recipe, the ingredients, and an alchemist's bench.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPoison_02.text: Dump it all together and stir well. When it becomes a sticky substance, you're finished.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_00.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_01.text: Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.

SVM_Ass_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_02.text: Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_06.text: ...you need to work with what you've got...

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_08.text: ...it will all look different in the morning...

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_SmalltalkRefuse.text: You can see we're talking right now...

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Smith.text: Only an experienced smith can make a truly good weapon!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Stone.text: This isn't easy on the arms!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Sweep.text: This work, too, must be done...
SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Sweep.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Crossbow_1_0.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.
For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.
But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!
Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_HeavyArmor_0.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.
All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.
Not so tightly that you cannot move.
But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_JumpAttack_0.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!
Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.
That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_SharpenBlade.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.
Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.
That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_00.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Pickpocket_1_.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Pickpocket_2_.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.
