SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Lockpick_2_00.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Pickpocket_1_.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Pickpocket_2_.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Ass_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Diego_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Lockpick_3_00.text: These locks are secured two and three times.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Lockpick_3_01.text: You have to feel very carefully with the lockpick for the right place in the lock.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Lockpick_3_02.text: Then you can open the lock with a quick twitch. But watch out, it sounds easier than it is.

SVM_Diego_Teach_MasterThief_00.text: A master thief is always on the search.

SVM_Diego_Teach_MasterThief_01.text: For loot, for shadow and for the perfect opportunity.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_1_01.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_1_02.text: You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_2_00.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_2_01.text: Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_2_03.text: Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_3_00.text: You've known the necessary hand movements for a while.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_3_02.text: Always keep your right hand moving. Wave it around. Right in front of his nose is best.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_3_03.text: That will distract him so that you can safely grab with your left hand.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Pickpocket_3_04.text: Believe me, that trick always works.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Diego_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Diego_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Diego_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Diego_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_3_00.text: Don't think. Concentrate on just one thing:

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_3_02.text: A good marksman can kill his enemy with a single shot.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Crossbow_3_03.text: Use that shot. You only need the one.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Gorn_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Axe_3_00.text: The axe is a heavy weapon. Use that to your advantage.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Axe_3_01.text: Let it rotate vigorously, and your opponents will drop quickly.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_3_00.text: Don't think. Concentrate on just one thing:

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_3_02.text: A good marksman can kill his enemy with a single shot.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_3_03.text: Use that shot. You only need the one.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcHunter_00.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcHunter_01.text: Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcHunter_02.text: Then send your arrow on its way.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcHunter_03.text: Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcSlayer_01.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcSlayer_02.text: So, when you strike, hit with real power!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_OrcSlayer_03.text: And you can seriously injure an orc with an aimed stab!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThatHurt.stageDirection: watching fight, friend took heavy blow

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_TheftRefuse.text: Get out of here, you dirty thief!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThereAreOrcs.text: There are still some orcs nearby, causing us trouble!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThereIsNoFightingHere.text: No fighting here, got it?! Let that be a lesson to you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThereIsPrey.text: I know where we can find prey!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThiefDown.text: Don't you ever mess with my stuff again!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThisTimeYoureLucky.text: I'll let you get away with it this time.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_ThisWayIn.text: We have to go in here!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_TooFarFromMeetingPoin.text: We're getting too far from our destination!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Trainer.text: If you want to train, I'm your man!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_TrainerLost.text: This time, I won't make it so easy for you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_TrainerWon.text: This time, you have to try harder!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_Victory_00.text: You shouldn't have messed with me!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WatchTheGuards.text: Don't let the guards catch you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WeatherHot.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WeatherRain.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WhatDidYouDoInThere.text: What were you doing in there, huh?!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WhatsThisSupposedToBe.text: Hey, you! What are you doing sneaking around?!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WillKillAllSuspects.text: If this doesn't stop, we'll have to kill everyone we don't trust completely.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WillKillSuspect.text: Once we find the guilty party, we'll make short work of them.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_WillTakeNoMoreRisks.text: I am no longer prepared to take a risk!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YesGetLost.stageDirection: angry, calling after, not too loud

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YouDareHitMe.text: You hit me?! Just you wait!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YouKnowTheAnswer.text: You can answer that question yourself.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YouLearnedALesson.text: I don't want to see you causing trouble here ever again, understand?!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YouLeftTheArena.text: You are out! The fight is over!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Hard_YouSureGotGold.text: I'm sure you have a bit of gold with you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Alchemist.text: Just don't make a mistake now...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Alchemist.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_AndNowGetOutOfHere.text: And now get out of here!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_AngryRefuse.text: Are you looking for more trouble?

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Barbecue.text: Here, you can take over for me.
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Barbecue.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_BattleWon.stageDirection: won fight, calling, not too loud

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_BetterNotTalk.text: You'd better go, otherwise we'll get in trouble!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_BetYouAreResponsible.text: I bet YOU are responsible for that!
And I bet you're responsible for THAT, too.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Campfire.text: There's nothing like a warm fire...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Campfire.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_CertainlyBusy.text: I'm sure you have something else to do...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Cook.text: This is totally overcooked... oh, whatever!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_DestinationNear.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_DieMonster_02.text: There are more of the beasts!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_DoYouKnowSomething.text: Do you know anything about that?

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_DoYouKnowSomethingOf.text: I assume you don't know anything about THAT either?!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Farmer.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_FirstEnclaveCrime.text: Someone is attacking our camp! And they aren't orcs!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_FirstTheft.text: Some valuable things have gone missing here.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GetOutOfHere.text: What are you doing here?! Get out!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoBed.text: I'm going to hit the hay...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoBed.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoBreak.text: I'm going to take a break.
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoBreak.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoDrink.text: I could drink a whole barrel!
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoDrink.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoEat.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoPee.text: I need to take a leak!
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoPee.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoSmoke.text: Now for a peaceful little smoke...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoSmoke.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GotoWork.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Grind.text: A weapon can never be sharp enough...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Grind.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GuardRefuse.text: Don't cause any trouble here, got it?!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_GuardRefuseFriend.text: We're keeping an eye on things!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_HeavyHit.stageDirection: watching fight, friend landed heavy blow

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_IDontBelieveYou.text: I don't believe a word of it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_IGetYouStill.text: So I'll get you after all!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_ISaidDontGoFurther.text: One more step in that direction and you won't know what hit you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_JoinRefuse.text: You already have someone with you...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_KillAllSuspectsNow.text: Everyone who is suspected of being involved in this will be killed!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_KnownMurder.text: You are wanted here for murder!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_KnownTheft.text: You are wanted here for theft!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_LookingForTroubleAga.text: Do really want to tangle with me again?

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Mine.text: This is a hard piece of rock...
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Mine.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_MobDismiss.text: We'll meet at the assembly point!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_MonsterKilled_00.text: Well, that takes care of that!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_MonsterKilled_02.text: There! So much for you, filthy beast!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NeverEnterAreaAgain.text: You have no business in there! I hope I make myself clear...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NeverHitMeAgain.text: You had better not mess with me again!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NeverTouchOurStuffAg.text: And next time, keep your hands to yourself!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NextTimeYoureGuilty.text: If this goes on, we will hold YOU responsible for everything!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoArmor.text: Forget it! You'll only get that once you've earned it!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfASS.text: You are no friend of the Hashishin!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfEnclave.text: We do not know if we can trust you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfMID.text: You are no friend of the forest people.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfNOM.text: You are no friend of the nomads.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfNRD.text: You are no friend of the people of Nordmar.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfORC.text: You are no friend of the orcs.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoFriendOfREB.text: You are no friend of the rebels.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NoMoreTroubleHere.text: Don't cause any more trouble here!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NotEnoughGold.text: You don't have enough gold with you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_NotEnoughLP.text: You don't have the necessary experience!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Ooh_01.text: Come on. You can take him!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_PartyDismiss.text: You know where to find me.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_RansackGold_00.text: Ah! Gold! That's mine, for starters.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_RansackGold_01.text: Well, at least you have gold on you...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_RansackWeapon.text: I think I'll take the weapon with me!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Read.text: What is all this supposed to mean?
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Read.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_RevolutionHero.text: Thanks to you, everything is all right!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SecondEnclaveCrime.text: More and more of our camps are being razed to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SecondMurder.text: We are still looking for the murderer!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SecondTheft.text: More and more of our people's valuables are disappearing.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_ShitNoGold.text: Damn! He doesn't even have any gold!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SlaveAttack.text: Do you think that's a good idea?

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SlaveDismiss.text: I thought we were staying together.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Smalltalk_03.text: ...if he goes on like that, it will never get anywhere...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_SmalltalkRefuse.text: We're talking right now. Come back later.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Smith.text: A smith never gets a moment's peace!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Stone.text: Lift the stone and the orcs will respect you...

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Sweep.text: I have to clean up here.
SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Sweep.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_3_00.text: The axe is a heavy weapon. Use that to your advantage.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Axe_3_01.text: Let it rotate vigorously, and your opponents will drop quickly.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_3_00.text: Don't think. Concentrate on just one thing:

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_3_02.text: A good marksman can kill his enemy with a single shot.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_3_03.text: Use that shot. You only need the one.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Druid_00.text: The power of the druids is to awaken the animal in you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Druid_01.text: Every creature that you change into will be all the stronger.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Druid_02.text: That is the secret of the druids.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_HeavyArmor_00.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_HeavyArmor_01.text: All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_HeavyArmor_02.text: Not so tightly that you cannot move.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_HeavyArmor_03.text: But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcHunter_00.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcHunter_01.text: Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcHunter_02.text: Then send your arrow on its way.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcHunter_03.text: Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcSlayer_01.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcSlayer_02.text: So, when you strike, hit with real power!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_OrcSlayer_03.text: And you can seriously injure an orc with an aimed stab!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_ResistHeat_01.text: Move as little as possible and save your strength.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_ResistHeat_02.text: The heat can be more exhausting than fighting a whole herd of monsters.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_SharpenBlade_0.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.
Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.
That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_04.text: So get yourself one and get started. You'll manage!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_3_00.text: For a blade of pure ore, you have to develop a feeling.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_3_01.text: Only use raw materials that seem right to you.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_3_02.text: Start your work when you have quiet, and handle the blank with care.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_3_03.text: When the flames begin to dance on the ore, it is hot enough.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Smith_3_04.text: Then form the ore on the anvil according to your desire.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sprinter_00.text: Breathing is the most important thing. If you breathe wrong, you will soon be winded.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sprinter_01.text: Breathe evenly and draw the air deep into your lungs. Then you'll always have some when you need it.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_Sprinter_02.text: And the absolutely most important thing: don't panic!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Elite_Proud_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_3_00.text: The axe is a heavy weapon. Use that to your advantage.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Axe_3_01.text: Let it rotate vigorously, and your opponents will drop quickly.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_00.text: The bow has to become a part of you, an extension of your arm.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_01.text: Find a rhythm and follow it.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_02.text: When your mind, your heart, and your breath follow that rhythm, your arrows will find their target by themselves.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_HeavyArmor_00.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_HeavyArmor_01.text: All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_HeavyArmor_02.text: Not so tightly that you cannot move.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_HeavyArmor_03.text: But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_OrcSlayer_01.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_OrcSlayer_02.text: So, when you strike, hit with real power!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_OrcSlayer_03.text: And you can seriously injure an orc with an aimed stab!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_SharpenBlade_0.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.
Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.
That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Hum_Fat_Bearish_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Learn_00.text: Of course you do. You are an inquisitive man.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Learn_01.text: So, use your time and use your head.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Learn_02.text: It isn't there just to hold up your helmet...

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_LightArmor_00.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_LightArmor_01.text: But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_00.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_01.text: Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_02.text: Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Hum_Old_Calm_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_GuardRefuse.text: Don't cause any trouble here, got it?!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_GuardRefuseFriend.text: We're keeping an eye on things!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_HandsOff.text: Get your hands off of that!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_IDontBelieveYou.text: I don't believe a word of it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_IGetYouStill.text: So I'll get you after all!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_InnosTeacher_00.text: The fire of Innos burns within you. Incinerate his enemies!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_InnosTeacher_01.text: Innos leads us in the battle against the darkness.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_InnosTeacher_02.text: Innos grants you this power. Remember that when you use it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ISaidDontGoFurther.text: One more step in that direction and you won't know what hit you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ISaidGetOutOfHere.text: Are you deaf?! Out of here!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ISaidWeaponDown.text: Didn't you hear me? Put that weapon away!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_JoinRefuse.text: You already have someone traveling with you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_KillAllSuspectsNow.text: Everyone who is suspected of being involved in this will be killed!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_KnownMurder.text: You are wanted here for murder!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_KnownTheft.text: You are wanted here for theft!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_LookingForTroubleAgain.text: Are you looking for another fight?

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NeverHitMeAgain.text: Don't you dare attack me again!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NeverTouchOurStuffAgain.text: Keep your hands to yourself in the future!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NextTimeYoureGuilty.text: If this goes on, we will hold YOU responsible for everything!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NextTimeYoureInForIt.text: Next time, you won't get off so easily...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoArmor.text: Not yet! First, prove that you are worthy!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfASS.text: You are no friend of the Hashishin!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfEnclave.text: We do not know if we can trust you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfMID.text: You are no friend of the forest people.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfNOM.text: You are no friend of the nomads.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfNRD.text: You are no friend of the people of Nordmar.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfORC.text: You are no friend of the orcs.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoFriendOfREB.text: You are no friend of the rebels.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NoMoreTroubleHere.text: Don't cause any more trouble here!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_NotEnoughGold.text: You don't have enough gold with you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_RansackGold_02.text: You have gold with you! That's good...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_SecondEnclaveCrime.text: More and more of our camps are being razed to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_SecondMurder.text: We are still looking for the murderer!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_SecondTheft.text: More and more of our people's valuables are disappearing.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_SlaveAttack.text: I don't think much of that...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_SlaveDismiss.text: I thought we were going together.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Smalltalk_01.text: ...I don't know if you're right about that...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Smith.text: There is always work for a smith. Whether there's a war on or not...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Stone.text: Whoever can lift the stone has earned the respect of the orcs..

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_3_00.text: The bow has to become a part of you, an extension of your arm.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_3_01.text: Find a rhythm and follow it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Bow_3_02.text: When your mind, your heart, and your breath follow that rhythm, your arrows will find their target by themselves.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Druid_00.text: The power of the druids is to awaken the animal in you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Druid_01.text: Every creature that you change into will be all the stronger.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Druid_02.text: That is the secret of the druids.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_FireArrow_00.text: Fire arrows do more damage than conventional arrows.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_FireArrow_01.text: It's actually quite simple. You need arrows and the necessary ingredients.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_FireArrow_02.text: Assemble them on an alchemist's bench.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Firemage_00.text: This knowledge will lend great strength to all magic spells of fire.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Firemage_01.text: This knowledge is the highest gift of Innos himself.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Firemage_02.text: The true power of the fire is with you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_HeavyArmor_00.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_HeavyArmor_01.text: All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_HeavyArmor_02.text: Not so tightly that you cannot move.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_HeavyArmor_03.text: But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Learn_00.text: Of course you do. You are an inquisitive man.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Learn_01.text: So, use your time and use your head.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Learn_02.text: It isn't there just to hold up your helmet...

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_LightArmor_00.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_LightArmor_01.text: But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_MasterMage_00.text: It is a great gift that slumbers in each of us.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_MasterMage_01.text: It is your will that awakens it. Concentrate your will.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_MasterMage_03.text: Practice this, and it will soon feel like it's always been that way.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_01.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_02.text: All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionPerm_03.text: Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_PotionTransform_0.text: Transformation potions allow you to take on another form for a short time.
It goes without saying that you need the necessary ingredients and an alchemist's bench!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_ResistCold_00.text: You have to move a lot, that warms the body.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_ResistCold_01.text: Every movement must come from your whole body.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_ResistCold_02.text: And make sure that you always have warm feet.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_SharpenBlade_00.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_SharpenBlade_01.text: Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_SharpenBlade_02.text: That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sprinter_00.text: Breathing is the most important thing. If you breathe wrong, you will soon be winded.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sprinter_01.text: Breathe evenly and draw the air deep into your lungs. Then you'll always have some when you need it.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Sprinter_02.text: And the absolutely most important thing: don't panic!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_00.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_01.text: Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_StaffMagic_02.text: Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Watermage_00.text: This knowledge enables you to unfold the true power of the magic of Adanos.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Teach_Watermage_01.text: You will understand nature, and it will reinforce your spells.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_TheftRefuse.text: Get out of my sight, you dirty thief!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ThereIsNoFightingHere.text: We don't need any troublemakers here!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ThiefDown.text: Don't try stealing from me again!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_ThisTimeYoureLucky.text: I'll let you get away with it this time.

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_TooFarFromMeetingPoint.text: We are too far from our destination!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Victory_00.text: Tangling with me was a mistake!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_Victory_02.text: What do you know... it works!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_WatchTheGuards.text: Don't let the guards catch you!

SVM_Hum_Old_Wise_YouLearnedALesson.text: I hope you learned something from this...

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_Acrobatic_00.text: Body control is a good thing.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_Acrobatic_01.text: It helps you safely survive a fall from a great height!

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_ImmuneToPoiso.text: Poison is a nasty business, especially when it's in your body.
You have to make sure that your body breaks down the poison as quickly as possible.
Keep moving and sweat a lot. That should spare you the results of the poison.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_LightArmor_00.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_LightArmor_01.text: But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PoisonBlade_0.text: First, you need a weapon and the poison.
Avoid dunking the whole blade in the poison.
Apply it in a thin coat only on the edge and the tip.
And make sure that you don't cut yourself.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionPerm_01.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionPerm_02.text: All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_PotionPerm_03.text: Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Hum_Slave_Clever_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_3_00.text: The axe is a heavy weapon. Use that to your advantage.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Axe_3_01.text: Let it rotate vigorously, and your opponents will drop quickly.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_00.text: The bow has to become a part of you, an extension of your arm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_01.text: Find a rhythm and follow it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Bow_3_02.text: When your mind, your heart, and your breath follow that rhythm, your arrows will find their target by themselves.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_1.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.
For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.
But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!
Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_2.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.
Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.
If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Crossbow_3.text: Don't think. Concentrate on just one thing:
A good marksman can kill his enemy with a single shot.
Use that shot. You only need the one.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_HeavyArmor.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.
All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.
Not so tightly that you cannot move.
But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_1_0.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.
Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Hunter_2_0.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.
Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.
Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.
Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_JumpAttack.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!
Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.
That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_OrcHunter_.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.
Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.
Then send your arrow on its way.
Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_OrcSlayer_.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.
So, when you strike, hit with real power!
And you can seriously injure an orc with an aimed stab!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_ResistCold.text: You have to move a lot, that warms the body.
Every movement must come from your whole body.
And make sure that you always have warm feet.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_SharpenBla.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.
Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.
That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Shield_1_0.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:
Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!
It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!
Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Shield_2_0.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.
A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.
Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!
But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_TrophyFur_.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!
The most important thing is: always from back to front!
Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_TrophySkin.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.
Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Bearish_Teach_TrophyTeet.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and bare the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.
