SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_3_00.text: The bow has to become a part of you, an extension of your arm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_3_01.text: Find a rhythm and follow it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Bow_3_02.text: When your mind, your heart, and your breath follow that rhythm, your arrows will find their target by themselves.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_OrcHunter_00.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_OrcHunter_01.text: Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_OrcHunter_02.text: Then send your arrow on its way.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_OrcHunter_03.text: Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionPerm_01.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionPerm_02.text: All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_PotionPerm_03.text: Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Teach_TrophyTeeth_0.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_ThatHurt.stageDirection: watching fight, friend took heavy blow

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_TheftRefuse.text: I don't want anything to do with thieving scum!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_ThereIsNoFightingHe.text: If anyone does any hitting around here, it will be ME!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_ThiefDown.text: Don't you dare steal from me ever again!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_ThisTimeYoureLucky.text: I'll let you get away with it this time.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_TooFarFromMeetingPo.text: We're too far from our destination!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Victory_01.text: Am I good or am I good?

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_Victory_02.text: Hey, I beat the crap out of him!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WatchTheGuards.text: Just watch out for the guards!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WeatherHot.text: This heat is really getting to me!
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WeatherHot.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WeatherRain.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WhatDidYouDoInThere.text: Hey! You don't belong in there!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WhatsThisSupposedTo.text: Hey, you! What are you doing sneaking around?!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WillKillAllSuspects.text: If this doesn't stop, we'll have to kill everyone we don't trust completely.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WillKillSuspect.text: Once we find the guilty party, we'll make short work of them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_WillTakeNoMoreRisks.text: I am no longer prepared to take a risk!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_YesGetLost.stageDirection: angry, calling after, not too loud

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_YouBetterShouldHave.text: You should have listened to me!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_YouKnowTheAnswer.text: You can answer that question yourself.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_YouLearnedALesson.text: Let that be a lesson to you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Calm_YouLeftTheArena.text: You left the arena! You have been defeated!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Alchemist.text: You need a great deal of quiet to brew a powerful potion!
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Alchemist.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_AndNowGetOutOfHere.text: And now get out of here!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_AngryRefuse.text: You're not looking for trouble again, are you?

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Barbecue.text: This has to be turned every now and then...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Barbecue.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_BattleWon.stageDirection: won fight, calling, not too loud

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_BetterNotTalk.text: You should go, otherwise we'll both get in trouble!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_BetYouAreResponsib.text: I bet YOU are responsible for that!
And I bet you're responsible for THAT, too.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Campfire.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_CertainlyBusy.text: I'm sure you've still got things to do!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Cook.text: A few spices, stir a bit...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DestinationNear.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DieEnemy_00.text: I'm gonna let you have it!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DieMonster_00.text: The beasts just won't leave us in peace!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DieMonster_01.text: There's another one of those damn beasts!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DieMonster_02.text: There are more of the beasts!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DirtyThief.text: Dirty thief! I'm gonna let you have it!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DontStealAnything.text: Keep your hands to yourself! Got it?

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_DoYouKnowSomething.text: Do you know anything about that?
I assume you don't know anything about THAT either?!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Farmer.text: When the harvest comes, all this work will have been worth it...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Farmer.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_FirstEnclaveCrime.text: Someone is attacking our camp! And they aren't orcs!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_FirstTheft.text: Some valuable things have gone missing here.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GetOutOfHere.text: You have no business here! Out!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoBed.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoBreak.text: I'm going to relax a little...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoBreak.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoDrink.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoEat.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoPee.text: I need to take a whiz...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoPee.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoSmoke.text: And now for a relaxing smoke...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoSmoke.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoWork.text: Then I'll get back to work...
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GotoWork.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Grind.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GuardRefuse.text: Don't cause any trouble here, got it?!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_GuardRefuseFriend.text: We're keeping an eye on things!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_HandsOff.text: Get your hands off of that!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_HeavyHit.stageDirection: watching fight, friend landed heavy blow

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_IDontBelieveYou.text: I don't believe a word of it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_IGetYouStill.text: So I'll get you after all!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ISaidDontGoFurther.text: One more step in that direction and you won't know what hit you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ISaidGetOutOfHere.text: Are you deaf?! Out of here!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ISaidWeaponDown.text: Didn't you hear me? Put that weapon away!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_JoinRefuse.text: You already have someone traveling with you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_KillAllSuspectsNow.text: Everyone who is suspected of being involved in this will be killed!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_KnownMurder.text: You are wanted here for murder!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_KnownTheft.text: You are wanted here for theft!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_LookingForTroubleA.text: Are you looking for another fight?

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Mine.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_MobDismiss.text: We'll meet at the assembly point!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NeverEnterAreaAgai.text: And don't let me catch you in there again!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NeverHitMeAgain.text: Don't you dare attack me again!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NeverTouchOurStuff.text: Keep your hands to yourself in the future!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NextTimeYoureGuilt.text: If this goes on, we will hold YOU responsible for everything!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NextTimeYoureInFor.text: Next time, you won't get off so easily...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoArmor.text: Not yet! First, prove that you are worthy!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfASS.text: You are no friend of the Hashishin!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfEnclave.text: We do not know if we can trust you.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfMID.text: You are no friend of the forest people.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfNOM.text: You are no friend of the nomads.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfNRD.text: You are no friend of the people of Nordmar.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfORC.text: You are no friend of the orcs.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoFriendOfREB.text: You are no friend of the rebels.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NoMoreTroubleHere.text: Don't cause any more trouble here!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NotEnoughGold.text: You don't have enough gold with you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_NotEnoughLP.text: You don't have the necessary experience!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Ooh_01.text: Come on. You can take him!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_PartyDismiss.text: You know where to find me.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_RansackGold_00.text: I'll take care of your gold...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_RansackGold_02.text: You have gold with you! That's good...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_RansackWeapon.text: It's better if I keep the weapon.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Read.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_SecondEnclaveCrime.text: More and more of our camps are being razed to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_SecondMurder.text: We are still looking for the murderer!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_SecondTheft.text: More and more of our people's valuables are disappearing.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_SlaveAttack.text: I don't think much of that...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_SlaveDismiss.text: I thought we were going together.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_01.text: ...I don't know if you're right about that...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_03.text: ...still, I don't like it at all...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_06.text: ...I don't think I want to hear this...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Smalltalk_09.text: ...right. Still, it can't go on like this....

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Smith.text: There is always work for a smith. Whether there's a war on or not...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Stone.text: Whoever can lift the stone has earned the respect of the orcs..

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Sweep.text: It's time to clean up here.
SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Sweep.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Crossbow_1_0.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.
For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.
But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!
Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_JumpAttack_0.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!
Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.
That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Learn_00.text: Of course you do. You are an inquisitive man.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Learn_01.text: So, use your time and use your head.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Learn_02.text: It isn't there just to hold up your helmet...

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_LightArmor_0.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.
But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Lockpick_2_0.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.
Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.
You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Pickpocket_1.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Pickpocket_2.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_StaffMagic_0.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.
Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.
Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_TrophySkin_0.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.
Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Teach_TrophyTeeth_.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ThatHurt.stageDirection: watching fight, friend took heavy blow

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_TheftRefuse.text: Get out of my sight, you dirty thief!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ThereIsNoFightingH.text: We don't need any troublemakers here!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ThiefDown.text: Don't try stealing from me again!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_ThisTimeYoureLucky.text: I'll let you get away with it this time.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_TooFarFromMeetingP.text: We are too far from our destination!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Victory_00.text: Tangling with me was a mistake!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_Victory_02.text: What do you know... it works!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WatchTheGuards.text: Don't let the guards catch you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WeatherHot.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WeatherRain.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WhatAreYouDoing.text: Hey! Watch what you're doing, will you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WhatDidYouDoInTher.text: What did you do in there?

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WhatsThisSupposedT.text: You're creeping around like a thief!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WillKillAllSuspect.text: If this doesn't stop, we'll have to kill everyone we don't trust completely.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Clear_WillKillSuspect.text: Once we find the guilty party, we'll make short work of them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_3_00.text: The axe is a heavy weapon. Use that to your advantage.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Axe_3_01.text: Let it rotate vigorously, and your opponents will drop quickly.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_00.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_OrcSlayer_01.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_OrcSlayer_02.text: So, when you strike, hit with real power!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_OrcSlayer_03.text: And you can seriously injure an orc with an aimed stab!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Pickpocket_1_.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Dumb_Teach_Pickpocket_2_.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Hunter_1_.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.
Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Hunter_2_.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.
Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.
Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.
Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_ResistHea.text: Move as little as possible and save your strength.
The heat can be more exhausting than fighting a whole herd of monsters.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_Sneak_2_0.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!
Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.
Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!
If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_TrophyFur.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!
The most important thing is: always from back to front!
Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_TrophySki.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.
Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Friendly_Teach_TrophyTee.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_00.text: The orcs are in league with Beliar. They murder and pillage. They serve the beast.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_01.text: They think we are defeated, but the fire of Innos is not extinguished. It still burns in our hearts, stronger than ever!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_02.text: As long as just one of us fights against the orcs with courage and conviction, the war is not lost!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_03.text: Even if the orcs kill every single one of us, others will take our place, and the fight will go on.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_04.text: Myrtana belongs to us, to humans. The orcs cannot and will not change that!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_05.text: They have driven us from our homes and cities. I say, we will take them back!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_06.text: The best fighters in the realm are in our ranks. They will lead us and show us how to fight!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_07.text: In every village, in every city, in every corner of the realm, there are people who think like we do. We will find them and help them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_08.text: The hopes of every human rest with us. For them, we will be victorious, and rebuild the realm!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Speech_09.text: We will rebuild the destroyed cities and defiled temples! And the word of Innos will resound where today blasphemy reigns.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Pickpocket_1_.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Pickpocket_2_.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Warrior_Hard_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H1H_1_00.text: The art of fighting with two weapons demands great concentration.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H1H_1_01.text: You carry two weapons at the same time - so use them.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_1H1H_1_02.text: You can block quickly and strike back fast.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_KnockOut_00.text: You've only got one chance. If your blow isn't just right, there will be a fight - and you want to avoid that.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_KnockOut_01.text: So, creep up on the unsuspecting victim from behind and hit him exactly in the spot between the neck and the head.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_KnockOut_02.text: If you strike hard enough, he'll collapse like a cheap tent.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Lockpick_2_00.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_OrcHunter_00.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_OrcHunter_01.text: Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_OrcHunter_02.text: Then send your arrow on its way.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_OrcHunter_03.text: Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Pickpocket_1_.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.
You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Pickpocket_2_.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.
Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:
Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Young_Clever_Teach_TrophyTeeth_0.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.
Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.
Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Acrobatic_00.text: Body control is a good thing.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Acrobatic_01.text: It helps you safely survive a fall from a great height!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Bow_2_00.text: You have to be fast, but you also have to remain calm.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Bow_2_01.text: You need a steady hand and a good eye.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Bow_2_02.text: Otherwise, you're just wasting your arrows.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_1_00.text: You have to be careful. Your prey will always be alert.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_1_01.text: Find a good place to shoot from and aim at the beast's heart.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_2_00.text: You won't be able to bag large animals with just one shot.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_2_01.text: Before you can kill it, you have to weaken it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_2_02.text: Aim at different vulnerable spots. And be quick so that it doesn't have time to kill you.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Hunter_2_03.text: Once it is weakened, it is only a question of time before you kill it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_OrcHunter_00.text: Take your time and aim at their weak spots.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_OrcHunter_01.text: Head, neck, unprotected body parts, you know what I mean.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_OrcHunter_02.text: Then send your arrow on its way.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_OrcHunter_03.text: Once you are more skilled, you will also do more damage.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sneak_2_00.text: This is quite different from sneaking up on people!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sneak_2_01.text: Stalking is the only way to get within reach of a wild animal.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sneak_2_02.text: Always creep up from behind - and don't think that the animal won't be able to scent you!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sneak_2_03.text: If you get too close, it's over. So the best weapon for hunting is the bow.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sprinter_00.text: Breathing is the most important thing. If you breathe wrong, you will soon be winded.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sprinter_01.text: Breathe evenly and draw the air deep into your lungs. Then you'll always have some when you need it.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_Sprinter_02.text: And the absolutely most important thing: don't panic!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyFur_00.text: Slit the prey open and remove the skin with a jerk!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyFur_01.text: The most important thing is: always from back to front!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyFur_02.text: Once you know how to do it, it's no problem.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophySkin_01.text: To lift off the skin, carefully make an incision.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophySkin_02.text: Then remove it from back to front - but do it very slowly!

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyTeeth_00.text: Above all, you have to make sure that the stuff doesn't splinter.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyTeeth_01.text: Jam your knife deep into the flesh and uncover the trophy.

SVM_Hum_Young_Naive_Teach_TrophyTeeth_02.text: Once you're in deep enough, lever it out.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Barter_00.text: No, I can't do that. You'll have to pay more for that.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Barter_01.text: Listen! I paid you, so teach me!

SVM_Lester_Teach_Barter_02.text: But look - you can already do it.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Barter_03.text: When you're trading, you'll see that you get better prices.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Excuse_00.text: A useful skill if you ever have trouble with the guards.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Excuse_01.text: The important thing is to come across convincingly.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Excuse_02.text: So, speak with a firm voice and look the guy straight in the eye!

SVM_Lester_Teach_Excuse_03.text: Then you assert something, anything. Just don't say, 'I can explain'!

SVM_Lester_Teach_KnockOut_00.text: You've only got one chance. If your blow isn't just right, there will be a fight - and you want to avoid that.

SVM_Lester_Teach_KnockOut_01.text: So, creep up on the unsuspecting victim from behind and hit him exactly in the spot between the neck and the head.

SVM_Lester_Teach_KnockOut_02.text: If you strike hard enough, he'll collapse like a cheap tent.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_2_00.text: Ah, you want to get at the really valuable stuff.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_2_01.text: Hold the lockpick with just your fingertips. Then you have more feeling.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_2_02.text: You can tell if you push the locking mechanism in the right direction from the noise it makes.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_3_00.text: These locks are secured two and three times.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_3_01.text: You have to feel very carefully with the lockpick for the right place in the lock.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Lockpick_3_02.text: Then you can open the lock with a quick twitch. But watch out, it sounds easier than it is.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_1_01.text: Involve your victim in a conversation.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_1_02.text: You wouldn't believe how carelessly some people secure their purses. Often, you can just pull them from their pockets.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_2_00.text: No problem. You have enough talent for that.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_2_01.text: Basically, you don't have to do anything other than what you've done in your earlier thefts:

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_2_03.text: Look your opponent straight in the eye. Most people find that unpleasant, and it distracts them.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_3_00.text: You've known the necessary hand movements for a while.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_3_02.text: Always keep your right hand moving. Wave it around. Right in front of his nose is best.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_3_03.text: That will distract him so that you can safely grab with your left hand.

SVM_Lester_Teach_Pickpocket_3_04.text: Believe me, that trick always works.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonArrow_00.text: You need poison and a couple of arrows.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonArrow_01.text: Then CAREFULLY dunk the arrowheads in the phial.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonArrow_02.text: You need a steady hand, so take your time.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonBlade_00.text: First, you need a weapon and the poison.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonBlade_01.text: Avoid dunking the whole blade in the poison.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonBlade_02.text: Apply it in a thin coat only on the edge and the tip.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PoisonBlade_03.text: And make sure that you don't cut yourself.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPerm_01.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPerm_02.text: All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPerm_03.text: Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPoison_00.text: Basically, poison is no different than a regular healing potion.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPoison_01.text: You need a recipe, the ingredients, and an alchemist's bench.

SVM_Lester_Teach_PotionPoison_02.text: Dump it all together and stir well. When it becomes a sticky substance, you're finished.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_InnosTeacher_00.text: The fire of Innos shall rain down upon his enemies and all heretics. Only thus can the world be saved.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_InnosTeacher_01.text: Without Innos, there is no justice. It is given to you to disseminate it.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_InnosTeacher_02.text: Many strive for the power of the gods. Be thankful that Innos has granted it to you.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ISaidDontGoFurther.text: One more step in that direction and you won't know what hit you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ISaidGetOutOfHere.text: Will you finally get out of here?!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_KnownTheft.text: You are wanted here for theft!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_LookingForTroubleAgain.text: Do I have to show you again who is stronger here?

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NeverTouchOurStuffAgain.text: You had better not touch anything here again!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NoFriendOfORC.text: You are no friend of the orcs.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NoFriendOfREB.text: You are no friend of the rebels.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NoMoreTroubleHere.text: Don't cause any more trouble here!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NotEnoughGold.text: You don't have enough gold with you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_NotEnoughLP.text: You don't have the necessary experience!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_PartyDismiss.text: You know where to find me.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_RansackGold_00.text: Gold from a Morra - but at any rate, gold!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_RansackGold_01.text: Look here! The Morra brought gold with him...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_RansackWeapon.text: We never should have allowed you Morras to carry weapons!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_SecondEnclaveCrime.text: More and more of our cities are being reconquered by the Morras!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_SecondMurder.text: We are still looking for the murderer!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_SecondTheft.text: More and more of our people's valuables are disappearing.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_SlaveDismiss.text: You were going to take me away from here...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Smalltalk_03.text: ...it's YOUR honor, you have to decide...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Smalltalk_06.text: ...I'd prefer a decent piece of meat...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Smalltalk_08.text: ...you know exactly where our problems come from...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Smalltalk_09.text: ...the Morras have no honor, that's the way it is...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_SmalltalkRefuse.text: A Morra never interrupts an orc! Remember that!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Smith.text: Orc weapons are still the best weapons around!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Stone.text: Can you lift the stone, Morra?!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_3_00.text: Don't think. Concentrate on just one thing:

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_3_02.text: A good marksman can kill his enemy with a single shot.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Crossbow_3_03.text: Use that shot. You only need the one.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_HeavyArmor_00.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_HeavyArmor_01.text: All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_HeavyArmor_02.text: Not so tightly that you cannot move.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_HeavyArmor_03.text: But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_LightArmor_00.text: You have to tighten it properly. Pull all the laces, strings, and straps nice and tight.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_LightArmor_01.text: But the trick is tightening. Tighten it properly, and it will protect you better!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_SharpenBlade_00.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_SharpenBlade_01.text: Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_SharpenBlade_02.text: That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_00.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_01.text: Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_Teach_StaffMagic_02.text: Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ThatHurt.stageDirection: watching fight, friend took heavy blow

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_TheftRefuse.text: You are a thief! You have no honor! Go!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ThereIsNoFightingHere.text: If anyone does any hitting around here, it will be ME!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ThiefDown.text: Don't you dare try stealing from me again!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ThisTimeYoureLucky.text: I'll let you get away with it this time.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_ThisWayIn.text: We have to go in here...

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_TooFarFromMeetingPoint.text: What are we doing here? Our destination is far away!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WatchTheGuards.text: Don't let the guards catch you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WeatherHot.text: This heat isn't good for an orc!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WhatsThisSupposedToBe.text: Hey! Morra! Why are you sneaking around here?!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WillKillAllSuspects.text: If this doesn't stop, we'll have to kill everyone we don't trust completely.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WillKillSuspect.text: Once we find the guilty party, we'll make short work of them.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_WillTakeNoMoreRisks.text: I am no longer prepared to take a risk!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YesGetLost.stageDirection: angry, calling after, not too loud

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YouBetterShouldHaveList.text: Next time, you will obey, Morra!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YouDareHitMe.text: You DARE to hit me, Morra?

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YouKnowTheAnswer.text: You can answer that question yourself.

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YouLeftTheArena.text: You are out! The fight is over!

SVM_Orc_Old_Calm_YouSureTookSomeTime.text: You were gone a long time...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_AdanosTeacher_00.text: Ice and cold are now your weapons against all that stand in the way of the will of Adanos!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_AdanosTeacher_01.text: Adanos gives you his magic so that you will help to guide the fate of the world.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_AdanosTeacher_02.text: Power means responsibility. Adanos does not give it frivolously.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Alchemist.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_AndNowGetOutOfHere.text: And now, get out of here, Morra!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_AngryRefuse.text: You don't want to cause even more trouble, Morra?!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_ArenaAttack.text: Do you really think you can beat me?

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_BeliarTeacher_01.text: From now on, Beliar's creatures will fight at your side.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_BeliarTeacher_02.text: Beliar does not share his power without a reason. Remember that.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_CertainlyBusy.text: You've still got things to do! I am sure of that!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DieEnemy_00.text: I will smash you to pieces!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DieMonster_00.text: Bah! Even more of the annoying beasts!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DieMonster_01.text: There are even more of the beasts!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DieMonster_02.text: I'll chop that beast to pieces!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DontDisturbMe.text: I need some peace and quiet!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_DontStealAnything.text: Don't make the mistake of stealing anything here!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Drummer.text: Yes! Let the Morras hear our drums!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_IGetYouStill.text: There you are again... come here!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_InnosTeacher_00.text: The fire of Innos burns within you. Incinerate his enemies!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_InnosTeacher_01.text: Innos leads us in the battle against the darkness.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_InnosTeacher_02.text: Innos grants you this power. Remember that when you use it.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_ISaidGetOutOfHere.text: Get out of here or I'll hack you to bits!!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_ISaidWeaponDown.text: Drop your weapon or I'll skin you alive!!!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_LeaveMeAlone.text: You have defeated me, Morra. Now, go!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_LookingForTroubleA.text: You still haven't learned, have you, Morra?

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_MonsterKilled_02.text: There is no honor in this carnage!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_NextTimeYoureInFor.text: I'm not finished with you, Morra!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_NoArmor.text: First, prove to me what you are worth, Morra!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_NotEnoughGold.text: You don't have enough gold with you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_NotEnoughLP.text: You don't have the necessary experience!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_PartyDismiss.text: You know where to find me.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_RansackGold_00.text: Gold from a Morra - but at any rate, gold!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_RansackGold_01.text: Your gold belongs to me now!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_RansackGold_02.text: We will pay the mercenaries with your gold.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_RansackWeapon.text: We never should have allowed you Morras to carry weapons!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Read.text: I'm starting to understand how Morras think!
SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Read.stageDirection: partly to self, partly to player

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_RevolutionHero.text: You have brought us victory, Morra!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_SeeYouLater.text: The time for talking is over!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_SlaveDismiss.text: You were going to take me away from here...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Smalltalk_01.text: ...we have to think before we act...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Smalltalk_05.text: ...the hand that feeds them, the fist that strikes them...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Smalltalk_09.text: ...it was Kan's will, so it must be...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_SmalltalkRefuse.text: Can't you see we're talking, Morra?

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Smith.text: You Morras don't know anything about forging...

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Stone.text: An easy exercise - for an ORC!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_PotionMP_00.text: Ah! Mana potions. Their power develops in their effect.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_PotionMP_01.text: They are a source of pure magic power.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_PotionMP_02.text: There are various recipes for these potions.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_PotionMP_03.text: So get yourself one, find the necessary ingredients, and go for it!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_PotionPerm_0.text: With this knowledge, you'll be able to brew ANY permanent potion.
All you need is a recipe and the required ingredients.
Most ingredients are very rare, so you will be out and about a lot.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Staff_1_00.text: A staff is awfully long. You can use that to keep your opponents at bay.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Staff_1_01.text: If you strike properly, almost no one will have a chance against you.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_00.text: Your opponent will always underestimate a staff. It doesn't seem as dangerous as a sword or an axe.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_01.text: Use that. There are maneuvers that aren't possible with a sword.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_Staff_2_02.text: If you can surprise your opponent, you've almost won.

SVM_Orc_Old_Insidious_Teach_StaffMagic_0.text: Take the staff in your hands and feel its energy.
Probe this energy and bring it into harmony with your spirit.
Only then can you merge the powers of the staff with your own.

All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.
Not so tightly that you cannot move.
But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_01.text: A strong swordfighter doesn't just whack at his opponent.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_02.text: He is aware of his opponent's position. Swing with your body, not just your arm.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_2_03.text: Remember that and use it. Then you'll live longer.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_00.text: Always keep your eye on your opponent.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_01.text: Some blows can be blocked, others can't.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_1H_3_02.text: Recognize the difference. Then you can dodge the blows or even beat your opponent to it.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_00.text: Grip the axe firmly with both hands and make sure that you have a solid stance.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_1_01.text: A couple of strong blows, always at the body, should be enough to knock down any opponent.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_00.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_01.text: For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_02.text: But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_1_03.text: Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_00.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_01.text: Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Crossbow_2_02.text: If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_01.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_02.text: Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_JumpAttack_03.text: That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Hard_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Axe_2_00.text: The axe is a good weapon for breaking through armor.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Axe_2_01.text: You can do a lot of damage and send your opponent to the ground.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_1_0.text: Hold the crossbow by the shaft, press it against your shoulder for a steady aim.
For the first few days, it will feel like your shoulder is ready to fall off.
But after just a week, your shoulder will be like a rock!
Aim at your target and pull. That's it.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Crossbow_2_0.text: Learn to estimate the speed of moving targets.
Shoot in your target's path, then you will hit it and also stop it in its tracks.
If you have several targets, then don't waste any time. Instead, nail them all down with targeted shots and then bring them down one after the other.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_HeavyArmor_0.text: Most people make the mistake of not putting their armor on properly.
All parts of the armor must be firmly connected.
Not so tightly that you cannot move.
But tightly enough so that there are no weak spots left in the armor.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_JumpAttack_0.text: You have to jump at the right time - you should jump at your opponent!
Strike while you are in the air - and with real force.
That way, you deal your opponent a hefty blow!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Mining_01.text: Swing the pickaxe into the rock and start hacking.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Mining_02.text: But use regular strokes. Then you'll get more chunks out of the rock.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_SharpenBlade.text: Go to the whetstone and let it rip.
Slowly draw the blade from left to right, and hone it evenly.
That makes it nice and sharp.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_00.text: The way of the shield is the way of the soldier. Listen:

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_01.text: Your shield is your best friend. So always carry it with you!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_02.text: It will protect you against most attacks - even against arrows!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_1_03.text: Oh, yes, one more thing. The shield does not belong on your weapon arm!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_00.text: Rhobar's army produced a couple of really good shield fighters.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_01.text: A strong shield fighter uses blocking tactics.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_02.text: Strike from cover - then move the shield back to the front!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Shield_2_03.text: But remember - even the best shield won't protect you against attacks from behind!

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_01.text: The principle is the same as in forging weapons.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_02.text: Heat the blank, work it, cool it.

SVM_Orc_Warrior_Proud_Teach_Smith_2_03.text: But of course, a magic ore weapon needs a magic ore blank.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_00.text: In the beginning, the nomads roamed the land.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_01.text: And the Eternal Wanderer led the way.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_02.text: And Innos spoke to the Eternal Wanderer: Lay aside your staff!

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_03.text: And in its stead, Innos gave him the scepter. And the Eternal Wanderer became his servant.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_04.text: And Innos gave him a part of his divine power, so that he might curb the doings of Beliar.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_05.text: And the power was fire. And he controlled it as he saw fit.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_06.text: But some among the nomads would not follow Innos. And the people of the nomads were divided.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_07.text: And those who followed Innos erected great temples, and they became the people of Varant. And the scepter became the token of their rulership.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_08.text: And Innos spoke to his servants: Erect a portal for me, so that I might reign over this world in all eternity!

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_09.text: And his servants did as they were bidden.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_10.text: But when Beliar saw what the servants of Innos were doing, he screamed with rage.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_11.text: And a being of ancient power heeded his call and arose from the earth, and some other great beings arose as well.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_12.text: But the time of the great beings had come to an end. For thus was the will of Adanos.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_13.text: And Adanos called a flood, and the being was washed off the earth.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_14.text: When the servant of Innos realized what was happening, he had the five divine artifacts brought into the temple.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_15.text: And the people of Varant perished, staff and scepter sank down into the waters.

SVM_Player_BookOfFlood_16.text: And Adanos said to his brothers: Never more shall you set foot in my land. For it is sacred. And thus shall it be.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_00.text: The barbarians lived in Nordmar. And Rhobar was one of them.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_01.text: He wandered through the ice without fire or weapons. And the Beast was hunting him.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_02.text: Rhobar hid in a cave, but the Beast tracked him down.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_03.text: And Rhobar felt behind him, and there he found a sword. He took it and killed the beast with ONE stroke.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_04.text: But the sword was surrounded by fire, and Innos was with it.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_05.text: And Innos said to Rhobar: Descend from the mountains, and defeat my enemies.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_06.text: And Rhobar waged war against the orcs. And the wrath of Innos descended upon them. And Rhobar was victorious.

SVM_Player_BookOfRhobar_07.text: Once his enemies were defeated, Innos said to him: This is where you shall establish your kingdom. And Rhobar did as he was bidden.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_00.text: After the first great war, the orcs ruled the kingdom of Myrtana.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_01.text: And the humans were their slaves. But the fighters were their gladiators.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_02.text: One of them was Zuben. And he fought well, for he shared the beliefs of the orcs.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_03.text: And the orcs granted him his freedom. And Zuben wandered south.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_04.text: But on his journey, he found the staff of the Eternal Wanderer, and he took it with him.

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_05.text: And Beliar said to him: Now proceed to the country of the nomads, and establish a realm for me!

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_06.text: And Zuben went to the desert. And there he drove his staff into the ground, and said: This is where I shall build my realm for you!

SVM_Player_BookOfZuben_07.text: And the faith of the orcs became the faith of the humans.

SVM_Player_CantProduce.text: I cannot create anything at the moment!

SVM_Player_Chronicles_00.text: Akascha had orders to hide the last artifact in the temple.

SVM_Player_Chronicles_01.text: And the waters raged, as Akascha looked on. And the temple sank beneath the surface.

SVM_Player_Chronicles_02.text: And Akascha wandered north, until he came to the huge mountain range in eternal ice.

SVM_Player_Chronicles_03.text: And he founded a clan. And it was the Clan of the Fire.

SVM_Rhobar_Teach_MasterGladiator_04.text: Thus, your mind will rule your body. It will bring peace and healing.

SVM_Rhobar_Teach_OrcSlayer_01.text: The orcs are more broadly and powerfully built than we are.

TUT_AfterFight.text: The orcs have been defeated! You can now put your weapon away by pressing the spacebar. Now go to your friends and talk to each one of them. Approach them until their name is displayed, then click the left mouse button.\n\nTalk to Diego, Gorn, and Milten!

TUT_AfterFriends.text: Very good! Next, you should talk to your old buddy Lester. Walk out of the village and follow the path to the left that leads to the coast. There you can find Lester, who will give you more information.\n\nTalk to Lester on the beach!

TUT_AfterLester.text: Great! Now return to Diego and give him Lester's message, and then let the adventure begin!\n\nReport to Diego!

TUT_Bow.text: Hold down the left mouse button in order to draw the bow. The white aiming guide in the middle of the screen shows where your arrow wil land. As soon as you release the left mouse button, the arrow is shot. The longer you hold the mouse button, the farther the arrow will fly.

TUT_Charscreen.text: All attributes and talents of the hero are shown here. Whenever the hero goes up a level, he will receive learning points that can be used with trainers. Any talents already mastered are shown in color. For more information about the various talents, move your mouse pointer over a talent icon.

TUT_Fight.text: Well done! In order to attack an opponent, move up close until his name appears above him. You can then deal out blows by clicking with the left and right mouse buttons. Hold down the right mouse button to parry. When fighting multiple opponents, you can also use the movement keys during an attack in order to hit an opponent to your left or right.\n\nAttack an orc!

TUT_Inventory.text: All items that you pick up appear in your inventory. There are different item categories that you can select in the upper right corner. Left-click on items to use or equip them. To make an item available in the quick slot bar, drag & drop it to one of the slots.

TUT_Maps.text: All smithing blueprints, recipes, alchemical formulas, letters and maps are stored here. To use blueprints, you must find an anvil. For recipes, you need a campfire or cooking stove, an alchemist's bench is needed for alchemical formulas. Letters and maps can be read by moving the mouse pointer over the corresponding icon. Some letters can even start missions - for this, left-click on the letter icon.

TUT_MissionLog.text: This menu shows the hero's missions and the reputation he has gained through successful missions with the various factions and in individual cities.

TUT_Spell.text: Left-click in order to cast the spell. To improve your chance of success, hold down the left mouse button until the spell activates itself.

TUT_Spellbook.text: As soon as the hero has learned a spell, the corresponding icon will appear in color in the book. These icons can then be dragged & dropped into the quick slot bar and used from there. For more information about a spell, move your mouse pointer over the corresponding spell icon.

TUT_Start.text: There's a quick slot bar at the lower edge of the screen. By pressing the corresponding number key, you can use an item or draw a weapon.\n\nPress '1' now to draw your sword.

TUT_Trade.text: Here you can buy goods, sell them, or barter. Simply drag the items you want to buy from the vendor's inventory to the field in the lower left. Drag any items you want to sell or trade to the field in the lower right. If the goods are of equal value, a trade is made. If the values are not equal, you can make up the difference by clicking on 'Gold Balance'.

TUT_Transformation.text: In order to regain your human shape, press ENTER or simply wait until the magical effect wears off.
